en: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and offer your [Rage] to the moon to receive a powerful blessing.
zh: [Shapeshift|变形]为[Werewolf|狼人]，将你的[Rage|怒火]献祭给月神以获得强大赐福。

en: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and let out an icy howl that damages enemies and [Freeze|Freezes] [PrimedFreeze|Primed] enemies. If an enemy is [Frozen] or a [Frozen] enemy is [HitDamage|Hit], this Skill [Empowered|Empowers] your attacks with added [Cold] damage, causes [Empowered] [Slam|Slams] to create [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground], and grants your [Allies] added [Cold] damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].
zh: [Shapeshift|变形]为[Werewolf|狼人]，发出凛冽嚎叫对敌人造成伤害，并[Freeze|冻结]处于[PrimedFreeze|可被冻结]状态的敌人。如果敌人被[Frozen|冻结]或[HitDamage|击中]被[Frozen|冻结]的敌人，此技能将[Empowered|强化]你的攻击，为其附加[Cold|冰霜]伤害，使[Empowered|强化]的[Slam|猛击]产生[ChilledGround|冰缓地面]，同时为[Allies|友军]附加[Cold|冰霜]伤害。消耗一个[Charges|耐力球]可以跳过此技能的冷却时间。

en: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and let out an icy howl.
Teleport to a target, dealing [Lightning] [Attack] Damage.
zh: 传送到目标位置，造成[Lightning|闪电][Attack|攻击]伤害。

en: Explodes to deal [Cold] Damage in an area after a short delay, based on the life of the slain frozen Enemy.
zh: 短暂延迟后爆炸，依据被击败的冻结敌人的生命在区域内造成[Cold|冰霜]伤害。

en: Pull enemies in and pulse [Lightning] damage, [Hinder|Hindering] enemies [HitDamage|Hit]. Each pulse increases in damage, with the final pulse dealing additional damage.
zh: 将敌人吸入并脉冲式释放[Lightning|闪电]伤害，对被[HitDamage|击中]的敌人施加[Hinder|缓速]效果。每次脉冲伤害逐次增强，最终脉冲将造成额外伤害。

en: Deal [Fire] Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the [Consume|Consumed] [Ignite].
zh: 根据[Consume|消耗]的[Ignite|点燃]效果的预期伤害，在区域内造成一定比例的[Fire|火焰]伤害。

en: Deal [Fire] Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the [Consume|Consumed] [Ignite].
zh: 根据[Consume|消耗]的[Ignite|点燃]效果的预期伤害，在区域内造成一定比例的[Fire|火焰]伤害。

en: Creates multiple Fissures when landing with Supported Skill.
zh: 使被辅助技能落地时产生多道裂缝。

en: Deals [Fire] damage in an area around the exploding [Corpse] based on its maximum Life.
zh: 根据爆炸的[Corpse|灵柩]生命上限，在其周围区域造成[Fire|火焰]伤害。

en: Creates Skittering Stone [Minion|Minions] from shattered objects created by Supported Skill.
zh: 从被辅助技能粉碎的物体中产生飞掠石[Minion|召唤生物]。

en: Hurl a fiery hammer that [Slam|Slams] into the ground and lodges there. While the hammer is lodged in the ground, reusing this Skill recalls the hammer and resets the Skill's cooldown. Alternatively, using a [Warcry] near the lodged hammer causes it to shatter, releasing a number of [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures] in a spiral.
zh: 投掷一把烈焰之锤，[Slam|猛击]并嵌入地面。当锤子嵌在地面时，再次使用此技能会召回锤子并重置技能的冷却时间。或者，在嵌入的锤子附近使用[Warcry|战吼]会使其粉碎，以螺旋形释放多道[MoltenFissure|熔岩裂缝]。

en: Hurl a fiery hammer that shatters into [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures] when you use a [Warcry].
zh: 投掷一把烈焰之锤，当你使用[Warcry|战吼]时会粉碎成[MoltenFissure|熔岩裂缝]。

en: While active, the first time any Skill [HitDamage|Hits] a [Shock|Shocked] enemy in your [Presence], that Skill also [HitDamage|Hits] other [Shock|Shocked] enemies in your [Presence], up to a maximum.
zh: 激活时，当你的任何技能首次[HitDamage|击中][Presence|在场]范围内的[Shock|感电]敌人时，该技能也会[HitDamage|击中]你[Presence|在场]范围内的其他[Shock|感电]敌人（存在上限）。

en: Skills [HitDamage|Hitting] [Shock|Shocked] enemies in your [Presence] also [HitDamage|Hit] other [Shock|Shocked] enemies in your [Presence], up to a maximum.
zh: [HitDamage|击中]你[Presence|在场]范围内[Shock|感电]敌人的技能也会[HitDamage|击中]你[Presence|在场]范围内的其他[Shock|感电]敌人（存在上限）。

en: Consume stored [Minion] Life to [Reviving|Revive] your [Minion|Minions]. [Reviving|Revives] as many [Minion|Minions] as possible with total maximum Life equal to or less than the Life stored by Grim Feast, prioritising those with higher maximum Life.
zh: 消耗储存的[Minion|召唤生物]生命以[Reviving|复活]你的[Minion|召唤生物]。最多[Reviving|复活]生命总和不超过饕餮飨宴所储存的生命的[Minion|召唤生物]，优先复活生命上限更高者。

en: Consume stored Life from [Minion] deaths to [Reviving|Revive Minions].
zh: 消耗由[Minion|召唤生物]被击败时所储存的生命以[Reviving|复活召唤生物]。

en: [Empowered|Empowers] the next [Projectile] Skill you use, causing it to create additional [Projectile|Projectiles] and fly faster.
zh: [Empowered|强化]你下一次使用的[Projectile|投射物]技能，使其创造额外的[Projectile|投射物]并飞行得更快。

en: Summon an untargetable Lightless Stalker [Minion] which blasts enemies with malefic visions, [Hinder|Hindering] their movement. Enemies that die while affected by the visions, or [Rarity|Rare] and [Rarity|Unique] enemies hit by you or your [Minion|Minions], spawn Foul Eye [Minion|Minions] which last for a duration or until killed.
zh: 召唤一个无法被攻击的暗光潜行者[Minion|召唤生物]，用邪恶幻象轰击敌人，[Hinder|缓速]其移动。受到幻象影响时被击败的敌人，或被你或你的[Minion|召唤生物]击中的[Rarity|稀有]和[Rarity|传奇]敌人，会生成邪眼[Minion|召唤生物]，持续一段时间或直到被击败。

en: Create an area of Toxic Bloom on the ground around you. While in the Bloom, you have increased Skill costs, Regenerate Life, and your [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] attach a Toxic Pustule, which can be [Poison|Poisoned]. Pustules will [DetonationTime|Detonate] after a duration or when enough [Poison] has been applied, dealing more damage based on the stored [Poison] damage and applying [Poison] in an area around it.
zh: 在你周围的地面上产生剧毒花群区域。位于花群范围时，你的技能消耗提高，可以再生生命，并且[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击]会附着一个可以造成[Poison|中毒]的剧毒芽孢。芽孢会在持续一段时间后或施加足够[Poison|中毒]时[DetonationTime|引爆]，根据积蓄的[Poison|中毒]伤害在其周围区域造成伤害并施加[Poison|中毒]。

en: Create an area of Toxic Bloom that regenerates Life and enhances your [Projectile] Skills with deadly [Poison|Poisonous] pustules.
zh: 产生剧毒花群区域，再生生命并用致命的[Poison|剧毒]芽孢强化你的[Projectile|投射物]技能。

en: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you cast [Spell|Spells]. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to trigger socketed [Spell|Spells], and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough [Energy].
zh: 激活时，当你对敌人施放[Spell|法术]时都会获得[Energy|能量]。积累一定的[Energy|能量]后再次使用该咒祈，即可消耗[Energy|能量]并触发镶嵌的[Spell|法术]。[Energy|能量]足够时可以多次触发。

en: Ready your active [Bow] or [Spear], [Empowered|Empowering] your next [Repeat|Repeatable] [Bow] or [Projectile] [Spear] [Attack|Attacks] to [Conversion|Convert] [Physical] Damage to [Cold] Damage and [Trigger] [IceFragment|Ice Fragments] on [HitDamage|Hit]. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a [Charges|Frenzy Charge]. Cannot [Empowered|Empower] [Sustained] Skills.
zh: 准备好你激活的[Bow|弓类]武器或[Spear|战矛]，[Empowered|强化]你的下一个[Repeat|可重复]的[Bow|弓类]武器或[Projectile|投射物]类[Spear|战矛]的[Attack|攻击]，将[Physical|物理]伤害[Conversion|转化]为[Cold|冰霜]伤害，并在[HitDamage|击中]时[Trigger|触发][IceFragment|冰霜碎片]。消耗一个[Charges|狂怒球]可重置技能冷却时间。无法[Empowered|强化][Sustained|持续性]技能。

en: [Empowered|Empower] your next [Bow] or [Projectile] [Spear] [Attack] to [Conversion|Convert] [Physical] damage and create [IceFragment|Ice Fragments].
zh: [Empowered|强化]你的下一次可连射的[Bow|弓类]武器或[Projectile|投射物]类[Spear|战矛]的[Attack|攻击]，将[Conversion|转化][Physical|物理]伤害并产生[IceFragment|冰霜碎片]。

en: When you [HitDamage|Hit] with [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed] [Melee] [Attack|Attacks], calls down lightning bolts which deal [UnarmedDamage|Unarmed] [Attack|Attack] damage to all surrounding enemies.
zh: 当你用[UnarmedAttack|徒手][Melee|近战][Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]时，召唤闪电箭对所有周围敌人造成[UnarmedDamage|徒手][Attack|攻击]伤害。

en: When you [HitDamage|Hit] with [Unarmed] [Melee] [Attack|Attacks], projects icy wind which deal [Unarmed] [Attack|Attack] damage to all surrounding enemies and destroy [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals].
zh: 当你使用[Unarmed|徒手][Melee|近战][Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]时，会投射出冰寒霜风，对周围所有敌人造成[Unarmed|徒手][Attack|攻击]伤害，并摧毁[IceCrystals|冰晶]。

en: Direct your flying companion to eviscerate another player's pet.
zh: 指示你的飞行伙伴撕碎另一名玩家的宠物。

en: Direct your flying companion to eviscerate another player's pet.
zh: 指示你的飞行伙伴撕碎另一名玩家的宠物。

en: Hinekora observes your Future-Past granting you the opportunity to subvert a lesser fate. After a period of Hindsight, she will grant you her Foresight, which prevents you from avoiding Hits while Dodge Rolling. When you are Hit while Dodge Rolling, Hinekora restores you to full Life immediately before taking damage from the Hit, and grants you Sight Beyond Sight, which prevents you from dying.
zh: 辛格拉观察你未来的过去，给予你小幅颠覆命运的机会。经过一段事件的后见之明后，她会给予你先见之明，使你在闪避翻滚时无法避免击中。当你在闪避翻滚期间被击中时，辛格拉会在你受到击中伤害前立即将你恢复到满血，并给予你超越视线，使你不会被击败。

en: [Channelling|Channel] to imbue your armour with Runic Plates. When you are [HitDamage|Hit] while you have these plates, some of the damage you would take will be prevented, and this skill will cause backlash, dealing your [Thorns] damage in an area around your attacker.
zh: [Channelling|持续吟唱]为你的护甲注入符文嵌板。当你拥有这些符文嵌板并受到[HitDamage|击中]时，此技能会产生反冲，对攻击者周围区域造成你的[Thorns|荆棘]伤害。

en: [Channelling|Channel] to imbue your armour with runic plates.
zh: [Channelling|持续吟唱]为你的护甲注入符文嵌板。

en: Explodes and deals [Chaos] Damage when an Enemy enters the area, applying the supported [Curse] on [HitDamage|Hit].
zh: 当敌人进入区域时爆炸，并造成[Chaos|混沌]伤害，[HitDamage|击中]时施加被辅助的[Curse|诅咒]。

en: Explodes to deal [Chaos] Damage and apply [Curse] on [HitDamage|Hit].
zh: 爆炸造成[Chaos|混沌]伤害，并[HitDamage|击中]时施加[Curse|诅咒]。

en: [Command] a Skeletal Frost Mage to target a location or [Minion] and apply Ice Armour to [Minion|Minions] in an area, reducing damage taken from [HitDamage|Hits], causing damage to enemies that [HitDamage|Hit] them, and counting as [Freeze|Frozen] for other effects.
zh: [Command|命令]一个魔侍冰霜法师以一个位置或[Minion|召唤生物]为目标，对区域内的[Minion|召唤生物]施加护甲，减少来自[HitDamage|击中]的伤害，对[HitDamage|击中]它们的敌人造成伤害，并被其他效果视为[Freeze|被冻结]。

en: [Command] a Skeletal Frost Mage to shield [Minion|Minions] in an area with a damaging Ice Armour.
zh: [Command|命令]一个魔侍冰霜法师为区域内的[Minion|召唤生物]提供伤害性冰霜护甲。

en: While active, has a chance to create an [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] [Remnant] when you [Freeze], [Shock] or [Ignite] a target.
zh: 激活时，当你[Freeze|冻结]、[Shock|感电]或[Ignite|点燃]目标时有几率产生一个[ElementalInfusion|灌注][Remnant|残片]。

en: [Command] a Skeletal Brute to use a [Warcry], [Intimidate|Intimidating] nearby enemies and [Consume|Consuming] [Freeze] on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.
zh: [Command|命令]一个魔侍蛮兵使用[Warcry|战吼]，[Intimidate|威吓]附近敌人并[Consume|消耗]敌人和友军身上的[Freeze|冻结]，在其周围区域造成伤害。

en: [Command] a Skeletal Brute to use a [Warcry], [Intimidate|Intimidating] enemies and [Consume|Consuming] [Freeze] on allies and enemies.
zh: [Command|命令]一个魔侍蛮兵使用[Warcry|战吼]，[Intimidate|威吓]敌人并[Consume|消耗]友军和敌人身上的[Freeze|冻结]。

en: Conjures a number of icy [Projectile|Projectiles] that launch towards the target. [Projectile|Projectiles] that [HitDamage|Hit] a [Chill|Chilled] or [Frozen] target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. [Consume|Consumes] a [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to cause each [Projectile] to lodge into the enemy then explode.
zh: 召唤多个冰霜[Projectile|投射物]向目标发射。[HitDamage|击中][Chill|冰缓]或[Frozen|冻结]目标的[Projectile|投射物]会产生冰块，撞击地面时造成额外伤害。尽量[Consume|消耗]一次[Cold|冰霜][ElementalInfusion|灌注]，使每个[Projectile|投射物]嵌入敌人然后爆炸。

en: Conjures icy [Projectile|Projectiles] that create damaging ice chunks against [Chill|Chilled] or [Frozen] enemies.
zh: 召唤冰霜[Projectile|投射物]，对[Chill|冰缓]或[Frozen|冰冻]敌人产生伤害性冰块。

en: An arc of [Lightning|Lightning] stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and [Chain|Chains] on to other nearby enemies. [Consume|Consumes] a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to deal more damage and [Chain] further.
zh: 一道[Lightning|闪电]之弧从施法者射向目标敌人，并[Chain|连锁]到其他附近敌人。尽量[Consume|消耗]一次[Lightning|闪电][ElementalInfusion|灌注]，造成更多伤害并[Chain|连锁]到更远的敌人身上。

en: Conjure Abyssal spirits to [Hinder] a [Rarity|Rare] [MonsterCategory|Undead] for a duration. If you defeat the [MonsterCategory|Undead] while it is [Hinder|Hindered], it will be captured and stored into a Soul Crystal Skill Gem. The Soul Crystal will allow a wielder of great Abyssal power to summon the bound [MonsterCategory|Undead] as a [Reviving] [Companion].
zh: 召唤深渊之灵持续使一个[Rarity|稀有][MonsterCategory|亡灵][Hinder|缓速]。若你在该[MonsterCategory|亡灵]被[Hinder|缓速]期间将其击败，它将被捕获并封存于一颗灵魂水晶技能宝石中。这颗灵魂水晶的持有者，若拥有强大的深渊力量，即可召唤被束缚的[MonsterCategory|亡灵]作为[Reviving|可复活的][Companion|伙伴]。

en: [Hinder] a [Rarity|Rare] [MonsterCategory|Undead] with Abyssal spirits to bind it on death.
zh: 用深渊之灵使一个[Rarity|稀有][MonsterCategory|亡灵][Hinder|缓速]，在其死亡时将其束缚。

en: Summon a [Reviving] [MonsterCategory|Undead] [Companion] to aid you in combat.
zh: 召唤一个[Reviving|可复活的][MonsterCategory|亡灵][Companion|伙伴]协助你作战。

en: Consume a [Charges|Power Charge] when you cast a damaging [Spell] to trigger an Abyssal Apparition who will also cast that same [Spell] for you. Does not work with [Channelling] Spells, Spells with a Cooldown, [Trigger|Triggered] Spells, Spells granted by items, or Spells which already consume a [Charges|Power Charge]. This Skill is not directly Supportable.
zh: 当你施放一个伤害性的[Spell|法术]时，消耗一个[Charges|暴击球]触发一个深渊幻象，深渊幻象会和你施放同样的[Spell|法术]。无法施放[Channelling|持续吟唱]法术、具有冷却时间的法术、[Trigger|触发]法术、物品赋予的法术或已消耗一个[Charges|暴击球]的法术。此技能无法直接辅助。

en: Creates spreading [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground] around [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] created by Supported Skills.
zh: 在被辅助技能创造的[IceCrystals|冰晶]周围，生成蔓延的[ChilledGround|冰缓地面]。

en: Whack another exile with your severed arm.
zh: 用你的断臂猛击其他流放者。

en: Whack another exile with your severed arm.
zh: 用你的断臂猛击其他流放者。

en: While active, a portion of the [Physical] [Attack] damage you deal is stored. Casting a [Spell] uses the stored damage to create a patch of [ThornyGround|Thorny Ground] that deals [Spell] damage to moving enemies.
zh: 激活时，你造成的[Physical|物理][Attack|攻击]伤害的一部分会被存储。施放[Spell|法术]会消耗存储的伤害来创建一片[ThornyGround|荆棘地面]，对在其上移动的敌人造成[Spell|法术]伤害。
激活时，你持续生成[Rage|怒火]。

en: Enter a bestial frenzy but constantly lose Life.
zh: 进入兽性狂乱状态，但不断失去生命。

en: While active, your Fury builds from [Attack|Attacking] enemies. Using this Skill releases your Fury to send you into a bestial frenzy, gaining damage and [Onslaught] but constantly losing life and forcing you into animal form. The frenzy ends immediately if you return to human form. You cannot gain Fury while in a frenzy.
zh: 激活时，[Attack|攻击]敌人可积累狂怒值。使用此技能将释放狂怒，进入兽性狂乱状态，获得伤害加成与[Onslaught|猛攻]效果，但会持续流失生命，并强制你保持动物形态。若变回人形，狂乱状态将立即结束。在狂乱状态下无法继续积累狂怒值。

en: This skill is [Trigger|Triggered] when Predator's Mark [MarkActivate|Activates] to Summon a Wolf [Minion] that follows you as long as it lives.
zh: 当掠食者印记[MarkActivate|激活]时，此技能将被[Trigger|触发]，召唤一只狼类[Minion|召唤生物]。只要该狼存活，它就会一直跟随你。

en: Build [Glory] by gaining [Rage] while already at maximum [Rage]. When you have maximum [Glory], roar to the heavens to bring them down upon your enemies. For the duration of the Skill, meteors rain down around you and you [Gain] [Fire] damage and [Rage] regeneration. This Skill's effects are suppressed if you leave [Bear] form, but will resume if you return to [Bear] form before the duration expires.
zh: 在[Rage|怒火]达到上限时继续获取[Rage|怒火]可积攒[Glory|荣耀]。当[Glory|荣耀]达到上限时，向天怒吼引动天罚攻击敌人。技能持续期间，陨石将环绕你坠落，使你[Gain|获得][Fire|火焰]伤害加成和[Rage|怒火]回复。若你脱离[Bear|巨熊]形态，此技能效果将被中止；但在持续时间内重新变为[Bear|巨熊形态]，效果将继续。

en: Build [Glory] in [Bear] form, then call down meteors around you for a sustained duration.
zh: 在[Bear|巨熊形态]下积攒[Glory|荣耀]，随后在持续时间内唤来环绕自身的陨石。

en: Leash the stars themselves by leveraging your vast magical power, repeatedly [Trigger|Triggering] Starfall targeting an enemy in an area around you, or a random location in that area if no enemies can be targeted.
zh: 利用你浩瀚的魔法力量牵引星辰本身，在你周围区域内反复[Trigger|触发]星陨，若区域内无敌人可锁定，则改为随机位置。

en: Call to the stars using sheer magical power to rain down Verisium comets around you.
zh: 凭借纯粹的魔法力量向星辰呼唤，使维金彗星如雨般降临在你周围。

en: A star falls at a targeted location, dealing area damage on impact. Larger stars leave [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground] for a short duration.
zh: 一颗星辰坠落在目标地点，撞击时造成范围伤害。较大的星辰会短暂留下[ChilledGround|冰缓地面]。

en: Build [Glory] by [HitDamage|Hitting] enemies with [ElementalDamage|Elemental] damage. When you have maximum [Glory], you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, [Trigger|Triggering] one of multiple powerful [ElementalDamage|Elemental] Skills at an interval while this [Buff] lasts.
zh: 通过[ElementalDamage|元素]伤害[HitDamage|击中]敌人来积攒[Glory|荣耀]。当[Glory|荣耀]达到上限时，你可在一段时间内化身为行走的天灾。该[Buff|增益状态]持续期间将间歇性随机[Trigger|触发]多种强力[ElementalDamage|元素]技能之一。

en: Build [Glory] and become a walking Apocalypse, wielding the [ElementalDamage|Elements] themselves against your enemies.
zh: 积攒[Glory|荣耀]并化身为行走的天灾，将[ElementalDamage|元素]之力本身作为武器挥向你的敌人。

en: Targets an area or an enemy, calling down a massive meteor to strike an area, dealing [Fire] damage and contributing to your enemies' extinction.
zh: 瞄准一个区域或敌人，召唤巨型陨石轰击目标区域，造成[Fire|火焰]伤害并加速敌人的灭亡。
召唤强力陨石轰击目标。

en: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a series of icy hailstones to rain down in an area over a duration.
zh: 瞄准一个区域或敌人，在持续时间内召唤一连串冷冽冰雹倾泻于目标区域。

en: Rain down a series of icy hailstones in an area to deal significant [Cold] damage.
zh: 在区域内降下连续冰雹，造成大量[Cold|冰霜]伤害。

en: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a rapid buildup of pulsing [Lightning] damage in an area that culminates in a powerful final [Lightning] strike.
zh: 瞄准一个区域或敌人，在目标地点引发急速积聚的[Lightning|闪电]脉冲伤害，最终以一道强力的终结[Lightning|闪电]打击收尾。

en: Unleash a series of pulses, culminating in a powerful [Lightning] strike.
zh: 释放一连串脉冲，最终以强力[Lightning|闪电]打击收尾。

en: Spawn a verdant flower that grows and explodes.
zh: 召唤一株翠绿的花朵，其将持续生长并爆炸。

en: Causes a fiery explosion in a cone behind the target, dealing [Attack] damage which is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]
zh: 在目标身后引发一道锥形火焰爆炸，造成[Attack|攻击]伤害。此伤害不基于你的[MartialWeapon|武器]。

en: Sends a [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] [Projectile] from the [Shock|Shocked] enemy towards a nearby Drenched enemy, dealing [Spell] damage.
zh: 从[Shock|感电]敌人处，向附近被浸湿的敌人发射一枚[Chain|连锁][Lightning|闪电][Projectile|投射物]，造成[Spell|法术]伤害。

en: Mirrors of Refraction appear in your [Presence] periodically. [HitDamage|Hitting] a mirror with a [Spell] [Projectile] causes it to shatter, copying the projectiles in a nova around the destroyed mirror. Copied [Projectile|Projectiles] may be copied again when colliding with other mirrors.
zh: 折射之镜会周期性在你[Presence|在场]时生成。使用[Spell|法术][Projectile|投射物][HitDamage|击中]镜子会使其碎裂，并在破碎的镜子周围呈新星状复制这些投射物。被复制的[Projectile|投射物]在接触到其他镜子时可能被再次复制。

en: While active, taking [HitDamage|Hit] damage from enemies to your [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] causes you to gain [Armour] for a short duration. [Armour] gained from multiple [HitDamage|Hits] can stack. The total [Armour] gained from this Skill cannot exceed the [ItemArmour|Item Armour] on your [EquipArmour|Equipped Armour Items].
zh: 激活时，敌人的[HitDamage|击中]伤害若作用于你的[EnergyShield|能量护盾]，将使你在短期内获得[Armour|护甲]。多次[HitDamage|击中]获得的[Armour|护甲]效果可以叠加。通过此技能获得的总[Armour|护甲]值不得超过你[EquipArmour|已装备护甲物品]的[ItemArmour|物品护甲]总和。

en: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you spend Mana. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to create visages which attack once with a socketed [Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] [Attack], creating multiple visages if it has enough [Energy].
zh: 激活时，消耗魔力时可获得[Energy|能量]。当积攒了足够的[Energy|能量]后使用此召唤技能，将消耗[Energy|能量]来创建幻影，这些幻影会使用已镶嵌的[Shapeshift|变形][Attack|攻击]技能发动一次攻击。若[Energy|能量]充足，则可创建多个幻影。

en: Attach a Toxic Pustule to the enemy, which [DetonationTime|Detonates] after a delay, dealing [Attack] damage. They can also be [Poison|Poisoned], causing them to [DetonationTime|Detonate] faster and more violently.
zh: 将一个剧毒芽孢附着在敌人身上，其将在短暂延迟后[DetonationTime|引爆]，造成[Attack|攻击]伤害。芽孢也可被施加[Poison|中毒]状态，这会使其更快[DetonationTime|引爆]且威力更猛。

en: Creates a deadly slash towards the target, dealing [Attack] damage which is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]
zh: 向目标发起一次致命劈砍，造成[Attack|攻击]伤害。此伤害不基于你的[MartialWeapon|武器]。

en: Build [Glory] by dealing [Chaos] damage to enemies. When you have maximum [Glory], you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his [Archon].
zh: 通过对敌人造成[Chaos|混沌]伤害来积累[Glory|荣耀]。当你拥有满[Glory|荣耀]时，可以祈求幻梦者附身于你，短暂化身为他的[Archon|执政官]。

en: You are chosen by Azmerian spirits who provide guidance, allowing you to see nearby [AncientBlooms|Ancient Blooms].
zh: 你被阿兹莫里万灵选中，它们指引着你，使你能够看见附近的[AncientBlooms|远古之花]。

en: Azmerian spirits offer guidance, allowing you to see nearby [AncientBlooms|Ancient Blooms].
zh: 阿兹莫里万灵指引着你，使你能够看见附近的[AncientBlooms|远古之花]。

en: Leap into the air carried by divine wings, damaging enemies with your spear where you land. If there is a [DivineFragment|Fragment of Divinity] near you or the targeted location, this attack will [Consume] it when you leap to become [Empowered], dealing more damage and granting life and mana recovery. This skill does not use up its Cooldown when empowered.
zh: 挥动神圣之翼跃入空中，以长矛重击落地处的敌人。若你附近或目标位置存在[DivineFragment|神圣碎片]，此次跳跃将[Consume|消耗]该碎片并获得[Empowered|强化]，造成更多伤害并回复生命与魔力。此技能在强化状态下不消耗其冷却时间。

en: Leap into the air carried by divinity, damaging enemies with your spear where you land.
zh: 挥动神圣之翼跃入空中，以长矛重击落地处的敌人。

en: Build up Glory by [Freeze|Freezing] or [Chill|Chilling] enemies. When you have maximum [Glory] you may jump backwards loosing your [Mace] with the force of a falling comet onto your target. The impact releases [MoltenFissure|Fissures] and causes stars to fall in the area for a brief period.
zh: 通过[Freeze|冰冻]或[Chill|冰缓]敌人来积攒[Glory|荣耀]。后跃并将[Mace|锤类]武器奋力掷出，锤类武器会在抵达目标地点时爆炸，释放出[MoltenFissure|熔岩裂缝]，并使流星短暂地坠落于该区域。

en: Build [Glory], then loose your [Mace] like a comet to create fissures and call down the stars on your enemies.
zh: 积攒[Glory|荣耀]。将[Mace|锤类]武器如彗星般掷出，创造裂缝，召唤流星坠落于敌人之上。

en: While active, summons short-lived Azmerian Swarms when you kill enemies affected by [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] or hit [Rarity|Rare or Unique] enemies affected by [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments]. The swarms are untargetable [Minion|Minions] that pursue nearby enemies to [Attack] them and infict [FaerieFire|Faerie Fire] on [HitDamage|Hit].
zh: 激活状态下，当你击杀受到[ElementalAilments|元素异常状态]影响的敌人，或击中受到[ElementalAilments|元素异常状态]影响的[Rarity|稀有或传奇]敌人时，会召唤出短暂的阿兹莫里虫群。这些虫群是无法被选中的[Minion|召唤生物]，会追击附近的敌人，对它们发动[Attack|攻击]，并在[HitDamage|击中]时施加[FaerieFire|仙灵之火]。

en: Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and [Rarity|Rare] or [Rarity|Unique] enemies you [HitDamage|Hit], turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.
zh: 从你击杀的敌人以及你[HitDamage|击中]的[Rarity|稀有]或[Rarity|传奇]敌人身上，汲取其潜藏的恐惧，将其转化为不稳定幽影，幽影会冲向敌人并爆炸。

en: The Flock damages enemies around you.
zh: 召唤鸟群伤害周围的敌人。

en: Hurl your [Shield] as a [Projectile] which [Return|Returns] to you at the end of its flight. While the [Shield] is in flight, this skill is replaced with Embrace the Fall. This skill's cooldown is skipped if you catch the [Shield] as it [Return|Returns], or destroy an [IceCrystals|Ice Crystal] with the Embrace the Fall.
zh: 将你的[Shield|盾牌]作为[Projectile|投射物]掷出，飞行结束后会[Return|返回]你身边。在[Shield|盾牌]处于飞行状态时，此技能会被天陨之拥替代。若你接住[Return|返回]的[Shield|盾牌]，或使用天陨之拥摧毁一个[IceCrystals|冰晶]，则重置该技能的冷却时间。

en: Hurl your [Shield] outward which [Return|Returns] at the end of its flight.
zh: 投掷你的[Shield|盾牌]，飞行结束后会[Return|返回]你身边。

en: Teleport to your thrown [Shield], appearing in the air and [Slam|Slamming] it into the ground to deal damage in an area. Destroying an [IceCrystals|Ice Crystal] with this skill skips the cooldown of Soaring Midnight.
zh: 传送至你掷出的[Shield|盾牌]处，凌空现身并向下[Slam|猛击]地面，造成范围伤害。用此技能摧毁一个[IceCrystals|冰晶]则重置午夜翱翔的冷却时间。

en: To teleport to your [Shield] and perform a flying shield [Slam].
zh: 传送至你的[Shield|盾牌]处，并施展凌空盾牌[Slam|猛击]。

en: Conjure a [Chaos] tornado that chases down and [Slow|Slows] enemies.
zh: 召唤一个[Chaos|混沌]龙卷风，追踪并[Slow|减速]敌人。

en: Summons a [Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] Spirit Vessel [Companion] that uses copies of socketed [Bear], [Werewolf], and [Wyvern] Skills.
zh: 召唤一个会[Shapeshift|变形]的灵魂容器[Companion|伙伴]，它会复制并使用已镶嵌的[Bear|巨熊]、[Werewolf|狼人]和[Wyvern|双足飞龙]技能。

en: Direct your feline companion to mesmerize another player's pet.
zh: 命令你的猫咪伙伴去魅惑另一名玩家的宠物。

en: Direct your feline companion to mesmerize another player's pet.
zh: 命令你的猫咪伙伴去魅惑另一名玩家的宠物。

en: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them, [CullingStrike|Culling] enemies if their life is low enough. When this skill kills an enemy you draw out their final fears, crushing them to create a shockwave. Enemies around you that can be [CullingStrike|Culled] will be highlighted.
zh: 向一名敌人冲刺并发起[Strike|打击]，若其生命值过低则直接将其[CullingStrike|终结]。当此技能击杀敌人时，你会将其临死前的恐惧抽离并粉碎，从而制造出一道冲击波。周围可被[CullingStrike|终结]的敌人将被高亮显示。

en: Dash to an enemy and kill near-death enemies to draw out their final fears.
zh: 向一名敌人冲刺，击败生命值过低的敌人，将其临死前的恐惧抽离。

en: While active, [Critical] [HitDamage|Hits] with other skills that kill targets, or hit powerful targets cause you to gain Arctic Petals. Once you have enough Arctic Petals they will be [Consume|Consumed] to create [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] near the most recent target.
zh: 激活时，使用其他技能造成[Critical|暴击][HitDamage|击中]造成击杀，或击中强大目标，你将获得极寒花瓣。积聚足够数量的极寒花瓣后，它们会被[Consume|消耗]，并在最近目标所在位置生成一个[IceCrystals|冰晶]。

en: While active, conjures a glittering barrier that accumulates protective gemstone Motes of each [Attributes|Attribute] type over time, but loses a random Mote when you are [HitDamage|Hit].
zh: 激活时，召唤一面闪烁的屏障，随时间积累每种[Attributes|属性]类型的保护性宝石尘埃，但当你被[HitDamage|击中]时会失去一个随机尘埃。

en: Explodes a Witchtoad to deal spell damage in an area.
zh: 引爆一只女巫蟾蜍，造成范围法术伤害。

en: While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful [Spell] damage boost but constantly drains your [Ward|Runic Ward]. Running out of [Ward|Runic Ward] causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.
zh: 激活时，会揭示你附近强烈的符文能量区域。站立其上可让你获得强大的[Spell|法术]伤害加成，但会持续消耗你的[Ward|符文结界]。符文结界耗尽会导致能量消散。

en: Unleash a wave of volatile ice that feeds on flames. While the wave doesn't deal damage, the ice latches onto [Ignite|Ignited] enemies, refreshing the duration of their active [Ignite] and rapidly [Freeze|Freezing] them but preventing them from being [Ignite|Ignited] further until the [Ignite] expires.
zh: 释放一波不稳定的冰霜，以火焰为食。此波动本身不造成伤害，但冰霜会附着于[Ignite|点燃]的敌人，刷新其当前[Ignite|点燃]的持续时间并快速[Freeze|冻结]它们，同时阻止其在本次[Ignite|点燃]结束前被再次[Ignite|点燃]。

en: Unleash a wave of volatile ice that causes rapid [Freeze] buildup on [Ignite|Ignited] enemies.
zh: 释放一波不稳定的冰霜，对[Ignite|点燃]的敌人造成[Freeze|冻结]积蓄快速增加。

en: Sacrifice your [Ward|Runic Ward] to send out an energy pulse that grants nearby [Allies] [Guard].
zh: 献祭你的[Ward|符文结界]，释放一道能量脉冲，为附近的[Allies|友军]提供[Guard|防卫]。

en: Sacrifice your [Ward|Runic Ward] to grant nearby [Allies] [Guard].
zh: 献祭你的[Ward|符文结界]，为附近的[Allies|友军]提供[Guard|防卫]。

en: Fires molten [Projectile|Projectiles] from the enemy hit, which will explode when they land nearby, dealing [Attack] damage in an area.
zh: 从被击中的敌人身上发射熔融[Projectile|投射物]，投射物落在附近时会爆炸，对范围内造成[Attack|攻击]伤害。

en: Spends [Ward] to generate [VerisiumInfusion|Verisium Infusions], which can be used in place of any [ElementalInfusion|Elemental Infusions].
zh: 消耗[Ward|符文结界]以生成[VerisiumInfusion|维金灌注]，该灌注可用于替代任意[ElementalInfusion|元素灌注]。

en: Generate [VerisiumInfusion|Verisium Infusions], which can be used in place of any [ElementalInfusion|Elemental Infusion].
zh: 生成[VerisiumInfusion|维金灌注]，可用于替代任意[ElementalInfusion|元素灌注]。

en: Spends all your [Ward] to gain a short-duration [Buff] that causes you to [Block] all [Block|Blockable] [HitDamage|Hits] and apply [ParriedDebuff|Parried] to enemies from which you've [Block|Blocked] a [HitDamage|Hit]. This [Buff] is removed if you are [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned]. While this [Buff] is active, you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned], but [Block|Blocking] too much damage may [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] you.
zh: 消耗所有[Ward|符文结界]以获得一个短时[Buff|增益]状态，使你能够[Block|格挡]所有[Block|可格挡]的[HitDamage|击中]，并对你已[Block|格挡]其[HitDamage|击中]的敌人施加[ParriedDebuff|被招架减益]状态。若你被[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]，此[Buff|增益]状态将被移除。当此[Buff|增益]状态激活时，你无法被[LightStun|轻度晕眩]，但[Block|格挡]过多伤害可能会使你[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]。

en: Gain a [Buff] that causes you to [Block] [HitDamage|Hits] and apply [ParriedDebuff|Parried] to enemies you [Block].
zh: 获得[Buff|增益]状态，使你能够[Block|格挡][HitDamage|击中]，并对你已[Block|格挡]的敌人施加[ParriedDebuff|被招架]减益状态。

en: Target an area and [Curse] enemies within with a Verisium Rune, inflicting them with Fragility. [HitDamage|Hitting] these enemies causes the [Curse] to [Trigger] an explosion to deal damage in an area and apply significant [Knockback] to other enemies near the [Curse|Cursed] target, with more [Stun] buildup based on the Fragility on the target [HitDamage|Hit].
zh: 选定一片区域，用维金符文[Curse|诅咒]其中的敌人，使其陷入脆弱。[HitDamage|击中]这些敌人会使[Curse|诅咒][Trigger|触发]一次爆炸，造成范围伤害，并对被[Curse|诅咒]目标附近的其他敌人施加显著的[Knockback|击退]，同时根据被[HitDamage|击中]目标身上的脆弱值造成更多[Stun|晕眩]积蓄。

en: [Curse] enemies in an area, which causes explosions and [Knockback|Knocks Back] other nearby enemies if [Curse|Cursed] targets [HitDamage|Hit].
zh: [Curse|诅咒]区域内的敌人，若[Curse|被诅咒]的目标被[HitDamage|击中]，则会引发爆炸并[Knockback|击退]附近的其他敌人。

en: Deals [Physical] [Attack] damage in an area around the [Curse|Cursed] target that is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]'s damage. Other targets are [Knockback|Knocked back] and take more [Stun] buildup based on the Fragility they have.
zh: 对被[Curse|诅咒]目标周围的区域造成[Physical|物理][Attack|攻击]伤害，此伤害不基于你的[MartialWeapon|武器]伤害。其他目标将被[Knockback|击退]，并根据其身上的脆弱值累积更多[Stun|晕眩]积蓄。

en: Deal significant damage to the target and nearby enemies, applying [Knockback|Knockback] to all other targets.
zh: 对目标及附近敌人造成大量伤害，并[Knockback|击退]所有其他目标。

en: Tap into the power of the Triskelion Flame to [Empowered|Empower] the next [Cascadable|Cascadable] [Spell] you cast. The [Empowered] [Spell] becomes centred on your location, and [Cascadable|Cascades] to six areas around you in a Triskelion pattern.
zh: 借助三耀之火的力量，[Empowered|强化]你下次施放的[Cascadable|可扩散][Spell|法术]。该[Empowered|强化的][Spell|法术]将以你的位置为中心，并沿三耀图案[Cascadable|扩散]至你周围的 6 个区域。

en: [Empowered|Empower] the next [Cascadable|Cascadable] [Spell] you cast to target multiple areas around you.
zh: [Empowered|强化]你下次施放的[Cascadable|可扩散][Spell|法术]，可扩散至周围的多个区域。

en: {DNT] Swap the currently dominant form of the Cradle of Conflict.
zh: 交换冲突摇篮当前的主导形态。

en: Build [Glory] by spending [Ward|Runic Ward]. When you have maximum [Glory], you may call down a mass of Verisium from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location and summoning a [TemporaryMinion|Temporary Minion]. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. [Consume|Consumes] a [VerisiumInfusion|Verisium Infusion], if possible, to increase the number of [TemporaryMinion|Minions] summoned .
zh: 通过消耗[Ward|符文结界]来积攒[Glory|荣耀]。当你拥有满[Glory|荣耀]时，可以从天空召唤大量[Verisium|维金]，对目标地点造成高额伤害，并召唤一个[TemporaryMinion|临时召唤生物]。若目标点靠近你，施放时会向后跳跃。若可能，则[Consume|消耗]一个[VerisiumInfusion|维金灌注]以增加召唤的[TemporaryMinion|临时召唤生物]数量。

en: Build [Glory] by spending [Ward|Runic Ward], then drop a mass of Verisium on the target and summon a [TemporaryMinion|Temporary Minion].
zh: 通过消耗[Ward|符文结界]来积攒[Glory|荣耀]，然后从天空召唤大量维金，砸向目标地点，并召唤一个[TemporaryMinion|临时召唤生物]。

en: [HitDamage|Hit] an enemy under the [CullingStrike|Culling Strike Threshold], causing them to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies. Highlights enemies under the [CullingStrike|Culling Strike Threshold].
zh: [HitDamage|击中]一名处于[CullingStrike|终结阈值]以下的敌人，会使其猛烈爆炸，伤害周围的敌人。高亮显示处于[CullingStrike|终结阈值]以下的敌人。

en: [HitDamage|Hit] an enemy under the [CullingStrike|Culling Strike Threshold] to cause them to explode, damaging nearby enemies.
zh: 使一名处于[CullingStrike|终结阈值]以下的敌人猛烈爆炸。

en: [Sacrifice] a portion of your Life to recover [Ward|Runic Ward]. [Ward|Runic Ward] recovered by this Skill can [Overflow].
zh: [Sacrifice|牺牲]部分生命以回复[Ward|符文结界]。该技能回复的[Ward|符文结界]可以[Overflow|溢出]。

en: [Sacrifice] a portion of your Life to recover [Ward|Runic Ward]. [Ward|Runic Ward] recovered by this Skill can [Overflow].
zh: [Sacrifice|牺牲]部分生命以回复[Ward|符文结界]。该技能回复的[Ward|符文结界]可以[Overflow|溢出]。

en: Spend [Ward] and target an area, transforming [Corpse|Corpses] into bitter cores that seek out enemies and [Chill] enemies near them. The cores explode at the end of their duration, creating runes which deal additional [Cold] damage over time.
zh: 消耗[Ward|符文结界]并选定一片区域，将[Corpse|灵柩]转化为苦痛核心，这些核心会追踪敌人并[Chill|冰缓]其附近的敌人。核心在持续时间结束时爆炸，生成符文，造成额外的持续[Cold|冰霜]伤害。

en: Transform [Corpse|Corpses] into bitter cores that seek out enemies and [Chill] them before exploding, creating runes which deal additional [Cold] damage over time.
zh: 将[Corpse|灵柩]转化为苦痛核心，追踪敌人并[Chill|冰缓]其附近的敌人。核心在持续时间结束时爆炸，生成符文，造成额外的持续[Cold|冰霜]伤害。

en: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to instantly [Reviving|Revive] your [Minion|Minions]. Prioritises the most powerful minions first.
zh: 消耗[Ward|符文结界]以立即[Reviving|复活]你的[Minion|召唤生物]。优先复活最强大的召唤物。
消耗[Ward|符文结界]以[Reviving|复活]你的[Minion|召唤生物]。

en: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to cause damaging [IceCrystals|Ice-Crystal] spears to erupt from the ground around you. These spears can be destroyed for an explosion of [Cold] damage.
zh: 消耗[Ward|符文结界]，在你的周围地面引发具有伤害的[IceCrystals|冰晶]长矛。这些长矛可被摧毁，被摧毁时会爆炸，造成[Cold|冰霜]伤害。

en: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to cause damaging [IceCrystals|Ice-Crystal] spears to erupt from the ground around you. These spears can be destroyed for an explosion of [Cold] damage.
zh: 消耗[Ward|符文结界]，在你的周围地面引发具有伤害的[IceCrystals|冰晶]长矛。这些长矛可被摧毁，被摧毁时会爆炸，造成[Cold|冰霜]伤害。

en: While active, [HitDamage|Hitting] with an [Attack] will spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to summon a Verisium Manifestation, a short-lived [TemporaryMinion|Temporary Minion] that rapidly [Attack|Attacks] nearby enemies, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these [Minion|Minions], and can pass through them.
zh: 激活时，使用[Attack|攻击]造成[HitDamage|击中]会消耗[Ward|符文结界]，召唤一个维金化形——一种[TemporaryMinion|临时召唤生物]，会快速[Attack|攻击]附近的敌人，且无视指令。敌人不会直接与这些[Minion|召唤生物]交战，并可穿过它们。

en: While active, [HitDamage|Hitting] with an [Attack] will summon a short-lived [TemporaryMinion|Temporary Minion] that rapidly [Attack|Attacks] nearby enemies. Enemies will not directly engage these manifestations, and can pass through them.
zh: 激活时，使用[Attack|攻击]造成[HitDamage|击中]会召唤一个[TemporaryMinion|临时召唤生物]，快速[Attack|攻击]附近的敌人。敌人不会直接与这些化形交战，并可穿过它们。

en: Summon a short-lived [TemporaryMinion|Verisium Manifestation] that launches [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] at enemies.
zh: 召唤一个短暂的[TemporaryMinion|维金化形]，向敌人发起[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击]。

en: While active, enemies you [Stun] or kill have a chance to generate a [Ward|Runic Ward] [Remnant]. These [Remnant|Remnants] can [Overflow] your [Ward|Runic Ward].
zh: 激活时，你[Stun|晕眩]或击杀的敌人有几率生成一个[Ward|符文结界][Remnant|残片]。这些[Remnant|残片]可使你的[Ward|符文结界][Overflow|溢出]。

en: While active, enemies you [Stun] or kill have a chance to generate a [Ward|Runic Ward] [Remnant]. These [Remnant|Remnants] can [Overflow] your [Ward|Runic Ward].
zh: 激活时，你[Stun|晕眩]或击杀的敌人有几率生成一个[Ward|符文结界][Remnant|残片]。这些[Remnant|残片]可使你的[Ward|符文结界][Overflow|溢出]。

en: Spend all your [Ward|Runic Ward] to summon [TemporaryMinion|Temporary] Wardbound Casters. These [Minion|Minions] target nearby enemies with damaging [Cold] [Spell|Spells].
zh: 消耗所有[Ward|符文结界]来召唤[TemporaryMinion|临时]结界施法者。这些[Minion|召唤生物]会以伤害性[Cold|冰霜][Spell|法术]对付附近的敌人。

en: Spend all your [Ward|Runic Ward] to summon [TemporaryMinion|Temporary] Wardbound Casters. These [Minion|Minions] target nearby enemies with damaging [Cold] [Spell|Spells].
zh: 消耗所有[Ward|符文结界]来召唤[TemporaryMinion|临时]结界施法者。这些[Minion|召唤生物]会以伤害性[Cold|冰霜][Spell|法术]对付附近的敌人。

en: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to create a Verisium volcano that deals damage on initial eruption and [Trigger|Triggers] [IceFragment|Ice Fragments].
zh: 消耗[Ward|符文结界]以创造一座维金火山，在初次喷发时造成伤害并[Trigger|触发][IceFragment|冰霜碎片]。

en: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to create a Verisium volcano that deals damage on intial eruption and [Trigger|Triggers] [IceFragment|Ice Fragments].
zh: 消耗[Ward|符文结界]以创造一座维金火山，在初次喷发时造成伤害并[Trigger|触发][IceFragment|冰霜碎片]。

en: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to create a number of [Hazard|Hazardous] Runes in a cone in front of you, which arm after a time. After arming, these Runes will activate when enemies step on them, exploding to deal [Attack] damage that is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]'s damage and apply [Electrocute|Electrocution] buildup.
zh: 消耗[Ward|符文结界]在你前方的锥形区域内创造数个[Hazard|危险性]符文，这些符文会在一段时间后武装。武装后，当敌人踩踏时，这些符文将激活，爆炸造成[Attack|攻击]伤害，此伤害不基于你的[MartialWeapon|武器]的伤害，并施加[Electrocute|触电]积蓄。

en: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to create a series of [Hazard|Hazardous] Runes which, after arming, will explode to damage and [Electrocute] enemies that step on them.
zh: 消耗[Ward|符文结界]，创造数个[Hazard|危险性]符文。符文武装后，当敌人踩踏时，这些符文将爆炸，造成伤害并施加[Electrocute|触电]。

en: Killing an enemy with [BloodLoss|Blood Loss] will cause a bloody explosion that deals [Physical] [Attack] damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon Damage], but is based on their accumulated [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The explosion destroys their [Corpse] if the enemy was [Rarity|Normal or Magic].
zh: 以[BloodLoss|失血]击杀敌人会引发鲜血爆炸，对周围敌人造成[Physical|物理] [Attack|攻击]伤害。此伤害不基于你的[MartialWeapon|武器伤害]，而是基于目标所累积的[BloodLoss|失血]量。若敌人为[Rarity|普通或魔法]怪物，爆炸会摧毁其[Corpse|灵柩]。

en: Expend a large amount of [Ward|Runic Ward] to instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once, then vanishes. This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform [Channelling|Channelled], [Remote], Cooldown or [Conditional] Skills, or summon [Minion|Minions].
zh: 消耗大量[Ward|符文结界]，立即创造一个短暂的自身复制体。该复制体会使用一次已镶嵌的技能，随后消失。此技能的消耗等于已镶嵌技能的总消耗。复制体无法施放[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能、[Remote|远距]技能、有冷却时间的技能或[Conditional|条件]技能，也无法召唤[Minion|召唤生物]。

en: Instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once.
zh: 立即创造一个短暂的自身复制体。该复制体会使用一次已镶嵌的技能。

en: [Channelling|Channel] to create a protective bubble all around you, [Block|Blocking] [HitDamage|Hits] against you. While [Channelling] this Skill, you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned] by [HitDamage|Hits] you [Block], and damage you take from [HitDamage|Hits] is also removed from [Ward|Runic Ward]. [Block|Blocking] [HitDamage|Hits] this way causes you to accumulate [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup. You cannot recover [Ward|Runic Ward] while this Skill is active.
zh: [Channelling|持续吟唱]以在你周围创造一个保护性泡泡，[Block|格挡]针对你的[HitDamage|击中]。[Channelling|持续吟唱]此技能时，你不会被你[Block|格挡]的[HitDamage|击中][LightStun|轻度晕眩]，且来自[HitDamage|击中]的伤害将先消耗[Ward|符文结界]。以此方式[Block|格挡][HitDamage|击中]会使你积蓄[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]。此技能激活期间，你无法恢复[Ward|符文结界]。

en: [Channelling|Channel] to [Block] [HitDamage|Hits] against you at the cost of [Ward|Runic Ward].
zh: [Channelling|持续吟唱]，消耗[Ward|符文结界]以[Block|格挡]针对你的[HitDamage|击中]。

en: Raise a pair of electrified pylons in front of you which project a wall of electricity between them, damaging and [Electrocute|Electrocuting] enemies caught between them. [Projectile|Projectiles] you fire through the wall become energised, and discharge that energy on [HitDamage|Hit] as [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] beams.
zh: 在你面前升起一对电塔，在两者之间投射出一道电力之墙，伤害并使被困其中的敌人[Electrocute|触电]。你发射的[Projectile|投射物]穿过此墙时会获得充能，并在[HitDamage|击中]时以[Chain|连锁][Lightning|闪电]光束的形式释放能量。

en: Create a wall of electricity that [Electrocute|Electrocutes] enemies and energises your [Projectile|Projectiles].
zh: 创造一道电力之墙，使敌人[Electrocute|触电]。并充能你的[Projectile|投射物]。

en: Creates a Fractured Mimic of yourself, suspended in time at the point of casting the [Trigger|Triggering] [Spell]. If you reach the [Limit] of Fractured Mimics, they will all finish casting their [Spell|Spells] and disappear.
zh: 创造一个自身的破碎拟像，在施放[Trigger|触发]类[Spell|法术]时将其定住。若达到破碎拟像的数量[Limit|上限]，它们将施放完全部[Spell|法术]后消失。

en: While active, picking up [Remnant|Remnants] [Trigger|Triggers] a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the [Remnant] based on the type of [Remnant] picked up.
zh: 激活时，拾取[Remnant|残片]会[Trigger|触发]一次致命爆炸，在[Remnant|残片]所在位置造成伤害，伤害类型基于所拾取[Remnant|残片]的类型。

en: While active, picking up [Remnant|Remnants] [Trigger|Triggers] a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the [Remnant] based on the type of [Remnant] picked up.
zh: 激活时，拾取[Remnant|残片]会[Trigger|触发]一次致命爆炸，在[Remnant|残片]所在位置造成伤害，伤害类型基于所拾取[Remnant|残片]的类型。

en: Pour your [Ward|Runic Ward] into conjuring blades. For the duration of the [Buff], these blades fall on enemies [HitDamage|Hit] by your [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks].
zh: 将你的[Ward|符文结界]灌注于召唤的刀刃。在[Buff|增益]状态持续期间，这些刀刃会落在被你的[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]的敌人身上。

en: Pour your [Ward|Runic Ward] into conjured blades which fall on enemies [HitDamage|Hit] by your [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks].
zh: 将你的[Ward|符文结界]灌注于召唤的刀刃。刀刃会落在被你的[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]的敌人身上。

en: Blows strong enough to [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] an enemy reverberate in an area around the enemy and heavily [ArmourBreak|Break Armour].
zh: 足以[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]敌人的攻击会在其周围区域内产生回荡，并造成大幅的[ArmourBreak|护甲破损]。

en: While active, Sprinting turns you into a locust swarm which deals [Physical] [Attack] damage, which is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]'s damage, in an area around you. You take damage and gain [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup if this [HitDamage|Hits] any targets, but damage you take from other sources while sprinting will not apply [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] or interrupt your sprinting.
zh: 激活后，奔跑会使你化做一群蝗虫，在你周围区域造成[Physical|物理][Attack|攻击]伤害，此伤害不基于你的[MartialWeapon|武器]伤害。若在此状态下[HitDamage|击中]任何目标，你会受到伤害并积蓄[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]，但奔跑时来自其他来源的伤害不会使你[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]或打断奔跑。

en: Something dark awaits you in the forests of Ogham...
zh: 欧甘的森林之中，某种黑暗的力量正在蠢蠢欲动……

en: Once verdant plains now course with sands red and black.
zh: 曾经绿意盎然的大平原，如今只剩下猩红与黑暗的飞沙。

en: Wild jungles have reclaimed the ruins of the Vaal Empire.
zh: 瓦尔帝国的残垣断壁，再次没入了蛮荒的雨林。

en: The sea holds many secrets. Those who seek must take care what they find.
zh: 海洋中隐藏着无数秘密，探秘者苦苦追寻的，却不知是福是祸。

en: The thrice-damned isle of Oriath has not been fully abandoned after all...
zh: 奥瑞亚岛虽三度遭遇劫难，却并不是荒无人烟之地……

en: Warriors of many different tribes must gather to save the world.
zh: 来自诸多部族的战士必须聚集起来拯救世界。

en: What you will do, you have always done.
Give up your flesh unto the gods, and in vulnerability find strength.
zh: 将身躯尽数献出，在脆弱中寻找力量。

en: Burn the spirit to vitalise the flesh.
You may live forever, so long as someone remains to be sacrificed.
zh: 只要自愿作出牺牲，你就可以长生不朽。

en: As true belief fades, the facade of faith grows, leaving you powerful but hollow.
zh: 正念消褪筑高墙，高墙愈坚愈迷惘。

en: Wreathed in madness and blood, you are unstoppable.
zh: 身披鲜血与疯狂，打遍天下无敌手。

en: Tasalio and Valako test you, child of the volcano. Prove yourself worthy.
zh: 这是塔赛里奥和瓦拉克的试炼，火山之子。证明你的价值吧。

en: Utter trust in your defence unleashes ultimate potential.
zh: 相信防御，你将有无限潜力。

en: No man may enslave you, for you have a secret: you're always angry.
zh: 没人可以奴役你，因为你始终愤怒不已。

en:
Invite the enemy when you are strong, evade them when you are weak;
strike with the coming of the storm.
zh:
强大时与敌为友，虚弱时暂避其锋，
时机一到就出手。

en: The fewer there are, the less you have to share.
zh: 数量越少，你分出去的就更少。

en: You circle the black scorpion with enmity, daring it time and again.
zh: 你带着敌意环绕黑蝎，屡败屡战。

en: Speak not, but listen, for danger reveals itself on the wind.
zh: 少说多听，危险在风声中吐露踪迹。

en: Put your faith in intellect rather than mysticism.
zh: 少一点玄学，多一点理性。

en: Master the mortal world, and you may find immortality beyond.
zh: 一旦主宰凡人世界，你将发现超凡之道。

en: Your every move is calm and calculated with absolute certainty.
zh: 你的每一步都从容自若，十拿九稳。

en: Empowered by the divine, you fear no weapon of man.
zh: 神力加持之下，无需畏惧凡人的刀兵。

en: You may find that having is less pleasing a thing than wanting.
zh: 你会发现，期待比占有更有乐趣。

en: Your fiery passion inspires everyone around you - especially your foes.
zh: 你高昂的激情鼓舞了周围每一个人，除了敌人。

en:
You are the heart of the empire, shining bright so that all are lifted up by your light.
Let none tell you otherwise.
zh:
你是帝国之心，给所有人带来光明。
除此之外，你一无所知。

en:
Displays of power are not just for show. If you are never truly tested,
you may divert those resources elsewhere.
zh:
仅用于力量并非宣示。如果你不愿尝试，
那力量多半会转向别处。

en:
The most important lesson the company
taught was simple. Be clever, and survive.
zh:
黑镰最重要的一条训诫朴实无华，
头脑机敏，勉励求生。

en:
It is both despair and inspiration, to look back,
and see oneself in the cycles of Time.
zh:
回首过去，发现自己深陷轮回，
既是绝望，同样也是一种启迪。

en:
Many men throughout history have claimed to
stand against evil. Only a few truly meant it.
zh:
不计其数的人立誓对抗邪恶。
信守诺言之人却是寥寥无几。

en: I pledge my soul to you, Liege of the Lightless, and vow to conquer nations in your name!
zh: 我将我的灵魂献给你，暗光领主，誓要以你之名征服万国！

en: I pledge my soul to you, Lord of Liches, and vow to end the scourge of Life itself!
zh: 我将我的灵魂献给你，巫妖之王，誓要终结生命这一祸患！

en: I pledge my soul to you, the Blackblooded, and vow to usurp the power of Darkness!
zh: 我将我的灵魂献给你，黑血之众，誓要夺取黑暗的力量！

en: I pledge my soul to you, Hated Slave, and vow to exact revenge upon your kind!
zh: 我将我的灵魂献给你，憎恨之奴，誓要向你的同类复仇！

en: I pledge my soul to you, Sovereign of the Well, and vow to bring eternal night!
zh: 我将我的灵魂献给你，弱言领主，誓要带来永恒的黑夜！

en: Incredible might has always laid buried within you. Now is the time to rise.
zh: 身负惊世骇俗之力，如今正是奋起之时。

en: Your home has been threatened. A good man must be roused to war.
zh: 家园危在旦夕，义士挺身而战。

en: You hunger for power, and by force of arms, you will take it.
zh: 力量令你如饥似渴，你将凭借刀兵将其夺得。

en: A woman can change the world with a single well-placed arrow.
zh: 只需一箭，便可改变世界的女人。

en: There are venoms and virtues aplenty in the wilds, if you know where to look.
zh: 荒野中充满了恶毒与美善，只要你知道在何处寻找。

en: You became a weapon of war so that others could live in peace.
zh: 为了让旁人和平安居，你甘愿化身为战争的武器。

en: You were chosen by the Sacred Wisps to enact the Spirit's will.
zh: 你被圣洁鬼灵选中，以践行万灵的意志。

en: Corruption cost you your home, but taught you so much more...
zh: 腐化令你失去了家园，又投以智慧作为回报……

en: You seek power at any cost... and there is no price too high to pay.
zh: 不计代价地追寻力量……多少代价都不足吝惜。

en: Your search for power took you on a journey inwards.
zh: 追求力量的旅程，通往了你的内心。

en: Death is your domain, your flesh merely a material to be mastered.
zh: 死亡是你的领域，血肉不过是有待掌控的耗材。

en: The Well of Souls is yours to command.
The rumble of thunder heralds your approach. Woe to those that draw your ire.
zh: 电闪雷鸣宣告着你的降临，狂徒鼠辈必将饱尝灾祸。

en: The tapestry of time is yours to weave; an element you alone may master.
zh: 时光的织缕任你编织，唯你掌控。

en: By your command, they will earn redemption...one duty at a time.
zh: 遵你命令，他们将完成一项项任务……逐步获得救赎。

en: Countless wars have left you with skills somewhat resembling a decent officer...
zh: 经历无数场战争的洗礼，你已和精锐的军官别无二致……

en: There's something very wrong with this world... and you're going to fix it.
zh: 横行世间的不义……将由你拨乱反正。

en: The more you embrace virtue gems, the more power they offer...
zh: 向古灵宝石献出身心，它们也会赋予你力量……

en: There are many paths to achieve your goals... and you see them all.
zh: 达成目标有多种途径……皆在你洞悉之下。

en:
Wraeclast has suffered for too long.
You are vengeance incarnate.
zh:
瓦尔克拉斯的苦难绵亘太久。
你就是复仇的化身。

en: They made you a human weapon... but that strength has set you free.
zh: 他们把你锻造成人形兵器……但那份力量，却让你挣脱了枷锁。

en: True strength lies within. One must only focus... and believe.
zh: 真正的力量源于内心，你只需全神贯注……坚守信念。

en: The truth of your faith threatens to break your very soul... but in that struggle lies power beyond belief.
zh: 追随的真相令你的内心摇摇欲坠……挣扎中却蕴藏着超乎想象的力量。

en: Defeat a Conqueror of the Atlas

zh: 击败脑层中的神主维纳留斯

en: Defeat The Elder in The Shaper's Realm
zh: 击败裂界者国度的塑界者
征服者的知识之书 I
征服者的知识之书 II
征服者的知识之书 III
征服者的知识之书 IV
征服者的知识之书 V

仲裁官的知识之书 III
仲裁官的知识之书 IV

交际花曼南的残酷符文
格兰内尔领主的掌控符文
塞丝克伯爵夫人的箭术符文
吉尔特领主的荒野符文
赫丝特拉女士的寒冬符文
雷尔德领主的春光符文
奎波拉特尔的波流灵核

en: Hear me, Ancestors! A warrior stands before you, a man who chooses his own Way. I fight without fear, and should I die, know that my war will continue in the Halls of the Dead. Neither monster nor man shall stand in my way.
zh: 先祖啊！英勇的战士傲立在你们面前，他选择了自己践行的道途。我将无畏地迎接战斗，倘若身死，也将在亡者之境继续这场征战。不管是怪物还是人类，都休想阻拦我的道路。

en: [DNT-UNUSED] trait stat that was her has been removed - it never functioned here anyway because it was a virtual stat
zh: 此处原有的职业特色已被移除——反正它作为虚拟属性从未生效过

en: I do not fear death. I am its master. Darkness and the dead are my weapons of war. My enemies will rot from the inside out, as my army of corpses tears them screaming limb from limb.
zh: 我不畏惧死亡，只因我是它的主人。黑暗与亡魂是我的战争利器，敌人将由内而外化为腐朽，被亡骸的大军撕成碎片，只留下惊恐的尖叫与哀嚎。
职业特色：天生具有混沌抗性

en: All I need is a single well-placed arrow. I'm fleet of foot, and have the eyes of a hawk. Put a bow in my hands, and they'll die trying to catch me.
zh: 一发精准的箭矢能够解决所有问题。有了轻快的步伐和鹰隼的锐眼，只需要张弓搭箭，胆敢追逐我的人唯有一个下场。

en: Trait: Arrows fly fast and true
zh: 职业特色：迅捷的飞矢无比精准

en: Life is all about making an impact. Leaving a mark. Simply surviving is not good enough. If you're not doing it with style, why fight at all? Put a sword in my hand. I'll give you a show you won't soon forget.
zh: 生命的意义在于引起轰动，留下印记。光是活命可不够，既然要去战斗，就应该战出风采！给我一把剑，我就让你欣赏一场终身难忘的表演。

en: Trait: Fast attack with offhand weapons
zh: 职业特色：副手武器快速攻击

en:
You were born with quickness of body and sharpness of mind. How have you paid for these gifts? With innocent blood.
 
Yours is a predatory profession. The business of butchery. You have stolen many a life to fill your purse.
 
Now you will earn your redemption in Wraeclast.
zh:
你生来就具有敏捷的身手和聪慧的头脑。可你又是如何报答这些恩惠的？你竟让无辜之人血溅三尺。

在那弱肉强食、谋财害命的行当里，你为填满自己的口袋而夺走了多少性命。

而现在，你只能在瓦尔克拉斯争取自己的救赎了。

en: Trait: Poison remain potent for longer
zh: 职业特色：毒素的强效时间较长

en: Do not mistake me for humble and weak because I am a man of God. No. We Templars have learned we must handle earthly affairs on our own. Though God is absent, evil shall not go unpunished.
zh: 别把我当成那些卑微的弱者，因为我是神的代行人。不。我们圣堂武僧领悟了如何应对凡俗的事务。虽然神已不在，但邪恶休想逃脱制裁。

en: Trait: His Spirit is stronger than most
zh: 职业特色：具有的灵魂胜于常人

en: I wanted very little for myself. A forge, a bed. They took that all away when they burned down my home. Give me one good hammer, and they will find that there is nothing more dangerous than a man of peace roused to war.
zh: 我并不贪图身外之物，只求一个熔炉，一张铺盖。他们却焚毁了我的家园，夺走了我的一切。给我一把精良的锤子，我就能让他们明白，不要逼迫和平的人民挺身而起。
职业特色：攻击时击退对手

en: The elements are mine to control. I know why lightning strikes, why fire burns, and why cold freezes. They do so because I command it. The vengeance of the Maraketh will find those who have transgressed no matter where they run.
zh: 元素之力任我掌控。电闪雷鸣，熊熊火光，天寒地冻，都是出自我的命令。僭越之人尽管逃亡天涯海角吧，马拉克斯人必将一雪前耻。
职业特色：天生具有元素抗性

en: The Spirit bid me leave my mountain, only to find violence and death. Give me a spear! If they want blood, I will show them what it means to fight for survival.
zh: 万灵呼唤我走出故山，眼前却只有暴行与死亡。给我一柄战矛！既然他们只愿沐血，我就让他们见识一下为生存而战的真正意义。

en: Trait: Trained to block incoming attacks
zh: 职业特色：经过格挡攻击的训练

en: You've got a weapon, I'll wield it. Just tell me where to point it. I've seen the highs and horrors of war, and I'll do whatever it takes to survive. If you've got coin, I'm your man.
zh: 你有武器，我就能用，告诉我将它指向何处就行。我见识过战争的热血和恐怖。为了生存，我会不惜一切代价。只要你有钱，我就是你的人。
职业特色：图腾持续时间更久

en: My life has been naught but discipline and focus, preparing me for this. I fight for the Benevolent Dreamer. Free my hands, and those who seek chaos will fall before me!
zh: 我辈此生别无他物，只与戒律专注相伴，得以面对此等乱局。我为仁爱的幻梦者而战。解放我的双手，我会让混沌的爪牙一一拜服在地！

en: Trait: Trained to evade incoming attacks
zh: 职业特色：经过闪避攻击的训练

en: The wrath of the wild and the mind of a man - with the ruthlessness of both. I have weathered more than most could fathom, and I will have my vengeance.
zh: 怀揣荒野之怒与人类心智——兼具二者的冷酷无情。我所历经的磨难远超常人想象，而我的复仇，必将到来。
职业特色：天生具有闪电抗性
贪婪战书佣兵关卡演示

en:
Physical damage is one of the five [DamageTypes|Damage Types]. It is the most common and the only one reduced by [Armour], rather than by a [Resistances|Resistance]. 

Most physical damage comes from [MartialWeapon|Weapon] [Attack|Attacks], but some [Spell|Spells] and other skills deal physical damage as well. Physical damage over time can be inflicted with [Bleeding].
zh:
物理伤害是五种[DamageTypes|伤害类型]之一。这是最常见，也是唯一会被[Armour|护甲]减免的伤害类型，但不受[Resistances|抗性]影响。

大部分物理伤害来自于[MartialWeapon|武器][Attack|攻击]，但有些[Spell|法术]和其他技能也会造成物理伤害。[Bleeding|流血]能够造成持续物理伤害。

en: Fire damage is one of the five [DamageTypes|Damage Types]. It is reduced by [Resistances|Fire Resistance]. Fire [HitDamage|Hits] inflict [Flammability] based on how much Fire damage is dealt, which provides a chance to [Ignite].
zh: 火焰伤害是五种[DamageTypes|伤害类型]之一。会被[Resistances|火焰抗性]减免。火焰[HitDamage|击中]根据造成的火焰伤害量施加[Flammability|易燃]，从而提供[Ignite|点燃]几率。

en: Cold damage is one of the five [DamageTypes|Damage Types]. It is reduced by [Resistances|Cold Resistance]. Cold hits apply [Chill] and build up [Freeze], but cannot build up [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun].
zh: 冰霜伤害是五种[DamageTypes|伤害类型]之一。这类伤害会被[Resistances|冰霜抗性]减免。冰霜击中会施加[Chill|冰缓]并积蓄[Freeze|冻结]，但无法累积[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]。

en: Lightning damage is one of the five [DamageTypes|Damage Types]. It is reduced by [Resistances|Lightning Resistance]. Lightning hits have a chance to [Shock] based on how much Lightning damage is dealt.
zh: 闪电伤害是五种[DamageTypes|伤害类型]之一。这类伤害会被[Resistances|闪电抗性]减免。闪电击中有几率根据造成的闪电伤害施加[Shock|感电]。

en:
Chaos damage is one of the five [DamageTypes|Damage Types]. It is reduced by [Resistances|Chaos Resistance]. 
Chaos damage is the least common damage type, and removes twice as much [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] as the damage value when taken.
zh:
混沌伤害是五种[DamageTypes|伤害类型]之一。这类伤害会被[Resistances|混沌抗性]减免。
混沌伤害是最罕见的伤害类型，受到混沌伤害时扣除的[EnergyShield|能量护盾]为伤害量的两倍。

en: Ailments are a family of common [Debuff|Debuffs] associated with specific damage types. The list of Ailments is: [Bleeding], [Ignite], [Chill], [Freeze], [Shock], [Electrocute], and [Poison].
zh: 异常状态是一类常见的[Debuff|减益状态]，与特定的伤害类型相关。异常状态包括[Bleeding|流血]、[Ignite|点燃]、[Chill|冰缓]、[Freeze|冻结]、[Shock|感电]、[Electrocute|触电]和[Poison|中毒]。

en:
[Strength], [Dexterity], and [Intelligence] are the 3 primary attributes. The most important use of Attributes is to meet requirements to use Equipment and Gems.

Each Attribute provides a different inherent bonus.
zh:
[Strength|力量]、[Dexterity|敏捷]和[Intelligence|智慧]是三种主要属性。属性至关重要，是装备许多物品和宝石的必需条件。

每种属性都能提供不同的固有加成。

en:
Strength is an [Attributes|Attribute] required to equip most equipment that grants [Armour], as well as various melee-aligned Weapons and Skills.

Strength provides an inherent bonus of +2 to maximum Life per 1 Strength.

Strength does not grant damage to Skills or any other benefits except where specifically stated.
zh:
力量[Attributes|属性]是装备大部分提供[Armour|护甲]的物品，以及众多近战武器和技能的必需条件。

力量能提供固有加成，每 1 点力量可提供 +2 生命。

除非另有说明，否则力量不提供技能伤害加成或其他效果。

en:
Dexterity is an [Attributes|Attribute] required to use most equipment that grants [Evasion|Evasion Rating], as well as various range-aligned Weapons and Skills.

Dexterity provides an inherent bonus of +8 to [Accuracy|Accuracy Rating] per 1 Dexterity.

Dexterity does not grant damage to Skills or any other benefits except where specifically stated.
zh:
敏捷[Attributes|属性]是使用大部分提供[Evasion|闪避值]的物品，以及众多远程武器和技能的必需条件。

敏捷能提供固有加成，每 1 点敏捷可提供 +8 [Accuracy|命中值]。

除非另有说明，否则敏捷不提供技能伤害加成或其他效果。

en:
Intelligence is an [Attributes|Attribute] required to use most equipment that grants [EnergyShield|Energy Shield], as well as various spell-aligned Weapons and Skills.

Intelligence provides an inherent bonus of +2 to maximum Mana per 1 Intelligence

Intelligence does not grant damage to Skills or any other benefits except where specifically stated.
zh:
智慧[Attributes|属性]是使用大部分提供[EnergyShield|能量护盾]的物品，以及众多法术类武器和技能的必需条件。

智慧能提供固有加成，每 1 点智慧可提供 +2 魔力。

除非另有说明，否则智慧不提供技能伤害加成或其他效果。

en:
Bleeding is an [Ailments|Ailment] that deals [Physical|Physical] damage over time, and lasts 5 seconds by default. Damage from Bleeding bypasses [EnergyShield|Energy Shield]

Bleeding deals an extra 100% damage while the target is moving, or if the Bleeding is [Aggravate|Aggravated].

[Physical] damage from [HitDamage|Hits] [Contributes|Contributes] to Bleeding [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude].

Damage does not [Contributes|Contribute] to Bleeding chance, so it cannot be inflicted without an explicit source of Bleeding chance.

The base [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Bleeding is [Physical] damage per second equal to 15% of the [Premitigation|Pre-mitigation] [Physical] damage of the [HitDamage|Hit] that inflicted it. This magnitude is not further affected by any modifiers to the damage you deal. 

Modifiers and [Debuff|Debuffs] that affect the enemy's ability to mitigate damage (such as [Shock]) can affect the damage the enemy takes from Bleeding, but any such modifiers that specifically apply to [HitDamage|Hit] damage (such as [ArmourBreak|Armour Break]) do not affect Bleeding damage.
zh:
流血[Ailments|异常状态]会造成持续的[Physical|物理]伤害，默认情况下持续 5 秒。流血伤害会穿透[EnergyShield|能量护盾]。

目标移动时，或者流血效果为[Aggravate|恶性]时，流血会造成 100% 的额外伤害。

[HitDamage|击中]造成的[Physical|物理]伤害会[Contributes|作用于]流血[BuffMagnitude|强度]。

伤害不[Contributes|作用于]流血几率，没有外延的流血几率时无法造成流血。

流血的基础[BuffMagnitude|强度]，其每秒[Physical|物理]伤害相当于造成该效果的[HitDamage|击中]的[Premitigation|减免前][Physical|物理]伤害的 15%，这一强度不会再受到伤害词缀的影响。

影响敌人抵御伤害的能力的词缀和[Debuff|减益状态]（例如[Shock|感电]），可以影响敌人受到的流血伤害。但仅作用于[HitDamage|击中]伤害（例如[ArmourBreak|护甲破损]）的词缀无法影响流血伤害。

en: Being Blinded causes 20% less [Accuracy|Accuracy] Rating and [Evasion|Evasion] Rating, and lasts for 4 seconds unless otherwise specified.
zh: 致盲状态会导致[Accuracy|命中]值和[Evasion|闪避]值总降 20%，除非另有说明，否则持续 4 秒。

en:
Chill is an [Ailments|Ailment] that [Slow|Slows] the afflicted target, and lasts 2 seconds on players or 8 seconds on non-players by default. Chill [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] depends on the Chilling damage dealt relative to the target's [AilmentThreshold|Elemental Ailment Threshold], with a minimum of 30% and a default maximum of 50%.

[Cold] damage from [HitDamage|Hits] can Chill by default, and does not require a chance to inflict Chill. However, Chills smaller than 30% will be ignored, so small [HitDamage|Hits] can fail to Chill.
zh:
冰缓是一种[Ailments|异常状态]，会[Slow|减缓]受影响目标，对玩家默认持续 2 秒，对非玩家默认持续 8 秒。冰缓[BuffMagnitude|强度]取决于造成冰缓的伤害相对于目标[AilmentThreshold|元素异常状态阈值]的比例，最低 30%，默认最高 50%。

[HitDamage|击中]造成的[Cold|冰霜]伤害默认可以造成冰缓，无需几率。但比例小于 30% 的冰缓会被无视，所以伤害较低的[HitDamage|击中]可能无法造成冰缓。

en: Chilled Ground [Chill|Chills] those standing in it, and lasts 6 seconds by default.
zh: 冰缓地面会对站在其中的单位施加[Chill|冰缓]，并且默认持续 6 秒。

en: You and [Allies|Allies] standing on your Consecrated Ground Regenerate 5% of their maximum Life per second, and [Curse|Curses] have 50% reduced effect on them.
zh: 你和站在你的奉献地面上的[Allies|友军]每秒回复生命上限的 5%，并且受到的[Curse|诅咒]效果降低 50%。

en: Culling Strikes kill Normal enemies if their life is at 35% or below. Magic enemies are instead killed at 20%, Rare at 10% and Unique at 5%. These thresholds are checked before the damage of the [HitDamage|Hit] is applied.
zh: 终结会立刻击败生命不高于 35% 的普通敌人，魔法敌人的阈值为 20%，稀有敌人为 10%，传奇敌人为 5%。终结阈值会在[HitDamage|击中]的伤害生效之前进行检测。

en: [HitDamage|Hits] against Full Life Enemies remove between 5% and 30% of Life, before the damage of the [HitDamage|Hit] is applied.
zh: [HitDamage|击中]满血敌人时，在[HitDamage|击中]的伤害生效前先移除5% - 30% 的生命。
伤害类型分为[Physical|物理]、[Fire|火焰]、[Cold|冰霜]、[Lightning|闪电]和[Chaos|混沌]。
造成伤害的[Ailments|异常状态]包括[Bleeding|流血]、[Ignite|点燃]和[Poison|中毒]。

en: You take [Chaos] damage over time while standing in Desecrated Ground.
zh: 站在腐化地面上时，你会受到持续[Chaos|混沌]伤害。
元素[Ailments|异常状态]包括[Ignite|点燃]、[Chill|冰缓]、[Freeze|冻结]、[Shock|感电]和[Electrocute|触电]。

en:
Freeze is an [Ailments|Ailment] that causes targets to be unable to move or act, and lasts 4 seconds by default.

[Cold] damage from [HitDamage|Hits] [Contributes] to Freeze Buildup on enemies until they become [Frozen].
zh:
冻结[Ailments|异常状态]会使目标无法移动或做出行动，默认持续 4 秒。

[HitDamage|击中]造成的[Cold|冰霜]伤害[Contributes|作用于]冻结积蓄，直到将敌人完全[Frozen|冻结]。

en: Hinder is a [Debuff] that [Slow|Slows] movement speed by 30% unless otherwise specified. Unless Specified, Hinder has a duration of 4 seconds.
zh: 缓速是一种[Debuff|减益状态]，除非另有说明，会使移动速度[Slow|减缓] 30%。除非另有说明，缓速持续 4 秒。

en:
Ignite is an [Ailments|Ailment] that deals [Fire] damage over time, and lasts for 4 seconds by default.

The chance for a [HitDamage|Hit] to Ignite a target is determined by the total [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of [Flammability] on the target, including the amount added by that [HitDamage|Hit].

[Fire] damage from [HitDamage|Hits] [Contributes] to the [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Ignite, so [HitDamage|Hits] dealing more [Fire] damage inflict stronger Ignites.
The base [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Ignite is [Fire] damage per second equal to 20% of the [Fire] damage dealt by the [HitDamage|Hit] that inflicted it. This is calculated using the final damage dealt by the [HitDamage|Hit], but not any modifiers on the target that affect how much damage they will take from the [HitDamage|Hit]. This [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] is not further affected by any modifiers to the damage you deal.

Modifiers and [Debuff|Debuffs] that affect the enemy's ability to mitigate damage (such as [Shock]) can affect the damage the enemy takes from Ignite, but any such modifiers that specifically apply to [HitDamage|Hit] damage (such as [Penetration]) do not affect Ignite damage.
zh:
点燃[Ailments|异常状态]会造成持续的[Fire|火焰]伤害，默认情况下持续 4 秒。

[HitDamage|击中]点燃目标的几率由目标身上的[Flammability|易燃]总[BuffMagnitude|强度]决定，包括该[HitDamage|击中]添加的数值。

[HitDamage|击中]造成的[Fire|火焰]伤害会[Contributes|作用于]点燃[BuffMagnitude|强度]。造成更高[Fire|火焰]伤害的[HitDamage|击中]，点燃的效果也更强。
点燃的基础[BuffMagnitude|强度]，其每秒[Fire|火焰]伤害相当于造成该效果的[HitDamage|击中][Fire|火焰]伤害的 20%，取决于造成该效果的[HitDamage|击中]最终造成的伤害，但不受目标具有的影响[HitDamage|击中]伤害的词缀影响。这一[BuffMagnitude|强度]不会再受到伤害词缀的影响。

影响敌人抵御伤害的能力的词缀和[Debuff|减益状态]（例如[Shock|感电]），可以影响敌人受到的点燃伤害。但仅作用于[HitDamage|击中]伤害（例如[Penetration|穿透]）的词缀无法影响点燃伤害。

en:
Flammability is a [Debuff] that provides the chance for [HitDamage|Hits] to [Ignite] the target. It is not itself an [Ailments|Ailment], but is closely associated with [Ignite], which is.

[Fire] damage from [HitDamage|Hits] [Contributes] to the [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Flammability, so [HitDamage|Hits] that deal more [Fire] damage will [Ignite] more often.

The base [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Flammability is 1% chance to Ignite the target for every 5% of the target's [AilmentThreshold|Ailment Threshold] dealt as [Fire] damage. Flammability from a [HitDamage|Hit] is applied before that hit checks whether it should [Ignite] the target, and so will affect that chance for that [HitDamage|Hit] to [Ignite].

Since chance for [HitDamage|Hits] to [Ignite] comes from Flammability on the target, modifiers which increase the chance to inflict [Ailments] will increase the [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Flammability inflicted.

Effects which do not [HitDamage|Hit] targets, but [Ignite] as if they had, such as [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground], also inflict Flammability, but do not roll a random chance to [Ignite]. Such effects will only [Ignite] once the total Flammability on the target reaches 50%.

Multiple instances of Flammability stack, raising the chance for [HitDamage|Hits] to [Ignite] the target up to 100%. Each instance of Flammability has its own independent duration, lasting 8 seconds by default.
zh:
易燃是提供[HitDamage|击中][Ignite|点燃]目标几率的[Debuff|减益状态]。它本身不是[Ailments|异常状态]，但与[Ignite|点燃]密切相关。

[HitDamage|击中]造成的[Fire|火焰]伤害[Contributes|作用于]易燃[BuffMagnitude|强度]，所以造成更高[Fire|火焰]伤害的[HitDamage|击中]，[Ignite|点燃]的几率也会提高。
易燃的基础[BuffMagnitude|强度]是每造成目标[AilmentThreshold|异常状态阈值] 5% 的[Fire|火焰]伤害，就有 1% 几率点燃目标。[HitDamage|击中]产生的易燃在该击中检查是否应该[Ignite|点燃]目标之前应用，因此会影响该[HitDamage|击中][Ignite|点燃]的几率。

由于[HitDamage|击中][Ignite|点燃]的几率来自目标身上的易燃，增加施加[Ailments|异常状态]几率的词缀会增加施加的易燃[BuffMagnitude|强度]。

不[HitDamage|击中]目标但视作击中所造成的[Ignite|点燃]的效果，如[IgnitedGround|点燃地面]，也会施加易燃，但不会随机判定是否[Ignite|点燃]。此类效果在目标身上的总易燃达到 50% 仅会[Ignite|点燃]一次。

多个易燃会叠加，将[HitDamage|击中][Ignite|点燃]目标的几率提高到最多 100%。每个易燃都有独立的持续时间，默认持续 8 秒。

en: Ignoring [Resistances] means your damage cannot be modified in any way by the target's [Resistances|Resistance] stats.
zh: 无视[Resistances|抗性]意味着你的伤害不会被目标任何[Resistances|抗性]属性影响。
击退会在[HitDamage|击中]时将敌人推向远处。

en:
When you deal damage with a [HitDamage|Hit], Life Leech causes you to recover an amount of Life to a percentage of the damage dealt, over a period of one second.

Hits that deal more than 40,000 total damage are treated as though they only dealt 40,000 damage for this calculation. If this damage is of multiple [DamageTypes|Damage Types], the ratios between them will stay the same.

Monsters have Leech Resistance that increases with monster level, reducing how much you recover from Leech from [HitDamage|Hits] against them.

You can only recover from a single instance of Life Leech at a time, and all Life Leech is removed when Life is filled.
zh:
当你造成[HitDamage|击中]伤害时，生命偷取会在 1 秒内回复一定数量的生命，数值等于造成伤害的一定比例。

若一次击中的总伤害超过 40,000，则在该计算中仅视为 40,000 伤害。若该伤害包含多种[DamageTypes|伤害类型]，其比例保持不变。

怪物拥有偷取抗性，抗性随怪物等级提升而增加，从而降低你通过[HitDamage|击中]获得的偷取回复量。

你每次只能从单个生命偷取实例中回复生命，且当生命值满时，所有生命偷取效果都会被移除。

en: You are on Low Energy Shield if you have 35% of your Maximum Energy Shield or less.
zh: 如果你的能量护盾达到或低于能量护盾上限的 35%，便处于低能量护盾状态。

en: A player or monster is on Low Life if it has 35% of its Maximum Life or less.
zh: 生命达到或低于生命上限 35% 的玩家或怪物处于低血状态。

en: You are on Low Mana if you have 35% of your Maximum Mana or less.
zh: 如果你的魔力达到或低于最大魔力上限的 35%，便处于低魔状态。

en: Lucky things are rolled twice and the better result used.
zh: 幸运会重复判断两次数值，取其中好的结果生效。

en: Maimed enemies suffer from 30% [Slow|Slower] Movement Speed and 15% reduced [Evasion|Evasion Rating]. Maim lasts for 4 seconds unless otherwise specified.
zh: 瘫痪敌人的移动速度[Slow|减慢] 30%，[Evasion|闪避]值降低 15%。除非另有说明，瘫痪持续 4 秒。

en:
When you deal damage with a [HitDamage|Hit], Mana Leech causes you to recover an amount of Mana to a percentage of the damage dealt, over a period of one second.

Hits that deal more than 40,000 total damage are treated as though they only dealt 40,000 damage for this calculation. If this damage is of multiple [DamageTypes|Damage Types], the ratios between them will stay the same.

Monsters have Leech Resistance that increases with monster level, reducing how much you recover from Leech from [HitDamage|Hits] against them.

You can only recover from a single instance of Mana Leech at a time, and all Mana Leech is removed when Mana is filled.
zh:
当你造成[HitDamage|击中]伤害时，魔力偷取会在 1 秒内回复一定数量的魔力，数值等于造成伤害的一定比例。

若一次击中的总伤害超过 40,000，则在该计算中仅视为 40,000 伤害。若该伤害包含多种[DamageTypes|伤害类型]，其比例保持不变。

怪物拥有偷取抗性，抗性随怪物等级提升而增加，从而降低你通过[HitDamage|击中]获得的偷取回复量。

你每次只能从单个魔力偷取实例中回复魔力，且当魔力值满时，所有魔力偷取效果都会被移除。

en:
When you deal damage with a [HitDamage|Hit], [Rage] Leech causes you to recover an amount of [Rage] to a percentage of the damage dealt, over a period of one second.

Hits that deal more than 40,000 total damage are treated as though they only dealt 40,000 damage for this calculation. If this damage is of multiple [DamageTypes|Damage Types], the ratios between them will stay the same.

Monsters have Leech Resistance that increases with monster level, reducing how much you recover from Leech from [HitDamage|Hits] against them.

You can only recover from a single instance of [Rage] Leech at a time, and all [Rage] Leech is removed when [Rage] is filled.
zh:
当你造成[HitDamage|击中]伤害时，[Rage|怒火]偷取会在 1 秒内回复一定数量的[Rage|怒火]，数值等于造成伤害的一定比例。

若一次击中的总伤害超过 40,000，则在该计算中仅视为 40,000 伤害。若该伤害包含多种[DamageTypes|伤害类型]，其比例保持不变。

怪物拥有偷取抗性，抗性随怪物等级提升而增加，从而降低你通过[HitDamage|击中]获得的偷取回复量。

你每次只能从单个[Rage|怒火]偷取实例中回复怒火，且当[Rage|怒火]值满时，所有[Rage|怒火]偷取效果都会被移除。

en: The Map Owner is the player who created the Map area.
zh: 地图拥有者指的是创建地图区域的玩家。

en: [Ailments] that do not deal damage are [Chill], [Freeze], [Shock], and [Electrocute].
zh: 不造成伤害的[Ailments|异常状态]包括[Chill|冰缓]、[Freeze|冻结]、[Shock|感电]和[Electrocute|触电]。

en: Overkill damage is any damage from a [HitDamage|Hit] in excess of the enemy's remaining Life when it is killed.
zh: 溢出伤害是一次[HitDamage|击中]造成的伤害超出敌人剩余生命的部分。

en:
Poison is an [Ailments|Ailment] that deals [Chaos] damage over time, and lasts 2 seconds by default. Damage from Poison bypasses [EnergyShield|Energy Shield].

[Physical] and [Chaos] damage from [HitDamage|Hits] [Contributes|Contribute] to Poison [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude].

Damage does not [Contributes|Contribute] to Poison chance, so it cannot be inflicted without an explicit source of Poison chance.

The base [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Poison is [Chaos] damage per second equal to 20% of the [Premitigation|Pre-mitigation] [Physical] and [Chaos] damage of the [HitDamage|Hit] that inflicted it. This magnitude is not further affected by any modifiers to the damage you deal.

Modifiers and [Debuff|Debuffs] that affect the enemy's ability to mitigate damage (such as [Shock]) can affect the damage the enemy takes from Poison, but any such modifiers that specifically apply to [HitDamage|Hit] damage (such as [Penetration]) do not affect Poison damage.
zh:
中毒[Ailments|异常状态]会造成持续的[Chaos|混沌]伤害，默认情况下持续 2 秒。中毒伤害会穿透[EnergyShield|能量护盾]。


[HitDamage|击中]造成的[Physical|物理]和[Chaos|混沌]伤害会[Contributes|作用于]中毒[BuffMagnitude|强度]。

伤害不[Contributes|作用于]中毒几率，没有外延的中毒几率时无法造成中毒。

中毒的基础[BuffMagnitude|强度]，其每秒[Chaos|混沌]伤害相当于造成该效果的[HitDamage|击中]的[Premitigation|减免前][Physical|物理]和[Chaos|混沌]伤害的 20%。这一强度不会再受到伤害词缀的影响。

影响敌人抵御伤害的能力的词缀和[Debuff|减益状态]（例如[Shock|感电]），可以影响敌人受到的中毒伤害。但仅作用于[HitDamage|击中]伤害（例如[Penetration|穿透]）的词缀无法影响中毒伤害。

en:
Rage grants 1% more [Attack|Attack] damage per 1 Rage. By default, you have 30 maximum Rage and lose 1 Rage every 0.2 seconds. Rage loss is paused for 4 seconds upon gaining Rage, or after taking damage.

Only one [HitDamage|Hit] every 0.5 seconds can cause you to gain Rage.
zh:
每提升 1 点怒火使[Attack|攻击]伤害增加 1%。默认情况下，你最多拥有 30 点怒火，每 0.2 秒会失去 1 点怒火。在获得怒火，或受到伤害时，怒火损失会暂停 4 秒。

每 0.5 秒只能有一次[HitDamage|击中]使你获得怒火。

en: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds.

Shapeshifting changes you into a non-human form. Shapeshifting skills still use your character's stats as normal unless otherwise specified.

Using a skill that is not compatible with your Shapeshifted form will automatically Shapeshift you back to human form.
zh:
变形会将你变为非人类形态。除非另有说明，否则变形技能仍然使用你角色的属性。

使用不兼容变形形态的技能时，你会自动恢复到人类形态。

en:
Shock is an [Ailments|Ailment] that causes targets to take 20% increased damage, and lasts 4 seconds on players or 8 seconds on non-players by default.

[Lightning] damage from [HitDamage|Hits] [Contributes] to chance to Shock enemies. The higher the [Lightning] damage dealt, the higher the chance. By default a [HitDamage|Hit] has 1% chance to Shock for every 4% of the target's [AilmentThreshold|Ailment Threshold] dealt.
zh:
感电是一种[Ailments|异常状态]，使目标受到的伤害提高 20%，对玩家默认持续 4 秒，对非玩家默认持续 8 秒。

[HitDamage|击中]造成的[Lightning|闪电]伤害[Contributes|作用于]感电几率。造成的[Lightning|闪电]伤害越高，施加的几率就越高。默认情况下，[HitDamage|击中]每造成相当于[AilmentThreshold|异常状态]阈值 4% 的伤害，就有 1 %的几率造成感电。

en:
Enemies standing in Smoke Clouds are [Blind|Blinded].
Smoke Clouds have a radius of 2 metres unless otherwise specified.
zh:
站在迷雾中的敌人将被[Blind|致盲]。
除非另有说明，否则迷雾的范围为 2 米。

en: Your base Stun Threshold is equal to your maximum Life. A [HitDamage|Hit] that deals damage equal to or greater than your Stun Threshold is guaranteed to [Stun] you, and the chance scales down linearly for lower damage [HitDamage|Hits]. A [Stun] chance of less than 10% is treated as 0%.
zh: 你的基础晕眩阈值等于你的最大生命。[HitDamage|击中]造成的伤害大于或等于你的晕眩阈值时必定会使你[Stun|晕眩]，[HitDamage|击中]伤害降低时该几率线性递减。低于 10% 的[Stun|晕眩]几率视作 0%。

en: The lower an enemy's Stun Threshold, the less [Stun] buildup is needed to [Stun] or [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] them.
zh: 敌人的晕眩阈值越低，使其[Stun|晕眩]或[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]所需的[Stun|晕眩]积蓄值就越低。

en: Freeze Threshold determines how much [Freeze] buildup is needed to [Freeze] a target.
zh: 冻结阈值决定了使目标[Freeze|冻结]所需的[Freeze|冻结]积蓄值。

en: Electrocute Threshold determines how much [Electrocute] buildup is needed to [Electrocute] a target.
zh: 触电阈值决定了使目标[Electrocute|触电]所需的[Electrocute|触电]积蓄值。

en: [Debuff|Debuffs] you are Unaffected by can still be placed on you, but will not actually apply their effect.
zh: 不受影响的[Debuff|减益状态]依然会施加在你身上，但不会产生效果。

en: Uncapped [Resistances|Resistance] is the value a [Resistances|Resistance] would have if ignoring Maximum Resistance. These values are shown in parentheses at the top of the Character Panel.
zh: 绝对[Resistances|抗性]指忽略抗性上限时的[Resistances|抗性]数值。该数值会显示在角色面板顶部的圆括号里。

en: Overcapped [Resistances|Resistance] is the amount by which your [UncappedResist|Uncapped Resistance] exceeds your [MaximumResistances|Maximum Resistance] for that damage type.
zh: 超量[Resistances|抗性]是你的[UncappedResist|绝对抗性]超过该伤害类型的[MaximumResistances|抗性上限]的数值。

en: Unlucky things are rolled twice and the worse result used.
zh: 不幸会重复判断两次数值，取其中最差的结果生效。

en: A target is immobilised if it cannot move, for example due to being [Frozen], [Pinned], [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned], or [Electrocute|Electrocuted].
zh: 因为被[Frozen|冻结]、[Pinned|定身]、[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]或[Electrocute|触电]而无法进行移动的目标视作不可移动。

en:
[HitDamage|Hits] against any target can potentially cause a Stun on that target, depending on the damage dealt. Stunning a target interrupts their current action and prevents them from taking actions for a short time. There are two types of Stun:

[LightStun|Light Stuns] last a fraction of a second but can be inflicted frequently. Any [HitDamage|Hit] has a chance to cause a [LightStun|Light Stun]. The chance is based on the damage dealt, up to 100% base chance for [HitDamage|Hits] that deal 100% of the target's maximum Life. Chances lower than 15% are treated as 0%.

[HeavyStun|Heavy Stuns] occur when a target's Stun bar is filled and last multiple seconds. [HitDamage|Hits] cause Heavy Stun buildup based on the damage dealt. Players and their [Minion|Minions] usually cannot be [HeavyStun|Heavily Stunned], but players can receive [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup where specifically mentioned while taking specific actions (such as raising their [Shield], Parrying with a [Buckler], or riding a mount).

Player [Physical] damage and [Melee] Damage each have 50% more [LightStun|Light Stun] chance and [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup. These bonuses are multiplicative with each other.
Monster [Physical] damage and [Melee] Damage have 100% more and 33% more [LightStun|Light Stun] chance and [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup respectively. These bonuses are multiplicative with each other.
zh:
[HitDamage|击中]任何目标都有几率使其晕眩，由造成的伤害决定。使目标晕眩会打断他们当前的行动，并使其在短时间内无法做出其他行动。晕眩包含两种类型：

[LightStun|轻度晕眩]的持续时间不到一秒，但可以频繁造成。任何[HitDamage|击中]都有几率造成[LightStun|轻度晕眩]。该几率由造成的伤害决定，造成相当于目标最大生命的 100% 的[HitDamage|击中]具有 100% 的几率。低于 15% 的几率视作 0%。

[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]会在目标的晕眩条填满时生效，可以持续数秒。[HitDamage|击中]会根据造成的伤害而产生重度晕眩积蓄。玩家和[Minion|召唤生物]通常不会受到[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]，但在特定行动期间（例如举起[Shield|盾牌]、使用[Buckler|轻盾]招架或骑乘坐骑时）可以获得[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]积蓄。

玩家的[Physical|物理]伤害和[Melee|近战]伤害，其[LightStun|轻度晕眩]几率和[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]积蓄各总增 50%。这些加成可以按乘法叠加生效。
怪物的[Physical|物理]伤害和[Melee|近战]伤害，其[LightStun|轻度晕眩]几率和[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]积蓄分别总增 100% 和 33%。这些加成可以按乘法叠加生效。

en:
Any [HitDamage|Hit] has a chance to [LightStun|Light Stun] the target, interrupting their current action and preventing them from taking actions for a fraction of a second. The chance is based on the damage dealt, up to 100% base chance for [HitDamage|Hits] that deal 100% of the target's maximum Life. Chances lower than 15% are treated as 0%.

[Physical] damage, and player (but not monster) [Melee] Damage, each have 50% more [LightStun|Light Stun] chance. For players, these bonuses are multiplicative with each other.
zh:
任意[HitDamage|击中]都有几率使目标[LightStun|轻度晕眩]，打断他们当前的行动，并使其在不到一秒的时间内无法做出其他行动。该几率由造成的伤害决定，造成相当于目标最大生命的 100% 的[HitDamage|击中]具有 100% 的几率。低于 15% 的几率视作 0%。

[Physical|物理]伤害，以及玩家（并非怪物）的[Melee|近战]伤害，其[LightStun|轻度晕眩]几率总增 50%。对玩家而言，这些额外加成可以按乘法叠加生效。

en:
[HeavyStun|Heavy Stuns] occur when a target's [Stun] bar is filled, interrupts the target's current action and prevent them from taking actions for a few seconds. [HitDamage|Hits] cause Heavy Stun buildup based on the damage dealt. Players and their [Minion|Minions] usually cannot be [HeavyStun|Heavily Stunned], but players can receive [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup where specifically mentioned while taking specific actions (such as raising their [Shield], Parrying with a [Buckler], or riding a mount).

While an enemy is Heavy Stunned, they cannot act and count as [Immobilised]. It will also be harder to Heavy Stun them again for a short time afterwards.

[Physical] damage, and player (but not monster) [Melee] Damage, each cause 50% more [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup. For players, these bonuses are multiplicative with each other.
zh:
[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]会在目标的[Stun|晕眩]条填满时生效，打断他们当前的行动，并使其在数秒的时间内无法做出其他行动。[HitDamage|击中]会根据造成的伤害而产生重度晕眩积蓄。玩家和[Minion|召唤生物]通常不会受到[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]，但在特定行动期间（例如举起[Shield|盾牌]、使用[Buckler|轻盾]招架或骑乘坐骑时）可以获得[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]积蓄。

敌人受到重度晕眩时，他们无法行动并被视作[Immobilised|不可移动]，并且使其在短时间内更难以被重度晕眩。

[Physical|物理]伤害，以及玩家（并非怪物）的[Melee|近战]伤害，其[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]积蓄总增 50%。对玩家而言，这些额外加成可以按乘法叠加生效。

en: Players and their [Minion|Minions] usually cannot be [HeavyStun|Heavily Stunned], but players can receive [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup where specifically mentioned while taking specific actions (such as raising their [Shield], Parrying with a [Buckler], or riding a mount). A player's stun bar only empties when they are not taking these actions or [HeavyStun|Heavily Stunned]. While [HeavyStun|Heavily Stunned] players cannot [Block], [Deflect] or [Evasion|Evade].
zh: 玩家和[Minion|召唤生物]通常不会受到[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]，但在特定行动期间（例如举起[Shield|盾牌]、使用[Buckler|轻盾]招架或骑乘坐骑时）可以获得[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]积蓄。玩家的晕眩条只会在不处于这些行动期间或受到[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]时才会清空。在[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]期间，玩家不能[Block|格挡]、[Deflect|偏转]或[Evasion|闪避]。

en:
Electrocution is an [Ailments|Ailment] that interrupts the target's actions and prevents them performing any action, and lasts 5 seconds by default.

Only [Lightning] damage from [HitDamage|Hits] with specific skills or effects [Contributes] to Electrocution Buildup on enemies until they become [Electrocute|Electrocuted]. Other sources of [Lightning] damage will not build up towards Electrocution.
zh:
触电[Ailments|异常状态]可以打断目标的行动，并令其无法做出任何行动，默认持续 5 秒。

只有特定技能或消耗的[HitDamage|击中]造成的[Lightning|闪电]伤害能够[Contributes|作用于]敌人的触电积蓄，直到造成[Electrocute|触电]。其他来源的[Lightning|闪电]伤害无法积蓄触电。

en:
Certain skills and effects allow damage to build up Pinned. Once this build up passes the enemy's Pinned Threshold, they are Pinned, preventing them moving, being moved or [Evasion|Evading] for 3 seconds. They are also [LightStun|Light Stunned] when they become Pinned.

Pinned targets count as [Immobilised].
zh:
部分技能和效果可以使伤害产生定身积蓄值。该积蓄值超过目标的定身阈值后，目标就会被定身，使其无法移动、被强制移动或[Evasion|闪避]，持续 3 秒，被定身的时候还会造成[LightStun|轻度晕眩]。

被定身的目标也会被视作[Immobilised|不可移动]。

en: Overwhelm negates a certain amount of the target's [Physical|Physical] damage reduction, but never more than the total [Physical|Physical] damage reduction the target has.
zh: 镇压会消除目标一定数值的[Physical|物理]伤害减免，但无法超过目标的[Physical|物理]伤害减免总值。

en:
Melee [Attack|Attacks] are those that directly hit with a melee [Strike] or a [Slam], dealing Melee damage. Melee attacks usually scale from Weapon or Unarmed damage. 

Any [Projectile|Projectiles] these attacks create do not count as Melee damage.
zh:
近战[Attack|攻击]是近战[Strike|打击]或[Slam|猛击]的直接击中，造成近战伤害。近战攻击通常会受到武器或徒手伤害的调整。

这类攻击产生的[Projectile|投射物]不视作近战伤害。

en: Slams are [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] that cause damaging areas of effect, rather than [Strike|Striking] enemies with your weapon directly. Damage from Slams is still [Melee] damage.
zh: 猛击是造成伤害性范围效果的[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]，而非直接用武器[Strike|打击]敌人。猛击造成的伤害依然属于[Melee|近战]伤害。

en:
Effects that Chain are redirected to another target after colliding with an enemy.
[Projectile|Projectiles] [Split|Splitting], [Pierce|Piercing] or [Fork|Forking] take priority over Chaining.
Projectiles have a base chaining distance of 6 metres whereas other effects have a chaining distance of 4 metres. Enemies cannot be targeted more than once in the same Chain.
zh:
连锁的效果在击中一个敌人后重新导向附近的另一个目标。
[Projectile|投射物]的[Split|分裂]，[Pierce|穿透]或[Fork|分叉]优先于连锁。
投射物的基础连锁距离为 6 米，其他效果的连锁距离为 4 米。在同一次连锁中，敌人不能被重复作为目标。

en: [Projectile|Projectiles] that Pierce can pass through a target while still damaging them.
zh: 穿透[Projectile|投射物]可以穿过一个目标，并依然会对其造成伤害。

en: [Projectile|Projectiles] that Fork split into two the first time they collide with an enemy and do not [Split] from it or [Pierce] it.
zh: 具有分叉效果的[Projectile|投射物]第一次击中敌人时会一分为二，并且不会触发[Split|分裂]或[Pierce|穿透]。

en: The first time a [Projectile] or beam that can Split collides with a target, it splits into a multiple which will all aim at different targets within 6 metres if able. If there aren't enough targets, the rest will be aimed in random directions.
zh: 具有分裂效果的[Projectile|投射物]第一次击中敌人时会分裂成多个投射物，并瞄准附近 6 米内的多个目标。如果没有足够的目标，其余投射物将向随机方向射出。

en: Deflection Rating provides a chance to Deflect damage from [HitDamage|Hits], preventing 40% of the damage from those Hits. Exact chance to Deflect also depends on the attacker's [Accuracy].
