zh: 偏转值提供偏转[HitDamage|击中]伤害的几率，阻止这些击中伤害的 40%。成功偏转的实际几率也取决于攻击者的[Accuracy|命中]。

en: 50% of damage from Suppressed Hits and [Ailments] they inflict is prevented.
zh: 被压制的击中和[Ailments|异常状态]造成伤害的 50% 会被阻挡。

en:
Blocking completely prevents the damage of an incoming [HitDamage|Hit].

You will still take any [Stun] from the Blocked hit. You can't Block while [Stun|Stunned] or [Freeze|Frozen]. 

Some Skills used by Bosses cannot be blocked. These are indicated by a red glow and audio cue during the windup of the Skill.
zh:
格挡会完全阻挡一次即将受到的[HitDamage|击中]伤害。

你仍会受到被格挡的击中施加的[Stun|晕眩]状态。你无法在[Stun|晕眩]或[Freeze|冻结]时进行格挡。

首领使用的部分技能无法被格挡。这类技能在蓄力过程中会具有红光光芒和音效提示。

en: Chance to [Block] only includes modifiers that are explicitly chance-based. Guaranteed [Block] (such as raising your [Shield]) does not affect your Chance to [Block].
zh: [Block|格挡]几率仅包含几率类的词缀，必定[Block|格挡]（例如举起[Shield|盾牌]）不会影响你的[Block|格挡]几率。

en: Overcapped [ChanceToBlock|Block Chance] is the amount by which your [ChanceToBlock|Chance to Block] would exceed your maximum [ChanceToBlock|Chance to Block] if it were uncapped.
zh: 超量[ChanceToBlock|格挡几率]是指当你可超出上限时，你的[ChanceToBlock|格挡几率]超过[ChanceToBlock|格挡几率]上限的数值。

en: A Strike is a [Melee] attack that directly hits with weapons or body parts. [Slam] attacks do not count as Strikes.
zh: 打击是使用武器或身体部位直接击中目标的[Melee|近战]攻击。[Slam|猛击]攻击不视作打击。

en:
A Projectile is a moving [Attack] or [Spell] that usually impacts with targets when it hits them.

When a group of multiple Projectiles is fired from the same source at the same time, only one Projectile in the group can hit each target unless otherwise specified.
zh:
投射物是会移动的[Attack|攻击]或[Spell|法术]，通常会在撞击时击中目标。

同一来源在同一时间发射一组多个投射物时，除非另有说明，否则每个目标只会被该组投射物中的一个投射物击中。

en:
Resistances reduce damage taken of the corresponding damage type — [Fire], [Cold], [Lightning] or [Chaos] — up to a [MaximumResistances|Maximum]. [Fire], [Cold] and [Lightning] Resistances are Elemental Resistances. Resistances can be improved with Equipment, Passives & Quest items.

Your Elemental Resistances are lowered as you progress through the game. Elemental Resistances are a vital defensive tool, and should be one of the first things to check if you're having difficulty surviving.
zh:
抗性会降低受到的对应类型的伤害，包括[Fire|火焰]、[Cold|冰霜]、[Lightning|闪电]或[Chaos|混沌]伤害，但存在[MaximumResistances|上限]。[Fire|火焰]、[Cold|冰霜]和[Lightning|闪电]抗性属于元素抗性。抗性可以通过装备、天赋和任务物品来提高。

随着游戏进程推进，玩家的元素抗性将会降低。元素抗性是一种至关重要的防御手段，如果你在生存方面遇到困难，这应该是首要检查的事项之一。

en:
Critical Hits deal +100% extra damage (i.e. twice as much damage) by default. [CriticalDamageBonus|Critical Damage Bonuses] can further modify this value.

[Attack|Attacks] usually use your weapon's base Critical Hit Chance, while [Spell|Spells] and some other skills have their base Critical Hit Chance listed on the skill. 

Most modifiers to Critical Hit Chance are percentage based. For example, gaining 100% increased Critical Hit Chance on a base Critical Hit Chance of 7% would result in a final Critical Hit Chance of 14%.
zh:
暴击默认情况下会造成 +100% 的额外伤害（即双倍伤害）。
[CriticalDamageBonus|暴击伤害加成]可以进一步调整这一数值。

[Attack|攻击]通常会使用武器的基础暴击率，[Spell|法术]和一些技能则会使用在技能中列出的基础暴击率。

大部分暴击率词缀都是基于比例的。例如，如果基础暴击率为 7%，而暴击率提高 100%，则最终的暴击率为 14%。

en: Multiplies the damage dealt by [Critical|Critical Hits]. Default value is +100% (i.e. twice as much damage).
zh: 使[Critical|暴击]造成的伤害倍增。默认数值为 +100%（即双倍伤害）。

en: Jagged Ground [Slow|Slows] the movement speed of enemies in its area by 20%.
zh: 崎岖之地使区域内的敌人的移动速度[Slow|减速] 20%。

en:
Totems are [Allies|allied] constructs which use skills for you. Totems are not [Minion|Minions] and their skills benefit from your stats, though they have their own defensive stats and can be damaged or killed.

Totem Limit is shared between different types of Totem by default.
zh:
图腾是[Allies|友军]构造体，可以为你使用技能。图腾不属于[Minion|召唤生物]，它们的技能可以从你的属性中收益，但也具有独立的防御属性，可以受到伤害或被击败。

在默认情况下，不同类型的图腾共享图腾上限。

en: Enemies you Taunt can only target you, and deal 10% less damage with [HitDamage|hits] to anyone else. If not otherwise specified, Taunt lasts for 3 seconds.
zh: 受你嘲讽的敌人只会以你为目标，对其他单位造成的[HitDamage|击中]伤害总降 10%。除非另有说明，否则嘲讽持续 3 秒。

en: Empowered Skills do not have any inherent bonuses, but a number of stats and modifiers specifically apply to Empowered Skills.
zh: 强化技能不具有固有加成，但一些属性和词缀会专门对强化技能生效。

en:
Monster Power is a number that approximately reflects how strong and dangerous a monster is. An average monster has a Power of 1, strong monsters can have Power of 2 to 3, and weak monsters might have as little as 0.5, or very occasionally less. This value is then multiplied according to the monster's [Rarity]:

Normal: 1
Magic: 2
Rare: 5

Unique monsters always have 20 Power.
zh:
怪物威力值大致反映出了怪物的强度和危险性。平平无奇的怪物威力值为 1，强大怪物的威力值为 2 或者 3，较弱的怪物可能只有 0.5，偶尔还会更低。这一数值还会与怪物的[Rarity|稀有度]相乘结算：

普通：1
魔法：2
稀有：5

传奇怪物始终具有 20 威力值。

en:
Armour reduces [HitDamage|Damage taken from Hits]. By default, Armour only applies to [Physical] [HitDamage|Damage].

Damage reduction from Armour is proportional to the amount of [HitDamage|Damage], and is more effective at reducing smaller hits.
zh:
护甲会降低[HitDamage|击中伤害]。默认情况下，护甲只对[Physical|物理][HitDamage|伤害]有效。

护甲的伤害减免与[HitDamage|伤害]量成正比，对低伤害的击中更为有效。

en: Enemies taking [Fire] damage over time are Burning. Usually this occurs because the enemy is [Ignite|Ignited].
zh: 受到[Fire|火焰]持续伤害的敌人会处于燃烧状态，这通常是因为该敌人已被[Ignite|点燃]。

en: A Frozen target cannot move or act. Targets become Frozen when they reach 100% [Freeze] buildup.
zh: 被冻结的目标无法移动或行动。目标的[Freeze|冻结]积蓄达到 100% 时就会被冻结。

en: Evasion Rating grants a chance to Evade enemy [HitDamage|Hits], preventing them from [HitDamage|Hitting] you at all. Exact chance to Evade also depends on the attacker's [Accuracy].
zh: 闪避值提供闪避敌人[HitDamage|击中]的几率，完全避免被[HitDamage|击中]。实际闪避几率也取决于攻击者的[Accuracy|命中]。

en:
Accuracy is used to hit a target with an [Attack|Attack], and is checked against the targets [Evasion] to determine that chance. 

Player [Attack|Attacks] incur an Accuracy penalty based on distance from the origin of the damage to the target, with no penalty for targets within 2 metres and up to 90% less Accuracy for targets further than 9 metres away.
zh:
命中用于使[Attack|攻击]能够击中目标，并会根据目标的[Evasion|闪避]进行检测，以确定命中的几率。

玩家的[Attack|攻击]会根据伤害来源与目标之间的距离，获得一定的命中惩罚。对 2 米内的目标没有惩罚，对 9 米外的目标命中总降 90%。

en:
Energy Shield protects your Life by taking damage instead. Rapidly [ESRecharge|Recharges] if you don't lose Energy Shield for a short time.
[Chaos] damage removes twice as much Energy Shield.
Damage from [Bleeding] and [Poison] bypasses Energy Shield to remove Life directly.
zh:
能量护盾会代替生命承受伤害，短时间内未损失能量护盾时能够快速[ESRecharge|充能]。
[Chaos|混沌]伤害会扣除双倍的能量护盾。
[Bleeding|流血]和[Poison|中毒]的伤害会忽略能量护盾，直接扣除生命。

en: Normal enemies are Primed for [Electrocute|Electrocution] when they have at least 40% Electrocution buildup. Magic enemies are instead Primed at 50% buildup, Rare at 60%, and Unique at 70%.
zh: 普通敌人具有至少 40% 触电积蓄值时可被[Electrocute|触电]。魔法敌人为 50%，稀有敌人为 60%，传奇敌人为 70%。

en: Normal enemies are Primed for [Stun] when they have at least 40% Heavy Stun buildup. Magic enemies are instead Primed at 50% buildup, Rare at 60%, and Unique at 70%.
zh: 普通敌人具有至少 40% 重度晕眩积蓄值时可被[Stun|晕眩]。魔法敌人为 50%，稀有敌人为 60%，传奇敌人为 70%。

en: Normal enemies are Primed for [Freeze] when they have at least 40% Freeze buildup. Magic enemies are instead Primed at 50% buildup, Rare at 60%, and Unique at 70%.
zh: 普通敌人具有至少 40% 冻结积蓄时可被[Freeze|冻结]。魔法敌人为 50%，稀有敌人为 60%，传奇敌人为 70%。

en:
Slows are modifiers from [Debuff|Debuffs] that cause actions to take longer. Slows can apply to a specific stat (such as attack speed or movement speed) — if a specific type of slow is not specified, it applies to everything the affected entity does. Slows are always multiplicative with each other.

Higher [Rarity] enemies are less affected by Slows:

15% less Slow effect on Magic monsters
30% less Slow effect on Rare monsters
50% less Slow effect on Unique monsters

Additionally, Slows have 10% less effect on all monsters for each player in the area beyond the first and monsters cannot be slowed below 25% of their base speed.
zh:
减速是由[Debuff|减益状态]产生的词缀，能够使行动所需的时间延长。减速可以对特定属性生效（例如攻击速度或者移动速度）。如果未指定减速类型，则会对受影响目标的所有速度生效。多个减速效果始终为乘法叠加。

高[Rarity|稀有度]的敌人不太容易受到减速影响：

魔法怪物受到的减速效果总降 15%
稀有怪物受到的减速效果总降 30%
传奇怪物受到的减速效果总降 50%

另外，如果区域内的玩家多于一人，每多出一名玩家，所有怪物受到的减速效果总降 10%，且怪物速度不能被减慢至其基础速度的 25% 以下。

en: [ItemRarity|Item] or [MonsterRarity|Monster] rarity can be Normal (grey), Magic (blue), Rare (yellow) or Unique (brown). As a general rule, monsters increase in difficulty depending on their Rarity.
zh: [ItemRarity|物品]或[MonsterRarity|怪物]的稀有度包括了普通（灰色）、魔法（蓝色）、稀有（黄色）和传奇（棕色）。一般来说，怪物的难度会随稀有度的提高而提高。

en: Faster Start of Energy Shield Recharge
zh: 能量护盾充能启动速度加快

en: Affects the delay before your [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] starts [ESRecharge|Recharging] after losing Energy Shield.
zh: 影响损失能量护盾后，[EnergyShield|能量护盾]开始[ESRecharge|充能]前的延迟。

en: Affects how quickly [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] is recovered by [ESRecharge|Recharge] once it starts Recharging.
zh: 影响[EnergyShield|能量护盾]开始[ESRecharge|充能]之后的回复速度。

en:
Any damage that isn't damage over time is Hit damage.

[DamagingAilments|Damaging Ailments] which result from a Hit will calculate their damage from that Hit, and will not subsequently have Damage modifiers applied directly to them. As a result of this, raising Hit Damage will result in more powerful Damaging Ailments innately.
zh:
任何非持续伤害，都属于击中伤害。

由击中造成的[DamagingAilments|伤害性异常状态]将基于该次击中计算其伤害，并不会再直接受到伤害加成的影响。因此，提高击中伤害会自然提升异常状态的伤害。

en:
Spells are skills that use raw magic to destroy your enemies. [Attack|Attacks] are not Spells.

Spells have their own base damage, cast speed and [Critical|Critical Hit] chance determined by the skill. They do not benefit from a weapon's inherent damage, attack speed or [Critical|Critical Hit] chance.
zh:
法术是使用源生的魔法来摧毁敌人的技能。[Attack|攻击]不属于法术。

法术具有独立的基础伤害、施法速度和[Critical|暴击]几率，具体由法术本身决定。它们不受武器的固有伤害、攻击速度或[Critical|暴击]几率影响。

en:
Attacks are skills that directly damage enemies, usually using your equipped [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon]. [Spell|Spells] are not Attacks.

The base damage, attack speed and [Critical|critical hit] chance of an attack are determined using your [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon]'s stats unless the skill says otherwise.

Attacks do not necessarily deal [Physical] damage — they can deal any damage type.
zh:
攻击是直接使用装备的[MartialWeapon|战斗武器]对敌人造成伤害的技能。[Spell|法术]不属于攻击。

除非技能另有说明，攻击的基础伤害、攻击速度和[Critical|暴击]几率会基于你的[MartialWeapon|战斗武器]的属性。

攻击不一定会造成[Physical|物理]伤害，它们可以造成任意类型的伤害。

en:
Traps are [Two-Handed] ranged weapons that require [Dexterity] and [Intelligence] to equip. Traps cannot be used to [Attack] directly. 

Throwing a Trap places it on the ground, where it can either be detonated manually or triggered by [CloseRange|Close by] enemies depending on the Trap type.
zh:
陷阱是[Two-Handed|双手]远程武器，需要[Dexterity|敏捷]和[Intelligence|智慧]才能装备。陷阱无法直接进行[Attack|攻击]。

投掷陷阱会将其放在地上，随后可以手动引爆，或者由附近[CloseRange|接近]的敌人触发，具体取决于陷阱的类型。

en: Withered applies 5% increased [Chaos] damage Taken, and can be inflicted up to 10 times.
zh: 死亡凋零会使受到的[Chaos|混沌]伤害提高 5%，最多造成 10 次。

en: Crushed lowers [Physical] Damage Reduction by 15%. This can result in [Physical] Damage Reduction being negative, causing more damage to be taken.
zh: 碾压使[Physical|物理]伤害减免降低 15%。[Physical|物理]伤害减免可被降为负值，从而导致其承受更多伤害。

en: Crushing Blows cause a [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] on enemies that are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun].
zh: 粉碎打击会对[PrimedStun|可被晕眩]的敌人造成[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]。

en: Hits have up to +6% [Critical|Critical Hit] Chance against Brittle enemies, based on the [Cold] damage of the Hit which inflicted Brittle, for 4 seconds.
zh: 对脆弱的敌人的击中[Critical|暴击]几率提高最多 +6%，由造成脆弱的击中的[Cold|冰霜]伤害决定，持续 4 秒。

en: Quest items are used to progress the story. They cannot be sold or stashed, but can be discarded. Discarded quest items can be reobtained from their original source.
zh: 任务物品是推进剧情的关键，无法出售或储存，但是可以丢弃。丢弃的任务物品可以从原处重新获得。

en:
Swords are [Melee] weapons that can be [One-Handed] or [Two-Handed]. Swords require [Strength] and [Dexterity] to equip. 

Sword [Attack|Attacks] are commonly related to elemental damage.
zh:
剑类武器是[One-Handed|单手]或[Two-Handed|双手]使用的[Melee|近战]武器。剑类武器需要[Strength|力量]和[Dexterity|敏捷]才能装备。

剑类武器的[Attack|攻击]通常与元素伤害相关。

en:
Maces are [Melee] weapons that can be [One-Handed] or [Two-Handed]. Maces require [Strength] to equip. 

Mace [Attack|Attacks] are often [Slam|Slams] or slow [Strike|Strikes] that deal [Physical] or [Fire] damage.
zh:
锤类武器是[One-Handed|单手]或[Two-Handed|双手]使用的[Melee|近战]武器。锤类武器需要[Strength|力量]才能装备。

锤类武器的[Attack|攻击]通常为[Slam|猛击]或缓慢的[Strike|打击]，能造成[Physical|物理]或[Fire|火焰]伤害。

en:
Sceptres are [One-Handed] weapons that require [Strength] and [Intelligence] to equip. Sceptres can be equipped in your main hand or off hand, but you cannot [DualWield|Dual Wield] two Sceptres. 

Sceptres cannot be used to [Attack] and do not grant bonuses to [Spell|Spellcasting]. Instead, they grant additional [Spirit] and can provide bonuses to your [Allies].
zh:
权杖是[One-Handed|单手]武器，需要[Strength|力量]和[Intelligence|智慧]才能装备。权杖可以装备在主手或副手，但无法[DualWield|双持]两把权杖。

权杖无法用于[Attack|攻击]，也不提供[Spell|施法]加成。它们能提供额外的[Spirit|精魂]，还能为[Allies|友军]提供加成。

en:
Wands are [One-Handed] [Spell|Spellcasting] weapons that require [Intelligence] to equip. 

Wands cannot be [DualWield|Dual Wielded] and cannot be used to [Attack] directly. However, they grant inbuilt [Spell|Spells] based on the wand type and powerful bonuses to spells.
zh:
法杖是[One-Handed|单手][Spell|施法]武器，需要[Intelligence|智慧]才能装备。

法杖无法[DualWield|双持]，也不能直接用于[Attack|攻击]。法杖会根据自身的类型提供内置的[Spell|法术]，还能提供强大的法术加成。

en:
Axes are [Melee] weapons that can be [One-Handed] or [Two-Handed]. Axes require [Strength] and [Dexterity] to equip. 

Axe [Attack|Attacks] commonly involve throwing your axe and/or inflicting [Bleeding].
zh:
斧类武器是[One-Handed|单手]或[Two-Handed|双手]使用的[Melee|近战]武器。斧类武器需要[Strength|力量]和[Dexterity|敏捷]才能装备。

斧类武器的[Attack|攻击]通常与掷斧和/或造成[Bleeding|流血]相关。

en:
Bows are [Two-Handed] ranged weapons that require [Dexterity] to equip. Equipping a Bow allows you to also equip a [Quiver] in the off hand slot. 

Bows can [Attack] from long range and with high mobility using a variety of skills, but generally deal less damage than other two-handed weapon types.
zh:
弓类武器是[Two-Handed|双手]武器，需要[Dexterity|敏捷]才能装备。装备弓类武器可以允许你在副手栏位中装备[Quiver|箭袋]。

弓类武器可以进行远距离[Attack|攻击]，可以使用多种技能来获得高机动性，但造成的伤害低于其他双手武器。

en:
Daggers are [One-Handed] [Melee] weapons that require [Dexterity] and [Intelligence] to equip. 

Dagger [Attack|Attacks] are commonly related to ambushing or debilitating enemies. Some blade-related [Spell|Spells] also require a Dagger.
zh:
匕首是[One-Handed|单手][Melee|近战]武器，需要[Dexterity|敏捷]和[Intelligence|智慧]才能装备。

匕首的[Attack|攻击]通常与伏击相关，还能使敌人疲惫。部分利刃相关的[Spell|法术]也需要一把匕首。

en:
Staves are [Two-Handed] [Spell|Spellcasting] weapons that require [Intelligence] to equip. 
Staves cannot be used to [Attack]. However, they grant inbuilt [Spell|Spells] based on the staff type and powerful bonuses to spells.
zh:
长杖是[Two-Handed|双手][Spell|施法]武器，需要[Intelligence|智慧]才能装备。
长杖不能用于[Attack|攻击]。长杖会根据自身的类型提供内置的[Spell|法术]，还能提供强大的法术加成。

en:
Claws are [One-Handed] [Melee] weapons that require [Dexterity] to equip. Claws can be [DualWield|Dual Wielded] with another Claw, but cannot be combined with other equipped items in the off hand.

Claw [Attack|Attacks] are commonly fast and cause [Bleeding].
zh:
爪类武器是[One-Handed|单手][Melee|近战]武器，需要[Dexterity|敏捷]才能装备。爪类武器可以与另一把爪类武器一起[DualWield|双持]，但无法与副手装备的其他武器组合使用。

爪类武器的[Attack|攻击]通常非常迅捷，还能造成[Bleeding|流血]。

en:
Talismans are [Two-Handed] [Melee] weapons that require [Strength] and [Intelligence] to equip.

Talismans allow you to use [Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] Skills associated with the Talisman's current form, and grants a basic Attack for that form. You can change the Talisman's form at any time.

While you have a Talisman in your active weapon set you will [Shapeshift] into its associated form. As a result, Skills that cannot be used in a [Shapeshift] form cannot be used with Talismans. [Trigger|Triggered] Skills and [Persistent] Skills will continue to function.
zh:
魔符是[Two-Handed|双手][Melee|近战]武器，需要[Strength|力量]和[Intelligence|智慧]才能装备。

魔符可让你使用与当前形态关联的[Shapeshift|变形]技能，赋予你该形态下的基础攻击。你可以随时切换魔符的形态。

当你激活的武器组中装备有魔符时，你将[Shapeshift|变形]为其关联的形态。因此，无法在[Shapeshift|变形]形态下使用的技能，也无法与魔符一同使用。[Trigger|触发]类技能与[Persistent|永久性]技能将继续生效。

en:
Shields are armour items that are equipped in your off hand. While holding a Shield you have a chance to passively [Block]. Most Shields can also be raised to [Block] all incoming [Strike|Strikes] and [Projectile|Projectiles] from the front.

[Buckler|Bucklers] are a special type of Shield that do not grant any [Armour] and can Parry enemy skills instead of being raised to [Block].
zh:
盾牌是装备于副手的护甲类物品。持有盾牌时，你有几率被动地[Block|格挡]。你还可以举起大部分类型的盾牌，[Block|格挡]所有来自正面的[Strike|打击]和[Projectile|投射物]。

[Buckler|轻盾]是一种特殊类型的盾牌，不提供任何[Armour|护甲]，并且能够招架敌人的技能，而非举盾[Block|格挡]。

en: Armoured [Shield|Shields] are any [Shield|Shields] that grant the player [Armour] — that is, any type of [Shield] other than [Buckler|Bucklers].
zh: 护甲[Shield|盾牌]指的是任意为玩家提供[Armour|护甲]的[Shield|盾牌]，即除了[Buckler|轻盾]之外的所有[Shield|盾牌]。

en: Bucklers are a special type of [Shield] that do not grant any [Armour] and can [Parry] enemy skills instead of being raised to [Block].
zh: 轻盾是一种特殊的[Shield|盾牌]，不提供[Armour|护甲]，无法举盾[Block|格挡]，但可以[Parry|招架]敌人的技能。

en:
Foci are armour items that are equipped in your off hand and require [Intelligence] to equip. 

Foci can grant significant amounts of [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] and powerful bonuses to your [Spell|Spells].
zh:
法器是装备于副手的护甲物品，需要[Intelligence|智慧]才能装备。

法器可以提供大量[EnergyShield|能量护盾]，还能为[Spell|法术]提供强大的加成。

en:
Quarterstaves are [Two-Handed] [Melee] weapons that require [Dexterity] and [Intelligence] to equip. 

Quarterstaff [Attack|Attacks] often focus on high mobility in combat.
zh:
节杖是[Two-Handed|双手][Melee|近战]武器，需要[Dexterity|敏捷]和[Intelligence|智慧]才能装备。

节杖的[Attack|攻击]通常注重在战斗中维持机动性。

en:
Spears are [One-Handed] [Melee] weapons that require [Strength] and [Dexterity] to equip. Spears cannot be dual wielded. 

Spear combat is often a mix of both ranged and [Melee], as many spear skills enable you to throw your spear.
zh:
战矛是[One-Handed|单手][Melee|近战]武器，需要[Strength|力量]和[Dexterity|敏捷]才能装备。战矛无法双持。

战矛的战斗方式结合了远程和[Melee|近战]，包含了许多投掷战矛的技能。

en:
Crossbows are [Two-Handed] ranged weapons that require [Strength] and [Dexterity] to equip. Crossbow basic [Attack|Attacks] can be modified with [Ammunition|Ammunition Skills].

Multiple [Projectile|Projectiles] fired from a single Crossbow skill can all hit the same target, and single-[Projectile] skills fire additional [Projectile|Projectiles] in sequence rather than in a spread.
zh:
战弩是[Two-Handed|双手]远程武器，需要[Strength|力量]和[Dexterity|敏捷]才能装备。战弩的基础[Attack|攻击]可以通过[Ammunition|弹药技能]更改。

单个战弩技能发射的多个[Projectile|投射物]可以击中同一个目标，并且单发[Projectile|投射物]技能会连续发射额外[Projectile|投射物]，而非并排发射。

en:
Flails are [One-Handed] [Melee] weapons that require [Strength] and [Intelligence] to equip. Flails cannot be [DualWield|Dual Wielded]. 

Flail [Attack|Attacks] tend to reward careful placement and long wind-up times with devastating effects.
zh:
连枷是[One-Handed|单手][Melee|近战]武器，需要[Strength|力量]和[Intelligence|智慧]才能装备。连枷无法[DualWield|双持]。

连枷的[Attack|攻击]需要巧妙的站位，并且起手时间较长，但效果非常显著。

en:
Flasks can be used to recover your Life or Mana. Flasks are not consumable, but require charges to use. Flask charges can be regained by killing enemies. 

[Rarity|Normal] enemies grant Flask charges equal to half their [Power]
[Rarity|Magic] enemies grant Flask charges equal to their [Power]
[Rarity|Rare] and [Rarity|Unique] enemies grant Flask charges equal to twice their [Power]

[Checkpoint|Checkpoints] and [Wells] completely refill Flasks when activated. Flasks can only hold charges while in a Flask slot.
zh:
药剂可以用于回复生命或魔力。药剂不属于消耗品，但需要充能才可以使用。击败敌人可以补充药剂充能。

[Rarity|普通]敌人能够提供相当于[Power|威力值]一半的药剂充能。
[Rarity|魔法]敌人能够提供相当于[Power|威力值]的药剂充能。
[Rarity|稀有]和[Rarity|传奇]敌人能够提供相当于[Power|威力值]双倍的药剂充能。

[Checkpoint|记录点]和[Wells|水井]在激活时能够完全补满药剂。药剂仅有放置在药剂栏位时才能获得充能。

en:
Utility Flasks can only hold charges while in a flask slot. They can be bound to action buttons to trigger strategically during combat. Utility Flasks offer a buff or combat ability for a limited time. 

Flasks refill at [Checkpoint|Checkpoints], [Wells|Wells] or by killing Monsters. More powerful Monsters will grant more charges.
zh:
功能药剂仅有放置在药剂栏位时才能获得充能。它们可以绑定在操作按键上，在战斗中适时触发。功能药剂可在限定时间内提供增益状态或战斗能力。

药剂可在[Checkpoint|记录点]或[Wells|水井]处补充，也可以通过击败怪物补充。怪物越强大，提供的充能越多。

en: Quivers are off hand items that are only usable while you have a [Bow] equipped. Quivers provide a variety of bonuses to Bow [Attack|Attacks].
zh: 箭袋是副手物品，只能在装备[Bow|弓类]武器时使用。箭袋可为弓类武器的[Attack|攻击]提供多种加成。

en:
Spirit is a reserve of power used to activate and maintain skills with permanent effects. Spirit-powered skills are managed within the Skills Panel.

[WeaponSets|Weapon Sets] can have differing amounts of available Spirit, due to weapons with Spirit (such as [Sceptre|Sceptres]), [WeaponSetPassiveSkillPoints|Weapon Set Passive Skills], or [Persistent] Skills that are active in specific [WeaponSets|Weapon Sets].
zh:
精魂是一种保留的力量，能用于激活和维持永久性效果。可在技能面板中管理消耗精魂的技能。

[WeaponSets|武器组]可能有不同的可用精魂量，这取决于带有精魂的武器（如[Sceptre|权杖]）、[WeaponSetPassiveSkillPoints|武器组天赋技能]或在特定[WeaponSets|武器组]中激活的[Persistent|永久性]技能。

en: One-handed weapons can be placed in the main weapon slot. Some one-handed weapon types can be dual wielded in both main and off hand weapon slots.
zh: 单手武器可以放在主手武器栏位中。部分单手武器类型可以放在主手和副手武器栏位中，从而实现双持。

en: Two-handed weapons take up both weapon slots when equipped.
zh: 双手武器装备时会占用两个武器栏位。

en:
Your allies include other players, [Minion|Minions], and any other entity that fights alongside you and has its own stats. 

You do not count as your own Ally.
zh:
友军包括了其他玩家、[Minion|召唤生物]，以及其他与你并肩作战、具有独立属性的实体。

你不算作是自己的友军。

en: Dual Wielding refers to using two [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapons], one in each hand.
zh: 双持指的是装备两把[MartialWeapon|战斗武器]，每只手各握持一把。

en: Minions are summoned [Allies] which will accompany and fight alongside you. [Persistent] Minions will reserve a portion of [Spirit] while active.
zh: 召唤生物是陪伴你，并为你作战的[Allies|友军]。[Persistent|永久性]召唤生物激活时会保留一部分[Spirit|精魂]。

en: Warcries are skills which count enemy [Power] within their area and [Empowered|Empower] your subsequent Melee [Attack|Attacks], sometimes depending on the total [Power] of enemies counted.
zh: 战吼技能会计算作用范围内敌人的[Power|威力值]，并以此[Empowered|强化]你后续的近战[Attack|攻击]，效果有时取决于所统计的敌人的总[Power|威力值]。

en:
Curses significantly [Debuff] affected targets. By default a target can have one Curse on them at a time.

Higher [Rarity] enemies are less affected by Curses:

15% less Curse effect on Magic monsters
30% less Curse effect on Rare monsters
50% less Curse effect on Unique monsters
zh:
诅咒会大幅[Debuff|减益]受影响的目标。默认情况下，一个目标同一时间只能受到一种诅咒影响。

更高[Rarity|稀有度]的敌人受到的诅咒效果更少：
魔法怪物受到的诅咒效果总降 15%
稀有怪物受到的诅咒效果总降 30%
传奇怪物受到的诅咒效果总降 50%

en:
[Curse|Curses] you inflict have 4% increased [Curse] [BuffMagnitude|Magnitudes] for each Dark Whisper you have. You can have a maximum of 10 Dark Whispers.

Dark Whispers last for 8 seconds, and this duration is refreshed whenever you gain more.

When Dark Whispers expire, you Lose 3% of Life, Mana, and Energy Shield for each of them, over 4 seconds.
zh:
你施加的[Curse|诅咒]每拥有一层暗言，[Curse|诅咒][BuffMagnitude|强度]就提高 4%。你最多可拥有 10 层暗言。

暗言持续 8 秒，当你获得新层数时，此持续时间会刷新。

当暗言消失时，每一层会使你在 4 秒内失去 3% 的生命、魔力和能量护盾。

en: Aftershocks are bursts of area damage that occur after the initial impact of the skill causing them. If not otherwise specified, the Aftershock will deal the same damage as the initial impact, in the same area. Only Attack damage can cause Aftershocks.
zh: 余震是相关技能在初始冲击后产生的爆发，造成范围伤害。除非另有说明，否则余震的伤害量和效果区域都与初始冲击相同。只有攻击伤害能够造成余震。

en: The Elusive buff grants increased Movement Speed, and additional chance to avoid damage. The effects of Elusive are reduced over time.
zh: 灵巧增益会提高移动速度，还有额外几率避免伤害。灵巧的效果会随时间递减。

en: Shocked Ground [Shock|Shocks] those standing in it, and lasts 6 seconds by default.
zh: 感电地面会对站在其中的单位施加[Shock|感电]，并且默认持续 6 秒。

en:
When you deal damage with a [HitDamage|Hit], [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] Leech causes you to recover an amount of [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] to a percentage of the damage dealt, over a period of one second.

Hits that deal more than 40,000 total damage are treated as though they only dealt 40,000 damage for this calculation. If this damage is of multiple [DamageTypes|Damage Types], the ratios between them will stay the same.

Monsters have Leech Resistance that increases with monster level, reducing how much you recover from Leech from [HitDamage|Hits] against them.

You can only recover from a single instance of [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] Leech at a time, and all [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] Leech is removed when [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] is filled.

Modifiers specific to Life Leech will not apply to Energy Shield Leech.
zh:
当你造成[HitDamage|击中]伤害时，[EnergyShield|能量护盾]偷取会在 1 秒内回复一定数量的[EnergyShield|能量护盾]，数值等于造成伤害的一定比例。

若一次击中的总伤害超过 40,000，则在该计算中仅视为 40,000 伤害。若该伤害包含多种[DamageTypes|伤害类型]，其比例保持不变。

怪物拥有偷取抗性，抗性随怪物等级提升而增加，从而降低你通过[HitDamage|击中]获得的偷取回复量。

你每次只能从单个[EnergyShield|能量护盾]偷取实例中回复怒火，且当[EnergyShield|能量护盾]值满时，所有[EnergyShield|能量护盾]偷取效果都会被移除。

专门的生命偷取词缀不会应用于能量护盾偷取。

en: You are considered Unarmed while you have no equipped [MartialWeapon|Martial] or [CasterWeapon|Caster Weapon].
zh: 当你没有装备[MartialWeapon|战斗武器]或[CasterWeapon|施法武器]时，你被视为徒手状态。

en:
Unarmed [Attack|Attacks] are [Attack|Attacks] which are performed while [Unarmed] and use your character's base [UnarmedDamage|Unarmed Damage] where other [Attack|Attacks] would use the base [HitDamage|Damage] from a [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon].

[Attack|Attacks] which can be performed while [Unarmed] but draw their base damage from other sources, such as skills which use a [Shield] to attack, are not considered Unarmed Attacks.
zh:
徒手[Attack|攻击]是在[Unarmed|徒手]状态下进行的[Attack|攻击]，它们使用角色的基础[UnarmedDamage|徒手伤害]来计算，而其他[Attack|攻击]则使用[MartialWeapon|战斗武器]的基础[HitDamage|伤害]。

可以在[Unarmed|徒手]状态下进行、但其基础伤害来源于其他途径的[Attack|攻击]，例如使用[Shield|盾牌]进行攻击的技能，不被视为徒手攻击。

en:
Unarmed Damage refers to the [HitDamage|Hit Damage] of [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attacks]. As such, Unarmed Damage is always [Attack] [HitDamage].

Players' base Unarmed Damage is [Physical], and has a minimum roll of 2, and a maximum roll between 5 - 8, depending on how aligned their class is with [Strength].

Other Damage is not considered Unarmed Damage, even if you are [Unarmed] while dealing it.
zh:
徒手伤害指的是[UnarmedAttack|徒手攻击]的[HitDamage|击中伤害]。因此，徒手伤害总是[Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中伤害]。

玩家的基础徒手伤害为[Physical|物理]伤害，其最小值固定为 2，最大值在 5 - 8 之间，具体取决于角色的职业与[Strength|力量]属性的契合程度。

其他伤害即使是在[Unarmed|徒手]状态下造成的，也不视为徒手伤害。

en: Orb Skills create lasting effects at a location which damage enemies in an area around them.
zh: 法球技能会在一个位置产生长时间的效果，对周围的敌人造成伤害。

en:
Exposure is a type of [Debuff] that lowers the affected enemy's [Total] [Resistances|Elemental Resistances]. By default it lowers [Resistances] by -20% and lasts for 4 seconds, though some sources of exposure can override these values. Like most sources of lowering [Resistances], this can cause the enemy's [Resistances|Resistance] to become negative.

Higher [Rarity] enemies are less affected by Exposure:

15% less Exposure effect on Magic monsters
30% less Exposure effect on Rare monsters
50% less Exposure effect on Unique monsters
zh:
曝露是一种[Debuff|减益状态]，能够降低受影响敌人的[Resistances|元素抗性][Total|总值]。默认情况下，曝露会使[Resistances|抗性] -20%，持续 4 秒，但部分来源的曝露可以覆盖这些数值。和大部分降低[Resistances|抗性]的效果一样，曝露可以使敌人的[Resistances|抗性]变为负值。

更高[Rarity|稀有度]的敌人受到的曝露效果更少：
魔法怪物曝露效果总降 15%
稀有怪物曝露效果总降 30%
传奇怪物曝露效果总降 50%

en:
Several [Meta] Skills generate and use Energy. Each Skill which generates Energy has its own Energy count particular to that Skill. Most effects which use Energy do so to [Trigger] other effects or Skills, based on the use time of the triggered Skill. When calculating Energy gain or consumption from the use time of a Skill, modifiers to [Total] use time are treated as though they were double the value.

Energy cannot be gained from direct effects of [Trigger|Triggered] Skills.
zh:
部分[Meta|非凡]技能会生成并使用能量，每个技能生成的能量专属于该技能。大部分效果都会通过消耗能量来[Trigger|触发]其他效果和技能，取决于触发技能的使用时间。通过技能使用时间计算能量获取或消耗时，[Total|总]使用时间的词缀数值视为双倍。

[Trigger|被触发]的技能的直接效果无法获得能量。

en:
Ice Crystals are solid blocks of ice which can be damaged. When destroyed, Ice Crystals will deal [Cold|Cold] damage in an area. Ice Crystals will block the movement of smaller monsters, while larger monsters will destroy Ice Crystals in their path.

Skills which [Consume] [Freeze] will instantly shatter Ice Crystals, causing them to deal more damage in a larger area.
zh:
冰晶是坚固的冰块，可以受到伤害。被摧毁时，冰晶会在周围造成[Cold|冰霜]伤害。冰晶会阻挡较小体型怪物的移动，大体型怪物则会直接摧毁路径上的冰晶。

[Consume|消耗][Freeze|冻结]的技能会立即击碎冰晶，使其在更大区域造成更多伤害。

en: Skills which [Consume] [Freeze] will instantly shatter [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals], causing them to deal more damage in a larger area.
zh: [Consume|消耗][Freeze|冻结]的技能会立即击碎[IceCrystals|冰晶]，使其在更大区域造成更多伤害。

en: [Projectile|Projectiles] which Return will Return to the entity which originated them after reaching the end of their travel, or on hitting a final target.
zh: 归返[Projectile|投射物]会在抵达飞行终点或击中最终目标时，返回产生它们的实体处。

en: While Phasing, you can pass through enemies without being blocked by them.
zh: 在迷踪状态下，你可以穿越敌人，不会被他们阻挡。

en: Corpses are left behind by slain Enemies and can be used or consumed by a number of different Skills or effects, though Corpses of [Rarity|Unique] monsters cannot be destroyed or consumed. Generally, slain [Allies|Allies] do not leave usable Corpses.
zh: 被击败的敌人会留下灵柩，可以由多种技能效果使用或消耗，但[Rarity|传奇]怪物的灵柩无法被摧毁或消耗。通常而言，被击败的[Allies|友军]不会留下可以使用的灵柩。

en:
Charges can be gained from a number of Skills, passives, and other effects. They do not grant any inherent benefits, but can be consumed to fuel many skills and other effects. Charges last for 15 seconds by default, refreshing whenever you gain another charge of the same type.

There are three types of Charges — Endurance, Frenzy and Power. By default players can have up to 3 of each type of Charge at once.
zh:
能量球可以通过许多技能、天赋和其他效果来获得。能量球本身不提供固有效果，但可以消耗它们来支持许多技能和效果。能量球默认持续 15 秒，获得同种能量球时会刷新时间。

能量球共有三种类型——耐力球、狂怒球和暴击球。默认情况下，玩家同一时间可以拥有每种能量球最多 3 个。

en: The three Elemental damage types are [Fire|Fire], [Cold|Cold], and [Lightning|Lightning].
zh: 三种元素伤害类型分别是[Fire|火焰]、[Cold|冰霜]和[Lightning|闪电]。

en: Wells are present in every Town, and will refill your [Flask|Flasks] as well as restoring your Life and Mana when used.
zh: 每个城镇里都有水井，使用水井可以补满你的[Flask|药剂]，并恢复你的生命和魔力。

en: Your Presence is an area around your character within which certain effects (such as many [Aura|Auras]) are applied. By default this has a 4 metre radius. The size of this area can be modified by Presence Area modifiers, but not by Skill Area modifiers.
zh: 在场范围指的是角色周围的产生某些特定效果的范围（例如[Aura|光环]的生效范围）。该范围默认为 4 米，可以被在场范围词缀调整，但不受技能范围词缀影响。

en: Your Light Radius determines the distance from your character which will be illuminated in dark areas, and the radius within which terrain and points of interest are revealed on the map.
zh: 照亮范围决定了角色能够在黑暗区域中照亮的距离，以及在地图上揭示地形和重要地点的范围。

en:
Items can be Normal (grey), Magic (blue), Rare (yellow) or Unique (brown). Item Classes which do not have these rarities, such as Currency, have individual rarity for each item.
Magic items can have 2 Modifiers; a Prefix and a Suffix.
Rare items can have up to 6 Modifiers; 3 Prefixes and 3 Suffixes.
More powerful and dangerous enemies are more likely to drop rarer Items.
zh:
物品包括了普通（灰色）、魔法（蓝色）、稀有（黄色）和传奇（棕色）。有些类型的物品不具有稀有度，例如通货物品，这类物品每种都具有独立的稀有度。
魔法物品可拥有最多 2 个词缀，包括一个前缀和一个后缀。
稀有物品可拥有最多 6 个词缀，包括 3 个前缀和 3 个后缀。
越强大、越危险的敌人越有可能掉落高稀有度的物品。

en: [Frozen] enemies Shatter when killed, destroying their corpse.
zh: [Frozen|冻结]的敌人被击败时会被击碎，将其灵柩摧毁。

en:
Penetration causes the target's corresponding [Resistances|Resistance] to be treated as lower than its actual value by the specified amount when of calculating Damage taken from your [HitDamage|Hits]. [Resistances] can only be Penetrated down to a minimum of 0% by default.

Since Penetration only affects [HitDamage|Hits] and applies to the target's defensive stats rather than your own offensive stats, it does not affect damage with [DamagingAilments|Ailments].
zh:
抗性穿透会使目标的对应[Resistances|抗性]在结算你的[HitDamage|击中]时的视作数值降低。在默认情况下，穿透后的[Resistances|抗性]最小值为 0%。

由于抗性穿透仅影响[HitDamage|击中]，并且只影响目标的防御属性，不影响你的攻击属性，所以它无法影响[DamagingAilments|异常状态]造成的伤害。

en:
Some Skills, Items, Support Gems and other effects can Break [Armour|Armour], which lowers a target's [Armour|Armour] by a specified amount. If this brings the target's [Armour|Armour] value to 0, their [Armour|Armour] is Fully Broken for 12 seconds, or 4 seconds for players. On top of not benefitting from [Armour], non-player targets with Fully Broken [Armour] take 20% increased [Physical] damage from [HitDamage|Hits].

Players Break 3 times Armour against Normal Monsters and 2 times Armour against Magic Monsters.
zh:
部分技能、物品、辅助宝石和其他效果可以粉碎[Armour|护甲]，使目标的[Armour|护甲]降低一定数值。如果使目标的[Armour|护甲]值降低为 0，则视作[Armour|护甲]完全破损，并且持续 12秒，对玩家则为 4 秒。非玩家目标的[Armour|护甲]完全破损后，除无法受益于[Armour|护甲]外，其受到的[HitDamage|击中][Physical|物理]伤害还会提高 20%。

玩家对抗普通怪物时可以粉碎 3 倍的护甲，对抗魔法怪物时可以粉碎 2 倍的护甲。
低于 0 时的护甲破损

en: Enemies with [Armour] [ArmourBreak|Broken] below 0 have negative [Armour]. This means they take more [Physical] damage from [HitDamage|Hits]. Armour broken below 0 is capped by the enemy's base [Armour].
zh: [Armour|护甲][ArmourBreak|破损]至 0 以下的敌人具有负值[Armour|护甲]，受到的[HitDamage|击中][Physical|物理]伤害提高。负值护甲的上限取决于敌人的基础[Armour|护甲]。

en: Channelling Skills can be held down to gain power or continue using the Skill for a longer period of time.
zh: 持续吟唱类技能可以按住按键来提高威力，或者在较长的时间内持续使用该技能。

en: Remote Skills are Skills that are performed for you by a different entity, such as a [Totem], [Trap], or Clone. [Minion|Minions] are not Remote Skills.
zh: 远距技能是其他实体，例如[Totem|图腾]、[Trap|陷阱]或复制体为你使用的技能。[Minion|召唤生物]不属于远距技能。

en: An Ancestrally Boosted [Slam] has 30% more damage and 25% increased area of effect, and an Ancestrally Boosted [Strike] will target 2 additional Enemies. [Trigger|Triggered Skills] cannot be Ancestrally Boosted. Ancestrally Boosted [Attack|Attacks] count as being [Empowered].
zh: 先祖加持的[Slam|猛击]造成的伤害总增 30%，效果范围总增 25%，先祖加持的[Strike|打击]能够以额外 2 个敌人为目标。[Trigger|触发]技能无法获得先祖加持。先祖加持的[Attack|攻击]视为[Empowered|强化]。

en: An Ancestrally Boosted [Spell] has 30% more damage and 25% increased area of effect. [Trigger|Triggered Skills] cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
zh: 受先祖加持的[Spell|法术]造成的伤害总增 30%，效果范围总增 25%。[Trigger|触发]类技能无法享受先祖加持效果。

en:
Buffs are effects that boost a player or monster's stats for a duration or while a condition is met.

Unless otherwise stated, Buffs of the same type do not stack — only the copy with the strongest effect applies.
zh:
增益状态能够提高玩家或怪物的属性。持续一定时间，或在满足条件时持续。

除非另有说明，否则同类增益状态无法叠效，仅有最强效的增益状态能够生效。

en:
Debuffs are negative effects that deal damage or penalise an entity's stats, either for a set duration or when a condition is met.

Unless otherwise stated, Debuffs of the same type do not stack — only the copy with the strongest effect applies.
zh:
减益状态是负面效果，可以造成伤害，或扣除实体的属性。效果会持续一定时间，或在满足条件时持续生效。


除非另有说明，否则同类减益状态无法叠加，仅有最强效的减益状态能够生效。

en: Persistent Skills are toggled in the Skills Panel instead of being used normally and often need to [Reservation|Reserve] [Spirit] in order to be activated.
zh: 永久性技能需要在技能面板中开关，而非正常使用。激活永久性技能通常需要[Reservation|保留][Spirit|精魂]。

en:
Multiple effects on enemies can be Consumed. Only one Consumption benefit can occur at once, and Consumption effects from Skills will take priority over those from other sources.

Consuming a [Debuff] on an enemy causes the enemy to be immune to that [Debuff] for 1 seconds.
zh:
敌人身上的多种效果都可以被消耗。同一时间只能产生一个消耗效果，技能的消耗效果先于其他来源生效。

消耗敌人身上的[Debuff|减益状态]会使敌人在 1 秒内免疫该[Debuff|减益状态]。

en: Reforges a [ItemRarity|Magic] item with new random modifiers.
zh: 使用新的随机词缀重置一件[ItemRarity|魔法]物品。

en: Adds an [Augment] Socket to a [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon] or Armour
zh: 为一件[MartialWeapon|战斗武器]或护甲添加一个[Augment|增幅器]插槽

en: Auras apply [Buff|Buffs] to [Allies|Allies] within a radius, or [Debuff|Debuffs] to enemies within a radius of the source of the Aura.
zh: 光环会对光环来源一定范围内的[Allies|友军]提供[Buff|增益状态]，或者为范围内的敌人提供[Debuff|减益状态]。

en: Each Stormsurge on this Weapon grants 3% of damage [Gain|Gained] as Extra [Lightning|Lightning] damage for 5 seconds. Maximum 10 Stormsurge.
zh: 这把武器的每层风雷涌动使 5 秒内额外[Gain|获得]相当于伤害 3% 的[Lightning|闪电伤害]。最多具有 10 层风雷涌动。

en: Reviving [Minion|Minions] heal after avoiding damage for a short time, and automatically revive after a short delay when killed. This delay is reset whenever another Reviving [Minion] dies.
zh: 可复活的[Minion|召唤生物]会在避免受到伤害一段时间后回复生命，被击败时会在短暂的延迟后自动复活。每当有其他可复活的[Minion|召唤生物]被击败时，复活延迟都会重置。

en:
Quality grants small bonuses to an item depending on the type of item, up to a default maximum of 20%.

[MartialWeapon|Martial Weapons] gain 1% more [Physical] damage per Quality.
Armours gain 1% more [Armour], [Evasion], [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] and [Ward|Runic Ward] per Quality.
Rings and Amulets have a number of possible quality types that provide bonuses to specific modifiers on the item.
[Flask|Flasks] gain 1% more Life and Mana recovery per Quality.
[Charm|Charms] gain 1% increased duration per Quality.
Skill Gems or equipment that grant Skills grant a specific bonus to their Skill based on their Quality.
zh:
品质能够根据物品的类型，为物品的属性提供少量加成，默认最高为 20%。

每一点品质使[MartialWeapon|战斗武器]的[Physical|物理]伤害总增 1%。 
每一点品质使护甲的[Armour|护甲]、[Evasion|闪避]、[EnergyShield|能量护盾]和[Ward|符文结界]总增 1%。
戒指和项链具有多种可能的品质类型，能够为该物品的特定词缀提供加成。
每一点品质使[Flask|药剂]的生命和魔力回复总增 1%。
每一点品质使[Charm|咒符]的持续时间延长 1%。
技能宝石或提供技能的装备会根据品质，为这一技能提供特定加成。

en:
Support Gems can be inserted into sockets on a Skill Gem in order to modify the effects of that Skill. They only apply to the Skill Gem they are socketed into.

You cannot use multiple copies of the exact same [LineageSupports|Lineage Support] across multiple Skills, or for Supports that grant global benefits to persistent reservation Skills while active.
Cannot use multiple Support Gems of the same [SupportGemCategory|Category] in one Skill.
zh:
辅助宝石可以镶嵌到技能宝石的插槽之中，从而修改该技能的效果。它们仅对镶嵌的技能宝石生效。

你无法在多个技能中使用多个相同的[LineageSupports|血脉辅助]，或是在激活时为持续生效技能提供全局加成的辅助。
无法在一个技能中使用多个相同[SupportGemCategory|类别]的辅助宝石。

en:
This Skill has an effect that applies to every target in its area, rather than picking specific targets.

Areas of Effect that originate from a target hit by a Skill will add that target's size to their radius.
zh:
这类技能的效果可以对范围内的每一个目标生效，而非仅选取特定目标。

如果效果区域技能来自一个被其他技能击中的目标，则会将目标的体型纳入到范围之中。

en: This Skill has a Duration that can be modified.
zh: 这类技能具有可以修改的持续时间。

en: Detonator Skills can cause flammable gas, [Oil], explosives, and similar effects to explode on contact.
zh: 引爆技能击中可燃气体、[Oil|黏油]、炸药和类似的效果时能够使其爆炸。

en: Nova Skills take effect in a circular area around their user.
zh: 新星技能会在使用者周围的圆形范围内生效。

en:
Many effects can cause a Skill to Trigger. A Triggered Skill occurs immediately, without an attack or cast time, and usually targets the cause of the trigger. Triggering a Skill does not count as using it.

If multiple methods of Triggering a Skill attempt to apply to the same skill, that skill will be disabled. [Channelling|Channelled] Skills cannot be Triggered.
zh:
许多效果都可以触发技能。触发技能会立即生效，不需要攻击或施法时间，通常会以触发的源头为目标。触发技能不视作使用该技能。

如果尝试对同一个技能使用多种触发技能的方式，则该技能会失效。[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能无法被触发。

en: Herald Skills are a type of [Persistent] [Buff] that grant powerful effects on killing enemies.
zh: 捷技能是一种[Persistent|永久性的][Buff|增益]，能够在击败敌人时产生强大的效果。

en: When you take damage from a [HitDamage|Hit], Recoup causes you to recover an amount of the stated resource equal to a percentage of the damage you took over 8 seconds.
zh: 当你受到[HitDamage|击中]伤害时，吸纳会使你在 8 秒内回复一定数量的指定资源，数值等于同受到伤害的一定比例。

en:
Thorns damage is a kind of [HitDamage|Hit] Damage you can deal. Thorns damage is not [Attack] damage or [Spell] damage and is not affected by modifiers specific to those.

If you have Thorns damage, you inherently [ThornsRetaliation|Retaliate] against [Melee] [Attack] [HitDamage|Hits], dealing your Thorns damage to the enemy that [HitDamage|Hit] you.

Some skills and other effects may also deal your thorns damage to enemies at other times.
zh:
荆棘伤害是你能够造成的一种[HitDamage|击中]伤害。荆棘伤害不属于[Attack|攻击]或[Spell|法术]伤害，不受相关的词缀影响。

如果你具有荆棘伤害，就会自动对[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]进行[ThornsRetaliation|反击]，对[HitDamage|击中]你的敌人造成荆棘伤害。

部分技能和其他效果可以在其他情况下对敌人造成荆棘伤害。

en: Ignited Ground repeatedly inflicts [Flammability] on enemies as long as they are standing on it, [Ignite|Igniting] them when it reaches 50%. By default, Ignited Ground lasts for 4 seconds and has a radius of 2 metres unless otherwise specified.
zh: 点燃地面会反复对站在其中的敌人施加[Flammability|易燃]，当其达到 50% 时[Ignite|点燃]他们。默认情况下，点燃地面持续 4 秒。除非另有说明，点燃地面的范围为 2 米。

en: Critical Weakness causes hits against affected targets to have +0.5% to [Critical|Critical Hit] Chance, and can stack up to 20 times. If not otherwise specified, each stack lasts for 4 seconds.
zh: 暴击弱点使针对受影响目标的击中的[Critical|暴击]几率 +0.5%，最多叠加 20 次。除非另有说明，否则每层效果持续 4 秒。

en: Elemental Ground Surfaces include [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground], [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground], and [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground].
zh: 元素地面效果包括[ShockedGround|感电地面]、[ChilledGround|冰缓地面]和[IgnitedGround|点燃地面]。

en: Using a [Crossbow] Ammunition Skill replaces your [Crossbow|Crossbow's] basic [Attack] with the skill indicated. The Ammunition Skill itself does not fire the Ammunition, only load it into your [Crossbow]. Most [Crossbow] Ammunition Skills that directly [HitDamage|Hit] enemies have [Knockback].
zh: 使用[Crossbow|战弩]弹药技能会将[Crossbow|战弩的]基础[Attack|攻击]替换为指定的技能。弹药技能本身不会发射弹药，仅仅是为[Crossbow|战弩]装填该类弹药。大多数直接[HitDamage|击中]敌人的[Crossbow|战弩]弹药技能都有[Knockback|击退]效果。

en:
[MonsterRarity|Magic and Rare] Monsters have Modifiers which will augment them in many ways, making them more rewarding, but also more powerful and deadly. Magic Monsters will normally have a single Monster Modifier, whereas Rare Monsters have up to 4 by default. 

Each Monster Modifier grants at least 100% increased Rarity of Items Dropped, and can grant the Monster additional abilities or permanant buffs.

Monster Modifier Chance increases the potential number of Rare Monster Modifiers with each modifier above 4 requiring twice as much Modifier Chance. Monster Modifier Chance above the maximum number of modifiers increases the chance Rare monsters will have maximum modifiers.

Other mechanics such as [AzmeriSpirit|Azmeri Spirits], [Essence|Essences] and [ContainsDelirium|Delirium] can add additional Monster Modifiers to monsters of any rarity.
zh:
[MonsterRarity|魔法和稀有]怪物拥有词缀，这些词缀会以多种方式强化它们，令它们的奖励更丰厚，同时也更强大而致命。魔法怪物通常拥有 1 条怪物词缀，而稀有怪物默认最多拥有 4 条。

每条怪物词缀至少使掉落物品的稀有度提高 100%，并且可以赋予怪物额外的能力或永久性增益。

怪物词缀几率会增加稀有怪物可能拥有的词缀数量。超出 4 条后，每增加 1 条，都需要 2 倍的词缀几率。超过最大词缀数量的怪物词缀几率会提高稀有怪物拥有满额词缀的几率。

其他机制，例如[AzmeriSpirit|阿兹莫里之灵]、[Essence|精华]和[ContainsDelirium|惊悸迷雾]，可为任意稀有度的怪物添加额外的怪物词缀。

en:
Cannot be Light Stunned
Cannot Dodge Roll or Sprint
zh:
无法被轻度晕眩
无法使用闪避翻滚或奔跑

en:
[StatConversion|Converts] 100% of maximum [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] to maximum Mana
Doubles Mana Costs
zh:
[StatConversion|转化] 100%的最大[EnergyShield|能量护盾]为最大魔力
魔力消耗翻倍

en:
All [DamageTypes|Damage] is taken from Mana before Life
50% less Mana Recovery Rate
zh:
受到的所有[DamageTypes|伤害]在扣除生命前优先从魔力扣除
魔力回复速度总降 50%

en:
You have no Mana
Skill Mana Costs [StatConversion|Converted] to Life Costs
zh:
你不具有魔力
技能的魔力消耗[StatConversion|转化]为生命消耗

en:
You can wield [Two-Handed] [Axe|Axes], [Mace|Maces] and [Sword|Swords] in one hand
Triple [Attributes|Attribute] requirements of weapons
Inherent Life granted by [Strength] is halved
zh:
你可以单手装备一把[Two-Handed|双手][Axe|斧类]、[Mace|锤类]或[Sword|剑类]武器
武器的[Attributes|属性]需求变为三倍
由[Strength|力量]提供的固有生命减半

en:
50% more amount of Life [LifeLeech|Leeched]
[LifeLeech|Leech Life] 67% less quickly
Cannot Recover Life other than from [LifeLeech|Leech]
[LifeLeech|Life Leech] effects are not removed when [Reservation|Unreserved] Life is Filled
zh:
生命[LifeLeech|偷取]量总增 50%
[LifeLeech|生命偷取]速度降低 67%
你只能通过[LifeLeech|偷取]来回复生命
[Reservation|未保留]生命值满时，[LifeLeech|生命偷取]效果不会被移除

en:
30% less [CriticalDamageBonus|Critical Damage Bonus] when on Full Life
30% more Critical Damage Bonus when on [LowLife|Low Life]
zh:
满血时[CriticalDamageBonus|暴击伤害加成]总降 30%
[LowLife|低血]时暴击伤害加成总增 30%

en:
You can apply an additional [Curse]
Double Activation Delay of Curses
zh:
你可以额外施加一个[Curse|诅咒]
诅咒的激活延迟翻倍

en:
Chance to [Evasion|Evade] is [Unlucky]
Chance to [Deflect] is [Lucky]
zh:
[Evasion|闪避]几率特别[Unlucky|不幸]
[Deflect|偏转]几率特别[Lucky|幸运]

en:
Your [Totem] [Limit] is doubled
No cost or [Charges|Charge] requirement for placing [Totem|Totems]
[Totem|Totems] reserve 75 [Spirit] each
zh:
你的[Totem|图腾][Limit|上限]翻倍
你可以无消耗、且没有[Charges|能量球]要求地放置[Totem|图腾]
每个[Totem|图腾]消耗 75 点[Spirit|精魂]

en: If you would gain a [Charges|Charge], [Allies] in your [Presence] gain that [Charges|Charge] instead.
zh: 若你即将获得一个[Charges|能量球]，则改为使你[Presence|在场]处的[Allies|友军]获得该[Charges|能量球]

en:
[Accuracy] Rating is Doubled
Never deal [Critical|Critical Hits]
zh:
[Accuracy|命中]值翻倍
但永远无法造成[Critical|暴击]

en:
You can apply an additional [Curse]
Double Activation Delay of [Curse|Curses]
zh:
你可以施加一个额外的[Curse|诅咒]
但所有[Curse|诅咒]的激活延迟将翻倍

en:
75% of Damage [Conversion|Converted] to [Fire] Damage
Deal no Non-[Fire] Damage
zh:
75% 的伤害[Conversion|转化]为[Fire|火焰]伤害
不会造成非[Fire|火焰]伤害

en:
5% of Physical Damage prevented [Recoup|Recouped] as [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] per enemy [Power]
[EnergyShield|Energy Shield] does not [ESRecharge|Recharge]
You cannot Recover [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] from Regeneration
You cannot Recover [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] to above [Armour]
zh:
敌人每点[Power|威力值]可使 5% 已预防的物理伤害[Recoup|吸纳]为[EnergyShield|能量护盾]
你的[EnergyShield|能量护盾]无法[ESRecharge|充能]
你无法通过再生效果恢复[EnergyShield|能量护盾]
你无法将[EnergyShield|能量护盾]恢复至[Armour|护甲]值之上

en:
You can equip a non-[ItemRarity|Unique] [Sceptre] while wielding a [Talisman]
50% less [Spirit]
Non-[Minion] Skills have 50% less [Reservation] [Efficiency]
zh:
佩戴[Talisman|魔符]时，可同时装备一把非[ItemRarity|传奇][Sceptre|权杖]
[Spirit|精魂]减少50%
非[Minion|召唤生物]技能的[Reservation|保留][Efficiency|效能]降低50%

en: All bonuses from [Equipped] Amulet apply to your [Minion|Minions] instead of you
zh: [Equipped|已装备]护身符的所有加成效果将提供给你的[Minion|召唤生物]，而不是你

en:
Can [Attack] as though using a [Quarterstaff] while both of your hand slots are empty
[UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attacks] that would use an [Equipped] [Quarterstaff]'s damage have:
• Base [UnarmedDamage|Unarmed] [Physical] damage replaced with damage based on their Skill Level
• 1% more [Attack] Speed per 75 [ItemEvasion|Item Evasion] on [EquipArmour|Equipped Armour Items]
• +0.1% to [Critical|Critical Hit Chance] per 10 [ItemEnergyShield|Item Energy Shield] on [EquipArmour|Equipped Armour Items]
zh:
当你的双手装备栏为空时，可如同使用[Quarterstaff|节杖]般进行[Attack|攻击]
若[UnarmedAttack|徒手攻击]本应使用[Equipped|已装备][Quarterstaff|节杖]的伤害时，可改为：
• 基础[UnarmedDamage|徒手][Physical|物理]伤害替换为基于技能等级的伤害
• 每 75 点[EquipArmour|已装备护甲物品]上的[ItemEvasion|物品闪避]提供 1% [Attack|攻击]速度加成
• 每 10 点[EquipArmour|已装备护甲物品]上的[ItemEnergyShield|物品能量护盾]提供 +0.1% [Critical|暴击率]

en:
Maximum Life is 1
Immune to [Chaos] Damage and [Bleeding]
zh:
生命上限是 1
免疫[Chaos|混沌]伤害与[Bleeding|流血]效果

en: Martial Weapons can be used to [Attack]. [Axe|Axes], [Bow|Bows], [Claw|Claws], [Crossbow|Crossbows], [Dagger|Daggers], [Flail|Flails], [Mace|Maces], [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaves], [Spear|Spears], [Sword|Swords], and [Talisman|Talismans] are Martial Weapons.
zh: 战斗武器可以用于[Attack|攻击]。[Axe|斧类]、[Bow|弓类]、[Claw|爪类]、[Crossbow|战弩]、[Dagger|匕首]、[Flail|连枷]、[Mace|锤类]、[Quarterstaff|节杖]、[Spear|战矛]、[Sword|剑类]和[Talisman|魔符]武器都属于战斗武器。

en: Sacrificing is loss of a resource (commonly Life, Mana or [EnergyShield|Energy Shield]) that does not count as taking damage. You cannot Sacrifice a resource you do not have. Sacrificing Life cannot reduce you below 1 Life, but Sacrifices you cause on others (such as Sacrificing [Minion] Life) can lead to their death.
zh: 献祭是一种资源（通常为生命、魔力或[EnergyShield|能量护盾]）的损失方式，但不视作受到了伤害。你无法献祭自己并不拥有的资源。献祭生命不会使你自己的生命降低至 1 以下，但献祭其他目标时（例如献祭[Minion|召唤生物]的生命）可能会将其击败。

en: Travel Skills cover a large amount of distance without needing to target an enemy. If you have multiple Travel Skills with cooldowns, their cooldowns are shared.
zh: 旅行技能可以进行长距离穿梭，并且不需要指定一名敌人作为目标。若你拥有多个带冷却时间的旅行技能，则共享冷却时间。

en:
Life [LifeRecharge|Recharges] instead of [ESRecharge|Energy Shield]
50% less Life Recovery from [Flask|Flasks]
zh:
生命[LifeRecharge|充能]，而非[ESRecharge|能量护盾]
[Flask|药剂]的生命回复减少 50%

en:
Every Support Gem you have socketed will incur a cumulative [Attributes|Attribute] requirement, generally at a value of five of the relevant stat for each support gem used.

This [Attributes|Attribute] requirement is separate from that required by your Skill Gems and Equipment.
zh:
镶嵌的每一个辅助宝石都会提高[Attributes|属性]需求，每一个使用的辅助宝石通常会使相关属性的需求提高五点。

这一[Attributes|属性]需求独立于技能宝石和装备的需求。

en:
The Magnitudes of a [Buff] or [Debuff] are the values of the stats it applies to the target. A [Buff] or [Debuff] with higher magnitudes is more powerful.

Modifiers to the Magnitude of [Buff|Buffs] or [Debuff|Debuffs] come from whoever applies it and are multiplicative with modifiers to the [BuffEffect|Effect] the [Buff] or [Debuff] has on the target.
zh:
[Buff|增益]状态或[Debuff|减益]状态的强度是对目标产生效果的数值。[Buff|增益]状态或[Debuff|减益]状态的强度越高，效果就越是强大。

[Buff|增益]状态或[Debuff|减益]状态的强度词缀取决于施加这些效果的对象，可以与目标本身具有的[Buff|增益]状态或[Debuff|减益]状态[BuffEffect|效果]词缀按乘法叠加生效。

en: Modifiers to the Effect of [Buff|Buffs] or [Debuff|Debuffs] usually come from the target it affects and are multiplicative with modifiers to the [BuffMagnitude|Magnitudes] of the [Buff] or [Debuff], which come from its creator.
zh: 影响[Buff|增益]状态或[Debuff|减益]状态效果的词缀通常来自于受到影响的目标，可以和施加[Buff|增益]状态或[Debuff|减益]状态的对象所具有的[BuffMagnitude|强度]词缀按乘法叠加生效。

en:
Take 50% less damage over time if you've started taking damage over time in the past second
Take 50% more damage over time if you haven't started taking damage over time in the past second
zh:
若过去一秒内开始受到持续伤害，受到的持续伤害总降 50%
若过去一秒内未开始受到持续伤害，受到的持续伤害总增 50%

en:
Create [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] [Remnant|Remnants] instead of [Fire]
Create [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] [Remnant|Remnants] instead of [Lightning]
Create [Fire] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] [Remnant|Remnants] instead of [Cold]
zh:
生成[Lightning|闪电][ElementalInfusion|灌注][Remnant|残片]，取代[Fire|火焰]类型
生成[Cold|冰霜][ElementalInfusion|灌注][Remnant|残片]，取代[Lightning|闪电]类型
生成[Fire|火焰][ElementalInfusion|灌注][Remnant|残片]，取代[Cold|冰霜]类型

无法使用[Charm|咒符]
[Flask|药剂]回复量总增 30%

en: Arcane Surge grants 15% increased Cast Speed and 20% more Mana Regeneration Rate.
zh: 秘术增强可以使施法速度提高 15%，魔力回复速度总增 20%。

en:
Arcane Surge grants 15% increased Cast Speed and 20% more Mana Regeneration Rate.
It lasts for 4 seconds by default.
zh:
秘术增强可以使施法速度提高 15%，魔力回复速度总增 20%。
默认情况下持续 4 秒。

en: Invoked Skills are those [Trigger|Triggered] by Invocation Skills.
zh: 祈唤技能是由咒祈技能[Trigger|触发]的技能。

en:
Meta Gems are Skill Gems that other Skill Gems can be socketed into. They can use, [Trigger], or otherwise apply the effects of those other Skill Gems. Skill Gems and [SupportGem|Support Gems] can be socketed into Meta Gems interchangeably, though most Meta Gems require at least one Skill Gem to be socketed to function.

Meta Gems can never be socketed into other Meta Gems.
zh:
非凡宝石是一种技能宝石，可以镶嵌其他技能宝石。非凡宝石能够使用、[Trigger|触发]或以其他方式应用所镶嵌技能宝石的效果。技能宝石和[SupportGem|辅助宝石]都可以镶嵌其中，但大部分非凡宝石都需要镶嵌至少一颗技能宝石才能发挥作用。

非凡宝石永远无法镶嵌到其他非凡宝石中。

en: Skills that meet this requirement use the term "Final Strike" to refer to the last strike of their sequence.
zh: 满足该需求的技能使用“绝杀打击”一词来表示其连续击中里的最后一次打击。

en:
Finality is a [Buff] that grants 100% increased [Critical|Critical Hit Chance] with [FinalStrike|Final Strikes], and makes your [Strike] skills skip to their [FinalStrike|Final Strike] if they have one.

Skills cannot gain [Combo] while you have Finality.
zh:
绝杀是一种[Buff|增益]状态，使你的[Final Strike|绝杀打击]获得 100% 增幅[Critical|暴击几率]，并使你的[Strike|打击]技能在有[Final Strike|绝杀打击]时直接跳至该击。

当你拥有绝杀时，技能无法获得[连击]。

en:
Corrupted Blood is a [Debuff] that deals [Physical] damage over time.
Up to 10 Corrupted Blood debuffs can be inflicted on each target.

Corrupted Blood is not [Bleeding] and is not affected by any stats related to [Bleeding].
zh:
腐化之血是一种[Debuff|减益状态]，能够持续造成[Physical|物理]伤害，每个目标可被施加最多 10 次腐化之血。

腐化之血不属于[Bleeding|流血]，不受[Bleeding|流血]相关属性的影响。

en:
[Bleeding] that has been Aggravated always treats the target as moving, which causes it to deal 100% extra damage.

Once a [Bleeding] [Debuff] has been Aggravated, it will remain Aggravated until its duration expires.

Each [Bleeding] [Debuff] can be Aggravated, or not, independently — one [Bleeding] [Debuff] being Aggravated does not mean other [Bleeding] [Debuff|Debuffs] on the target are also Aggravated, and Aggravating some or all of them will have no effect on new [Bleeding] [Debuff|Debuffs] applied afterwards. However, effects which Aggravate [Bleeding] on a target do so to all [Bleeding] [Debuff|Debuffs] currently on that target unless otherwise specified.
zh:
恶性的[Bleeding|流血]始终将目标视作正在移动，造成 100% 的额外伤害。

[Bleeding|流血][Debuff|减益状态]变为恶性之后，它将在持续期间始终维持恶性状态。

每个[Bleeding|流血][Debuff|减益状态]的恶性状态都是独立的，使一个[Bleeding|流血][Debuff|减益状态]变为恶性不代表目标身上的其他[Bleeding|流血][Debuff|减益状态]也会变为恶性，使部分或全部效果变为恶性也不会影响后续施加的[Bleeding|流血][Debuff|减益状态]。然而，除非另有说明，否则使[Bleeding|流血]变为恶性的效果会对目标当前所具有的所有[Bleeding|流血][Debuff|减益状态]生效。

en:
[Ignite] that has been Aggravated deals 100% extra damage.

Once an [Ignite] has been Aggravated, it will remain Aggravated until its duration expires.

Just like [Bleeding], each [Ignite] [Debuff] can be Aggravated, or not, independently of others on the target.
zh:
恶性的[Ignite|点燃]会造成 100% 的额外伤害。

[Ignite|点燃]变为恶性之后，它将在持续期间始终维持恶性状态。

和[Bleeding|流血]一样，目标身上的每个[Ignite|点燃][Debuff|减益状态]的恶性状态都是独立的。

en: Their modifiers to the amount they leech will not affect this amount; your modifiers have already applied to it.
zh: 友军的偷取量词缀不会影响该偷取量；你自己的相关词缀已经生效了。

en: This effect does not stack. Applying it again before the first expires will refresh the duration.
zh: 该效果无法叠加，在第一个效果结束前重复施加会刷新持续时间。

en:
Marks are a family of [Debuff|Debuffs] that apply powerful effects to a single enemy, usually for a limited duration. You can have multiple Marked enemies at once, but each individual enemy can only have a single Mark applied to them at once.

Marks can be [MarkActivate|Activated] when specific conditions occur, which will case some extra effect and then [Consume] the Mark.
zh:
印记是一类作用于单个敌人的[Debuff|减益状态]，通常施加强大的特定效果并持续有限时间。你可以同时对多个敌人添加印记，但每个敌人同一时间只能受到一种印记的影响。

当满足特定条件时，印记可被[MarkActivate|激活]，触发额外效果后，该印记将被[Consume|消耗]。

en:
Lost Life will start Recharging at a rate of 12.5% per second after a base delay of 4 seconds. Further loss of Life resets this delay, interrupting Recharge.
Modifiers to Energy Shield [ESRechargeRate|Recharge Rate] or to [FasterESRechargeStart|how fast it starts] will also apply to Life Recharge.
zh:
失去生命会在短暂的延迟后开始充能，每秒充能 12.5%，基础延迟为 4 秒。进一步失去生命会重置延迟时间，也会打断充能。
能量护盾[ESRechargeRate|充能速度]和[FasterESRechargeStart|充能开始速度加快]词缀也会对生命充能生效。

en: Lost [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] will start Recharging at a rate of 12.5% per second after a base delay of 4 seconds. Further loss of [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] resets this delay, interrupting Recharge.
zh: 失去[EnergyShield|能量护盾]会在短暂的延迟后开始充能，每秒充能 12.5%，基础延迟为 4 秒。进一步失去[EnergyShield|能量护盾]会重置延迟时间，也会打断充能。

en: Energy Shield will no longer protect you from Damage, unless that damage would be dealt to Mana.
zh: 能量护盾不再保护你免受伤害，除非该伤害会对魔力造成。

en:
Onslaught grants 20% increased [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed] and 10% increased movement speed.
Unless specified, Onslaught lasts 4 seconds.
zh:
猛攻使你的[SkillSpeed|技能速度]加快 20%，移动速度加快 10%。
除非另有说明，猛攻持续 4 秒。

en: Druidic Prowess is a stacking [Buff] which grants 10% increased [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed] and causes [HitDamage|Hits] with [Spell] Damage to grant 3 [Rage] per stack for 10 seconds. Each stack has an independent duration. Maximum 3 stacks.
zh: 德鲁伊之威是一种可叠加的[Buff|增益状态]，每层叠加会使[SkillSpeed|技能速度]提升 10%，使用[Spell|法术]伤害[HitDamage|击中]时获得 3 点[Rage|怒气]，持续 10 秒。每层叠加具有独立的持续时间。最大可叠加 3 层。

en:
Each Fear Incarnate grants 10% increased [CullingStrike|Culling Strike] Threshold and lasts 10 seconds. This duration is refreshed when you gain another Fear Incarnate.

You can have up to a maximum of 20 Fear Incarnate.
zh:
每层恐惧化身使你的[CullingStrike|终结]阈值提高 10%，持续 10 秒。当你获得另一层恐惧化身时，此持续时间会刷新。

你最多可拥有 20 层恐惧化身。

en:
Each Fear Overwhelming grants 5% increased Area of Effect for [Attack] Skills and lasts 10 seconds. This duration is refreshed when you gain another Fear Overwhelming.

You can have up to a maximum of 20 Fear Overwhelming.
zh:
每层恐惧侵袭使[Attack|攻击]技能的效果区域提高 5%，持续 10 秒。当你获得另一层恐惧侵袭时，此持续时间会刷新。

你最多可拥有 20 层恐惧侵袭。

en:
Checkpoints are a form of saving your progress through Wraeclast and will often appear before Boss fights and at points of interest. Reaching a Checkpoint will refill your Life, Mana, [Flask|Flasks] and [Charm|Charms].

On death, you can choose to revive either in Town or at the last Checkpoint you reached. For this purpose, [Waypoint|Waypoints] also function as Checkpoints.

You can also teleport between Checkpoints within an area, or from a Checkpoint to the Waypoint.
zh:
记录点能够保存你在瓦尔克拉斯的冒险进度，通常会出现在首领战前和关键地点。抵达记录点会补满你的生命、魔力、[Flask|药剂]和[Charm|咒符]。

被击败后，你可以选择在城镇复活，或者在最后抵达的记录点处复活。因此，[Waypoint|传送点]也可以作为记录点使用。

你还可以在同一区域内的记录点之间或记录点与传送点之间传送。

en: Once all Checkpoints have been activated and the Map is completed, all remaining unfinished map content will be revealed on the minimap.
zh: 当所有记录点被激活，地图完成时，地图内所有剩余的未完成内容会在小地图上显示。

en: Waypoints are a form of saving your progress through Wraeclast. Most areas (though not all) will have one, and they can be used to quickly travel from area to area. Reaching a Waypoint will refill your Life, Mana, [Flask|Flasks] and [Charm|Charms].
zh: 传送点能够保存你在瓦尔克拉斯的冒险进度，大部分区域（但并非所有区域）都有一个传送点，可以用于在不同的区域之间快速往返。抵达传送点会补满你的生命、魔力、[Flask|药剂]和[Charm|咒符]。

en: A higher Elemental Ailment Threshold makes it less likely that being [HitDamage|Hit] by [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] will apply the relevant [ElementalAilments|Ailment], as well as lowering the amount of [Freeze] and [Electrocute] buildup recieved. A lower Elemental Ailment Threshold makes it more likely, and increases buildup of [Freeze] and [Electrocute] recieved. By default a player's Ailment Threshold is equal to half their Life.
zh: 较高的元素异常状态阈值能够使你被[ElementalDamage|元素伤害][HitDamage|击中]时不太容易受到相应的[ElementalAilments|异常状态]影响，也会降低受到的[Freeze|冻结]和[Electrocute|触电]积蓄值。较低的元素异常状态阈值会使你更容易受到它们的影响，并提高受到的[Freeze|冻结]和[Electrocute|触电]积蓄值。在默认情况下，玩家的异常状态阈值等于其生命的一半。

en: The default maximum for [ElementalDamage|Elemental] or [Chaos|Chaos] resistances is 75%. Maximum resistances cannot be raised above 90%.
zh: [ElementalDamage|元素]和[Chaos|混沌]抗性的默认上限为 75%。抗性上限不能超过 90%。

en:
Gain [Charges|Power Charges] instead of [Charges|Frenzy Charges]
Gain [Charges|Frenzy Charges] instead of [Charges|Endurance Charges]
Gain [Charges|Endurance Charges] instead of [Charges|Power Charges]
zh:
获得狂怒[Charges|球]时改为获得[Charges|暴击球]
获得[Charges|耐力球]时改为获得[Charges|狂怒球]
获得[Charges|暴击球]时改为获得[Charges|耐力球]

en: Sustained skills cause a large number of [HitDamage|Hits] over a period of time. They roll for [Critical|Critical Hits] independently each time they damage enemies, rather than rolling once for the entire skill as other skills do.
zh: 持续性技能会在一定时间里造成多次[HitDamage|击中]，每次对敌人造成伤害时都会独立结算[Critical|暴击]，而非和其他技能一样仅结算一次。

en:
Some skills and effects have a chance to apply Daze to enemies on [HitDamage|Hit].

Daze lasts for 8 seconds, and a Dazed enemy will take 50% more [Stun|Stun Buildup]. There are also a number of Skills, Effects, and other mechanics which interact with Daze for various benefits.
zh:
部分技能和效果有几率在[HitDamage|击中]敌人时施加恍惚。

恍惚持续 8 秒，恍惚的敌人受到的[Stun|晕眩积蓄]总增 50%。一些技能、效果和其他机制也能与恍惚互动，产生多样的效果。

en:
Combo is a counter on some Skills that can be required to use the Skill or grant extra effects. Skills gain Combo when you [Strike] Enemies. Combo will fall off after a short time without this happening.

Combo can only be built while using the same weapon as the Combo Skill is bound to, and will be lost if you [WeaponSets|Swap Weapons].
zh:
连击是某些技能上的计数器，可用于要求达到一定连击数才能使用技能，或赋予额外效果。当你[Strike|打击]敌人时，技能会获得连击。若在一小段时间内未发生打击，连击数将逐渐衰减。

连击只能在使用与连击技能所绑定的相同武器时积累，若你[WeaponSets|切换武器]，连击将会丢失。
召唤生物的死亡和击败

en: [Minion|Minions] whose durations expire or that are despawned by the player are considered to have died. However, effects that state they trigger when a [Minion] is Killed do not trigger in these cases. [Minion|Minions] are only Killed if they reach 0 life, though this can be caused by their summoner as well as enemies.
zh: 持续时间结束或被玩家取消的[Minion|召唤生物]会视作死亡，但[Minion|召唤生物]被击败时触发的效果无法在此时生效。[Minion|召唤生物]只有生命降低至 0 才会视作被击败，但可以由敌人或召唤师造成。

en: You are Surrounded if there are at least 5 enemies within 3 metres of you. The number of enemies required to be Surrounded cannot be reduced below 1.
zh: 当你的 3 米范围内存在至少 5 个敌人时，你视作被包围。触发该效果所需的敌人数量无法被降低至1以下。

en: Reservation effects prevent a portion of a given resource — usually [Spirit], though it can also be Life or Mana — from being used for other purposes while active. Reserving a resource does not change the maximum value of that resource.
zh: 保留效果激活时会使特定资源的一部分无法使用。该资源通常为[Spirit|精魂]，但也可以是生命或魔力。保留一种资源并不会改变资源的上限数值。

en: You are on Low Infernal Flame if you have 35% of your maximum Infernal Flame or less.
zh: 如果你的地狱烈焰达到或低于地狱烈焰上限的 35%，便处于低地狱烈焰状态。

en:
Dodge Roll cannot Avoid Damage
Take 30% less [HitDamage|Damage from Hits] while Dodge Rolling
zh:
闪避翻滚无法避免伤害
闪避翻滚时受到的[HitDamage|击中伤害]总降 30%

en:
Damage can be converted from one type to another. This causes it to deal the new damage type, scale with modifiers to the new damage type, and no longer scale with modifiers to the old damage type.

For example, [Fire] damage converted to [Lightning] now scales with [Lightning] damage modifiers and causes [Shock], but no longer scales with [Fire] damage modifiers or causes [Ignite].

Conversion is a two step process. Conversion inherent to Skills occurs first, then Conversion from all other sources. Damage over time cannot be converted.
zh:
伤害可以转化为不同的类型，使其造成新类型的伤害，受到新伤害类型词缀的调整，不再受到旧伤害类型词缀的影响。

例如，[Fire|火焰伤害]转化为[Lightning|闪电]后，就可以受到[Lightning|闪电]伤害词缀的影响，也可以造成[Shock|感电]，但不再受到[Fire|火焰]伤害词缀的影响，也无法造成[Ignite|点燃]。

转化过程分为两步。技能本身的转化效果最先结算，随后再结算其他来源的转化效果。持续伤害无法被转化。
获得 X 的额外伤害

en:
Damage gained as a specific damage type only scales with modifiers to the new type, not with modifiers to the source damage's type (unless they're the same type). 

For example, [Lightning] damage gained from [Physical] damage scales with [Lightning] damage modifiers, but not [Physical] damage modifiers.

Damage Gain occurs in the same two step process as [Conversion|Damage Conversion]. Damage over time cannot benefit from damage Gain.
zh:
获得特定伤害类型的伤害，该伤害仅能受到新伤害类型词缀的调整，不受源伤害类型词缀的调整（除非两者为相同类型）。

例如，[Physical|物理]伤害获得的[Lightning|闪电]伤害会受到[Lightning|闪电]伤害词缀的影响，不受[Physical|物理]伤害词缀的影响。

获得伤害的过程分为两步，与[Conversion|转化]相同。持续伤害不受获得伤害的影响。

en: Tailwind is a stacking [Buff] which grants 1% increased movement speed, 2% increased [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed], 10% increased [Evasion] Rating and prevent 1% of Damage from [Deflect|Deflected] [HitDamage|Hits] per stack. Maximum 10 stacks.
zh: 提速尾流是可叠加的[Buff|增益]状态，每层提高 1% 移动速度，2% [SkillSpeed|技能速度]，10% [Evasion|闪避]值，防止 1% 来自[Deflect|偏转]的[HitDamage|击中]的伤害。最多可叠加 10 层。

en: Jade is a stacking [Buff] which grants 1% additional Physical Damage Reduction per stack. Maximum of 10 Jade stacks.
zh: 青玉护身是可叠加的[Buff|增益状态]，每层提供 1% 的额外物理伤害减免。最多可叠加 10 层青玉护身。

en: Enemies have less [CooldownRecovery|Cooldown Recovery Rate] the lower their Concentration, scaling down to 50% less [CooldownRecovery|Cooldown Recovery Rate] when Concentration is 0%.
zh: 敌人的专注越低，他们的[CooldownRecovery|冷却回复速度]就越低。专注为 0% 时，[CooldownRecovery|冷却回复速度]最多总降 50%。

en:
Flames of Chayula are [Remnant|Remnants] that grant the following bonuses when collected:
Red Flames of Chayula [LifeLeech|Leech] 20% of your maximum Life to you
Blue Flames of Chayula [ManaLeech|Leech] 20% of your maximum Mana to you
Purple Flames of Chayula provide a stacking [Buff] granting 7% of damage as extra [Chaos] damage for 8 seconds, and stacks up to 10 times.
zh:
夏乌拉之焰属于[Remnant|残片]，收集可获得以下加成：
红色夏乌拉之焰使你获得相当于生命上限 20% 的[LifeLeech|偷取]生命
蓝色夏乌拉之焰使你获得相当于魔力上限 20% 的[ManaLeech|偷取]魔力
紫色夏乌拉之焰使你获得可叠加的[Buff|增益]效果，获得 7% 伤害的额外[Chaos|混沌]伤害，持续 8 秒，可以叠加最多 10 次。

en:
Ancient Blooms are [Remnant|Remnants] that grant the following bonuses when collected:
Vivid Blooms grant 5 Charges to all of your [Charm|Charms]
Primal Blooms grant 5 Charges to all of your Mana [Flask|Flasks]
Wild Blooms grant 5 Charges to all of your Life [Flask|Flasks]
zh:
远古之花属于[Remnant|残片]，收集可获得以下加成：
鲜活之花使你的所有[Charm|咒符]获得 5 点充能
原初之花使你的所有魔力[Flask|药剂]获得 5 点充能
狂野之花使你的所有生命[Flask|药剂]获得 5 点充能

en: Red Flames of Chayula [LifeLeech|Leech] 20% of your maximum Life to you to when collected.
zh: 收集红色夏乌拉之焰时为你[LifeLeech|偷取]生命上限的 20%。

en: Blue Flames of Chayula [ManaLeech|Leech] 20% of your maximum Mana to you when collected.
zh: 收集蓝色夏乌拉之焰时为你[ManaLeech|偷取]魔力上限的 20%。

en: Small Passive Skills are Passives that are not Notables, Keystones, Ascendancy Passive Skills or Passive Skills where you can select an [Attributes|Attribute].
zh: 除了核心天赋、基石天赋、升华天赋，以及能够选择[Attributes|属性]的天赋，其他天赋都属于小型天赋。

en:
Valour is used to fuel Banner Skills. Killing an enemy with an [Attack] generates 1 Valour, and Banners passively gain 1 Valour per second while a [Rarity|Unique] enemy is in your [Presence]. You can only gain Valour once every 0.5 seconds, and a Banner skill cannot gain Valour while its Banner is placed.

Each Banner has 50 maximum Valour by default. If you have multiple Banner skills active, each gains Valour separately.
zh:
胆魄是用于维持旗帜技能的资源。使用[Attack|攻击]击败敌人能够获得 1 点胆魄。有[Rarity|传奇]敌人[Presence|在场]时，旗帜技能每秒被动获得 1 点胆魄。你每 0.5 秒只能获得一次胆魄，并且旗帜技能在放置旗帜时无法获得胆魄。

每个旗帜默认的胆魄上限为 50 点。如果你同时激活了多个旗帜技能，每个旗帜技能会单独计算胆魄。

en: Intimidate is a [Debuff] that inflicts 10% increased damage taken and 10% reduced damage dealt.
zh: 威吓是一种[Debuff|减益]状态，使受到的伤害提高 10%，造成的伤害降低 10%。

en: Ballistas are a type of [Totem] that use [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks].
zh: 弩炮是一种使用[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击]的[Totem|图腾]。

en: Soul Cores are artifacts of the ancient Vaal empire and function as a type of [Augment].
zh: 灵核是古代瓦尔帝国的遗物，其功能相当于一种[Augment|增幅器]。

en: Abyssal Eyes are artifacts recovered from Abyssals which function as a type of [Augment].
zh: 深渊之眼是从深渊生物身上回收的遗物，其功能相当于一种[Augment|增幅器]。

en: Runes are [Augment|Augments] of Kalguuran origin and make.
zh: 符文是卡古兰文明所制的[Augment|增幅器]。

en: Idols are a type of [Augment|Augment] fashioned by the Azmeri.
zh: 雕像是由阿兹莫里人所制作的一种[Augment|增幅器]。

en:
Honour is an additional resource you have to manage within the Trial of the Sekhemas. A percentage of the damage you take from enemies in the Trial will be taken from your Honour. If your Honour reaches zero then the Trial is failed.

Your starting and maximum Honour are the sum of your maximum Life, [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] and [Ward|Runic Ward]. Your maximum Mana is also added if you have [passive_keystone_mind_over_matter|Mind Over Matter].
zh:
荣誉是丝克玛试炼中需要精心管控的额外资源。在试炼中受到敌人造成的伤害时，一部分伤害会从荣誉中扣除。如果荣誉降低至零，则试炼失败。

你的起始荣耀值与最大荣耀值等于你的最大生命值、[EnergyShield|能量护盾]和[Ward|符文结界]的总和。若你还拥有[passive_keystone_mind_over_matter|心灵升华]天赋，则还需加上你的最大魔力值。
闪电[Ailments|异常状态]包括了[Shock|感电]和[Electrocute|触电]。

en: This additional use time is fixed and will not be modified by skill use speed stats.
zh: 附加的额外使用时间为固定时间，不受技能使用速度属性的影响。

en:
Enemies covered in Oil have their movement speed [Slow|Slowed], are inflicted with [Exposure] and have 200% more [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of [Flammability] inflicted on them.

[IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground] or [Detonator] Skills will [Ignite] Oil-covered enemies. This removes the Oil, but the [Exposure] will remain for the duration of that [Ignite].
zh:
黏油缠身的敌人的移动速度[Slow|减慢]，受到[Exposure|曝露]，并且被施加的[Flammability|易燃][BuffMagnitude|强度]提升 200%。

[IgnitedGround|点燃地面]或[Detonator|引爆]技能会[Ignite|点燃]黏油缠身的敌人。这会移除黏油，但[Exposure|曝露]效果将在[Ignite|点燃]期间持续存在。

en:
Enemies standing in Oil Ground have their movement speed [Slow|Slowed] and are inflicted with [Exposure].

[Ignite|Ignited] enemies, [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground], or [Detonator] Skills that touch the Oil cause it to catch fire, [Ignite|Igniting] enemies instead of [Slow|Slowing] them, but still inflicting the [Exposure].
zh:
位于黏油地面中的敌人的移动速度[Slow|减慢]，并受到[Exposure|曝露]。

[Ignite|被点燃]的敌人、[IgnitedGround|点燃地面]或[Detonator|引爆]技能触及黏油时将引燃地面，进而[Ignite|点燃]其中的敌人，这不会使敌人[Slow|减速]，但依然会造成[Exposure|曝露]。

en: The Total value of a stat is the value after all calculations have been performed. Modifiers to the Total value apply after all other modifiers.
zh: 总属性值是完成全部结算后的属性数值。作用于总属性值的词缀会在其他所有词缀计算完毕后计算。

en: Adding to the Total value of a stat occurs after all other calculations have been performed. This means that the added value does not benefit from percentage modifiers to the stat.
zh: 附加至总属性会在完成其他所有结算后，附加至最终的属性总值中。这意味着附加值不会受到该属性百分比词缀影响。

en:
Charms are protective trinkets you can equip that automatically trigger a defensive effect when a specific condition is met. Similar to [Flask|Flasks], Charms require charges to trigger. Charm charges can be regained by killing monsters, granting charges equal to half of the monster's [Power]. [Checkpoint|Checkpoints] and [Wells] completely recharge Charms when activated.

The maximum number of Charm slots is capped at 3.
zh:
咒符是一种防御性饰品，装备后能够在满足特定条件时自动触发防御效果。咒符类似于[Flask|药剂]，需要充能才能触发。咒符充能可以通过击败怪物获得，充能量相当于怪物[Power|威力值]的一半。[Checkpoint|记录点]和[Wells|水井]在激活时能够完全补满咒符。

咒符栏位最多 3 个。

en:
Excess Life Recovery from Regeneration is applied to [EnergyShield|Energy Shield].
[EnergyShield|Energy Shield] does not Recharge.
zh:
再生的溢出生命回复会作用于[EnergyShield|能量护盾]。
[EnergyShield|能量护盾]无法充能。

en: [Chill|Chilling], [Shock|Shocking], or [Ignite|Igniting] Enemies grants 1 Unbound Fury. [Freeze|Freezing] or [Electrocute|Electrocuting] Enemies grants 6 Unbound Fury.
zh: 使敌人[Chill|冰缓]、[Shock|感电]或[Ignite|点燃]可获得 1 点不羁狂怒。使敌人[Freeze|冻结]或[Electrocute|触电]可获得 6 点不羁狂怒。

en:
Converting stat A to stat B applies the base value of stat A to stat B instead. The converted stat scales with percentage modifiers to stat B, but not with percentage modifiers to stat A.

For example, if you converted your [Evasion] to [Armour], the converted portion would be scaled by percentage modifiers to [Armour], but percentage modifiers to [Evasion] would have no effect.
zh:
将 A 属性转化为 B 属性时，属性 A 的数值将改为对属性 B 生效。转化后的属性会根据属性 B 的百分比词缀而调整，但不再受到属性 A 的百分比词缀影响。

例如，如果你将[Evasion|闪避]转化成了[Armour|护甲]，则转化的那一部分属性会受到[Armour|护甲]百分比词缀的影响，而[Evasion|闪避]的百分比词缀不会对其生效。

en: Life Loss is not damage, and can't be mitigated or absorbed by [EnergyShield|Energy Shield]. Life Loss can still kill you.
zh: 生命损失不属于伤害，无法减免或被[EnergyShield|能量护盾]吸收。不过生命损失依然能够令你败北。
获得相当于其他属性的属性

en:
Gaining a percentage of stat A as stat B is calculated from the base value of stat A. The portion gained scales with percentage modifiers to stat B, but not with percentage modifiers to stat A.

For example, if you gained 50% of [Evasion] as [Armour], the portion gained would be scaled by percentage modifiers to [Armour], but not by percentage modifiers to [Evasion].
zh:
获得相当于属性 A 一定比例的属性 B 时，会根据属性 A 的基础数值进行计算。获得的这部分属性会根据属性 B 的百分比词缀而调整，但不再受到属性 A 的百分比词缀影响。

例如，如果你获得了相当于[Evasion|闪避] 50% 的[Armour|护甲]，获得的这部分属性会受到[Armour|护甲]百分比词缀的影响，而[Evasion|闪避]的百分比词缀不会对其生效。

en: Recovery which Overflows its maximum can be recovered up to 1.5 times that maximum.
zh: 溢出上限的回复最多可以回复到上限的 1.5 倍。

en: Some [Minion|Minions] can be Commanded to perform certain actions. This requires you to use the corresponding Command skill, which will cause one of your [Minion|Minions] to carry out the Command.
zh: 一些[Minion|召唤生物]可以接受命令，从而执行特定的行动。你需要使用对应的命令技能，使一个[Minion|召唤生物]来执行命令。

en:
Difficulty causes monsters to have increased damage and life, as well as improving the items they drop.

Certain Bosses with increased difficulty will gain new abilities and begin to drop exclusive items, and have a reduced number of [LimitedRespawn|Respawn Attempts].

Difficulty above 4 has no additional effect.
zh:
难度会提高怪物的伤害和生命，并使他们掉落更好的物品。

部分首领会在高难度下获得全新的技能，也会开始掉落专属物品，同时降低玩家的[LimitedRespawn|复活]次数。

高于 4 级的难度不产生额外效果。

en:
Most endgame content allows for a limited number of deaths before you can no longer access the area. Most areas allow unlimited leaving and re-entry for other reasons except while fighting a boss.

On death during a boss fight, the [MapOwner|Map Owner] may respawn all players into a new instance of the area to attempt the boss fight again.

The number of modifiers on a [Waystone] will reduce the number of Revivals available allowed when opening a Map.
zh:
多数终局内容会限制玩家可被击败的次数。次数耗尽后，你将无法继续进入区域。多数区域在非首领战期间允许自由进出。

在首领战中被击败时，[MapOwner|地图拥有者]可以将所有玩家重生到该区域的新副本中，重新尝试首领战。

[Waystone|引路石]上的词缀数量将减少开启地图时可用的复活次数。

en:
Endgame Maps each contain a Map Boss. These Map Bosses are Unique Monsters that have special mechanics and drop increased rewards.

Defeating the Map Boss will complete the Map.
zh:
终局地图都包含一个地图首领。这些地图首领是传奇怪物，具有特殊机制并掉落增加的奖励。

击败地图首领将直接完成该地图。

en:
Powerful Map Bosses are [MapBoss|Map Bosses] that are even more difficult and drop even better rewards.

Powerful Map Bosses frequently drop [Waystone|Waystones] one Tier higher.
zh:
强力地图首领是难度更高的[MapBoss|地图首领]，会掉落更好的奖励。

强力地图首领经常掉落比当前层级更高一层的[Waystone|引路石]。

en: Empowering a [MapBoss|Map Boss] upgrades it to a [PowerfulMapBoss|Powerful Map Boss]
zh: 强化一个[MapBoss|地图首领]会将其升级为[PowerfulMapBoss|危险的地图首领]。

en: This [Debuff|Debuff] causes you take 10% increased damage and have 10% reduced Light Radius for 10 seconds per stack.
zh: 该[Debuff|减益]状态每层使你受到的伤害提高 10%，照亮范围缩小 10%，持续 10 秒。

en:
The higher toughness a monster has, the less damage it takes. A monster with 100% increased toughness takes 50% less damage, a monster with 200% increased toughness takes 67% less damage, and so on. 

Negative toughness instead causes the monster to take more damage. A monster with 100% reduced toughness takes 100% more damage, a monster with 200% reduced toughness takes 200% more damage, and so on. 

Effectively, each 100% of toughness halves the damage a monster takes, and each -100% toughness doubles the damage a monster takes.
zh:
怪物的韧性越高，受到的伤害越低。韧性提高 100% 的怪物受到的伤害总降 50%，提高 200% 的怪物受到的伤害总降 67%，以此类推。

负韧性则会导致怪物受到更多伤害。韧性降低 100% 的怪物受到伤害提高 100%，韧性降低 200% 的怪物受到伤害提高 200%，以此类推。

简言之，每 100% 的韧性会使怪物受到的伤害减半，而每 -100% 的韧性则会使怪物受到的伤害加倍。

en:
Spreading an ailment inflicts a new, matching ailment on another target, from the same source. The new ailment can potentially spread further, but never back to the same target twice.

Ailments can never spread to, or from, the entity that originally inflicted them.
zh:
扩散异常状态会在其他目标身上施加一个对应的、全新的异常状态，并视作同一个来源。新的异常状态可以继续扩散，但永远无法扩散到同一个目标身上多次。

异常状态永远无法扩散至最初施加它们的实体，也无法从该实体扩散出去。

en: 25% more [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed] while Off Hand is empty and you have a [One-Handed] [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon] equipped in your Main Hand.
zh: 副手为空，且主手装备一把[One-Handed|单手][MartialWeapon|战斗武器]时，[SkillSpeed|技能速度]总增 25%。

en:
By default, specific [Ailments] are calculated based on only specific [DamageTypes|damage types], such as only the [Fire] damage of a [HitDamage|Hit] mattering when inflicting [Ignite].

Allowing another damage type to contribute to an [Ailments|Ailment] means that all damage of the relevant types is summed when performing calculations for that [Ailments|Ailment].

For [Ailments] that use [HitDamage|Hit] damage to determine [Ailments|Ailment] chance or buildup, this means that the damage type becomes capable of inflicting that [Ailments|Ailment]. For [Ailments] that only use [HitDamage|Hit] damage to determine [Ailments|Ailment] [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] (i.e. [Bleeding] and [Poison]), you still need a way to apply those [Ailments] (e.g. a source of [Bleeding] or [Poison] chance).
zh:
在默认情况下，只有特定的[DamageTypes|伤害类型]才能计入特定的[Ailments|异常状态]。例如在一次[HitDamage|击中]里，只有[Fire|火焰]伤害的部分与[Ignite|点燃]相关。

如果允许其他伤害类型作用于[Ailments|异常状态]，则在计算该类[Ailments|异常状态]时，会将所有相关的伤害类型加总结算。

如果某种[Ailments|异常状态]会使用[HitDamage|击中]伤害来确定[Ailments|异常状态]几率或积蓄值，则这些伤害类型都可以施加对应的[Ailments|异常状态]。如果某种[Ailments|异常状态]仅使用[HitDamage|击中]伤害来确定[Ailments|异常状态]的[BuffMagnitude|强度]（例如[Bleeding|流血]和[Poison|中毒]），则你依然需要想办法来施加这些[Ailments|异常状态]（即需要获得[Bleeding|流血]和[Poison|中毒]几率）。

en: Weapon Set Passive Skill Points can be allocated differently in each of your Weapon Set Passive Trees, including your default Passive Tree.
zh: 武器组天赋点可以在每一个武器组天赋树中以不同方式配置，也可以配置在默认天赋树里。

en: Certain Skills which create Areas of Effect on the ground create Runic Inscriptions when doing so. Various effects such as Support Gems and Unique Items can interact with these Inscriptions to cause many different effects.
zh: 部分在地上产生范围效果的技能可以在生效时产生符刻铭文。许多效果，例如辅助宝石和传奇物品，都可以与铭文互动，并产生五花八门的效果。

en:
Each Runic Binding grants 10% reduced [Spell] Damage and 2% reduced Skill cost [Efficiency]. You can have up to 10 Runic Bindings. Runic Bindings last for 10 seconds.

Runic Bindings cannot be gained while [Shapeshift|Shapeshifted].
zh:
每层符文咒缚使你承受的[Spell|法术]伤害降低 10%，并使技能消耗[Efficiency|效能]降低 2%。你最多可拥有 10 层符文咒缚。符文束缚持续 10 秒。

[Shapeshift|变形]状态下无法获得符文咒缚。

en:
Each Unbound Potential grants 20% increased Damage, 10% increased [Armour], and 10% increased [EnergyShield|Energy Shield]. You can have up to 10 Unbound Potential, and will lose one every 5 seconds.

Lose all Unbound Potential when you [Shapeshift] into a Human.
zh:
每层潜能释放使你的伤害提高 20%，[Armour|护甲]和[EnergyShield|能量护盾]提高 10%。你最多可拥有 10 层潜能释放，且每 5 秒会失去一层。

当你[Shapeshift|变形]为人形时，将失去所有潜能释放。

en: Offering Skills target an active Skeleton [Minion] to create an Offering Spike. Offering Spikes grant various [Buff|Buffs] to you or your [Minion|Minions], and can even directly damage Enemies. Offering Skills are themselves damageable [Minion|Minions] and their [Buff|Buffs] are lost if they die.
zh: 奉献技能需要以一个激活的魔侍[Minion|召唤生物]为目标，产生一根奉献尖刺。奉献尖刺会为你和[Minion|召唤生物]提供多种[Buff|增益]状态，甚至可以直接对敌人造成伤害。奉献技能本身也属于[Minion|召唤生物]，可以受到伤害，并且被击败时会失去[Buff|增益]状态。

en: Payoff Skills have powerful extra affects when [HitDamage|Hitting] enemies inflicted with specific [Debuff|Debuffs], often [Consume|Consuming] the [Debuff] in the process. Payoff Skills cannot inflict the [Debuff] they interact with.
zh: 清算技能[HitDamage|击中]敌人时，如果敌人受到特定[Debuff|减益状态]影响，就可以产生强大的额外效果，通常也会[Consume|消耗][Debuff|减益]状态。清算技能本身无法造成与其互动的[Debuff|减益状态]。

en:
Grenade Skills are only usable when wielding a [Crossbow]. They have cooldowns, but generally deliver high damage or powerful utility.

Grenade Skills have a fuse duration and will generally not explode until the fuse has expired, so they are strongest when you aim carefully and predict enemy movements.

Grenades cannot [Fork] or [Chain].
zh:
榴弹技能只能在装备[Crossbow|战弩]时使用。这类技能具有冷却时间，通常可以造成高额的伤害，或产生强力的功能效果。

榴弹技能具有引线持续时间，通常只会在引线燃尽后爆炸，需要仔细瞄准并预判敌人的行动，才能发挥出最强的效果。

榴弹无法[Fork|分叉]或[Chain|连锁]。

en: Increasing your Stun Recovery causes you to recover more quickly from being [Stun|Stunned].
zh: 提高晕眩回复可以让你在[Stun|晕眩]之后更快回复。

en:
Grasping Vines is a stacking [Debuff] that [Slow|Slows] character movement speed by 8% for each stack applied.
Moving will gradually remove stacks of Grasping Vines.
zh:
缓速藤蔓是可叠加的[Debuff|减益状态]，每层使角色的移动速度[Slow|减慢] 8%。
移动会逐渐移除缓速藤蔓的层数。

en: Enraged is a [Buff] that grants 25% [Toughness] and 25% increased damage.
zh: 狂暴[Buff|增益状态]可以使[Toughness|韧性]提高 25%，伤害提高 25%。

en: Volatiles are homing orbs which move towards a target before exploding after a duration or when they get close enough, dealing damage in a larger area.
zh: 无常是一种追踪法球，能够向一个目标移动，并在一段时间后或接近目标时爆炸，在较大的范围内造成伤害。

en: Petrify is a [Debuff] which causes targets to become covered in stone and unable to move or act.
zh: 石化[Debuff|减益状态]能够使目标化作岩石，无法移动或行动。

en: Each Explosive Rhythm [Buff] grants 10% increased [CooldownRecovery|Cooldown Recovery Rate] to your [Grenade] Skills.
