zh: 每层[Explosive Rhythm|爆破韵律][Buff|增益状态]能使你的[Grenade|榴弹]技能的[CooldownRecovery|冷却回复速度]提高 10%。

en:
Explosive Fervour is a [Buff] that grants 15% increased Attack Speed per different [Grenade] Skill you've used [Recently], causes [Grenade] Skills to ignore their cooldown and fire an additional projectile, and makes [Grenade|Grenades] explode on any impact.

You cannot gain [ExplosiveRhythm|Explosive Rhythm] while you have Explosive Fervour.
zh:
爆破热忱是一种[Buff|增益状态]，根据你[Recently|近期]使用过的每种不同[Grenade|榴弹]技能，每种使攻击速度提高 15%，使[Grenade|榴弹]技能无视冷却时间并额外发射一枚投射物，并且使[Grenade|榴弹]在受到任意撞击时都会爆炸。

当你拥有爆破热忱时，你无法获得[ExplosiveRhythm|爆破韵律]。

en:
Augments are items which can be placed into Augment sockets, usually on [Equipment] items. Once socketed, they can be replaced by other Augments, but cannot be removed by normal means. 

The types of [Equipment] which an Augment can be placed into and the corresponding benefit provided are listed on the item.
zh:
增幅器是可嵌入增幅器插槽的物品，通常在[Equipment|装备]物品上。一旦镶嵌，虽可被其他增幅器替换，但无法通过常规方式移除。

增幅器可嵌入的[Equipment|装备]类型及其对应增益已在物品描述中列明。

en:
Gain no inherent bonus from [Strength]
1% increased [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] per 2 Strength
zh:
无法获得[Strength|力量]的固有加成
每 2 点力量提高 1% 的[EnergyShield|能量护盾]

en:
Gain no inherent bonus from [Dexterity]
1% increased [Armour|Armour] per 2 Dexterity
zh:
无法获得[Dexterity|敏捷]的固有加成
每 2 点敏捷提高 1% 的[Armour|护甲]

en:
Gain no inherent bonus from [Intelligence]
1% increased [Evasion|Evasion Rating] per 2 Intelligence
zh:
无法获得[Intelligence|智慧]的固有加成
每 2 点智慧提高 1% 的[Evasion|闪避值]

en: Sacred Water is a resource you find within the Trial of the Sekhemas. It is used to purchase [Boons] from merchants and venerate Maraketh Shrines, granting you various effects within the Trial.
zh: 圣水是能够在丝克玛试炼中找到的资源，用于从商人处购买[Boons|恩赐]，或用于敬拜马拉克斯神龛，使你在试炼中获得多项效果。

en:
Boons are positive effects that are applied to the Trial of the Sekhemas; making them easier to run.
Boons can be gained from certain Maraketh Shrines or from buying them from the Trial Merchant using [SacredWater|Sacred Water].
Boons can be either Minor or Major, providing varying benefits to your Trial.
zh:
恩赐是丝克玛试炼中生效的正面效果，能够降低试炼的难度。
恩赐可以使用[SacredWater|圣水]从特定的马拉克斯神龛处获得，也可以从试炼商人处购买。
恩赐分为次要恩赐和主要恩赐，能够在试炼中产生不同的增益状态。

en:
Afflictions are negative effects that are applied to the Trial of the Sekhemas; making them harder to run.
Afflictions will be applied for entering certain rooms in the Trial or from encountering certain Maraketh Shrines.
Afflictions can be either Minor or Major, providing varying negative effects to your Trial.
zh:
痛苦是丝克玛试炼中生效的负面效果，能够提高试炼的难度。
痛苦会在进入试炼中的某些房间时获得，遭遇特定的马拉克斯神龛时也会获得。
痛苦分为主要痛苦和次要痛苦，能够在试炼中产生不同的负面效果。

en: Enfeeble is a [Curse] that lessens the damage dealt by those affected. If not otherwise specified, Enfeeble lessens damage dealt by unique targets by 10%, and other targets by 20%.
zh: 衰弱是一种[Curse|诅咒]，能够降低受影响目标造成的伤害。除非另有说明，否则衰弱使传奇目标伤害总降10%，其他目标总降 20%。

en: Binding Chains is a stacking [Debuff] that [Slow|Slows] character movement speed by 8% for each stack applied.
zh: 束缚之链是可叠加的[Debuff|减益状态]，每层使角色的移动速度[Slow|减慢] 8%。

en: Bronze, Silver or Gold Keys are sometimes awarded for completing rooms or for killing monsters within the Trial of the Sekhemas. After completing each floor of the Trial there will be an assortment of Bronze, Silver and Gold caches which can be opened by their respective key, revealing treasures within.
zh: 在丝克玛试炼中，完成房间或击败怪物有时可以获得青铜、白银或黄金钥匙。完成试炼的每个楼层之后，就能找到青铜、白银和黄金宝匣，用对应的钥匙开启即可获得其中的珍宝。

en:
Relics are items that are placed in the Relic Altar before the start of the Trial of the Sekhemas.
Relics influence various aspects of the Trial to make it easier. Your Relics persist between Trials.
Selected Relics cannot be changed while you have an active Trial.
Relics have varying dimensions, so arrange them carefully to maximise your benefits.
You can unlock more Relic slots by killing bosses deeper into the Trials.
Spare Relics can be stored in the Relic Locker or any of your personal stash tabs.
zh:
遗物是开启丝克玛试炼之前放置在遗物之殿中的物品。
遗物影响了试炼的方方面面，来使你的旅途更加轻松。你的遗物可以在多场试炼中保留。
激活一场试炼之后，就无法改变选择的遗物。
遗物具有不同的维度，你必须谨慎选择才能充分发挥它的作用。
你可以通过击败试炼深处的首领来解锁更多的遗物插槽。
多余的遗物可以存放在遗物陈列柜或你的任意个人仓库页中。

en: This is modifier applies to [Debuff|Debuffs] you inflict that [Slow|Slow] enemies, and scales only the specific [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] that slows the target. It will not affect any other [BuffMagnitude|Magnitudes] that [Debuff] has if it does other things in addition to the [Slow].
zh: 这类词缀会对使敌人[Slow|减速]的[Debuff|减益]状态生效，并且仅影响减速的[BuffMagnitude|强度]。如果[Debuff|减益]除了[Slow|减速]之外还具有其他效果，这部分效果的[BuffMagnitude|强度]将不受影响。

en: You are on High Infernal Flame if you have 65% of your maximum Infernal Flame or more.
zh: 如果你的地狱烈焰达到或高于地狱烈焰上限的 65%，便处于高地狱烈焰状态。

en: Purple Flames of Chayula provide a stacking [Buff] granting 7% of damage as extra [Chaos] damage. Stacks up to 10 times.
zh: 紫色夏乌拉之焰能够提供可叠加的[Buff|增益]状态，获得相当于伤害 7% 的额外[Chaos|混沌]伤害。最多叠加 10 次。

en: Affects the speed at which all Skills are used. Increases and reductions to Skill Speed stack additively with increases and reductions to [Attack] Speed, [Spell|Cast] Speed, [Warcry] Speed, and similar stats.
zh: 影响所有技能的使用速度。技能速度的增减效果与[Attack|攻击]速度、[Spell|施法]速度、[Warcry|战吼]速度和类似属性的效果为加法叠加生效。

en: Wildwood Wisps grant 30% increased Tribute Gained to Players within 3 metres of it.
zh: 荒林鬼灵会使 3 米内的玩家获得的贡品提高 30%。

en: Close Range is anywhere within 2 metres of your character. Normally, [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] you make are in Close Range.
zh: 近距离指的是角色 2 米以内的范围。通常来说，你的[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]都位于近距离内。

en: Unleash is an effect that allows [Spell|Spells] to accumulate Seals that allows the [Spell] to reoccur when being cast. There is a limit of 2 Seals per [Spell].
zh: 释出效果使[Spell|法术]能够积累封印，使[Spell|法术]在施放时可以重复。每个[Spell|法术]的封印上限为 2 个。

en: Link Skills are Skills that allow you to link to your [Allies] to provide them with [Buff|Buffs] while you are within a certain distance of them.
zh: 羁绊技能使你能够与[Allies|友军]产生羁绊，但你们位于一定距离内时为对方提供[Buff|增益]状态。

en:
Guard is a [Buff] that provides a buffer against damage from [HitDamage|Hits], taking the damage before your Life or [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] until the buff expires or is depleted.

You can only have a single Guard buff at a time. If you gain Guard when you already have it, whichever buff has the higher magnitude will be kept, and that buff's duration will be refreshed by an amount proportional to the magnitude of the discarded buff, but not to longer than its original duration. Your maximum amount of Guard is equal to 200% of your maximum Life.
zh:
防卫是一种[Buff|增益状态]，为来自[HitDamage|击中]的伤害提供缓冲，在增益状态消失或耗尽前优先承受伤害，然后才会扣减你的生命或[EnergyShield|能量护盾]。

你同时只能拥有一个防卫增益状态。如果你在已有防卫时再次获得防卫，会保留强度较高的增益状态，并根据被丢弃增益状态的强度按比例刷新持续时间，但不会超过原始持续时间。你的最大防卫值等同于 200%你的最大生命值。

en:
Maps containing a Delirium Mirror can have the mirror walked through to unleash the rolling Delirium fog ring across the current area. 
You must stay within this fog as it expands to maintain the [Delirious|Delirium] or it will disappear.

[Rarity|Magic] monsters are able to gain Delirium specific [MonsterModifiers|Modifiers] while inside the fog.

[Rarity|Rare] or [Rarity|Unique] monsters in the fog may manifest Delirium Demons. Manifested Delirium Demons inhabit the monster's body to occasionally use Skills of their own.

[FracturingMirror|Fractured Mirrors] may be found within Delirium Fog, summoning extra monsters while [FracturingMirrorShard|Fracturing Mirror Shards] are found at set depths, with more varied rewards.

Defeating [MapBoss|Map Bosses] has a chance to summon a [DeliriumGigaMirror|Grand Mirror] on a nearby map.
zh:
地图包含惊悸迷雾之镜时，穿过镜子即可释放出遍及整个区域的滚动的惊悸迷雾之环。
你必须在这片迷雾扩张时始终留在迷雾中，才能维持[Delirious|惊悸迷雾]，否则它就会消散。

迷雾中的[Rarity|魔法]怪物能够获得惊悸迷雾专属的[MonsterModifiers|词缀]。

迷雾中的[Rarity|稀有]或[Rarity|传奇]怪物可能显化出惊悸迷雾恶魔。显化出的惊悸迷雾恶魔会寄宿于怪物体内，并偶尔使用其自身的技能。

惊悸迷雾中可发现[FracturingMirror|破溃之镜]，它们会召唤额外的怪物；而在特定深度可发现[FracturingMirrorShard|破溃之镜碎片]，提供更多样的奖励。

击败[MapBoss|地图首领]后，有机会在附近地图上召唤出[DeliriumGigaMirror|恢宏之镜]。

en:
Expeditions are Ancient Kalguuran burial sites, with [ContainsExpedition2|Verisium Remnants] and dangers buried beneath the ground.

Set up a chain of explosives and unearth the treasures, but beware of the dangers that hide in wait. Verisium Remnants apply their Modifiers to Monsters and Chests that are excavated with the same explosive that destroys the Remnant and all subsequent unearthed Monsters and Chests.

Using [ExpeditionLogbookCurrency|Logbooks] on the Atlas can reveal [GrandExpedition|Grand Expeditions] which are larger versions of regular Expeditions and can contain special types of Remnants.
zh:
先祖秘藏是远古卡古兰人的墓葬遗址，地下埋藏着[ContainsExpedition2|维金残片]和各种危机。

设置一连串炸药，挖掘出宝藏，但要当心其中潜伏的危险。维金残片会将其词缀应用于由摧毁该残片的同一炸药所挖掘出的怪物和宝箱，以及后续所有挖掘出的怪物和宝箱。

在异界图鉴上使用[ExpeditionLogbookCurrency|日志]可以揭示[GrandExpedition|宏大先祖秘藏]，这是普通先祖秘藏的放大版本，可能包含特殊类型的残片。

en:
Verisium Remnants are fragments of the stars themselves, called down by Kalguurans to harness their power.

Verisium Remnants allow you to craft a variety of rewards. Each Remnant has a number of slots available for runes to be inscribed, and when you first find it, it will have one rune already inscribed.

Based on the inscribed rune, you'll be able to select a reward and, based on the runes required for the recipe, you will have to fight waves of Verisium infused monsters to complete the encounter and receive your reward.

The number of monster waves are one less than the total number of inscribable slots for the chosen recipe. Each wave of the encounter will activate an additional runic effect, starting from the first two runes on the left.
zh:
维金残片是星辰本身的碎片，由卡古兰人召唤下来以驾驭其力量。

维金残片允许你制作各种奖励。每个残片都有若干可铭刻符文的槽位，当你首次发现它时，已有一个符文预先铭刻其上。

根据已铭刻的符文，你可以选择一项奖励，并基于配方所需的符文，你需要对抗数波被维金强化的怪物以完成此次遭遇并领取奖励。

怪物波次的数量比所选配方可铭刻槽位总数少一波。遭遇的每一波都会激活一个额外的符文效果，从左侧的头两个符文开始依次激活。

en:
Grand Expeditions are a larger version of [ContainsExpedition|Expeditions] with many more explosives. These contain special [ContainsExpedition2|Remnants] and treasures to unearth.

These are only found in Ocean Biomes revealed with [ExpeditionLogbookCurrency|Logbooks].

These areas have additional modifiers to improve their rewards.
zh:
宏大先祖秘藏是[ContainsExpedition|先祖秘藏]的放大版本，拥有更多炸药。其中包含特殊的[ContainsExpedition2|残片]和有待挖掘的宝藏。

这些先祖秘藏仅出现在由[ExpeditionLogbookCurrency|日志]揭示的海洋地貌中。

这些区域会带有额外词缀，以提升其奖励。

en:
Breaches allow invaders from another world to access ours.

Unstable Breaches are a small tear in the fabric that will open for a short time. Kill Breach monsters to keep them open longer.
Once enough monsters have been killed, the Breach will stabalise, calling stronger monsters through the portal at the centre.
Kill these monsters in the centre will complete the Unstable Breach, closing the tear.

A Breach Hive is a tear that has already grown out of control. You will need the help of Ailith to close these.
With a blessing from Chayula, burn your way to the centre of the Hive and help Ailith start the process of destorying the centre.
As Ailith destroys the Hive, Breach monsters will pour in to try and kill her. Defend Ailith until she has completely destroyed the centre of the hive to remove it from existence.
If Ailith dies during this, the Hive will remain.
zh:
裂隙的存在，让另一个世界的入侵者得以进入我们的世界。

不稳定裂隙是维度结构上的微小裂口，只会短暂开启。击杀裂隙怪物可延长其开启时间。
击杀足够多的怪物后，裂隙将趋于稳定，通过中央传送门召唤更强大的怪物。
击杀中央的怪物即可完成不稳定裂隙，关闭裂口。

裂隙巢穴是已失控的裂口。你需要艾利丝的帮助才能关闭它们。
借助夏乌拉的祝福，一路烧穿，直至虫巢核心，协助艾利丝摧毁核心。
当艾莉丝摧毁巢穴时，裂隙怪物会蜂拥而入，试图杀死她。保护艾利丝，直至她完全摧毁虫巢核心，将其从存在中抹除。
若此期间艾利丝死亡，巢穴将继续存在。

en:
Ritual Altars are sacrificial sites that absorb the monsters slain within their ritual circles. After an amount of monsters have been slain, the Ritual can be activated.
Activating the Ritual will resurrect the slain monsters, requiring you slay them once more. 

Defeating these revived monsters earns you Tribute, a resource that you can trade for various Favours from the Ritual Altar. 
The list of Favours tradable for Tribute can be rerolled, costing Tribute.
Favours can be deferred, paying a part of their cost but having them appear again later.
zh:
驱灵祭坛是奉献之地，能够吸收法阵范围内被击败的怪物。击败一定数量的怪物后，就可以开启灵坛。
激活灵坛会复苏被击败的怪物，需要你再一次击败他们。

击败复苏的怪物能够获得贡品，并用这种资源在驱灵祭坛处换取各种恩典。
贡品能够交换的恩惠可以刷新，但刷新也需要消耗贡品。
恩惠可以延期保留，支付相当于价格一定比例的贡品，使它们之后再次出现。

en:
An Abyss is a pit which leads deep underground with multiple fissures branching from it. Any monsters spawned near an Abyss will be weakened by it.
Defeating these weakened monsters will cause the fissures to close.
Once the fissures have closed all the way to the pit, the pit will activate and spawn a large number of Abyssal monsters. Defeating these monsters will close the pit. 

Each closed pit has a chance to spawn an Abyssal Trove which can grant pieces of [Abyssalify|Preserved Bone] to craft onto your Items. The final Abyss in the area has a chance to instead open an underground dungeon called an [AbyssalDepths|Abyssal Depths].

There are three separate groups of Abyssal Monsters: the Lightless, the Blackblooded and the Legion of the Pit, each area generally contains one of these groups.
The rarity of the monsters spawned depends on the rarity of the slain weakened monsters and the emerging Abyssal will steal some or all of the modifiers from them.
Any of the modifiers stolen by Rare Abyssal can be upgraded to [AbyssalModifiers|Abyssal Modifiers].
zh:
深渊是一座通往地底深处的巨坑，其中有多道分支的裂缝。深渊附近生成的任何怪物会受其弱化。
击败这些受弱化的怪物会关闭裂缝。
通往巨坑的所有裂缝都被关闭后，巨坑便会开启，并生成大量的深渊怪物。击败这些怪物将关闭巨坑。

每个关闭的巨坑有一定几率生成深渊保险箱，可获得[Abyssalify|遗存颚骨]，可用于物品工艺。区域内最后的深渊有几率开启名为[AbyssalDepths|绝望深渊]的地下城。

深渊势力怪物有三种不同群体：暗光、黑血之众以及深渊军团。每个区域一般仅含有其中一个群体。
生成怪物的稀有度取决于击杀弱化怪物的稀有度，而出现的深渊势力会偷取其部分或全部词缀。
稀有深渊势力偷取的任何词缀可升级为[AbyssalModifiers|深渊词缀]。

en: Tablets are special items that can be used in the Map Device to add more Endgame Mechanics to Maps on your Atlas.
zh: 石板是一种特殊物品，能够在地图设置中使用，为异界上的地图添加更多终局游戏机制。

en:
Waystones are items that can be used to travel to Maps on the Atlas.
 
Higher Waystone tiers open higher level areas containing more difficult monsters which drop higher level items and allows the use of higher tier Atlas Passives.

Waystones can be modified to increase the difficulty and reward of monsters encountered in Maps.
zh:
引路石是一种物品，能够让你前往异界图鉴上的地图。

引路石等阶越高，开启的区域等阶就越高，其中的怪物就更强大，掉落物品等级更高，并允许使用更高等级的异界天赋。

引路石可以被修改，以增加地图中遭遇的怪物难度和奖励。

en:
Essence monsters are powerful monsters trapped in crystallised corruption.

Breaking these monsters free allows them to be defeated, dropping the Essence that can then be used to modify equipment.

Any monsters with Essences [MonsterModifiers|Modifiers] drop an additional Essence of that type.
zh:
精华怪物是被结晶的腐化所困的强力怪物。

让这些怪物挣脱束缚并击败它们，就能掉落精华物品，可以为装备添加词缀。

任何带有精华[MonsterModifiers|词缀]的怪物会额外掉落一个同类型的精华。

en:
Shrines are Precursor Artifacts that empower monsters with its [Presence] with various effects.
Defeat all the monsters [ShrineMonster|Worshipping] the Shrine and interact with it to temporarily gain the power for yourself.
zh:
神龛是先驱者遗物，能够为[Presence|在场]的怪物提供多种效果的强化。
击败[ShrineMonster|敬拜]神龛的怪物并与其互动，就能暂时让这份力量为你所用。

en:
Strongboxes are locked chests that contain various items.
Attempting to unlock a Strongbox will unleash [Pack|Packs] of monsters that must be defeated in order to get the items within.
Strongboxes can be modified to increase the difficulty and reward of the monsters and rewards within respectively.
zh:
保险箱是上锁的箱子，其中含有多件物品。
尝试打开保险箱会释放出[Pack|成群]的怪物，只有击败它们才能获得其中的物品。
保险箱可以添加词缀，提升遭遇怪物的难度和提供的奖励，以及保险箱本身的奖励。

en:
Precursor Towers are ancient structures that are scattered all throughout the Atlas. Precursor Tower Maps can be completed to reveal a large area around them and to obtain a [Tablet|Tablet].

Completing a Precursor Tower requires you to activate the Precursor Beacon at the end of the Map, after defeating the [MapBoss|Map Boss].
zh:
先驱高塔是远古时期的建筑，散落在异界的各地。完成先驱高塔地图可以揭示其周围的大片区域，并获得一个[Tablet|石板]。

完成先驱高塔需要你击败[MapBoss|地图首领]后，在地图终点时激活先驱灯塔。

en:
Fracturing Mirrors are structures found in [ContainsDelirium|Delirium] Fog that shatter when you get near them, spawning [ContainsDelirium|Delirium] monsters.

Occasionally Fracturing Mirrors [FracturingMirrorShard|Shards] may appear with other bonuses, such as adding [DistilledEmotion|Liquid Emotions] to monsters or summoning a Mirrored Boss.
zh:
破溃之镜是能够在[ContainsDelirium|惊悸迷雾]中找到的建筑，当你靠近时就会碎裂，并生成[ContainsDelirium|惊悸迷雾]怪物。

偶尔，破溃之镜[FracturingMirrorShard|碎片]会附带其他增益效果出现，例如为怪物附加[DistilledEmotion|液化情感]，或召唤一个镜像首领。

en:
Fracturing Mirror Shards are a type of [FracturingMirror|Fracturing Mirror] found within [ContainsDelirium|Delirium] Fog at set depths.

Escalation Shards may add modifiers to rare Delirium monsters, summoning more difficult and rewarding monsters, or pausing the Fog.

Deceptive Shards summon Delirium bosses or lead to an extra Delirious area.

Capricious Shards do not manifest by default, once unlocked they may summon a mirrored Map Boss, or cause Map Bosses to manifest [DeliriumGigaMirror|Grand Mirrors].
zh:
破溃之镜碎片是[FracturingMirror|破溃之镜]的一种，可在特定深度的[ContainsDelirium|惊悸迷雾]中找到。

恶变碎片可为惊悸迷雾怪物添加词缀，召唤更强大、奖励更丰厚的怪物，或暂停迷雾。

欺瞒碎片可召唤惊悸迷雾首领，或引向额外的惊悸迷雾区域。

无常碎片默认不会显现，一旦解锁，可召唤地图首领的镜像，或使地图首领显化为[DeliriumGigaMirror|恢宏之镜]。

可以[Evasion|闪避]所有击中
[Evasion|闪避]值总降 75%

en:
Basic Jewels do not affect nodes in a radius.
Basic Jewels are Rubies, Emeralds, Sapphires and Diamonds.
zh:
基本珠宝不会影响一定范围内的天赋节点。
基本珠宝包含红玉、翡翠、蓝玉和宝钻。

en: The Realmgate is a piece of Vaal Technology which allows the use of Atlas mechanic keys; accessing deadly areas and facing off against powerful enemies.
zh: 界域之门是瓦尔科技的杰作，能够让你使用异界机制钥匙，开启危险的区域，面对强力的敌人。

en: The Reliquary Vault is a Vaal Vault which can be accessed by using Reliquary Keys found throughout the Atlas.
zh: 圣物宝库是一处瓦尔宝库，可以使用在异界各地找到的圣物厅钥匙开启。

en:
Contains Corruption, which may add an additional modifier to the area.

Corrupted Areas cause slain monsters to [CoalescedCorruption|Coalesce Corruption] to manifest powerful monsters.
zh:
包含腐化，可能为该区域增加一个额外词缀。

被腐化的区域会使被击败的怪物[CoalescedCorruption|凝聚腐化]，形成强大的怪物。

en:
Contains a [Rarity|Unique] Map layout which may contain specialised rewards.

Unique Maps cannot gain additional content, [Essence|Essences], [Shrine|Shrines], or [Strongbox|Strongboxes].
zh:
包含[Rarity|传奇]地图布局，可能含有专门的奖励。

传奇地图不会具有额外内容、[Essence|精华]、[Shrine|神龛]或[Strongbox|保险箱]。

en:
Contains a Hideout that can be fully cleared to unlock the Hideout for personal use.

All monsters in the area are at least [Rarity|Magic].
zh:
包含一个藏身处，完全清空即可解锁该私人藏身处。

区域内的所有怪物至少为[Rarity|魔法]怪物。

en: Contains a Wandering Trader who may offer you powerful rewards.
zh: 包含一个流浪的商人，会为你提供强大的奖励。

en:
There are three types of Citadels, each located in different cities throughout Wraeclast. 

[CopperCitadel|Copper Citadels] in Faridun Cities, [IronCitadel|Iron Citadels] in Ezomyte Cities and [StoneCitadel|Stone Citadels] in Vaal Cities.

Complete one of each type of Citadel and collect their Crisis Fragments to gain access to [TheBurningMonoilth|The Burning Monolith].
zh:
瓦尔克拉斯各地散布着三座城塞，分别位于不同族群的城市中。

法里顿城市中有[CopperCitadel|古铜城塞]，艾兹麦城市中有[IronCitadel|钢铁城塞]，瓦尔城市中有[StoneCitadel|磐石城塞]。

完成全部 3 座城塞并收集对应的危机碎片，即可进入[TheBurningMonoilth|燃石巨塔]。

en:
The Copper [Citadel] is an endgame area which can be accessed with a Tier 15 or above [Waystone]. The boss of this area will drop a [PinnacleKey2|Faded Crisis Fragment].

Increases to [Waystone] Drop Chance gives a chance for additional Crisis Fragments to drop.
zh:
古铜[Citadel|城塞]是一处终局游戏区域，可以使用 15 阶或以上的[Waystone|引路石]开启。该区域的首领会掉落一个[PinnacleKey2|褪色的危机碎片]。

提高[Waystone|引路石]的掉落几率就有几率掉落额外的危机碎片。

en:
The Iron [Citadel] is an endgame area which can be accessed with a Tier 15 or above [Waystone]. The boss of this area will drop a [PinnacleKey1|Ancient Crisis Fragment].

Increases to [Waystone] Drop Chance gives a chance for additional Crisis Fragments to drop.
zh:
钢铁[Citadel|城塞]是一处终局游戏区域，可以使用 15 阶或以上的[Waystone|引路石]开启。该区域的首领会掉落一个[PinnacleKey1|古老的危机碎片]。

提高[Waystone|引路石]的掉落几率就有几率掉落额外的危机碎片。

en:
The Stone [Citadel] is an endgame area which can be accessed with a Tier 15 or above [Waystone]. The boss of this area will drop a [PinnacleKey3|Weathered Crisis Fragment].

Increases to [Waystone] Drop Chance gives a chance for additional Crisis Fragments to drop.
zh:
磐石[Citadel|城塞]是一处终局游戏区域，可以使用 15 阶或以上的[Waystone|引路石]开启。该区域的首领会掉落一个[PinnacleKey3|风蚀的危机碎片]。

提高[Waystone|引路石]的掉落几率就有几率掉落额外的危机碎片。

en:
The Burning Monolith houses the most dangerous foe in all of Wraeclast. 
Access to this foe requires three different Crisis Fragments from the [CopperCitadel|Copper], [IronCitadel|Iron] and [StoneCitadel|Stone] [Citadel|Citadels].
zh:
燃石巨塔中潜藏着瓦尔克拉斯最危险的敌人。
要挑战此敌人，需集齐分别来自[CopperCitadel|古铜]、[IronCitadel|钢铁]和[StoneCitadel|磐石][Citadel|城塞]的三块不同危机碎片。

en:
This represents a Map. A [Waystone] can be used to access it. 

If you fail to complete the Map, it may be attempted again but will not contain additional content, [Essence|Essences], [Shrine|Shrines], or [Strongbox|Strongboxes]. It will not be [ContainsCorruption|Corrupted]. [Tablet|Tablets] cannot be used on failed Maps.

To complete a Map, defeat the [MapBoss|Boss].
zh:
代表一张地图，需要使用一个[Waystone|引路石]才能开启。

如果你未能完成地图，则可以再次尝试挑战，但地图不会具有额外内容、[Essence|精华]、[Shrine|神龛]或[Strongbox|保险箱]。地图不会被[ContainsCorruption|腐化]。[Tablet|石板]效果不再适用于未完成的地图。

要完成地图，你需要击败[MapBoss|首领]。

en:
Cooldown Recovery Rate modifies the speed at which your Skill cooldowns are restored. For example, with 100% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate your Skill cooldowns will effectively be halved.

Cooldown Recovery Rate does not affect anything other than Skill cooldowns.
zh:
冷却回复速度会影响你的技能冷却时间的回复速度。例如，冷却回复速度提高 100% 时，你的技能冷却时间就等同于减半。

冷却回复速度只会影响技能的冷却时间。

en: Jewels are items that can be socketed into Jewel Sockets on the Passive Skill Tree to grant bonuses. Basic Jewels simply grant you the listed stats, while some other kinds of Jewel can have more complicated effects, such as modifying other Passive Skills within a certain radius.
zh: 珠宝物品可以镶嵌到天赋树中的珠宝插槽中，从而提供额外加成。基本珠宝只会提供列出的属性，其他类型的珠宝可能拥有更复杂的效果，例如影响一定范围内的其他天赋。

en:
Gain no inherent bonus from [Strength]
1% increased [Projectile] [Attack] damage per 2 [Strength]
zh:
无法获得[Strength|力量]的固有加成
每 2 点[Strength|力量]提高 1% 的[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击]伤害

en:
Gain no inherent bonus from [Strength]
1% increased [Spell] damage per 2 [Strength]
zh:
无法获得[Strength|力量]的固有加成
每 2 点[Strength|力量]提高 1% 的[Spell|法术]伤害

en:
[EatenSoul|Eat the Souls] of enemies that die in your [Presence].

Each Soul grants 1% increased [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed]. You can have up to 50 eaten Souls, and lose a Soul every 0.5 seconds if you have not eaten one in the past 4 seconds.
zh:
你[Presence|在场]范围内的敌人遭到[EatenSoul|灵魂吞噬]。

每个灵魂使你的[SkillSpeed|技能速度]提高 1%。你最多可拥有50个被吞噬的灵魂，若在过去 4 秒内未吞噬任何灵魂，则每 0.5 秒失去 1 个灵魂。

en: Each Soul eaten grants 1% increased [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed]. You can have up to 50 eaten Souls, and lose a Soul every 0.5 seconds if you have not eaten one in the past 4 seconds.
zh: 每个被吞噬的灵魂使你的[SkillSpeed|技能速度]提高 1%。你最多可拥有50个被吞噬的灵魂，若在过去 4 秒内未吞噬任何灵魂，则每 0.5 秒失去 1 个灵魂。

en:
Leech recovers an amount of [LifeLeech|Life], [ManaLeech|Mana], [EnergyShieldLeech|Energy Shield], or [RageLeech|Rage] over one second, usually as a result of [HitDamage|Hitting] an enemy and based on the damage of the [HitDamage|Hit].

Only one instance of Leech for each resource can provide recovery at a time.
zh:
偷取会根据[HitDamage|击中]敌人的[HitDamage|击中]伤害，在 1 秒内回复一定量的[LifeLeech|生命]、[ManaLeech|魔力]、[EnergyShieldLeech|能量护盾]或[RageLeech|怒火]。

每种资源同时只能有一个偷取实例提供回复。

en: You can only have one Historic Jewel socketed.
zh: 你只能镶嵌一个久远珠宝。

en: Catalysts are Currency items that are exclusive drops from the [ContainsBreach|Breach] mechanic. Catalysts add [Quality] that affect certain modifiers on items. There are two categories of Catalyst, one that affects [Jewellery] and one that affects [Jewel|Jewels].
zh: 催化剂是通货物品，只能通过[ContainsBreach|裂隙]机制掉落。催化剂可以为物品添加影像特定词缀的[Quality|品质]。催化剂分为两类：一类影响[Jewellery|饰品]，另一类影响[Jewel|珠宝]。

en: Omens are Currency items that enable exclusive meta-crafting effects, allowing for more specialised crafting.
zh: 预兆是通货物品，可以开启专属的超凡工艺效果，实现定向工艺制作。

en: An Audience with the King is an item that is an exclusive drop from the [ContainsRitual|Ritual] mechanic. This item allows you to access the Crux of Nothingness via the [Realmgate].
zh: 谒王之约是一种物品，只能通过[ContainsRitual|驱灵祭坛]机制掉落。你可以在[Realmgate|界域之门]处使用该物品以进入虚无之症。

en: Liquid Emotions are Currency items that are exclusive drops from the [ContainsDelirium|Delirium] mechanic. Liquid Emotions allow you to instil an amulet with a Notable Passive Skill from the Passive Tree. Instilling a Notable Passive Skill which you have already allocated normally will not grant its effects a second time.
zh: 液化情感是通货物品，只能通过[ContainsDelirium|惊悸迷雾]机制掉落。液化情感使你能够为项链灌注一个天赋树上的核心天赋。灌注已通过正常途径配置的核心天赋不会重复获得它的效果。

en: Ancient Liquid Emotions are a type of [DistilledEmotion|Liquid Emotion] that applies specific modifiers to Time-Lost Jewels.
zh: 远古液态情感是[DistilledEmotion|液化情感]的一种，可将特定词缀附加至失落时空珠宝上。

en:
Certain items can be found Corrupted or made Corrupted using a Vaal Orb, changing their properties unpredictably.
Most methods of item crafting and modification cannot be used on Corrupted items. There is no penalty for using Corrupted items.
zh:
部分物品在获得时就是腐化物品，或者使用过瓦尔宝珠，在不可预测地改变属性的同时而被腐化。
大部分物品工艺和修改的方式都无法对腐化物品使用。使用腐化物品并没有惩罚。

en:
Certain items can be found Mirrored or made Mirrored using a Mirror of Kalandra.
Mirrored items are copies of an original item. Most methods of item crafting and modification cannot be used on Mirrored items.
zh:
部分物品在获得时就是复制物品，或者使用卡兰德的魔镜而被复制。
复制物品是原始物品的复制版。大部分物品工艺和修改的方式都无法对复制物品使用。

en: Hexproof means that you are [Unaffected] by [Curse|Curses].
zh: 诅咒免疫表示[Curse|诅咒]对你[Unaffected|不产生影响]。

en:
Runic Monsters are powerful monsters encountered in [ContainsExpedition|Expeditions].

Runic Monsters are more commonly found by using explosives on larger [ContainsExpedition|Expedition] markers.
zh:
符文怪物是[ContainsExpedition|先祖秘藏]中遭遇的强力怪物。

对较大的[ContainsExpedition|先祖秘藏]标记使用炸药通常就会发现符文怪物。

en: Monsters slain close together have a chance to merge together and manifest powerful Monsters.
zh: 聚集在一起的怪物被击败时，有几率融合成形，凝聚出强力的怪物。

en:
Certain [Channelling] skills have extra effects and benefits if released within a certain timing window while using the skill.
Certain support gems and items can modify the duration of that timing window.
zh:
使用部分[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能时，在特定的时间窗口内释放该技能，就能产生额外的效果和加成。
特定的辅助宝石和物品可以影响这一时间窗口的持续时间。

en:
Certain skills can only have a limited number of effects active at once.
If a new effect is created while at the maximum number of effects, the oldest effect will dissapear.
Certain support gems and items can modify skill effect limits.
zh:
部分技能在同一时间只能激活一定数量的效果。
如果在达到效果上限时产生新的效果，则最久远的效果将会消失。
特定的辅助宝石和物品可以影响技能效果的上限。

en: Monsters with Soul Eater gain 1% increased [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed] and 1% less damage taken when a monster dies in their [Presence], stacking up to 50 times. An eaten Soul is lost every 0.5 seconds if none have been eaten within the past 4 seconds.
zh: 带有噬魂者的怪物，其[Presence|在场]范围内有怪物死亡时，[SkillSpeed|技能速度]提高 1%，受到的伤害总降 1%，最多叠加 50 次。若过去 4 秒内没有吞噬任何灵魂，则每 0.5 秒失去 1 个被吞噬的灵魂。

en: Remnants are lingering objects in the world which are generally created by player Skills. Walking over a Remnant collects it to grant a bonus based on the type of Remnant. Remnants will generally disappear if not collected for some time.
zh: 残片是世界中的残留物体，通常由玩家技能创造。走过残片会收集它，根据残片类型获得加成。残片在经过一段时间不收集后会消失。

en:
Ascendancy Passive Skill Points can be allocated in your Ascendancy Skill Tree once you have chosen your Ascendancy. Your Ascendancy class is unlocked by completing any Ascension Trial. In order to change your Ascendancy, you must complete an Ascension Trial to the furthest extent you have successfully already done so, and then interact with the Ascendancy Altar while you have no Ascendancy Passive Skill Points currently assigned. Trialmaster and Balbala will offer the ability to refund passive points while in rooms with Ascendancy Altars to facilitate this.

You can obtain 4 sets of 2 Ascendancy Points for a total of 8 in the following ways:
Set 1 - Completing floor 1 of the Trial of the Sekhemas or completing the Trials of Chaos with at least 7 Trials
Set 2 - Completing floor 2 of the Trial of the Sekhemas or completing the Trials of Chaos
Set 3 - Completing floor 3 of the Trial of the Sekhemas or completing the Trials of Chaos with at least 10 Trials
Set 4 - Completing floor 4 of the Trial of the Sekhemas or completing the secret challenge behind the locked door in the Trials of Chaos
zh:
选择了升华职业之后，你就可以在升华天赋树中配置升华点数。完成任意升华试炼即可解锁升华职业。要更改升华职业，你必须完成一次升华试炼，并达到你此前达到过的最高层级，然后在没有配置升华天赋点数的前提下与升华祭坛互动。你可以在升华祭坛所在房间内找到试炼使者或贝尔巴拉，重置所有升华天赋点数。

你可以通过 4 次试炼，每次解锁 2 个升华点数，总计 8 点。方法如下：
第 1 次 - 完成丝克玛试炼的第 1 层，或者完成至少有 7 场试炼的混沌试炼
第 2 次 - 完成丝克玛试炼的第 2 层，或者完成混沌试炼
第 3 次 - 完成丝克玛试炼的第 3 层，或者完成至少有 10 场试炼的混沌试炼
第 4 次 - 完成丝克玛试炼的第 4 层，或者完成混沌试炼封印之门后的秘密挑战

en:
You lose this much less [Honour].
Maximum Honour Resistance is capped at 75% by default and cannot be higher than 90%.
zh:
降低你所失去的[Honour|荣誉]。
荣誉抗性上限默认为 75%，并且无法高于 90%。

en:
Skills can gain Stages passively or while attacking/casting them, depending on the Skill in question.

Stages gained for a given Skill apply to that instance of the Skill and will not carry over from one area to another.
zh:
有些技能可以被动叠加层数，或者在攻击/施放时叠加层数，具体取决于技能本身。

特定技能获得的层数仅对该次技能生效，并且无法保留到下一个区域中。

en: Normal enemies are Primed for [Pinned|Pin] when they have at least 40% [Pinned|Pin] buildup. Magic enemies are instead Primed at 50% buildup, Rare at 60%, and Unique at 70%.
zh: 普通敌人具有至少 40% [Pinned|定身]积蓄时可被[Pinned|定身]。魔法敌人为 50%，稀有敌人为 60%，传奇敌人为 70%。

en:
Elemental Surges are consumed when you use a non-[Melee] [Projectile] [Attack] to suffuse the [Projectile|Projectiles] fired by that [Attack], causing them to trigger a Surging Blast when they reach the end of their flight.

Your weapon can have a maximum of 6 of each type of Surge active by default. Surges last 15 seconds. Surges are specific to your current weapon, so do not affect non-weapon damage and are not carried over if you weapon swap.

[Projectile|Projectiles] which [Split] or [Fork] do not gain the benefits of Surges.
zh:
元素涌动在你使用非[Melee|近战][Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击]时被消耗，为该[Attack|攻击]发射的[Projectile|投射物]灌注力量，使它们在飞行结束时触发涌动冲击。

你的武器默认最多可以激活每种类型的元素涌动各 6 个。涌动持续 15 秒，仅对当前武器生效，不影响非武器伤害，切换武器时也不会继承。

[Split|分裂]或[Fork|分叉]的[Projectile|投射物]不会获得涌动的效果。

en: Chaos Surge behaves identically to [Surge|Elemental Surges], but causes a [Chaos] blast.
zh: 混沌涌动的效果与[Surge|元素涌动]完全相同，但触发的是[Chaos|混沌]冲击。

en:
Banner Skills generate [Glory] when you attack a Monster while it is activated. [Glory] generated corresponds to the [Power] of the Monster hit. Once at full [Glory], the Banner can be placed to create powerful [Buff|Buffing] Areas.
Normally you have a limit of a single Banner placed at one time.
zh:
旗帜技能在激活时攻击怪物会生成[Glory|荣耀]。生成的[Glory|荣耀]与被击中怪物的[Power|威力值]相对应。达到满[Glory|荣耀]后，可以放置旗帜来创造强大的[Buff|增益]区域。
通常你同时只能放置一面旗帜。

en: Skills which are Conditional require some sort of condition to be met before they can be used. [Combo] is an example of this, but almost anything can be a condition, such as having to have killed a certain number of enemies [Recently] or having to have moved a certain distance.
zh: 条件性技能只有在满足特定的条件之后才能使用。[Combo|连击]就是一个很好的例子，但几乎所有行动都可以作为条件，例如要求你[Recently|近期]击败一定数量的敌人，或者移动一定的距离。

en:
Whirlwinds [Blind] and [Slow] the movement speed of enemies within them.  If their creator crosses the edge of the Whirlwind it collapses, damaging and [Knockback|Knocking Back] enemies caught inside. The collapse deals [Melee] damage.

Trying to create a Whirlwind that would overlap with an existing Whirlwind instead moves the existing Whirlwind and grants it a stage, making it larger and more damaging.

A Whirlwind that overlaps an allied [ElementalGround|Elemental Ground Surface] takes on that element, gaining 50% of damage as the corresponding type and applying the Ground Surface's debuff to enemies inside the Whirlwind for 8 seconds.
zh:
旋风会使内部的敌人[Blind|致盲]并[Slow|减慢]其移动速度。旋风的产生者跨越旋风的边缘时会使其塌缩，对内部的敌人造成伤害和[Knockback|击退]。塌缩会造成[Melee|近战]伤害。

如果试图产生的旋风和现有的旋风重叠，则会改为移动现有的旋风并使其叠加一层，扩大范围并提高伤害。

与友军的[ElementalGround|元素地面效果]重叠的旋风会吸收元素的力量，获得 50% 对应类型的伤害，并对旋风内部的敌人施加地面效果的减益状态，持续 8 秒。

en:
Volatility explodes after 4 seconds, dealing 100 [Physical] Damage to you per Volatility. For 10 seconds after explosion, you will gain Volatile Power, [Gain|Gaining] 1% of Damage as [Chaos] for each Volatility which exploded. The explosion timer will reset on gaining another stack of Volatility.

Volatility can be gained once every 0.1 seconds, and the default maximum for Volatility stacks on you at once is 200.
zh:
无常会在 4 秒后爆炸，每层无常对你造成 100 [Physical|物理]伤害。爆炸后 10 秒内你会获得无常之力，爆炸的每层无常使你[Gain|获得] 1% 伤害的[Chaos|混沌]伤害。叠加无常层数会重置爆炸倒计时。

无常每 0.1 秒可以获得一次，你身上的无常最大堆叠层数默认为 200。

en:
While [Bleeding] enemies build up Bloodstained, gaining the Bloodstained [Debuff] after Bleeding for a total of 6 seconds. Bloodstained builds up 100% faster if the [Bleeding] enemy is moving or the Bleeding is [Aggravate|Aggravated].

Certain skills allow you to view the Bloodstained Debuff on enemies and can consume the Debuff for powerful effects.
zh:
[Bleeding|流血]的敌人会积蓄血痕，流血总计 6 秒后会获得血痕[Debuff|减益状态]。如果[Bleeding|流血]的敌人在移动，或者流血为[Aggravate|恶性]时，血痕的积蓄速度加快 100%。

部分技能允许你查看敌人身上的血痕减益状态，并消耗该减益状态来触发强力效果。

en: Revealed Weaknesses are highlighted on enemy Life bars, and occupy a total of 45% of their maximum Life (but in random segments). While the enemy's current Life is within a highlighted segment, they are considered to have an Open Weakness.
zh: 揭示的弱点会在敌人的生命条上标亮，总共占据其最大生命的 45%（但随机分段）。当敌人的当前生命位于标亮的分段中时，则视作弱点暴露。

en:
Affinity is a buff granted by the Trinity skill. There are three types of Affinity: Fire, Cold and Lightning. You can have a maximum of 100 of each type of Affinity.

You lose 10 Affinity per second of specific types if you haven't gained Affinity of that type in the past 8 seconds.
zh:
亲和是三位一体技能提供的增益状态，包含三种类型：火焰、冰霜和闪电。你可以拥有每种类型的亲和最多 100 点。

如果你在过去 8 秒内没有获得某一类型的亲和，则会每秒失去该类型的 10 点亲和。

en:
Incision is a Debuff which causes the affected target to gain increasingly higher chance to be inflicted with [Bleeding] when [HitDamage|Hit]. All Incision stacks are removed when [Bleeding] is inflicted.

Each stack of Incision applies 10% chance to be inflicted with [Bleeding] when [HitDamage|Hit]. A maximum of 10 Incision stacks can be present on a target at once.
zh:
创口是一种减益状态，使受影响的目标被[HitDamage|击中]时有更高的几率[Bleeding|流血]。造成[Bleeding|流血]时会移除所有创口层数。

每层创口使[HitDamage|击中]有 10% 的几率施加[Bleeding|流血]。同一目标同一时间最多叠加 10 层创口。

en:
Retaliating specifically refers only to the inherent ability to deal [Thorns] damage to enemies when they [HitDamage|Hit] you.

Some effects may cause you to deal [Thorns] damage in other ways, but those are not Retaliation, and effects which specifically care about when you Retaliate will ignore them.
zh:
反击特指敌人[HitDamage|击中]你时对其造成的[Thorns|荆棘]伤害。

部分效果能使你通过其他途径造成[Thorns|荆棘]伤害，但这些途径不属于反击，特别指明反击的效果将忽略这些途径。

en: Companions are a type of [Reviving] [Minion] that are more complex and powerful than typical [Minion|Minions]. By default you can only have one Companion of any type summoned at a time.
zh: 伙伴是一种[Reviving|可复活的][Minion|召唤生物]，和通常的[Minion|召唤生物]相比具有更复杂、更强大的能力。在默认情况下，你同一时间只能召唤一名任意类型的伙伴。

en:
Every Monster has exactly one Monster Category. These are Humanoid, Beast, Undead, Construct, Demon and Eldritch.

Certain Skills interact with specific Monster Categories.
zh:
每一种怪物都有具体的单一怪物类型，包括人形、野兽、亡灵、构造体、恶魔和古灵。

部分技能可以和特定的怪物类型产生互动。

en:
Hobbling a target lowers their [Evasion] by a specified amount. If this brings that target's [Evasion] value to 0, they are fully Hobbled for 12 seconds.

Hobble from Players lowers [Evasion] by 3 times as much against Normal Monsters and 2 times as much against Magic Monsters.
zh:
跛行会使目标的[Evasion|闪避]降低一定数值。如果该效果使目标的[Evasion|闪避]值降低至 0，则会使其在 12 秒内踉跄。

玩家造成的跛行降低的[Evasion|闪避]对普通怪物变为 3 倍，对魔法怪物变为 2 倍。

en: Hazards are objects created in the world (usually by some player skill) and which are destroyed when traversed by an enemy, dealing damage and/or applying some effect to the enemy which triggered the Hazard.
zh: 危害是在世界场景中产生的物体（通常由玩家击败敌人而生成），敌人穿越时会将其摧毁，对触发危害的敌人造成伤害并/或施加效果。

en: Unholy Might is a [Buff] that grants 30% of all damage as [Gain|extra] [Chaos|Chaos Damage].
zh: 不洁之力是一种[Buff|增益]状态，可提供相当于 30% 所有伤害的[Gain|额外][Chaos|混沌伤害]。

en:
Impale is a [Debuff] inflicted by [HitDamage|Hits], which stores 30% of the [Premitigation|Pre-mitigation] [Physical] [HitDamage|Hit damage] of the Impaling hit as its [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude].

Subsequent [Attack] [HitDamage|Hits] against Impaled targets will Extract the Impale debuff. When this occurs, the [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of the Impale is added to the [Premitigation|Pre-mitigation] [Physical] damage of that attack hit.

A maximum of 60 Impale [Debuff|Debuffs] can be present on a target at once. If multiple Impales are present on a target, each [Attack|Attack's] [HitDamage|Hit] only Extracts and benefits from the strongest one of them.
zh:
穿刺是一种由[HitDamage|击中]施加的[Debuff|减益状态]，造成穿刺的击中会将 30% 的[Premitigation|减免前][Physical|物理][HitDamage|击中伤害]存储为[BuffMagnitude|强度]。

对被穿刺目标的后续[Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]会提取穿刺减益状态。发生时，穿刺的[BuffMagnitude|强度]会添加到该次攻击击中的[Premitigation|减免前][Physical|物理]伤害中。

同一个目标同一时间最多叠加 60 层穿刺[Debuff|减益状态]。如果目标身上具有多个穿刺效果，每次[Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]只会提取并获得最强的穿刺效果的加成。

en: All [Physical] damage over time taken by a target (including [Bleeding]) is accumulated as Blood Loss.
zh: 目标受到的所有[Physical|物理]持续伤害（包括[Bleeding|流血]）都会积累为失血。

en:
Perfection lasts for 10 seconds and can stack up to 4 times, granting 5% more Damage per stack. This Damage bonus is not limited to Skills Supported by Perfection Support.

Failing to successfully execute any [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] will remove all Perfection stacks on you.
zh:
完美持续 10 秒，最多可以叠加 4 层，每层使伤害总增 5%。该伤害加成也会对不受完美（辅）辅助的技能生效。

未能抓住[PerfectTiming|完美时机]会移除你身上的所有完美层数。

en: A Killing Blow is any [HitDamage|Hit Damage] which successfully reduces a target to zero Life, killing them. Damage over time cannot cause Killing Blows.
zh: 最后一击指的是任意将目标的生命值降低至零并将其击败的[HitDamage|击中伤害]。持续性伤害不能造成最后一击。

en:
Hits with this weapon roll against their [Critical|Critical Hit] chance twice when determining if they are a [Critical|Critical Hit].

If either roll succeeds, the hit will be a [Critical|Critical Hit], and thus the [CriticalDamageBonus|Critical Damage Bonus] will apply as normal.

If both rolls succeed, the hit will be a [Critical|Critical Hit], and the [CriticalDamageBonus|Critical Damage Bonus] will apply twice to that Hit.

If a modifier makes your Critical Hit Chance [Lucky], that Luck will apply individually to both of these rolls.
zh:
该武器的击中结算是否造成[Critical|暴击]时，会根据其[Critical|暴击]率判断两次。

如果任意一次结算成功，则击中为[Critical|暴击]，并使[CriticalDamageBonus|暴击伤害加成]正常生效。

如果两次结算全部成功，则击中为[Critical|暴击]，并使该次击中的[CriticalDamageBonus|暴击伤害加成]翻倍。

如果有词缀使你的暴击率[Lucky|特别幸运]，两次结算会独立判断幸运。

en:
Your Pre-mitigation Damage is the damage of your hits after all your modifiers to damage have been applied, but before the target's mitigation, such as [Armour], [Resistances] or [Block|Blocking], prevents any of that damage.

The target's modifiers to Damage taken apply after their mitigation, so Pre-mitigation Damage also does not include the effects of those modifiers. However, modifiers that cause the target to take damage as a different [DamageTypes|Type] occur before mitigating the damage, so are included in Pre-mitigation Damage.
zh:
你的减免前伤害指的是击中获得所有伤害词缀加成，但未经[Armour|护甲]、[Resistances|抗性]或[Block|格挡]等效果减免前的伤害。

目标受到伤害的词缀会在减免之后结算，所以减免前伤害不受这些词缀的效果影响。然而，使目标受到的伤害转换[DamageTypes|类型]的效果会在减免之前生效，所以会影响到减免前伤害。

en: Easy Target is a [Debuff] which causes the next [Projectile] [Attack] [HitDamage|Hit] against the affected target to deal increased Damage, at which point the [Debuff] is consumed.
zh: 活靶子是一个[Debuff|减益状态]，使受影响目标受到的下一次[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]造成更高的伤害，同时消耗该[Debuff|减益状态]。

en: The Expected Knockback distance is the distance a target would be [Knockback|Knocked Back] were there nothing impeding that [Knockback], such as terrain, other entities, or other mitigating circumstances.
zh: 预期击退距离指的是在不受地形、其他实体或减免效果等[Knockback|击退]限制影响时，目标本应被[Knockback|击退]的距离。

en:
Rogue Exiles are dangerous foes that wander Wraeclast and Maps. 
They have access to the same Skills, Items, and Uniques that you do. This can make them very formidable opponents - however, if they can be defeated they will drop a full set of gear, including any [Rarity|Unique] equipment that they were using in combat.
If any Rogue Exile manages to defeat you, they will portal away, taking their equipment with them.
zh:
盗贼流放者是游荡于瓦尔克拉斯与地图中的危险敌人。
他们拥有与你相同的技能、物品与传奇物品，因此极具威胁性——但若你击败他们，他们将掉落一整套装备，包括他们战斗时所使用的任何[Rarity|传奇]装备。
若任何盗贼流放者击败你，他们将开启传送门，并携带他们的装备逃走。

en:
Azmeri Spirits are the spirits of various Azmeri Animal Guardians. 
Azmeri Spirits appear as wisps that flee as you approach them. [Rarity|Normal or Magic] Monsters the Spirit comes into contact with become [SpiritTouched|Spirit-Influenced], making them more powerful. 
Sometimes the Spirit will reach and [SpiritPossessed|Possess] a [Rarity|Rare or Unique] monster, making them substantially stronger and rewarding while occasionally summoning spiritual animals depending on the type of Animal Spirit they represent.
[SpiritPossessed|Possessed] monsters are more rewarding depending on how many [SpiritTouched|Spirit-Influenced] monsters were defeated leading up to possession.
zh:
阿兹莫里之灵是各类阿兹莫里动物守卫的灵魂。
阿兹莫里之灵表现为当你接近时会逃走的灵光。被其接触的[Rarity|普通或魔法]怪物将成为[SpiritTouched|灵魂影响]怪物，变得更强。
有时灵魂会[SpiritPossessed|附身]于一只[Rarity|稀有或传奇]怪物上，使其大幅强化并提高掉落奖励，偶尔会依照其代表的动物灵魂类型召唤灵体动物。
[SpiritPossessed|附身]怪物的掉落奖励会依据在附身前你击败了多少[SpiritTouched|灵魂影响]怪物而提升。

en:
A Possessed monster is a [Rarity|Rare or Unique] monster that has had an [AzmeriSpirit|Azmeri Spirit] enter and empower them. The possessed monster is empowered by the spirit and gains bonuses depending on the type of Spirit that possessed them. Occasionally the possessed monster will summon spiritual animals depending on the type of Animal Spirit they represent.
Possessed monsters are more rewarding depending on how many [SpiritTouched|Spirit-Influenced] monsters were defeated leading up to possession.
zh:
附身怪物是被[AzmeriSpirit|阿兹莫里之灵]进入并强化的[Rarity|稀有或传奇]怪物。附身怪物会被灵体强化，根据附身灵体类型获得加成，有时还会根据附身灵体的动物种类召唤相应的灵体动物。
击败更多[SpiritTouched|灵魂影响]怪物能提升最终附身怪物的奖励。

en:
A Spirit-Influenced monster is a [Rarity|Normal or Magic] monster that has been passed through by an [AzmeriSpirit|Azmeri Spirit]. These monsters are empowered by the spirit and gain bonuses depending on the type of Spirit that passed through them. 
Defeating Spirit-Influenced monsters makes the resulting [SpiritPossessed|Possessed] monster more rewarding.
zh:
灵魂影响怪物是被[AzmeriSpirit|阿兹莫里之灵]穿越的[Rarity|普通或魔法]怪物。它们会根据穿越其的灵魂种类获得加成。
击败这些怪物将提高之后出现的[SpiritPossessed|附身]怪物的掉落奖励。

en: Random Extra Content is [Shrine|Shrines], [Strongbox|Strongboxes], [Essence|Essences], [RogueExile|Rogue Exiles], [AzmeriSpirit|Azmeri Spirits] and [StoneSummoningCircle|Summoning Circles].
zh: 随机额外内容包括了[Shrine|神龛]、[Strongbox|保险箱]、[Essence|精华]、[RogueExile|盗贼流放者]、[AzmeriSpirit|阿兹莫里之灵]和[StoneSummoningCircle|召唤法阵]。

en: Seeking [Shrine|Shrines] grant increased [ItemRarity|Rarity] of Items Found.
zh: 寻觅[Shrine|神龛]可以提高找到的物品的[ItemRarity|稀有度]。

en: Enlightening [Shrine|Shrines] cause you to gain increased Experience.
zh: 启迪[Shrine|神龛]可以提高你获得的经验值。

en: Gloom [Shrine|Shrines] cause you to [Gain|Gain] Damage as Extra [Chaos] Damage and slain enemies can explode dealing Chaos Damage based on their maximum Life.
zh: 隐忍[Shrine|神龛]使你[Gain|获得]额外[Chaos|混沌]伤害，且被击杀的敌人会爆炸，造成基于其最大生命的混沌伤害。

en: Greed [Shrine|Shrines] cause item drops to be converted to Gold and monsters to drop increased Gold.
zh: 贪婪[Shrine|神龛]会使掉落的物品转化为金币，并使怪物掉落更多金币。
制图师的[Strongbox|保险箱]会掉落[Waystone|引路石]。
研究员的[Strongbox|保险箱]会掉落通货物品。
华丽的[Strongbox|保险箱]掉落物品的[ItemRarity|物品稀有度]较高。

en: Basic [Strongbox|Strongboxes] are specifically named "Strongbox" and drop random items.
zh: 基础[Strongbox|保险箱]就是那些直接叫“保险箱”的箱子，打开会掉落随机物品。

en:
Some effects manipulate how random chances are rolled in ways that affect the result without changing the stated chance for the effect, such as a chance being [Lucky] causing it to be rolled twice and use the better result, or an effect skipping the roll entirely to force something to succeed or fail. The Effective chance is the real chance to get a specific result, accounting for all such roll-manipulating effects.

For example, if you had a [Critical|Critical Hit] chance of 20%, and your Critical Hit chance was [Lucky], you would have an Effective Critical Hit chance of 36%, which is the chance that at least one of the two 20% rolls succeeds.
zh:
部分效果可以影响随机几率的选取方式，在不改变效果的规定几率的同时，对其结果产生影响，例如[Lucky|特别幸运]会使其结算两次并使用最佳的结果，有些效果可以直接跳过随机，使结算强制成功或失败。实际几率是考虑到所有影响随机的效果之后获得某项结果的真实几率。

例如，如果你的[Critical|暴击]率为 20%，暴击率[Lucky|特别幸运]，你的实际暴击率为 36%，也就是两次 20% 的随机中有一次成功过的几率。

en:
[Bleeding] you inflict is [Aggravate|Aggravated]
Base [Bleeding] Duration is 1 second
50% more [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of [Bleeding] you inflict
zh:
你造成的[Bleeding|流血]效果为[Aggravate|恶性]
基础[Bleeding|流血]持续时间为 1 秒
你施加的[Bleeding|流血]效果[BuffMagnitude|强度]提高 50%

en: Weapon, [EquipArmour|Armour], Belt, and [Jewellery] Items are Equipped to the character in the Inventory Panel. Flasks, Skill Gems, and Jewels are never considered to be Equipped.
zh: 武器、[EquipArmour|护甲]、腰带和[Jewellery|饰品]物品可以装备在角色的物品栏位里。药剂、技能宝石和珠宝不视作已装备。

en: Amulets and Rings are considered Jewellery
Equipment are items that can be [Equipped]
zh: 装备是角色能够穿戴并视作[Equipped|已装备]的物品

en:
[HitDamage|Hits] from a weapon or skill with this property will not roll a random value between the minimum or maximum damage value, but instead will always roll either the minimum value or the maximum value, with a 50% chance for each.

Each [DamageTypes|Damage Type] has its damage value rolled separately, so if the hit deals multiple types of damage, some types may roll the maximum while others roll minimum.

If the damage rolls are [Lucky], that will still apply, make this roll twice and picking the maximum if either roll had that result, only picking minimum damage if both rolls selected minimum. Unlucky damage rolls will prefer minimum damage in the same way.
zh:
如果武器或技能具有此属性，则其造成的的[HitDamage|击中]不会在最小或最大伤害值之间随机选取，而是必定选取最小或最大值，几率各为 50%。

每种[DamageTypes|伤害类型]的伤害值都会独立选取，如果该击中造成多种类型的伤害，部分伤害类型可能选取到最大值，也有部分可能选取到最小值。

如果伤害随机[Lucky|特别幸运]，该效果依然会生效并进行两次随机，若有一次最大则选取最大值，若都为最小则选取最小值。特别不幸的结算方式相同，但偏向于最小伤害。

en:
You can have two [Companion|Companions] of different types
30% more [Reservation] [Efficiency] of [Companion] Skills
20% less [Reservation] [Efficiency] of non-[Companion] Skills
zh:
你可以拥有两个不同类型的[Companion|伙伴]
[Companion|伙伴]技能的[ReservationEfficiency|保留效能]总增 30%
非[Companion|伙伴]技能的[ReservationEfficiency|保留效能]总降 20%

en: Absorption effects include [Guard], Encased in Jade and Sorcery Ward.
zh: 吸收效果包括了[Guard|防卫]、青玉囚笼和元素结界。

en: Parry is a Skill granted by [Buckler|Bucklers] that allows you to [Block] and retaliate against an enemy [HitDamage|Hit], leaving them off balance and inflicting the [ParriedDebuff|Parried Debuff].
zh: 招架是由[Buckler|轻盾]提供的技能，使你能够[Block|格挡]并反击敌人的[HitDamage|击中]，使敌人失去平衡并施加[ParriedDebuff|被招架减益状态]。

en: Enemies you [Parry] with a [Buckler] take more [Attack] Damage and cannot [Evasion|Evade] [Attack|Attacks] for a duration.
zh: 被你使用[Buckler|轻盾]成功[Parry|招架]的敌人在短时间内会受到更高的[Attack|攻击]伤害，并且无法[Evasion|闪避][Attack|攻击]。

en: When you reach full [EnergyShield|Energy Shield], [Sacrifice] all [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] to gain +5% to all [MaximumResistances|Maximum Resistances] for 4 seconds
zh: [EnergyShield|能量护盾]回满时，[Sacrifice|牺牲]所有[EnergyShield|能量护盾]，使所有[MaximumResistances|抗性上限]在 4 秒内 +5%

en:
This effect will occur when a hit with the weapon directly causes at least one [Bleeding] [Debuff] on the target to become [Aggravate|Aggravated].

It will not occur if an on-hit effect tries to [Aggravate] [Bleeding] but there are no [Bleeding] [Debuff|Debuffs] on the target to [Aggravate], or all of them are already [Aggravate|Aggravated], since no [Bleeding] [Debuff|Debuffs] will be [Aggravate|Aggravated] by that hit.
zh:
该效果会在武器直接击中时生效，使目标身上的至少一个[Bleeding|流血][Debuff|减益状态]变为[Aggravate|恶性]。

如果击中时效果尝试使[Bleeding|流血]变为[Aggravate|恶性]，但目标身上没有能变为[Aggravate|恶性]的[Bleeding|流血][Debuff|减益状态]，或者所有效果都已处于[Aggravate|恶性]状态，则该次击中不会使任何[Bleeding|流血][Debuff|减益状态]变为[Aggravate|恶性]，并将该效果视作没有生效。

en: Skills with a Detonation Time [Detonator|Detonate] once this time has elapsed. This time is not affected by duration modifiers.
zh: 具有引爆时间的技能会在经过指定的时间后[Detonator|引爆]。该时间不受持续时间词缀的影响。

en:
Only the Final [PowerfulMapBoss|Powerful Map Boss] in a Map Area has a chance to drop a [Waystone] of a higher tier than the tier of that Map Area.

The chance diminishes the higher the tier of the [Waystone] used to the create the Map Area, but can be increased again by adding modifiers to [Waystone|Waystones], additional modifiers on [Waystone|Waystones] can give increased chance for [Waystone|Waystones] to drop in the Map Areas they create.
zh:
只有地图区域中的最终[PowerfulMapBoss|强力地图首领]才有几率掉落比该地图区域更高阶的[Waystone|引路石]。

使用高阶[Waystone|引路石]创建地图区域时，此掉落几率会降低，但可以通过为[Waystone|引路石]添加词缀再次提高。额外的[Waystone|引路石]词缀也能增加其生成的地图区域中掉落[Waystone|引路石]的几率。

en:
The final [Rarity|Rare Monster] slain in a Map Area has a chance to drop a [Waystone] equal to the tier of the [Waystone] used to create that Map Area. 

The chance diminishes the tier of the [Waystone] used to the create the Map Area, but can be increased again by adding modifiers to [Waystone|Waystones], additional modifiers on [Waystone|Waystones] can give increased chance for [Waystone|Waystones] to drop in the Map Areas they create.
zh:
地图区域中被击败的最后一只[Rarity|稀有怪物]有几率掉落与该区域所使用的[Waystone|引路石]同阶的[Waystone|引路石]。

使用高阶[Waystone|引路石]创建地图区域时，此掉落几率会降低，但可以通过为[Waystone|引路石]添加词缀再次提高。额外的[Waystone|引路石]词缀也能增加其生成的地图区域中掉落[Waystone|引路石]的几率。

en: A Corrupted Nexus is the source of immense corruption, guarded by a powerful [CorruptedBoss|Corrupted Boss].
zh: 腐化枢纽是强大的腐化源头，有一名强大的[CorruptedBoss|腐化首领]守卫着这里。

en: Each [CorruptedNexus|Corrupted Nexus] is guarded by a powerful Corrupted Boss. Defeat the Corrupted Boss to cleanse the Nexus.
zh: 每个[CorruptedNexus|腐化枢纽]都由一名强大的腐化首领守卫。击败腐化首领来扫清枢纽。

en: Irradiated Areas have +1 to Monster Level
zh: 能量辐照的区域的怪物等级 +1

en: This allows your [Thorns] to [ThornsRetaliation|Retaliate] against any kind of [HitDamage|Hit] dealt to you by enemies, rather than just [Melee] [Attack|Attacks], except that you can never [ThornsRetaliation|Retaliate] against the enemy's [Thorns] damage.
zh: 使你的[Thorns|荆棘]能够对敌人对你造成的所有类型[HitDamage|击中]发起[ThornsRetaliation|反击]，而非仅限于[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]，但敌人的[Thorns|荆棘]伤害依然无法[ThornsRetaliation|反击]。

en:
[UpfrontCost|Upfront Costs] will result in taking the damage all at once as a [HitDamage|Hit].

A per-second costs will instead result in taking Damage per second, which is damage over time, and thus not a [HitDamage|Hit].
zh:
[UpfrontCost|预支花费]会使你立即受到等额的[HitDamage|击中]伤害。

每秒消耗会每秒造成伤害，即不属于[HitDamage|击中]的持续伤害。

en:
An upfront cost is one that lists just an amount of resource to pay, rather than a per-second rate to pay at.

"3 Mana" is an Upfront Cost, while "3 Mana per second" is not.
zh:
预支花费指的是按固定数额列出的资源花费，而不是每秒花费。

“3 点魔力值”属于预支花费，“每秒 3 点魔力值”则不属于。

en: Account Bound items cannot be traded to other players, but can be shared between other characters on your account.
zh: 账户绑定物品无法与其他玩家交易，但可在你账户内的角色间共享。

en: A monster empowered by an Essence of Delirium will periodically summon the demons that lay behind the [ContainsDelirium|Delirium] Mirror.
zh: 被谵妄精华强化的怪物会周期性召唤受困于[ContainsDelirium|惊悸迷雾]之镜的恶魔。

en:
The Corruption in this area has been Cleansed, which may add an additional modifier to the area.

Cleansed areas also contain monsters twisted by the disruption of power in the area.
zh:
此区域的腐化已被净化，可能为区域添加额外词缀。

净化区域还包含因区域力量紊乱而扭曲的怪物。

en:
Delirious players are assaulted by illusions, making combat more difficult. Higher delirium causes monsters to deal more damage and have additional [Toughness]. It can also cause additional monsters to appear or can grant additional modifiers to existing monsters. Monster item drops are improved by higher delirium.

Maps within Fog Banks gain Deliriousness as [MapBoss|Map Bosses], [Rarity|Rare] Monsters or Unique Monsters are killed.
zh:
亢奋玩家受到幻象侵扰，使战斗变得更加困难。亢奋度越高，怪物造成伤害的越高并拥有额外[Toughness|韧性]。还有几率出现额外的怪物，或为现有怪物给予额外词缀。亢奋度越高，怪物的物品掉落就会越好。

迷雾云团内的地图会在[MapBoss|地图首领]、[Rarity|稀有]怪物或传奇怪物被击杀时获得亢奋度。

en: By default, chance-based stats cap at 100% chance for the result to occur. However, some chances can exceed 100%. Unless otherwise specified, a chance higher than 100% is equivalent to 100% chance - the chance always succeeds. But some effects may scale based on how high the chance is or how much it exceeds 100% by.
zh: 默认情况下，基于几率的属性上限为 100%，即结果必然发生。但是，某些几率可以超过 100%。除非特别说明，超过 100% 的几率通常等同于 100% 成功率——结果必定触发。但某些效果可能会根据几率的高低或超出 100% 的幅度，按比例计算。

en:
Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Owl have 60% increased [EnergyShield|Energy Shield], 80% increased Damage and [Gain] 20% of Damage as Extra [Cold] Damage.
Players will also periodically summon a spiritual Owl that conjures a [Cold] tornado.
zh:
被枭之灵附身的玩家使[EnergyShield|能量护盾]提高 60%、伤害提高 80%，并[Gain|获得]附加[Cold|冰霜]伤害，相当于伤害的 20%。
玩家还会定期召唤灵魂枭，召唤出[Cold|冰霜]龙卷风。

en:
Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Serpent have [DamageTypes|All Damage] from [HitDamage|Hits] [Contributes|Contributes] to [Poison] Magnitude, Always [Poison] on [HitDamage|Hit] and 80% increased Damage.
Players will also be accompanied by Spiritual Snakes that periodically strike enemies.
zh:
被蛇之灵附身的玩家[HitDamage|击中]的[DamageTypes|所有伤害]会[Contributes|作用于][Poison|中毒]强度，[HitDamage|击中]时必定[Poison|中毒]，伤害提高 80%。
玩家还会有灵魂之蛇陪伴，定期攻击敌人。

en:
Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Primate have [DamageTypes|All Damage] from [HitDamage|Hits] [Contributes|Contributes] to [Chill] Magnitude, 60% Increased [Freeze] Buildup and 80% increased Damage.
Players will also periodically summon a group of spiritual Primates.
zh:
被狂猿之灵附身的玩家[HitDamage|击中]的[DamageTypes|所有伤害]会[Contributes|作用于][Chill|冰缓]强度，[Freeze|冰冻]积蓄提高 60%，伤害提高 80%。
玩家还会定期召唤一群灵魂狂猿。

en:
Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Bear have 20% Increased Maximum Life, 60% increased [StunThreshold|Stun Threshold], 60% increased [Stun|Stun] Buildup and 20% reduced damage taken.
Players will also periodically summon a spiritual Bear that uses slam attacks.
zh:
被巨熊之灵附身的玩家使最大生命提高 20%、[StunThreshold|晕眩阈值]提高 60%、[Stun|晕眩]积蓄提高 60% 且受到的伤害降低 20%。
玩家还会定期召唤使用猛击攻击的灵魂巨熊。

en:
Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Boar [Gain] 20% of Damage as Extra [Fire] Damage, always inflict [Bleeding] on [HitDamage|Hit] and have 20% reduced damage taken.
Players will also periodically summon spiritual Boars that explode, dealing [Fire] Damage.
zh:
被野猪之灵附身的玩家[Gain|获得]附加[Fire|火焰]伤害，相当于伤害的20%，[HitDamage|击中]时必定造成[Bleeding|流血]，受到的伤害降低 20%。
玩家还会定期召唤会产生爆炸并造成[Fire|火焰]伤害的灵魂野猪。

en:
Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Ox have 50% reduced [Slow|Slowing] Potency of [Debuff|Debuffs] on them, 60% increased [AilmentThreshold|Elemental Ailment Threshold] and [Armour] and 20% reduced damage taken.
Players will also periodically summon a spiritual stampede of Oxen that tramples over enemies.
zh:
被蛮牛之灵附身的玩家身上[Debuff|减益状态]的[Slow|减速]效果降低 50%，[AilmentThreshold|元素异常状态阈值]和[Armour|护甲]提高 60%，受到伤害降低 20%。

en:
Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Wolf have 50% chance to [Maim|Maim] on [Attack] [HitDamage|Hit], 30% increased [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed], 15% increased Movement Speed and [ArmourBreak|Break Armour] equal to 10% of [HitDamage|Hit Damage] dealt.
Players will also periodically summon a spiritual Wolf which uses a dash attack.
zh:
被头狼之灵附身的玩家[Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]时有 50% 几率造成[Maim|瘫痪]，[SkillSpeed|技能速度]提高 30%，移动速度提高 15%，且造成相当于[HitDamage|击中伤害] 10% 的[ArmourBreak|粉碎护甲]。
玩家还会定期召唤使用冲刺攻击的灵魂头狼。

en:
Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Stag have +30% to all [ElementalDamage|Elemental] [Resistances], 30% increased [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed], 15% increased Movement Speed and [Gain] 20% of Damage as Extra [Lightning] Damage.
Players will also periodically summon a spiritual Stag that calls down [Lightning] bolts.
zh:
被雄鹿之灵附身的玩家所有[ElementalDamage|元素][Resistances|抗性] +30%，[SkillSpeed|技能速度]提高 30%，移动速度提高 15%，且[Gain|获得]附加[Lightning|闪电]伤害，相当于造成伤害的 20%。
玩家还会定期召唤的灵魂雄鹿发射[Lightning|闪电]光束。

en:
Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Cat have 60% increased [Evasion] Rating, 100% increased [Critical|Critical Hit chance], 30% increased [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed] and 15% increased Movement Speed.
Players will also periodically summon a ravaging flurry of spiritual Cats.
zh:
被豹之灵附身的玩家的[Evasion|闪避]率提高 60%，[Critical|暴击率]提高 100%，[SkillSpeed|技能速度]提高 30%，移动速度提高 15%。
玩家还会定期召唤灵魂豹群，肆虐攻击敌人。

en: Players possessed by Spirits of the Azmeri gain powerful buffs depending on what Spirit Animal has possessed them. Spiritual beasts will occasionally be summoned to aid the player. Players can only be possessed by one Spirit at a time.
zh: 被阿兹莫里之灵附身的玩家会根据附身的灵魂之兽获得强力增益。阿兹莫里之灵偶尔会召唤灵魂之兽协助玩家。玩家同时只能被一个灵魂附身。

en: Vulnerability is a [Curse] that lowers the [Armour] of those affected. If not otherwise specified, Vulnerability removes 191 [Armour].
zh: 脆弱是一种能够降低受影响者[Armour|护甲]的[Curse|诅咒]。除非另有说明，否则脆弱移除 191 点[Armour|护甲]。

en: Despair is a [Curse] that lowers the [Chaos] [Resistances|Resistance] of those affected. If not otherwise specified, Despair lowers [Chaos] [Resistances|Resistance] by 25%.
zh: 绝望是一种能够降低受影响者[Chaos|混沌][Resistances|抗性]的[Curse|诅咒]。除非另有说明，否则绝望使[Chaos|混沌][Resistances|抗性]降低 25%。

en: Temporal Chains is a [Curse] that [Slow|slows] those affected and makes other effects on them expire more slowly. If not otherwise specified, Temporal Chains [Slow|slows] by 26%.
zh: 时空锁链是一种[Curse|诅咒]，能够让受影响者[Slow|减速]并使其身上其他效果削减速度变慢。除非另有说明，是否时空锁链使目标[Slow|减速] 26%。

en:
Damage from your [HitDamage|Hits] will effectively ignore the value of the target's relevant [Resistances|Resistance], and instead be mitigated by the specified value of [Resistances|Resistance].

This will still occur even if you [IgnoreResistances|Ignore] the target's [Resistances|Resistance], as this mitigation is not based on their [Resistances|Resistance] stats. Similarly, [Penetration] will not apply to this [Resistances|Resistance] value.
zh:
你[HitDamage|击中]的伤害不再受目标[Resistances|抗性]影响，转而按指定[Resistances|抗性]数值减免。

即使你[IgnoreResistances|无视]目标[Resistances|抗性]，此效果依然生效，因为该减免与目标自身[Resistances|抗性]属性无关。同样，[Penetration|穿透]也不会影响此指定[Resistances|抗性]数值。

en:
Glory is a resource that must be spent to use certain powerful Skills. These Skills each have a method of generating Glory, and actions taken against enemies will generate Glory equal to the monster's [Power]. Different Skills gain and lose Glory separately, and each Skill can only generate Glory once every 0.5 seconds per monster.

Different Skills have different Glory requirements. Skills lose 2 Glory per second if they haven't gained Glory in the past 15 seconds. You cannot gain Glory for a Skill while any instance of that Skill is active unless that Skill is a [Banner], but different Skills can generate Glory from the same Glorious action.
zh:
荣耀是某些强大技能必须消耗的资源。这些技能都有各自生成荣耀的方式，对敌人采取的行动会生成与怪物[Power|威力值]等量的荣耀。不同技能分别获得和失去荣耀，每个技能每 0.5 秒对每个怪物只能生成一次荣耀。

不同技能有不同的荣耀需求。如果技能在过去 15 秒内未获得荣耀，则每秒损失 2 点荣耀。技能的任意效果激活时无法为该技能获得荣耀，除非该技能是[Banner|旗帜]，但不同技能可以从同一荣耀行动中生成荣耀。

en:
Players with Mounting Greed gain increased [ItemRarity|Rarity of Items] on kill up to a limit of 100%. This increased Rarity decays over time.

Higher [Rarity] monsters grant a greater amount of Rarity.
zh:
拥有贪婪积聚的玩家击败敌人时会获得更高的掉落[ItemRarity|物品稀有度]，最多可达 100%。该稀有度增益会随时间递减。

[Rarity|稀有度]更高的怪物提供更多稀有度增益。

en: An Obelisk of Corruption is an object that activates once a player gets close enough; granting a 10 second [Buff] that makes enemies killed by you explode, dealing 10% of their life as [Physical] damage.
zh: 腐化尖碑会在靠近后激活。你会获得持续 10 秒的[Buff|增益效果]，使你击败的敌人爆炸，造成相当于其 10% 生命的[Physical|物理]伤害。

en: An Obelisk of Cleansing is an object that activates once a player gets close enough; granting a 10 second [Buff] that grants 100% [ItemRarity|Item Rarity], 50% increased [Armour], [Evasion] and [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] and makes players [Gain] 30% of Damage as extra [Lightning] Damage.
zh: 净化尖碑会在靠近后激活。你会获得持续10秒的[Buff|增益效果]，提升 100% 的[ItemRarity|物品稀有度]、提高 50%[Armour|护甲]，[Evasion|闪避]和[EnergyShield|能量护盾]，并[Gain|获得] 30% 的额外[Lightning|闪电]伤害。

en: The Immured Fury is a powerful monster that has appeared due to the Cleansing process. This monster has dangerous abilities but greatly increased rewards.
zh: 禁锢之怒是因净化过程而出现的强大怪物，虽然技能危险，但掉落奖励极为丰厚。

en: A Fractured Modifier is locked onto the item permanently. It cannot be removed or altered.
zh: 分裂词缀是永久锁定在物品上的词缀，无法被移除或改变。

en:
Your character has two Weapon Sets that can be used independently by equipping items into both sets.

By default your Skills will use the currently active Weapon Set if possible, or automatically swap to your other Weapon Set if required to use the Skill. You can also specify the Weapon Set you want to automatically swap to for each Skill in that Skill's information panel.

In addition to changing your active items, Weapon Sets also have [WeaponSetPassiveSkillPoints|dedicated Passive Skill Points] that can be allocated differently in each Weapon Set.

Weapon Sets can have differing amounts of available [Spirit], due to weapons with Spirit (such as [Sceptre|Sceptres]), [WeaponSetPassiveSkillPoints|Weapon Set Passive Skills], or [Persistent] Skills that are active in specific Weapon Sets.
zh:
你的角色有两个武器组，可在每个组中独立装备物品。

默认情况下，技能会尽可能使用当前激活的武器组，或在需要时自动切换。你也可在技能信息面板中为每个技能指定要自动切换的武器组。

武器组除了改变激活的装备外，还有各自的[WeaponSetPassiveSkillPoints|天赋点配置]，你可分别为两个武器组配置天赋点数。

武器组可能具有不同数量的[Spirit|精魂]，这取决于具有精魂的武器（如[Sceptre|权杖]）、[WeaponSetPassiveSkillPoints|武器组天赋技能]或在特定武器组中激活的[Persistent|持续]技能。
