zh: 怪物周期性产生无常植物，释放向敌人移动的球体，靠近时爆炸，造成[Chaos|混沌]伤害。

en: Monster periodically creates Powerful Volatile Plants, releasing orbs that move towards enemies; exploding when they get close enough; dealing [Chaos] Damage.
zh: 怪物周期性产生强大的无常植物，释放向敌人移动的球体，靠近时爆炸，造成[Chaos|混沌]伤害。

en: Monster periodically creates Volatile Crag that moves towards enemies; exploding when they get close enough; dealing [Fire] Damage.
zh: 怪物周期性产生无常碎岩，向敌人移动，靠近时爆炸，造成[Fire|火焰]伤害。

en: Monster periodically creates Powerful Volatile Crag that moves towards enemies; exploding when they get close enough; dealing [Fire] Damage.
zh: 怪物周期性产生强大的无常碎岩，向敌人移动，靠近时爆炸，造成[Fire|火焰]伤害。

en:
A Pack Monster or [MonsterMinion|Minion] is a Monster that naturally spawns as a part of a Monster Pack in areas or from mechanics like [Strongbox|Strongboxes].

Modifiers to Pack Size also provide a chance that there is an [AdditionalRareMonster|Additional Rare Monster] in the Pack.

Monsters summoned or created by other Monsters do not count as Pack Monsters or [MonsterMinion|Minions].
zh:
群落及[MonsterMinion|怪物仆从]是自然生成于区域中的怪物群的一部分，或来自诸如[Strongbox|保险箱]等机制。

怪物群规模的相关词缀也会使群落有几率出现一个[AdditionalRareMonster|额外稀有怪物]。

由其他怪物创造或召唤的怪物，不计为群落怪物或[MonsterMinion|怪物仆从]。

en: Crescendo Arrows [Chain] 6 additional times and deal 60% increased Damage for each time they have [Chain|Chained].
zh: 渐强箭可[Chain|连锁]额外6次，每次[Chain|连锁]都会使伤害提高 60%。
裂片箭会向 6 个目标[Split|分裂]。

en: Reversing Arrows [Pierce] all targets and [Return] to you.
zh: 回转箭会[Pierce|贯穿]所有目标，并[Return|归返]到你身边。

en: All [HitDamage|Hits] with Diamond Arrows are [Critical|Critical Hits] with 60% increased [CriticalDamageBonus|Critical Damage Bonus].
zh: 金刚箭的所有[HitDamage|击中]必定为[Critical|暴击]，并获得 60% 的[CriticalDamageBonus|暴击伤害加成]。

en: Enemies killed with Covetous Arrows drop items with 600% increased [ItemRarity|Rarity].
zh: 用贪婪箭击败的敌人掉落的物品[ItemRarity|稀有度]提高 600%。
钝击箭造成的[Stun|晕眩积蓄]提高 600%。

en:
Some effects can cause Repeatable Skills to Repeat, causing you to perform the part of the skill where it fires off projectiles or other effects multiple times in quick succession from a single use of the skill.

[Trigger|Triggered] skills, Instant skills, and [Channelling] skills cannot Repeat.

Skills take 5% longer to perform for each time they Repeat.
zh:
某些效果可以使可重复技能进行重复，即从单次技能使用中，快速连续地多次执行技能中发射投射物或产生其他效果的部分。

[Trigger|触发]技能、瞬发技能和[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能无法重复。

技能每重复一次，其施放时间就会延长 5%。

en: Meteors rain down around you when in range of enemies.
zh: 靠近敌人时，陨石会从天而降。

en: Lightning bolts strike the ground around you when in range of enemies.
zh: 靠近敌人时，闪电会击中地面。

en: Freezing shards fire around you in a spiral when in range of enemies.
zh: 靠近敌人时，急冻碎片会螺旋射出。

en: Slain enemies explode, dealing [Chaos] damage equal to a quarter of their maximum Life.
zh: 被击败的敌人会爆炸，造成其生命上限四分之一的[Chaos|混沌]伤害。

en: Abyssal Wasting reduces Life Regeneration Rate by 50% for 6 seconds
zh: 深渊耗散会在 6 秒内降低 50% 生命回复速率。

en: These are [Augment|Augments] which have powerful singular effects, but are more limited. You may not have more than one [Augment] of this type socketed at a time.
zh: 此类[Augment|增幅器]虽拥有强大的单一特效，但限制也更为严格。一次只能镶嵌一个这种类型的[Augment|增幅器]。

en: Equippable Armours are pieces of equipment that you can wear to provide various defences. Equippable Armours include Helmets, Body Armours, Gloves, Boots, [Shield|Shields] and [Focus|Foci].
zh: 可装备护甲是你可穿戴的护甲部件，提供各类防御属性，包括头盔、护甲、手套、靴子、[Shield|盾牌]与[Focus|法器]。

en: Caster Weapons are Sceptres, Staves and Wands.
zh: 施法武器指权杖、长杖和法杖。

en: Targets affected by a Spectral Fire [Debuff] do not take damage from [Ignite]. Instead that damage feeds the Spectral Fire. When the Spectral Fire [Debuff] expires or the target dies, the Spectral Fire explodes, dealing all the damage it has absorbed to all enemies within 1.8m, including the affected target. Damage modifiers do not apply to the explosion.
zh: 受灵体火焰[Debuff|减益状态]影响的目标不会受到[Ignite|点燃]伤害，该伤害会被灵体火焰吸收。当灵体火焰[Debuff|减益状态]结束或目标被击败时，灵体火焰将会爆炸，对 1.8 米范围内的所有敌人造成所吸收的伤害，包括原先受影响的目标。伤害词缀不能作用于该爆炸伤害。

en:
Sanctifying an item will multiply the values of an items modifiers by a random value ranging from 78% to 122% for each modifier. The resulting item will now be Sanctified.
Most methods of item crafting and modification cannot be used on Sanctified items.
zh:
圣化一件物品会将其词缀数值乘以 78% 到 122% 之间的随机值，最终物品将变为已圣化状态。
大多数物品工艺和修改方式无法用于已圣化的物品。

en: Efficiency modifiers act as divisors to the stat they modify. For example, 50% increased Reservation Efficiency causes your Reservations to be 67% of their base value, 100% increased Reservation Efficiency causes your Reservations to be 50% of their base value, and so on. Reduced Reservation Efficiency will cause the modified stat to grow larger instead of smaller.
zh: 被效能词缀影响的数值将会除以效能词缀。例如：增加 50% 的保留效能会使你的保留量变为基础值的 67%。增加 100% 的保留效能会使你的保留量变为基础值的 50%。以此类推。若减少保留效能，被效能词缀影响的数值反而会增加，而非减少。

en:
[Fire] [Spell|Spells] [Conversion|Convert] 100% of Fire Damage to [Chaos|Chaos Damage]
[Chaos|Chaos Damage] from [Fire] [Spell|Spells] [Contributes] to [Flammability] and [Ignite] [BuffMagnitude|Magnitudes]
[Ignite] inflicted with [Fire] [Spell|Spells] deals [Chaos|Chaos Damage] instead of Fire Damage
zh:
[Fire|火焰][Spell|法术]将 100% 的火焰伤害[Conversion|转化]为[Chaos|混沌伤害]
[Fire|火焰][Spell|法术]的[Chaos|混沌伤害][Contributes|作用于][Flammability|易燃]和[Ignite|点燃][BuffMagnitude|强度]
[Fire|火焰][Spell|法术]施加的[Ignite|点燃]造成[Chaos|混沌伤害]而非火焰伤害

en: [Invoke|Invocation] Skills instead [Trigger] [Spell|Spells] every 2 seconds. [Invoke|Invocation] Skills cannot gain [Energy] while [Trigger|Triggering] [Spell|Spells]. [Invoke|Invoked] Spells consume 50% less [Energy].
zh: [Invoke|咒祈]技能改为每 2 秒[Trigger|触发][Spell|法术]。[Invoke|咒祈]技能在[Trigger|触发][Spell|法术]时无法获得[Energy|能量]。[Invoke|咒祈]法术消耗的[Energy|能量]降低 50%

en: Elemental Weakness is a [Curse] that lowers Elemental [Resistances]. If not otherwise specified, it lowers Elemental Resistances by 30% and has a duration of 20 seconds.
zh: 元素要害是一种[Curse|诅咒]，会降低元素[Resistances|抗性]。除非另有说明，会使元素抗性降低 30%，持续时间为 20 秒。

en: Debilitate is a [Debuff] that inflicts 20% reduced movement speed and 10% reduced damage dealt. Unless specified, Debilitate lasts 1 second.
zh: 疲惫是一种[Debuff|减益状态]，使移动速度降低 20%，造成的伤害降低 10%。除非另有说明，疲惫持续 1 秒。

en: Every [SupportGem|Support Gem] falls into one or more Categories. [SupportGem|Support Gems] from the same Category cannot be socketed into the same skill simultaneously, but can be used across multiple skills.
zh: 每个[SupportGem|辅助宝石]都属于一个或多个类别。同一类别的[SupportGem|辅助宝石]无法同时镶嵌到同一个技能中，但可以用于多个不同技能。

en: Added random Modifiers are at least this level or higher, except if a specific Modifier type would be excluded entirely from being able to roll. Currency with a Minimum Modifier Level cannot be used on items with an item level below the Minimum Modifier Level.
zh: 添加的随机词缀至少为此等级或更高，除非特定词缀类型完全无法掷出。带有最低词缀等级的通货不能用于物品等级低于该最低词缀等级的物品。

en: You cannot use this currency on items above this level.
zh: 你无法在高于此等级的物品上使用此通货。

en: Heat is gained from using specific [Crossbow] Skills, and can be either beneficial or detrimental depending on the Skill.
zh: 过热可通过使用特定的[Crossbow|战弩]技能获得，根据技能的不同，过热可能产生有利或不利效果。

en:
Some Skills create Elemental Infusion [Remnant|Remnants] when specific conditions are met. Picking up the [Remnant] grants you the Infusion for 20 seconds or until it is Consumed by another Skill. You can have up to 3 of each Infusion by default.

Skills that can Consume Infusions specifically mention the type(s) of Infusion they can Consume and the benefits for doing so. If a Skill repeats or reoccurs, each of them must Consume an Infusion separately to gain the effect.
zh:
某些技能在满足特定条件时会创造元素灌注[Remnant|残片]。拾取[Remnant|残片]会使你获得灌注，持续 20 秒或直到被其他技能消耗。默认情况下，你最多可拥有 3 个同类别灌注。

能够消耗灌注的技能会明确说明它们可以消耗的灌注类型以及消耗的受益。如果技能重复或再次发生，每次都必须单独消耗一个灌注来获得效果。

en:
Desecrating an item adds an Unrevealed Desecrated modifier. If modifiers are full then a random modifier is also removed. These modifiers can be revealed at the Well of Souls.

Items with Desecrated Modifiers cannot be Desecrated again.
zh:
渎灵物品会添加一个未揭示的渎灵词缀。如果词缀已满，则会随机移除一个词缀。这些词缀可在灵魂之井处显示。

具有渎灵词缀的物品无法再次被渎灵。

en: This item can be [Abyssalify|Desecrated] using the Preserved Cranium currency item. There is an increasing chance for it to be destroyed each time it is [Abyssalify|Desecrated].
zh: 此物品可以使用遗存头骨通货物品进行[Abyssalify|渎灵]。每次[Abyssalify|渎灵]，被摧毁的几率会增加。

en:
Abyssal Monsters spawned from [ContainsAbyss|Abysses] steal modifiers from monsters killed near their pit, these modifiers can be upgraded to Abyssal Modifiers.

Abyssal Modifiers rarely have a chance to become a more powerful Lichborn Modifier.
zh:
生成于[ContainsAbyss|深渊]的深渊怪物会偷取被击杀于巨坑附近的怪物的词缀，这些词缀会被升级为深渊词缀。

深渊词缀有极小概率升级为更强大的巫妖血脉词缀。

en:
Abyssal Depths are an underground dungeon sometimes found when completing the final [ContainsAbyss|Abyss] in the area.

The Abyssal Depths contains many Abyssal monsters and all Rare monsters will have an [AbyssalModifiers|Abyssal Modifier].
At the end of the Abyssal Depths is a more powerful Rare with both a Lichborn Modifier and an Abyssal Modifier. Defeating this Rare will unlock valuable chests nearby.

The chests at the end of the Abyssal Depths can also drop pieces of [Abyssalify|Preserved Bone], but also can rarely drop additional exclusive [Omen|Omens] and [LineageSupports|Lineage Supports].

At higher levels the Abyssal Depths can lead to powerful Boss Fights.
zh:
绝望深渊是一种地下城，有时可在完成区域中最后一个[ContainsAbyss|深渊]时发现。

绝望深渊内存在大量深渊怪物，且所有稀有怪物都将携带[AbyssalModifiers|深渊词缀]。
在绝望深渊尽头，会出现一名更强大的稀有怪物，其同时拥有巫妖血脉词缀和深渊词缀。击败该怪物可解锁附近的珍贵宝箱。

绝望深渊尽头的宝箱除可能掉落[Abyssalify|遗存颚骨]碎片外，亦有几率额外掉落专属的[Omen|预兆]与[LineageSupports|血脉辅助]。

在更高等级下，绝望深渊还可能展开强大的首领战。

en: Marked for Death is a [Debuff] that causes you to take 50% increased damage.
zh: 死亡印记是一种[Debuff|减益状态]，使你受到的伤害提高 50%。

en:
Lineage Supports are powerful and transformative [SupportGem|Support Gems] which can drop in maps, or come from specific sources like a particular Boss.

You may only Socket one copy of any given Lineage Support across all of your Skills at once.
zh:
血脉辅助是强大的变革性[SupportGem|辅助宝石]，可在地图中掉落，或来自特定来源，如特定首领。

你同一时间只能镶嵌每种血脉辅助宝石各一个。

en: Naturally Spawning Monsters are those who are spawned upon entering an area for the first time. Monsters that spawn from Secondary Mechanics like [Strongbox|Strongboxes] or [ContainsExpedition|Expedition] do not count as Naturally Spawning.
zh: 源生怪物是首次进入区域时生成的怪物。从次要机制如[Strongbox|保险箱]或[ContainsExpedition|先祖秘藏]生成的怪物不算作自然生成。

en: [DNT-UNUSED] You gain edict declaration when you disable a mod with The Towering Shadow
zh: 当你使用塔影禁用一条词缀时，你将获得敕令宣告

en:
The first Gruelling Madness on a target [Slow|Slows] their movement speed by 15%.
Each additional Gruelling Madness instead increases the [Slow|Slowing] Potency of [Debuff|Debuffs] on the targets by 10%, which affects both the first Gruelling Madness and any other [Debuff|Debuffs] that are [Slow|Slowing] the target.

A maximum of 10 Gruelling Madness can be inflicted on each target. Targets will lose 1 Gruelling Madness every 2 seconds that passes without more being inflicted.
zh:
目标身上的第一层苦痛狂乱会使其移动速度[Slow|减速]15%。
每额外增加一层苦痛狂乱，则会令目标身上[Debuff|减益状态]的[Slow|减速]效力提高 10%。此效果同时作用于第一层苦痛狂乱以及任何其他能[Slow|减速]目标的[Debuff|减益状态]。

每个目标最多可被施加 10 层苦痛狂乱。若在 2 秒内未施加新的层数，目标将失去 1 层苦痛狂乱。

en: Each Faerie Fire [Debuff] causes [HitDamage|Hits] against the affected target to [Gain] 2% of damage as [Gain|Extra] Damage of a random [ElementalDamage|Element]. The [Debuff] lasts 8 seconds, and up to 10 can be applied to each target.
zh: 每层仙灵之火[Debuff|减益]状态会使对该目标造成的[HitDamage|击中]，[Gain|获得]2% 的伤害转化为随机的[Gain|额外][ElementalDamage|元素]伤害。该[Debuff|减益]状态持续 8 秒，每个目标最多可被施加 10 层。

en: Runefather's Challenge is a [Debuff] which raises the [Power] of affected targets by 5.
zh: 符文之父的挑战是一种[Debuff|减益状态]，使受影响目标的[Power|威力值]提高 5 点。

en:
You can have up to 10,000 Runefather's Boast [Buff|Buffs].

Each Runefather's Boast grants +1 to [Armour], +1 to [Evasion|Evasion Rating], and +1 to [StunThreshold|Stun Threshold].

Runefather's Boast does not have a duration, but is lost when you die or change area.
zh:
你最多可拥有 10,000 层符文之父加持[Buff|增益]状态。

每层符文之父加持提供 +1 [Armour|护甲]、[Evasion|闪避值]和 [StunThreshold|晕眩阈值]。

符文之父加持没有持续时间，但会在你死亡或切换区域时消失。

en: Monster [Pack|Packs] in a Union of Souls transfer their soul to another Monster in their [Pack] when slain, granting the receiving Monsters 6% [Toughness], and 2% increased damage.
zh: 聚魂中的怪物[Pack|群落]被击败时会将其灵魂转移给同[Pack|群落]的一只其他怪物，使其获得 6% [Toughness|韧性]并且伤害提高 2%。

en:
While Thaumaturgical Dynamism is active, you passively generate a [Charges|Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charge] once every five seconds. 

The kind of [Charges|Charge] you generate is determined by the Attribute Requirements of the Skills you have socketed in your Skill Gem sockets. The higher the total [Strength] Requirement total of your socketed Skill Gems, the more likely you will be to generate an [Charges|Endurance Charge]. Higher total [Dexterity] Requirement corresponds to a higher chance for [Charges|Frenzy Charges], and [Intelligence] to [Charges|Power Charges].
zh:
奇术活力激活时，你每 8 秒被动生成一个[Charges|暴击球、狂怒球或耐力球]。

生成的[Charges|能量球]类型由你技能宝石插槽中技能的属性需求决定。镶嵌技能宝石的[Strength|力量]需求总和越高，生成[Charges|耐力球]的可能性越大。[Dexterity|敏捷]需求总和越高，生成[Charges|狂怒球]的可能性越大，[Intelligence|智慧]需求则对应生成[Charges|暴击球]。

en:
Depending on the type of [EquipArmour|Armour] equipped, Players will have a less Movement Speed penalty applied depending on what [Attributes|Attribute] the Armour requires. These penalties only apply to equipped Body Armours and [Shield|Shields].
For Body Armour, pure [Strength] has a 5% penalty, hybrid [Strength] and [Dexterity] or [Intelligence] has a 4% penalty and pure [Dexterity] or [Intelligence] has a 3% penalty.
For [Shield|Shields], pure [Strength] has a 3% penalty, hybrid [Strength] and [Dexterity] or [Intelligence] has a 1.5% penalty and pure [Dexterity] or [Intelligence] has no penalty.
zh:
取决于装备的[EquipArmour|护甲]类型，玩家会根据护甲所需的[Attributes|属性]受到移动速度惩罚。这些惩罚只适用于装备的胸甲和[Shield|盾牌]。
胸甲方面，纯[Strength|力量]装备有 5% 惩罚，[Strength|力量]与[Dexterity|敏捷]或[Intelligence|智慧]的混合装备有 4% 惩罚，纯[Dexterity|敏捷]或[Intelligence|智慧]装备有 3% 惩罚。
[Shield|盾牌]方面，纯[Strength|力量]装备有 3% 惩罚，[Strength|力量]与[Dexterity|敏捷]或[Intelligence|智慧]的混合装备有 1.5% 惩罚，纯[Dexterity|敏捷]或[Intelligence|智慧]装备无惩罚。

en: Merging [Crossbow] bolts have fragments that can hit the same target at the same time to combine their damage into a single [HitDamage|Hit].
zh: 融合[Crossbow|战弩]弩箭的碎片可以同时击中同一目标，将伤害合并为单次[HitDamage|击中]。
被宁心的敌人无法造成伤害。

en:
Archons are a type of [Buff] that significantly augment your prowess with a certain type of Skills, such as [ElementalArchon|Elemental Spells] or [NatureArchon|Plant Skills].

By default, each Archon Buff lasts 10 seconds.

You cannot gain any Archon Buff while you already have one, or during a recovery period after you lose one, which lasts 20 seconds by default.
zh:
执政官是一种[Buff|增益状态]类型，能显著强化你的特定类型技能的威力，例如例如[ElementalArchon|元素法术]或[NatureArchon|植物技能]。

默认情况下，每个执政官增益状态持续 10 秒。

当你已经拥有一个执政官增益状态时，或在失去一个执政官增益状态后的恢复期间（默认持续 20 秒），你无法获得任何执政官增益状态。

en:
Ice Archon is a type of [Archon] [Buff]. It grants:
• 25% more [Cold] Damage with [Spell|Spells]
• [StatConversion|Convert] 100% of [ElementalDamage|Elemental] Damage with [Spell|Spells] to [Cold] Damage
• Cannot deal [Cold|Non-Cold] Damage with [Spell|Spells]
• [HitDamage|Hits] with [Spell|Spells] cause 100% more [Freeze] Buildup

Using a non-instant [Attack] causes Ice Archon to be removed immediately.
zh:
冰霜执政官是一种[Archon|执政官][Buff|增益状态]，能够提供：
•[Spell|法术][Cold|冰霜]伤害总增 25%
•[Spell|法术]的 100% [ElementalDamage|元素]伤害[StatConversion|转化]为[Cold|冰霜]伤害
•[Spell|法术]无法造成[Cold|非冰霜]伤害
•[Spell|法术][HitDamage|击中]造成的[Freeze|冻结]积蓄总增 100%

使用非瞬发[Attack|攻击]会立即移除冰霜执政官。

en:
Flame Archon is a type of [Archon] [Buff]. It grants:
• 25% more [Fire] Damage with [Spell|Spells]
• [StatConversion|Convert] 100% of [ElementalDamage|Elemental] Damage with [Spell|Spells] to [Fire] Damage
• Cannot deal [Fire|Non-Fire] Damage with [Spell|Spells]
• [Spell|Spells] have 100% more [Flammability] [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude]

Using a non-instant [Attack] causes Flame Archon to be removed immediately.
zh:
火焰执政官是一种[Archon|执政官][Buff|增益状态]，能够提供：
•[Spell|法术][Fire|火焰]伤害总增 25%
•[Spell|法术]的 100% [ElementalDamage|元素]伤害[StatConversion|转化]为[Fire|火焰]伤害
•[Spell|法术]无法造成[Fire|非火焰]伤害
•[Spell|法术]的[Flammability|易燃][BuffMagnitude|强度]总增 100%

使用非瞬发[Attack|攻击]会立即移除火焰执政官。

en:
Lightning Archon is a type of [Archon] [Buff]. It grants:
• 25% more [Lightning] Damage with [Spell|Spells]
• [StatConversion|Convert] 100% of [ElementalDamage|Elemental] Damage with [Spell|Spells] to [Lightning] Damage
• Cannot deal [Lightning|Non-Lightning] Damage with [Spell|Spells]
• [HitDamage|Hits] with [Spell|Spells] have 100% more [Shock] chance

Using a non-instant [Attack] causes Lightning Archon to be removed immediately.
zh:
闪电执政官是一种[Archon|执政官][Buff|增益状态]，能够提供：
•[Spell|法术][Lightning|闪电]伤害总增 25%
•[Spell|法术]的 100% [ElementalDamage|元素]伤害[StatConversion|转化]为[Lightning|闪电]伤害
•[Spell|法术]无法造成[Lightning|非闪电]伤害
•[Spell|法术][HitDamage|击中]的[Shock|感电]几率总增 100%

使用非瞬发[Attack|攻击]会立即移除闪电执政官。

en:
Elemental Archon is a type of [Archon] [Buff]. It grants:
• 25% more [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] with [Spell|Spells]
• Cannot deal [ElementalDamage|Non-Elemental] Damage with [Spell|Spells]
• [HitDamage|Hits] with [Spell|Spells] cause 100% more [Freeze] Buildup
• [Spell|Spells] have 100% more [Flammability] [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude]
• [HitDamage|Hits] with [Spell|Spells] have 100% more [Shock] chance

Using a non-instant [Attack] causes Elemental Archon to be removed immediately.
zh:
元素执政官是一种[Archon|执政官] [Buff|增益状态]，能够提供：
•[Spell|法术][ElementalDamage|元素]伤害总增 25%
•[Spell|法术]无法造成[ElementalDamage|非元素]伤害
•[Spell|法术][HitDamage|击中]造成的[Freeze|冻结]积蓄总增 100%
•[Spell|法术]的[Flammability|易燃][BuffMagnitude|强度]总增 100%
•[Spell|法术][HitDamage|击中]的[Shock|感电]几率总增 100%

使用非瞬发[Attack|攻击]会立即移除元素执政官。

en:
Nature's Archon is a type of [Archon] [Buff]. It grants:
• 25% more Damage with [Plant] Skills
• [Plant|Plants] have a 100% chance to immediately [Plant|Overgrow]
• 200% more Skill Effect Duration of [Plant] Skills
• [Plant] Skills have +2 to [Limit]
zh:
自然执政官是一种[Archon|执政官] [Buff|增益状态]，能够提供：
•[Plant|植物技能与蔓生]伤害总增 25%
•[Plant|植物技能与蔓生]有 100% 几率立即[Plant|蔓生]
•[Plant|植物技能与蔓生]效果持续时间总增 200%
•[Plant|植物技能与蔓生][Limit|上限]+2

en:
Archon of Undeath is a type of [Archon] [Buff]. It grants:
• 25% more [Minion] Damage
• 200% more [CooldownRecovery|Cooldown Recovery Rate] for [Command] Skills
• [TemporaryMinion|Temporary Minion Skills] have 100% more [Limit] of [Minion|Minions] summoned

When you gain Archon of Undeath all of your Persistent Undead [Minion|Minions] are revived.
zh:
亡灵执政官是一种[Archon|执政官] [Buff|增益状态]，能够提供：
•[Minion|召唤生物]伤害总增 25%
•[Command|命令][CooldownRecovery|冷却回复速度]总增 200%
•[TemporaryMinion|临时召唤生物技能]的[Minion|召唤生物][Limit|上限]总增 100%

获得亡灵执政官时，你所有持续性的亡灵[Minion|召唤生物]都会被复活。

en: A Temporary [Minion] is a [Minion] that does not revive after it dies.
zh: 临时[Minion|召唤生物]是一种在死亡后不会复活的[Minion|召唤生物]。

en: [Minion] Reforming is similar to [Minion] [Reviving], but only occurs at the end of the "Minion Reforming" [Buff] Timer that is granted while [Persistent] [Minion|Minions] are dead, as opposed to other effects that may revive [Minion|Minions].
zh: [Minion|召唤生物]重组与[Minion|召唤生物][Reviving|复活]类似，但只有在[Persistent|永久性][Minion|召唤生物]被击败后获得的“召唤生物重组”[Buff|增益状态]持续时间结束时才会发生，而不是通过其他能够复活[Minion|召唤生物]的效果触发。

en: Gigantic [Minion|Minions] have 20% more Maximum Life, 20% more Damage and 20% increased size.
zh: 庞然大物[Minion|召唤生物]生命上限总增 20%，伤害总增 20%，体型增大 20%。

en: [Abyssalify|Desecrating] an item with the Mark of the Abyssal Lord modifier always removes that modifier, replacing it with an Unrevealed Desecrated modifier of a higher tier.
zh: 使用深渊领主的印记词缀[Abyssalify|渎灵]物品时，总是会移除该词缀，将其替换为更高阶的未揭示渎灵词缀。

en:
Riven Armour is a [Debuff] inflicted by [HitDamage|Hits], which stores 5% of the [Premitigation|Pre-mitigation] [Physical] [HitDamage|Hit damage] of the Hit that inflicts it as its [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude].

The inflicter's subsequent [Attack] [HitDamage|Hits] against the target will gain additional unscaleable added [Physical] [HitDamage|Damage] equal to that magnitude.

Enemies with Riven Armour cannot get their [ArmourBreak|Armour Broken] further.
zh:
撕裂护甲是一种由[HitDamage|击中]施加的[Debuff|减益状态]，会将施加它的那次击中的[Premitigation|减免前][Physical|物理][HitDamage|击中伤害]的 5% 储存为其[BuffMagnitude|强度]。

施加者后续对目标的[Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]将获得等同于该强度数值的额外不可调整的附加[Physical|物理][HitDamage|伤害]。

拥有护甲撕裂的敌人无法再被进一步[ArmourBreak|护甲破损]。

en:
Molten Fissures are long-lasting fissures created by some [Slam|Slams] that can themselves be [Slam|Slammed] to create [Aftershock|Aftershocks]. 

Hitting a Molten Fissure with a [Slam] other than another Molten Fissure causes an [Aftershock] to propagate along its length, dealing the Fissure's damage again to enemies standing on it. This [Aftershock] will also spread to other intersecting Molten Fissures. Each Molten Fissure can [Aftershock] no more than once every 0.2 seconds.
zh:
熔岩裂缝是由某些[Slam|猛击]创造的持续时间很长的裂缝，这些裂缝本身受到[Slam|猛击]时可以产生[Aftershock|余震]。

用[Slam|猛击]（其他熔岩裂缝除外）击中熔岩裂缝会产生沿其长度传播的[Aftershock|余震]，对站在其上的敌人造成裂缝的伤害。此[Aftershock|余震]还会扩散到其他相交的熔岩裂缝。每个熔岩裂缝每 0.2 秒最多产生一次[Aftershock|余震]。

en: Sands of Time grants 60% increased Skill Speed, scaling down to 1% over 10 seconds, at which point it will then scale back up to 60%. It also grants 1% increased Area of Effect, scaling up to 60% over 10 seconds, at which point it will then scale back down to 1%.
zh: 时光沙尘使施法速度加快 60%，在 10 秒内逐渐降至 1%，然后再次回升至 60%。同时使效果范围提高 1%，在 10 秒内逐渐增至 60%，然后再次降回 1%。

en: While affected by Unravelling, your [Chaos] Damage randomly either also contributes to [Freeze] buildup, [Flammability] and [Ignite] [BuffMagnitude|Magnitudes], or [Shock] chance - changing which it contributes to every two seconds.
zh: 受到解析影响时，你的[Chaos|混沌]伤害随机同时作用于[Freeze|冻结]积蓄、[Flammability|易燃]和[Ignite|点燃][BuffMagnitude|强度]，或[Shock|感电]几率，作用的对象每两秒改变一次。

en:
[Totem|Totems] you place which grant Embankment Auras give a different Aura [Buff] to Players in range depending on the kind of [Totem], as follows:

Artillery Ballista grants 20% increased [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed].

Siege Ballista grants 25% more Damage against [Immobilised] Enemies.

Mortar Cannon grants 25% of Damage [Gain|Gained] as extra [Fire].

Shockwave Totem grants 30% increased Area of Effect.

Ancestral Warrior Totem grants 40% increased [Glory] Generation.

Dark Effigy grants 40% increased Damage over Time.

Spell Totem grants 50% increased [Critical|Critical Hit Chance].
zh:
你放置的提供堤防光环的[Totem|图腾]会根据[Totem|图腾]类型为范围内的玩家提供不同的光环[Buff|增益状态]，具体如下：

火力弩炮使[SkillSpeed|技能速度]提高 25%。

攻城炮台对[Immobilised|不可移动]敌人的伤害提高 25%。

迫击大炮[Gain|获得]相当于伤害 25% 的额外[Fire|火焰]伤害。

震波图腾使效果范围扩大 30%。

先祖战士图腾使[Glory|荣耀]生成量提高 40%。

黑暗塑像使持续伤害提高 40%。

法术图腾使[Critical|暴击率]提高 50%。

en:
Ice Fragments are created by a variety of Skills and [DetonationTime|Detonate] in an Area to deal [Cold] damage. If a Skill creates multiple Ice Fragments at the same time, only one of them can damage a single enemy.

Some skills can interact with Ice Fragments. Unless otherwise specified, each Ice Fragment can only interact with a single Skill use during its lifetime.
zh:
冰霜碎片由多种技能创造，并在一个区域内[DetonationTime|引爆]以造成[Cold|冰霜]伤害。如果一个技能同时创造多个冰晶碎片，其中只有一个碎片能对同一个敌人造成伤害。

某些技能可以与冰霜碎片互动。除非另有说明，每个冰霜碎片在其存续期间，只能与单个技能互动一次。

en: Fragments of Divinity are [Consume|Consumed] by certain Skills to grant additional effects. Divine Fragments last 10 seconds.
zh: 神性碎片会被特定技能[Consume|消耗]以赋予额外效果。神性碎片持续 10 秒。

en:
Divinity can be spent for skills, similar to Mana.

Divinity inherently Regenerates at a rate of 25% per second.
zh:
神性可以作为技能的资源消耗，类似于魔力。
神性天然会以每秒 25% 的速度再生。

en:
Broken Stance is a [Debuff] inflicted by [HitDamage|Hits], which stores 10% of the [Premitigation|Pre-mitigation] [Physical] [HitDamage|Hit damage] of the [HitDamage|Hit] that inflicts it as its [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude].

The inflicter's subsequent [HitDamage|Hits] against the target will gain additional unscaleable added [Physical] [HitDamage|Damage] equal to that magnitude.

Enemies with Broken Stance cannot be [Daze|Dazed] again.
zh:
破碎姿态是一种由[HitDamage|击中]施加的[Debuff|减益状态]，会将施加它的那次[HitDamage|击中]的[Premitigation|减免前][Physical|物理][HitDamage|击中伤害]的10% 储存为其[BuffMagnitude|强度]。

施加者后续对目标的[HitDamage|击中]将获得等同于该强度数值的额外不可调整的附加[Physical|物理][HitDamage|伤害]。

具有破碎姿态的敌人无法再次被[Daze|恍惚]。

en:
Umbral Souls grant varying [Buff|Buffs] depending on the kind of Skeletal [Minion] being replaced, as follows -

Umbral Souls from:
• Skeletal Warriors grant 15% increased [Attack] Damage.
• Skeletal Snipers grant 15% increased [Projectile] Speed.
• Skeletal Clerics grant 30% increased [ESRecharge|Energy Shield Recharge Rate].
• Skeletal Arsonists grant 15% increased Area of Effect.
• Skeletal Storm Mages grant 25% increased Spell Damage.
• Skeletal Frost Mages grant 35% increased maximum Energy Shield.
• Skeletal Brutes grant 60% increased [Stun] buildup.
• Skeletal Reavers grant 6% increased Skill Speed.
zh:
幽影灵魂根据被替换的魔侍[Minion|召唤生物]类型提供不同的[Buff|增益状态]，如下 - 

幽影灵魂来源：
• 魔侍武士使[Attack|攻击]伤害提高 15%。
• 魔侍神射手使[Projectile|投射物]速度提高 15%。
• 魔侍祭司使[ESRecharge|能量护盾充能率]提高 30%。
• 魔侍焚焰使使效果范围扩大 15%。
• 魔侍风暴法师使法术伤害提高 25%。
• 魔侍冰霜法师使最大能量护盾提高 35%。
• 魔侍蛮兵使[Stun|晕眩]积蓄提高 60%。
• 魔侍掠夺者使技能速度提高 6%。

en:
Deadly Map Bosses are specific [PowerfulMapBoss|Powerful Map Bosses] that appear in specific Maps and are more difficult and drop better rewards.

These rewards are often accompanied by a specific item, usually from a pool of items. For example Unique Items, or [LineageSupports|Lineage Supports].

Deadly Map Bosses can also drop items that grant access to [PinnacleBoss|Pinnacle Bosses].
zh:
危险的地图首领是出现在特定地图中的特殊[PowerfulMapBoss|强力地图首领]，难度更高且掉落更好的奖励。

这些奖励常伴随特定物品，往往选自一个物品池，如传奇物品或[LineageSupports|血脉辅助]。

危险的地图首领也可能掉落可挑战[PinnacleBoss|巅峰首领]的物品。

en: Pinnacle Bosses are endgame bosses accessed via specific keys or interactions with their mechanic.
zh: 巅峰首领是终局游戏首领，需通过特定钥匙或与其相关机制互动才能进入。

en: Invocation Skills are [Persistent] Skills that gain [Energy] through some condition and can be used once sufficient [Energy] has been gathered to [Invoke] socketed Skills, expending the [Energy] to [Trigger] them. Invocations can [Trigger] socketed Skills multiple times if enough [Energy] is expended, unless otherwise specified.
zh: 咒祈技能为[Persistent|永久性]技能，在某些条件下可获得[Energy|能量]，在达到足够[Energy|能量]来[Invoke|咒祈]插槽中的技能时，可消耗[Energy|能量][Trigger|触发]。如无另外说明，在有足够[Energy|能量]可供消耗时，可多次[Trigger|触发]插槽中的技能。

en:
Sundered Armour is a [Debuff] that can be applied to enemies with [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour] that increases the [Physical] damage they take from [HitDamage|Hits] by an additional 20%. This effect stacks with the target's normal [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour].

Unless otherwise specified, modifiers to [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour] also apply to Sundered Armour. Enemies with Sundered Armour cannot get their [ArmourBreak|Armour Broken] further.
zh:
护甲撕裂是一种[Debuff|减益状态]，可对受到[ArmourBreak|护甲完全破损]效果的敌人施加，使被[HitDamage|击中]时受到的[Physical|物理]伤害额外增加 20%。该效果可与目标一般的[ArmourBreak|护甲完全破损]效果叠加。

如无另外说明，[ArmourBreak|护甲完全破损]的词缀也对护甲撕裂有效。拥有护甲撕裂的敌人无法再被进一步[ArmourBreak|护甲破损]。

en: A target is Isolated if none of its allies are within 6m of it.
zh: 若目标周围 6 米内没有友军，则该目标处于孤立状态。

en: Overflowing Chalice is a buff that causes Life and Mana [Flask|Flasks] to gain 2 charges per second and provide 30% increased recovery.
zh: 满溢圣杯是一种增益效果，使生命和魔力药剂每秒获得 2 次充能，并提高 30%回复量。

en: Withering Ground applies [Withered] every second to enemies standing in it.
zh: 凋零地面每秒对站在地面上的敌人施加[Withered|凋零]。

en:
Default Attacks are the innate [Attack] skills provided by [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapons], and the innate [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack] skill "Punch".

The skill level of your Default Attacks is determined by your character level, and in turn determines the Attack Damage scaling of the skill, which is the percentage of your [MartialWeapon|Weapon's] damage the Default Attack deals.

Default Attacks never have any cost.
zh:
普通攻击是由[MartialWeapon|战斗武器]提供的固有[Attack|攻击]技能，以及固有的[UnarmedAttack|徒手攻击]技能“拳击”。
普通攻击的技能等级取决于角色等级，进而决定该技能的攻击伤害系数，即普通攻击会造成你的[MartialWeapon|武器]伤害的一定百分比。

普通攻击没有任何消耗。

en:
Your Default Attack Damage is the expected damage of a [DefaultAttack|Default Attack], and is determined by the damage of your [MartialWeapon|Weapon] and an Attack Damage scaling value based on your character level.

Your [DefaultAttack|Default Attacks] will always deal Default Attack Damage unless modifiers are applied to change their damage or skill level.

Some [Attack] skills provided by [SupportGem|Support Gems] do not determine their Attack Damage scaling from skill level, but instead deal a percentage of Default Attack Damage.
zh:
你的普通攻击伤害为[DefaultAttack|普通攻击]的预期伤害，该数值由你的[MartialWeapon|武器]伤害以及随角色等级变化的攻击伤害调幅决定。

你的[DefaultAttack|普通攻击]在未受到任何改变其伤害或技能等级的词缀影响时，始终会造成普通攻击伤害。

某些由[SupportGem|辅助宝石]提供的[Attack|攻击]技能，并非根据技能等级来决定攻击伤害调幅，而是造成一定百分比的普通攻击伤害。

en: Khatal's Rejuvenation stacks up to 8 times and grants 5% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate per stack. Each stack of Khatal's Rejuvenation lasts for 10 seconds.
zh: 卡哈塔的复苏可叠加8层，每层提高 5%冷却回复速度。每层持续 10 秒。

en: While you have this [Buff], damage you take is stored. When the [Buff] expires, you gain [Guard] equal to 50% of the stored damage and [Rage] equal to 3% of the stored damage.
zh: 当你拥有此[Buff|增益]状态时，你所承受的伤害会被储存。当此[Buff|增益]状态结束时，你将获得相当于储存伤害 50% 的[Guard|防卫]，以及相当于储存伤害 3% 的[Rage|怒火]。

en:
Two gems are considered Connected if one is socketed into the other, or if both are socketed into a third gem.

A [SupportGem|Support Gem] socketed in a [Meta|Meta] Skill  is still Connected to that [Meta] Skill and to all other Skills socketed in that [Meta] Skill, even if it cannot Support some of those skills.
zh:
如果一颗宝石镶嵌在另一颗宝石上，或者两颗宝石都镶嵌在第三颗宝石上，则认为这两颗宝石是相连的。

一颗[SupportGem|辅助宝石]镶嵌在[Meta|非凡]技能中，即使无法辅助该[Meta|非凡]技能中的某些技能，它仍然被视为与该[Meta|非凡]技能及镶嵌在该非凡技能中的所有其他技能相连。

en:
Activating a Summoning Circle will cause a Boss to be spawned. 

If an area contains more than one Summoning Circle it will contain runes to reactivate the Summoning Circle instead of additional Summoning Circles.
zh:
激活召唤法阵将生成一位首领。

如果一个区域包含多个召唤法阵，那么该区域将包含用于重新激活召唤法阵的符文，而非额外的召唤法阵。

en:
Adaptations are gained by taking [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] from [HitDamage|Hits] and cause you to take less damage of that [ElementalDamage|Type] from subsequent [HitDamage|Hits].

Unless otherwise specified, you can have 3 Adaptations at a time, and Adaptations do not have a duration.
zh:
适者生存可通过承受来自[HitDamage|击中]的[ElementalDamage|元素伤害]获得，并使你在后续[HitDamage|击中]时受到的相同[ElementalDamage|类型]元素伤害降低。

除非另有说明，否则你最多可同时拥有 3 层适者生存，且效果没有持续时间限制。

en:
[Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] into a Bear grants access to devastating [Slam|Slams] and [Fire] [Attack|Attacks] fuelled by smouldering [Rage].

While in Bear form, you gain:
• +10 to [Armour] per level
• 30% of [Armour] also applies to [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage]
• an [Charges|Endurance Charge] for every 15 [Rage] you spend
zh:
[Shapeshift|变形]为巨熊使你能够使用由闷烧[Rage|怒火]驱动的强力[Slam|猛击]与[Fire|火焰][Attack|攻击]。

处于巨熊形态时，你将获得：
• 每级 +10 点[Armour|护甲]
• 30% 的[Armour|护甲]值同时对[ElementalDamage|元素伤害]生效
• 每消耗 15 点[Rage|怒火]，便获得一个[Charges|耐力球]

en:
[Shapeshift] into a Werewolf to draw power from the [Cold] light of the moon, leading your pack with rabid [Attack|Attacks].

While in Werewolf form, you drop to all fours after moving for a short time, gaining 30% increased movement speed when not Sprinting.
zh:
[Shapeshift|变形]为狼人可从月亮的[Cold|冰霜]辉光中汲取力量，并以狂猛的[Attack|攻击]率领你的狼群。

处于狼人形态时，短暂移动后会转为四肢着地奔跑，在非疾跑状态下获得 30% 的移动速度加成。

en:
[Shapeshift] into a Wyvern to bombard your enemies with [Fire] and [Lightning], then close in for the kill.

While in Wyvern form, you gain:
• 50% increased [StunThreshold|Stun Threshold]
• 50% increased [AilmentThreshold|Elemental Ailment Threshold]
• 50% [FasterESRechargeStart|faster start of Energy Shield Recharge]
zh:
[Shapeshift|变形]为双足飞龙使你能够使用[Fire|火焰]和[Lightning|闪电]伤害轰炸敌人，最终靠近并击杀敌人。

处于双足飞龙形态时，你将获得：
• [StunThreshold|晕眩阈值]提高 50%
• [AilmentThreshold|元素异常状态阈值]提高 50%
• [FasterESRechargeStart|能量护盾充能启动速度加快] 50%

en: Plants created by Plant Skills can be Overgrown to gain power in ways detailed on the Plant Skill. This generally cannot be caused by the Skill that creates the Plants, and requires a different Skill or effect that specifically causes them to Overgrow.
zh: 由植物技能创造的植物可以被蔓生，以此获得植物技能上所详述的强化效果。这通常不能由创造该植物的技能本身触发，而需要依靠其他能专门蔓生植物的技能或效果。

en:
[HitDamage|Hits] which could potentially be a [Critical|Critical Hit] but do not roll a [Critical|Critical Hit] will re-roll [Critical|Critical Hit] chance until they succeed.

Hits have 30% less [CriticalDamageBonus|Critical Damage Bonus] for each time [Critical|Critical Hit] chance was re-rolled.
zh:
对于可能造成[Critical|暴击]但未成功判定为[Critical|暴击]的[HitDamage|击中]，将反复重置[Critical|暴击]几率直至成功。

每次[Critical|暴击]几率重置后，击中的[CriticalDamageBonus|暴击伤害加成]都会降低 30%。

en: For every 2% increased Effectiveness, Monsters gain 2% more [Toughness], 1% more Experience granted and 1% more quantity of items dropped.
zh: 效能每增加 2%，怪物获得的[Toughness|韧性]就提高 2%，并提供 1%更多经验值和 1%更多物品掉落数量。

en:
100% more Maximum [Rage]
Regenerate 1 [Rage] per second per 4 [Rage] spent [Recently]
No [Rage] effect
zh:
[Rage|怒火]上限提高 100%
[Recently|近期]每消耗 4 点[Rage|怒火]，则每秒回复 1 点[Rage|怒火]
[Rage|怒火]效果失效

en: [ItemRarity|Unique] items may be closely tied to certain cultures as indicated by an icon in their tooltip. These cultures may hold secrets to manipulating these unique items.
zh: [ItemRarity|传奇]物品可能与特定文化（通过物品提示框中的图标标示）紧密相关。这些文化或许掌握着操控此类传奇物品的秘法。

en: Wind Skills gain additional interactions with other specified Skills, typically [Fire] Skills.
zh: 风系技能会与特定其他技能产生额外互动效果，通常为[Fire|火焰]技能。

en:
You see what is and what might have been. Reveal a suite of Oracle-only passive tree nodes after Ascending as an Oracle.

On taking The Unseen Path Ascendancy Notable, gain the ability to allocate these nodes.
zh:
你将窥见现实与未成之路。作为神谕者完成升华后，可解锁一系列神谕者专属的天赋树节点。

当分配至升华核心天赋"无踪之道"时，可获得分配这些节点的能力。

en: Some modifiers on [Rune|Runes] and [Idol|Idols] are available only to players who have allocated the Shaman's Wisdom of the Maji Ascendancy Notable.
zh: 部分[Rune|符文]与[Idol|雕像]上的词缀仅限已点出“萨满的智慧”众神升华核心天赋的玩家使用。

en:
An item with a Vaal Siphoner will require a set number of kills to complete. Once complete the tier of a random modifier on the item will be downgraded and all other modifiers will have their numeric values improved.

These improved modifier will have their values randomised between their current value and 10% above their maximum value.
zh:
带有“瓦尔虹吸者”词缀的物品需要达成一定击杀数才能完成充能。完成后，物品的一个随机词缀的阶位将会降低，而其他所有词缀的数值都将获得提升。

这些被提升的词缀的数值，将在其当前值与比其最大值高 10% 的数值之间随机分配。

en:
By default, chance-based stats cap at 100% chance for the result to occur. However, some chances can surpass 100%. In this case, the event for which you have a chance to effect will occur once for each 100% chance for that event you have, and then have a normal percentage chance for it to occur again based on the remaining value.

For example, a Surpassing 215% chance for an event to occur will cause the event to occur twice (once for each 100% chance) and have a 15% chance for it to occur a third time.
zh:
默认情况下，基于几率的属性生效上限为 100%。然而，部分几率可突破此限制。当几率超过 100% 时，每拥有一个 100% 几率即可保证效果触发一次，剩余几率将作为额外触发一次的常规几率独立计算。

例如：若某效果的溢出几率为 215%，则效果将必定触发两次（每100%几率对应一次），并有 15% 的几率额外触发第三次。

en: Thorny Ground deals Spell damage to enemies upon being created, then continues to damage enemies that move over the Ground, no more than twice per second.
zh: 荆棘地面在生成时对敌人造成法术伤害，之后会对在其上移动的敌人持续造成伤害，每秒最多触发两次。

en:
[Strike] Skills can be made to deal Splash damage when hitting an enemy, causing an additional [HitDamage|Hit] to other enemies around the one hit by the [Strike].

The base radius of Splash damage is 1.5 metres.
zh:
[Strike|打击]技能击中敌人时能够造成溅射伤害，并对[Strike|打击]技能击中的敌人附近的其他敌人造成额外一次[HitDamage|击中]。

溅射伤害的基准范围半径为 1.5米。

en:
[Mark|Marks] all have a condition that makes them Activate.
When a [Mark] Activates, it will cause an extra effect and then be [Consume|Consumed].
zh: 所有[Mark|印记]均设有可将其激活的特定条件。当[Mark|印记]被激活时，将引发额外效果，随后被[Consume|消耗]。

en:
Any mechanic where the calculation of a single [HitDamage|Hit] would roll [Critical|Critical Hit] Chance more than once is considered to be Rerolling. This includes anything that makes [Critical|Critical Hit] Chance [Lucky], [Unlucky], [ForksCrit|Bifurcated], or [InevitableCriticalHits|Inevitable].

[Sustained] Skills using an independent [Critical|Critical Hit] Chance roll for each different time they deal damage is not Rerolling.
zh:
任何机制中，若对单次[HitDamage|击中]的[Critical|暴击]几率进行多次判定，则被视为“重置”。这包含使[Critical|暴击]几率[Lucky|幸运]、[Unlucky|不幸]、[ForksCrit|分叉暴击]或 [InevitableCriticalHits|命定]的所有情况。

[Sustained|持续性技能]在不同时段造成伤害时进行各自独立的[Critical|暴击]几率判定，则不属于重置。

en:
When [Ignite|Igniting] a target which has already been [Ignite|Ignited] by the same use of this Skill, the existing [Ignite] is removed to boost the new [Ignite], multiplying its [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] by the total number of [Ignite|Ignites] compounded this way.

[Ignite|Ignites] cannot Compound when reflected, or when applied by [OilGround|Oil Ground] that has been [Ignite|Ignited]. They will neither remove existing [Ignite], nor get any boost to [BuffMagnitude|Ignite Magnitude].
zh:
当使用同一个技能[Ignite|点燃]一个已被该技能[Ignite|点燃]的目标时，现有的[Ignite|点燃]效果将被移除，用以强化新的[Ignite|点燃]，其效果[BuffMagnitude|强度]将乘以通过此方式累计叠加的[Ignite|点燃]总数。

由反射，或由被[Ignite|点燃]的[OilGround|黏油地面]施加的[Ignite|点燃]，无法进行叠加。这些[Ignite|点燃]既不会移除现有的[Ignite|点燃]，也不会获得任何[BuffMagnitude|点燃强度]加成。

en: Drenched is a [Debuff] that causes enemies to be easier to [Shock] and [Freeze].
zh: 浸湿是一种[Debuff|减益状态]，会使敌人更容易[Shock|感电]和[Freeze|冻结]。

en: Storm Skills are long-duration weather-based Skills that have special interactions with other effects.
zh: 风暴技能是基于天气的长持续时间技能，可与其他效果产生特殊的相互作用。

en: The maximum value of this modifier is applied to the whole modifier, including the constant part.
zh: 该词缀的最大值将应用于整个词缀，包括其恒定部分。

en:
[Storm|Storm] and [Plant|Plant] [Spell|Spells] deal 50% more damage
[Storm|Storm] and [Plant|Plant] [Spell|Spells] have 75% less duration
[Storm|Storm] and [Plant|Plant] [Spell|Spells] have 50% less cost
zh:
[Storm|风暴]与[Plant|植物]类[Spell|法术]造成的伤害提高 50%
[Storm|风暴]与[Plant|植物]类[Spell|法术]持续时间缩短 75%
[Storm|风暴]与[Plant|植物]类[Spell|法术]消耗降低 50%

en:
Energised Crystals are collected by energising [ContainsIncursion|Vaal Beacons] throughout Wraeclast, and are required to access Atziri's Temple.

6 Energised Crystals are required to power the Temple Console.
zh:
充能水晶可通过激活遍布瓦尔克拉斯的[ContainsIncursion|瓦尔灯塔]进行收集，是进入阿兹里神庙的必要物品。

需要 6 个充能水晶才能为神庙控制台供能。

en: This refers to the base amount of time to perform an [Attack] Skill, accounting only for the Attacks per Second value of the relevant [MartialWeapon|Weapon] and the percentage of Base Attack Speed listed on the [Attack] gem.
zh: 指执行一次[Attack|攻击]技能所需的基础时间，其计算仅依据相关[MartialWeapon|武器]的每秒攻击次数，以及[Attack|攻击]技能宝石上所列出的基础攻击速度百分比。

en:
Each time you enter the Temple a random selection of rooms are Destabilised, removing them permanently when you next exit. 

In addition to the randomly selected rooms, some rooms are Destabilised upon completion. [IncursionRestrictedRoom|Restricted Rooms] that are accessible will always destabilise upon exiting the Temple.

Defeating the Architect or Atziri causes greater Destabilisation.
zh:
每次进入神庙时，会随机选择若干房间陷入瓦解状态，并在你下次退出时永久移除这些房间。

除了随机选择的房间外，部分房间在完成后也会瓦解。可进入的[IncursionRestrictedRoom|秘藏房间]在离开神庙时总是会瓦解。

击败建筑师或阿兹里将导致更剧烈的瓦解。

en: Restricted Rooms are those that are placed by using Xipocado's Console in the Architect's Chamber
zh: 秘藏房间指通过筑师殿堂中的夏波卡多控制台所放置的房间

en: Juatalotli's Medallion prevents the next [IncursionDestabilization|Destabilisation] of a Room
zh: 华塔洛蒂的纹章可防止一个房间下次发生[IncursionDestabilization|瓦解]

en: Hayoxi's Medallion rerolls a [IncursionRestrictedRoom|Restricted Room] in the Temple
zh: 海幽夏的纹章可重掷神庙中的一个[IncursionRestrictedRoom|秘藏房间]

en: Quipolatl's Medallion [IncursionRoomUpgrades|Upgrades] the Tier of a Room
zh: 奎波拉特尔的纹章可[IncursionRoomUpgrades|升级]一个房间的等阶。

en: Uromoti's Medallion allows you to place a specific Room in the Temple
zh: 武罗摩提的纹章允许你在神庙中放置一个指定房间

en: Xopec's Medallion increases your Maximum [IncursionCrystal|Crystal] Capacity by 6 (up to 60)
zh: 肖佩克的纹章使你的[IncursionCrystal|充能水晶]最大容量增加 6（上限为 60 ）

en: Azcapa's Medallion increases your Maximum Medallion Capacity by 1 (up to 6)
zh: 阿兹卡帕的纹章使你的纹章最大容量增加 1（上限为 6 ）

en: Estazunti's Medallion allows you to place an additional [IncursionRestrictedRoom|Restricted Room Card] after defeating the Architect
zh: 埃斯塔祖提的纹章允许你在击败建筑师后额外放置一张[IncursionRestrictedRoom|秘藏房间卡牌]

en: Puhuarte's Medallion allows you to reroll the Room Cards available for placement
zh: 普华特的纹章允许你重掷可供放置的房间卡牌

en: Zantipi's Medallion adds one to the number of random [Waystone] Modifiers added to your Temple.
zh: 赞提佩的纹章使你的神庙增加一个随机[Waystone|引路石]词缀数量。

en:
Power is provided to connected Paths by Generator rooms. Powered Paths provide Power to adjacent rooms.

The Generator rooms are Dynamo, Shrine of Empowerment, Solar Nexus and Infinite Horizon. 

The Smithy, Synthflesh Lab, Transcendent Barracks and Golem Works rooms can be [IncursionRoomUpgrades|Upgraded] by receiving Power.
zh:
供能房间会为相连的路径提供能量。被充能的路径会为相邻房间供能。

供能房间包括：动力核心、赋能圣所、烈日核心和无穷天际。

铁匠铺、合成血肉实验室、升华守卫兵营与魔像工坊房间可通过接收能量来[IncursionRoomUpgrades|升级]。

en: Limb Modification can be performed by using a Transcension Device. Limb Modification will replace a chosen body part with a modified version, granting you an additional stat. Limb Modifications are lost when you resurrect after dying.
zh: 肢体改造可通过使用升华装置进行。该改造会将选定身体部位替换为具有词缀的新肢体，为你提供额外属性。从死亡中复活后，肢体改造效果将消失。

en: Medallions are obtained from Atziri's Temple and can be used to modify the Temple in various ways.
zh: 纹章可从阿兹里的神庙中获得，并可用于以多种方式调整神庙属性。

en:
Modifiers to [Ailments|Ailment] Application apply to:
[Bleeding], [Poison] and [Shock] chance
[Flammability], [Freeze] and [Electrocute|Electrocution] Buildup.
zh:
[Ailments|异常状态]应用相关的词缀适用于：
[Bleeding|流血]、[Poison|中毒]与[Shock|感电]的几率
[Flammability|易燃]、[Freeze|冰冻]与[Electrocute|触电]的积蓄。

en:
Activating Vaal Beacons [IncursionCrystal|Energises Crystals] allowing access to Atziri's Temple.

Within the Vaal Ruins a Vaal architect's console may be activated to allow the manipulation of the Temple before activating a temporal portal to travel back in time to 400 BIC, during the reign of Queen Atziri.
zh:
激活瓦尔灯塔可为[IncursionCrystal|充能水晶]充能，从而进入阿兹里神庙。

在瓦尔遗迹中，可激活瓦尔建筑师的控制台，以便在开启时空之门回到恒历前 400 年，也就是阿兹里女王统治时期，对神庙进行改造。

en:
Each Mirror offers a rare item of one of the following base types:
• [FourRingLake1|Dusk Ring]
• [FourRingLake2|Gloam Ring]
• [FourRingLake3|Penumbra Ring]
• [FourRingLake4|Tenebrous Ring]
• [FourAmuletLake1|Dusk Amulet]
• [FourAmuletLake2|Gloam Amulet]
• [FourAmuletLake3|Penumbra Amulet]
• [FourAmuletLake4|Tenebrous Amulet]
zh:
每面魔镜会提供以下基底类型之一的稀有物品：
• [FourRingLake1|暮色戒指]
• [FourRingLake2|薄暮戒指]
• [FourRingLake3|半影戒指]
• [FourRingLake4|暗黑戒指]
• [FourAmuletLake1|暮色项链]
• [FourAmuletLake2|薄暮项链]
• [FourAmuletLake3|半影项链]
• [FourAmuletLake4|暗黑项链]

en:
Soaring Ground grants 30% increased [Evasion] Rating, 40% increased damage while on Full Life, and [Onslaught] to you or [Allies] standing on it. These effects Linger for 1 second.

Soaring Ground has a 6 second base duration unless otherwise specified.
zh:
腾飞之地能使立于其上的你或[Allies|友军]的[Evasion|闪避]提高 30%，满血时伤害提高 40%， 获得[Onslaught|猛攻]效果。这些效果在离开后持续 1 秒。

除非另有说明，腾飞之地的基础持续时间为 6 秒。

en:
[Shrine|Shrines] are found with multiple packs of monsters Worshipping the Shrine.

Other monsters may be affected by the Shrine's [Presence] but do not count as Worshippers.
zh:
[Shrine|神龛]周围常伴有多群敬拜神龛的怪物。

其他怪物可能会受到神坛[Presence|存在]的影响，但不被视为敬拜者。

en:
Runic Ward is a last line of protection, absorbing fatal damage instead of your Life. If you take damage that would cause your Life to reach 0 while you have Runic Ward, you will drop to 1 Life and your Runic Ward will take the remaining damage. You will still die if you do not have enough Runic Ward to absorb the remaining damage. Runic Ward does not protect against Life loss that is not caused by taking damage.

Runic Ward constantly regenerates at a default rate of 5% per second.

Monsters can also have Runic Ward. While a monster has Runic Ward, it cannot be [CullingStrike|Culled].
zh:
符文结界是抵御死亡的最终防护，可代替你的生命值吸收致命伤害。当你拥有符文结界时，若受到本会使生命降至 0 的伤害，你会降至 1 点生命，并由符文结界承受剩余的伤害。若你剩余的符文结界不足以吸收剩余伤害，你仍会死亡。符文结界无法抵御非伤害造成的生命损失。

符文结界会以默认每秒 5% 的速度持续再生。

怪物也可拥有符文结界。当怪物拥有符文结界时，其无法被[CullingStrike|终结]。

en:
Monster Rarity increases the chance for monsters to be [Rarity|Rare and Magic].

Monster Rarity also increases [MonsterModifiers|Monster Modifier] Chance for Rare Monsters.
zh:
怪物稀有度会提高怪物成为[Rarity|稀有与魔法]怪物的几率。

怪物稀有度也会提高稀有怪物的[MonsterModifiers|怪物词缀]几率。

en: Stats that refer to an item's [Armour] use the exact value listed on the item. This means that [Quality] and local modifiers on the item are taken into account, but stats from other sources that change the amount of [Armour] actually granted to your character are not considered.
zh: 涉及物品[Armour|护甲]的属性，使用的是物品上列出的具体数值。这意味着物品的[Quality|品质]及局部词缀都会被纳入计算，但通过其他来源获得的、会改变实际赋予角色的[Armour|护甲]值的属性则不被考虑。

en: Stats that refer to an item's [Evasion] use the exact value listed on the item. This means that [Quality] and local modifiers on the item are taken into account, but stats from other sources that change the amount of [Evasion] actually granted to your character are not considered.
zh: 涉及物品[Evasion|闪避]的属性，使用的是物品上列出的具体数值。这意味着物品的[Quality|品质]及局部词缀都会被纳入计算，但通过其他来源获得的、会改变实际赋予角色的[Evasion|闪避]值的属性则不被考虑。

en: Stats that refer to an item's [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] use the exact value listed on the item. This means that [Quality] and local modifiers on the item are taken into account, but stats from other sources that change the amount of [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] actually granted to your character are not considered.
zh: 涉及物品[EnergyShield|能量护盾]的属性，使用的是物品上列出的具体数值。这意味着物品的[Quality|品质]及局部词缀都会被纳入计算，但通过其他来源获得的、会改变实际赋予角色的[EnergyShield|能量护盾]值的属性则不被考虑。

en: [ContainsRitual|Ritual] Free Rerolls allow rerolling Favours an additional time at no Cost.
zh: [ContainsRitual|驱灵祭坛]免费重置允许你无需消耗即可额外重置一次恩典。

en:
Monster Minions are any monsters that are part of a [Rarity|Rare] Monster [Pack].

These monsters receive one modifier from each Rare Monster in the Pack.

Monsters summoned or created by other Monsters do not count as Monster Minions.
zh:
怪物仆从是指作为[Rarity|稀有]怪物[Pack|群落]的一部分的任何怪物。

这些怪物从该群落中的每个稀有怪物处获得一条词缀。

由其他怪物召唤或创造的怪物不计入怪物仆从。

en: Rogue Exile Hunting Grounds contain 2 additional [RogueExile|Rogue Exiles] and 5 additional [Pack|Packs] of [Rarity|Rare] [MonsterCategory|Beasts].
zh: 盗贼流放者猎场包含 2 个额外的[RogueExile|盗贼流放者]和 5 群额外的[Rarity|稀有][MonsterCategory|野兽][Pack|群落]。

en:
Rooms in Atziri's Temple may have their tier upgraded in various ways, up to a default maximum of tier 3.

Most rooms are upgraded via their adjacent rooms, some rooms are upgraded via [IncursionPower|Powered Paths].

Garrisons may be transformed into a Legion Barracks when adjacent to a Viper Spymaster or to a Transcendant Barracks when adjacent to a Synthflesh Lab.

Flesh Surgeon and Thaumaturge instead have their level equal to the highest adjacent Synthflesh Lab or Sacrificial Chamber, respectively.

Quipolatl's Medallion may be used to upgrade the tier of a room by 1.
zh:
阿兹里神庙中的房间可通过多种方式提升等阶，默认最高为 3 阶。

大多数房间通过与其相邻的房间升级，部分房间则通过[IncursionPower|充能路径]升级。

驻军地在与毒蛇密使的房间相邻时可转变为军团兵营，在与合成血肉实验室相邻时可转变为升华守卫兵营。

血肉外科医师与奇术师的等级，则分别等同于相邻的最高等级合成血肉实验室或献祭室的等级。

奎波拉特尔的纹章可用于将房间的等阶提升 1 级。

en:
Additional Rare Monsters can spawn in [Rarity|Rare] Monster [Pack|Packs] with larger pack sizes.

Each Rare Monster in the Pack provides one modifier to the Pack's [MonsterMinion|Minions].

Additional Rare Monsters in [Essence] Packs also carry Essences.
zh:
[Rarity|稀有][Pack|群落]在规模更大时，可以生成额外的稀有怪物。

群落中的每个稀有怪物都会为该群落中的[MonsterMinion|怪物仆从]提供一条词缀。

[Essence|精华]群落中的额外稀有怪物也携带精华。

en:
Empowered [MonsterMinion|Monster Minions] deal increased damage and have increased health.

Empowerment does not inherently increase rewards but some effects add rewards when Empowering Minions.
zh:
强化的[MonsterMinion|怪物仆从]会造成更多伤害，并拥有更高的生命值。

强化本身并不会内在增加奖励，但某些效果会在强化怪物仆从时添加奖励。

en:
Abandoned Cities have very few living inhabitants. 

Monsters in the area are replaced by Undead. These undead have 50% chance to drop non-equipment items instead of equipment.

Abandoned Cities have 25% increased Chests in the area.
zh:
废弃之城中鲜有活物存留。

该区域的怪物将被亡灵取代。这些亡灵有 50% 的几率掉落非装备物品，而非装备本身。

废弃都市中的宝箱数量提高 25%。

en:
Exceptional Items have [Quality] over maximum or an additional [Augment] Socket.

High Tier [Rarity|Rare] Items found have a chance to instead drop as an Exceptional Normal Item.
zh:
卓越物品要么拥有超过上限的[Quality|品质]，要么拥有一个额外的[[Augment|增幅器]插槽。

发现的高阶[Rarity|稀有]物品，有几率以卓越普通物品的形态掉落。

en: Protects the Bear Spirit's [Allies] while they are in its [Presence], granting them 2% of maximum Life regenerated per second and causing 8% of the damage they would take to be taken by the Bear Spirit instead.
zh: 熊灵会庇佑其[Presence|存在]范围内的[Allies|友军]，为其提供每秒 2% 最大生命的回复，并令其本会承受的伤害中的 8% 改为由熊灵承担。

en:
Biomes are found throughout Endgame Maps.

Grass, Forest, Swamp, Desert, Mountain and Water Biomes are all commonly found.

Cities and special biomes are less likely to be encountered.
zh:
终局地图中分布着多种地貌。

常见的有草原、森林、沼泽、沙漠、山岳与水泽地貌。

城市及特殊地貌则较为罕见。

en:
Invaded Cities have their natural inhabitants plus 15 extra [Pack|Packs] of another faction.

Invaded Cities gain the [Biome] bonuses of the invading faction.

The Factions are the Ezomyte, Faridun and Vaal.
zh:
沦陷之城中，除了原有怪物外，还会额外出现 15 [Pack|群落]其他阵营的怪物。

沦陷之城将获得入侵阵营的[Biome|地貌]加成。

可能的阵营有：艾兹麦、法里顿与瓦尔。

en:
Some methods of item crafting guarantee that a specific Modifier will be crafted onto the item. An item can only have one Crafted Modifier, but they otherwise behave identically to other Modifiers.

Crafted Modifiers are displayed in a lighter blue colour than regular Modifiers.
zh:
某些物品制作方法能保证将特定词缀制作到物品上。一件物品只能拥有一条工艺词缀，但除此之外，它们的行为与其他词缀一致。

工艺词缀以比普通词缀更浅的蓝色显示。

en:
A Grand Mirror causes a reflection of the [MapBoss|Map Boss]. When the bosses are defeated [ContainsDelirium|Delirium] fog spreads to nearby Maps.

When the fog reaches 100% [Delirious|Deliriousness] one of the remaining maps will be transformed into a Simulacrum.
zh:
恢宏之镜会生成一个[MapBoss|地图首领]的镜像，当这些首领被击败后，[ContainsDelirium|惊悸迷雾]会扩散至附近的地图。

当迷雾达到 100%[Delirious|亢奋度]时，剩余地图中的 1 张会转变为梦魇拟像。

en:
While you have any amount of Mountain's Teachings:
• [Attack|Attacks] you use yourself and [Attack|Attacks] granted by this Ascendancy Class deal 15% more damage
• Enemy [HitDamage|Hits] you take that would deal damage less than or equal to 30% of your maximum Life (after mitigation such as [Armour] and [Resistances], but before other modifiers to damage taken) deal 40% less damage
• You have 50% more [StunThreshold|Stun Threshold]

All Mountain's Teachings are lost if you go 20 seconds without gaining any.
zh:
当你拥有任意层数的山之教诲时：
• 你亲自发动的[Attack|攻击]以及由该升华职业赋予的[Attack|攻击]造成的总伤害提高 15%
• 你承受的敌人造成的[HitDamage|击中]伤害，若该伤害（在经[Armour|护甲]和[Resistances|抗性]等减免后，但在承受伤害的其他修正生效前）小于或等于你最大生命值的 30%，则其造成的总伤害降低 40%
• 你的[StunThreshold|晕眩阈值]总增 50%

若你在 20 秒内未获得任意层数的山之教诲，则失去所有层数。

en:
Wombgifts are found within [ContainsBreach|Breaches] and are grown on The Genesis Tree.

The 4 types of Wombgifts are:
* [BreachFruitCurrency|Lavish Wombgift]
* [BreachFruitAmulet|Ornate Wombgift]
* [BreachFruitBelt|Banded Wombgift]
* [BreachFruitRing|Signet Wombgift]
zh:
孕育赠礼可在[ContainsBreach|裂隙]中找到，并在起源之树上生长。

4 种孕育赠礼分别为：
* [BreachFruitCurrency|丰裕孕育赠礼]
* [BreachFruitAmulet|华丽孕育赠礼]
* [BreachFruitBelt|束带孕育赠礼]
* [BreachFruitRing|印戒孕育赠礼]

en:
The Rite of the Nameless is a group of maps which each contain [ContainsRitual|Ritual Altars] and a [MapBoss|Map Boss].

Completing all Ritual Altars will drop an [RitualPinnacleEffigyPiece|Effigy Piece].
zh:
“无名仪式”由一组地图组成，每张地图都包含[ContainsRitual|驱灵祭坛]和 1 个[MapBoss|地图首领]。

完成所有祭坛后，会掉落一个[RitualPinnacleEffigyPiece|雕像碎片]。

en: Effigy Pieces can be placed on an incomplete Effigy in Caer Tarth to complete the [RitualRiteOfTheNameless|Rite of the Nameless].
zh: 雕像碎片可以放置在赛尔塔斯的未完成雕像上，以完成[RitualRiteOfTheNameless|无名仪式]。

en: You are on Low [Ward|Runic Ward] if you have 35% of your maximum [Ward|Runic Ward] or less.
zh: 若你的[Ward|符文结界]值不高于最大值的 35%，则你处于低[Ward|符文结界]状态。

en: A Savage Hit is a Hit that removes at least 15% of Maximum Life.
zh: 残暴打击是指一次击中移除至少 15% 最大生命的击中。

en: Completing this Map will apply the specified Modifier to other Maps in the [RitualRiteOfTheNameless|Rite of the Nameless].
zh: 完成此地图会将指定的词缀应用于[RitualRiteOfTheNameless|无名仪式]中的其他地图。

en: The first list of Favours at [ContainsRitual|Ritual Altars] in this Map will contain the specified Item.
zh: 此地图中[ContainsRitual|驱灵祭坛]首次列出的恩典将包含指定物品。

en:
Basic Maps are any maps with no special interaction with areas or access requirements.

Notably, not [ContainsUniqueMap|Unique Maps], [DeadlyMapBoss|Deadly Map Boss] Maps, [PrecursorTower|Precursor Towers], Expedition Areas or Quest Areas.
zh:
基础地图是指任何不与区域产生特殊互动或没有进入要求的地图。

需要注意的是，[ContainsUniqueMap|传奇地图]、[DeadlyMapBoss|危险地图首领]地图、[PrecursorTower|先驱高塔]、先祖秘藏区域或任务区域并非基础地图。

en:
An item's Base Type refers to the specific variety of item it is, and grants it inherent properties such as damage on [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapons], defensive bonuses on Armour, or Life recovery on Life [Flask|Flasks]. It is also often responsible for the Level and/or [Attributes|Attribute] Requirements to equip an item.

For example:
• [Quarterstaff1|Wrapped Quarterstaff] and [Quarterstaff2|Long Quarterstaff] are both [Quarterstaff] Base Types
• [GlovesStr1|Stocky Mitts] and [GlovesDexInt2|Linen Wraps] are both Gloves Base Types
• [FlaskMana1|Lesser Mana Flask] and [FlaskMana3|Greater Mana Flask] are both Mana [Flask] Base Types
zh:
物品的基底类型指其具体种类，并赋予其固有属性，例如[MartialWeapon|战斗武器]的伤害、护甲的防御加成，或生命[Flask|药剂]的回复量。基底类型通常也决定了装备该物品所需的等级和/或[Attributes|属性]需求。

例如：
•[Quarterstaff1|裹布节杖]和[Quarterstaff2|长柄节杖]均为[Quarterstaff|节杖]基底类型
•[GlovesStr1|敦实护手]和[GlovesDexInt2|亚麻裹手]均为手套基底类型
•[FlaskMana1|次级魔力药剂]和[FlaskMana3|良质魔力药剂]均为魔力[Flask|药剂]基底类型

en:
There are a number of possible Mage's Legacies, each granting a different bonus:
• [LegacyOfAmethyst|Legacy of Amethyst]
• [LegacyOfBasalt|Legacy of Basalt]
• [LegacyOfBismuth|Legacy of Bismuth]
• [LegacyOfDiamond|Legacy of Diamond]
• [LegacyOfGold|Legacy of Gold]
• [LegacyOfGranite|Legacy of Granite]
• [LegacyOfJade|Legacy of Jade]
• [LegacyOfQuicksilver|Legacy of Quicksilver]
• [LegacyOfRuby|Legacy of Ruby]
• [LegacyOfSapphire|Legacy of Sapphire]
• [LegacyOfSilver|Legacy of Silver]
• [LegacyOfStibnite|Legacy of Stibnite]
• [LegacyOfSulphur|Legacy of Sulphur]
• [LegacyOfTopaz|Legacy of Topaz]

Only one instance of each Mage's Legacy can apply its bonus to you at a time.
zh:
存在多种可能的法师的遗产，每种提供不同的加成：
• [LegacyOfAmethyst|紫晶遗产]
• [LegacyOfBasalt|玄武岩遗产]
• [LegacyOfBismuth|灰岩遗产]
• [LegacyOfDiamond|钻石遗产]
• [LegacyOfGold|黄金遗产]
• [LegacyOfGranite|坚岩遗产]
• [LegacyOfJade|青玉遗产]
• [LegacyOfQuicksilver|水银遗产]
• [LegacyOfRuby|红玉遗产]
• [LegacyOfSapphire|蓝玉遗产]
• [LegacyOfSilver|白银遗产]
• [LegacyOfStibnite|黑锑遗产]
• [LegacyOfSulphur|硫磺遗产]
• [LegacyOfTopaz|黄玉遗产]

每种法师的遗产在同一时间只能有一个实例将其加成作用于你。

en: Legacy of Amethyst is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants +45% to [Chaos] [Resistances|Resistance].
zh: 紫晶遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 45%的[Chaos|混沌] [Resistances|抗性]提高。

en: Legacy of Basalt is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants 150% increased [Armour].
zh: 玄武岩遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 150%[Armour|护甲]提高。

en: Legacy of Bismuth is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants +45% to all [ElementalDamage|Elemental] [Resistances].
zh: 灰岩遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 45%全部[ElementalDamage|元素] [Resistances|抗性]提高。

en: Legacy of Diamond is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants 75% increased [Critical|Critical Hit] Chance.
zh: 钻石遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 75%[Critical|暴击]几率提高。

en: Legacy of Gold is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants 45% increased [ItemRarity|Rarity of Items] found.
zh: 黄金遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 45%[ItemRarity|物品稀有度]提高。

en: Legacy of Granite is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants +2000 to [Armour].
zh: 坚岩遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 2000 [Armour|护甲]提高。

en: Legacy of Jade is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants +2000 to [Evasion] Rating.
zh: 青玉遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 2000 [Evasion|闪避]值提高。

en: Legacy of Quicksilver is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants 30% increased Movement Speed.
zh: 水银遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 30%移动速度提高。

en: Legacy of Ruby is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants +60% to [Resistances|Fire Resistance] and +5% to [MaximumResistances|Maximum Fire Resistance].
zh: 红玉遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 60%[Resistances|火焰抗性]提高和 5%[MaximumResistances|火焰抗性上限]提高。

en: Legacy of Sapphire is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants +60% to [Resistances|Cold Resistance] and +5% to [MaximumResistances|Maximum Cold Resistance].
zh: 蓝玉遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 60%[Resistances|冰霜抗性]提高和 5%[MaximumResistances|冰霜抗性上限]提高。

en: Legacy of Silver is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants 30% increased [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed].
zh: 白银遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 30%[SkillSpeed|技能速度]提高。

en: Legacy of Stibnite is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants 150% increased [Evasion|Evasion Rating].
zh: 黑锑遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 150%[Evasion|闪避值]提高。

en: Legacy of Sulphur is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants 60% increased Damage, and makes the area within 2.5 metres of you [ConsecratedGround|Consecrated Ground] while you're stationary.
zh: 硫磺遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 60%伤害提高，并且在你静止时，你周围 2.5 米内的区域变为[ConsecratedGround|奉献地面]。

en: Legacy of Topaz is a [MagesLegacy|Mage's Legacy] which grants +60% to [Resistances|Lightning Resistance] and +5% to [MaximumResistances|Maximum Lightning Resistance].
zh: 黄玉遗产是一种[MagesLegacy|法师的遗产]，提供 60%[Resistances|闪电抗性]提高和 5%[MaximumResistances|闪电抗性上限]提高。

en:
Some Remnant encounters have Bonus Rewards which provide guaranteed rewards, in addition to allowing you to choose a Runeshape Combination. 

Bonus rewards are granted to all party members who have not previously claimed the reward and were in the area when the Remnant was encountered.
zh:
部分残片事件拥有额外奖励，除了允许你选择一组符文组合外，还会提供固定的奖励。

额外奖励将给予所有尚未领取过该奖励、且在该残片事件发生时位于区域内的队伍成员。

en:
A Verisium Infusion can be used instead of any of the [ElementalInfusion|Elemental Infusions]. Skills will prioritise using non-Verisium Infusions. Verisium Infusions last for 20 seconds or until Consumed by another Skill.

Your maximum number of Verisium Infusions is equal to the maximum number of any single type of [ElementalInfusion|Elemental Infusion] you can have (3 by default).
zh:
维金灌注可以用来替代任意一种[ElementalInfusion|元素灌注]。技能会优先使用非维金灌注。维金灌注将持续 20 秒，或被其他技能消耗为止。

维金灌注数量上限等同于你拥有的任意一种[ElementalInfusion|元素灌注]的最大数量（默认 3 个）。

en: Secured [Strongbox|Strongboxes] are guarded by additional [Pack|Packs] of [Rarity|Rare] Monsters and may roll Modifiers which add [MonsterModifiers|Monster Modifiers] to any Rares guarding the Strongbox.
zh: 受保护的[Strongbox|保险箱]由额外的[Rarity|稀有]怪物[Pack|群落]守卫，并且可能具有随机词缀，为守卫保险箱的任意稀有怪物添加[MonsterModifiers|怪物词缀]。

en: [Slow|Slows] by 10%, reapplying this [Debuff] stacks and refreshes it's duration.
zh: [Slow|减速] 10%，重复施加此[Debuff|减益状态]会叠加并刷新其持续时间。

en:
Each "Boss Encounter" icon on the World Screen is a face which can be broken by beating the encounter.

"Rare Monster Encounter" icons do not provide any bonus when broken.
zh:
世界地图上的每个“首领遭遇战”图标都是一张可击碎的面孔，击败该遭遇即可将其击碎。

“稀有怪物遭遇战”图标在击碎时不会提供任何奖励。

en:
Allocated Sinister [Jewel] Sockets are visible on the left edge of the character portrait in the centre of the passive skill tree.

[ItemRarity|Unique] [Jewel|Jewels] cannot be socketed in Sinister Jewel Sockets, and modifiers to the effect of Jewel Sockets do not apply to Sinister Jewel Sockets.

They are entirely disconnected from the rest of your passive skill tree - they are not considered to be within any radius of any other passive skill, and no passive skill is within any radius of a Sinister [Jewel] Socket. Multiple Sinister [Jewel] Sockets are also not within any radius of each other. Radius effects of [Jewel|Jewels] will therefore have no effect when socketed in Sinister Sockets.
zh:
已分配的凶邪[Jewel|珠宝]插槽会显示在天赋树中央角色头像的左侧边缘。

[ItemRarity|传奇][Jewel|珠宝]无法镶嵌在凶邪珠宝插槽中，且珠宝插槽效果的修正不适用于凶邪珠宝插槽。

它们与天赋树的其他部分完全断开连接——不被视为处于任何其他天赋技能的范围内，也没有任何天赋技能处于凶邪[Jewel|珠宝]插槽的范围内。多个凶邪[Jewel|珠宝]插槽之间也互不在范围内。因此，镶嵌在凶邪插槽中的[Jewel|珠宝]的范围效果将不会生效。

en:
Socket-bound [Augment|Augments] permanently fill any [Augment] Socket they are placed into.

Once Socketed, they cannot be removed, replaced or extracted by any means.
zh:
插槽绑定的[Augment|增幅器]物品会永久填充它们所放入的[Augment|增幅器]插槽。

一旦镶嵌，便无法以任何方式移除、替换或提取。

en:
[Warcry|Warcries], and Non-[Channelling] [Spell|Spells] that affect an area around you or a targeted location, are Cascadable.

Certain effects can cause Cascadable Skills to Cascade, making them also affect other locations, or to Echo, affecting the same targeted location again after a delay.

A Cascadable Spell that [Repeat|Repeats] will not Cascade or Echo while [Repeat|Repeating].
zh:
[Warcry|战吼]，以及影响你周围或目标地点的非[Channelling|持续吟唱][Spell|法术]，都是可扩散的。

某些效果可以使可扩散技能产生扩散，使其也影响其他位置，或者产生回响，在延迟后再次影响同一个目标位置。

一个可扩散且[Repeat|可重复]的法术在[Repeat|重复]期间不会扩散或回响。

en: Anaemia is a [Debuff] that allows more than 10 [CorruptedBlood|Corrupted Blood] debuffs to be applied to a target. The [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Anaemia determines how many additional Corrupted Blood stacks to be applied.
zh: 贫血是一种[Debuff|减益状态]，允许对目标施加超过 10 层的[CorruptedBlood|腐化之血]。贫血的[BuffMagnitude|强度]决定了可额外施加的腐化之血层数。

en:
Phased Form is a notable Ascendancy Passive Skill granted by Chronomancer granting the following stats:

Take 30% less Damage.
4 seconds after being Damaged by an Enemy Hit, take Damage equal to 30% of that Hit's Damage.
zh:
迷踪形态是塑时术师升华天赋提供的一个核心天赋，具有以下属性：

承受的伤害总降 30%。
在受到敌人击中伤害的 4 秒后，承受相当于该击中伤害 30% 的伤害。

en:
The number of Kalguuran Support Gems you can use is limited by your character level:
Level 1+: 1
Level 17+: 2
Level 33+: 3
Level 45+: 4
Level 65+: 5
Level 80+: 6
zh:
你可使用的卡古兰辅助宝石数量受角色等级限制：
等级 1+：1 个
等级 17+：2 个
等级 33+：3 个
等级 45+：4 个
等级 65+：5 个
等级 80+：6 个

en:
Activating a Precursor Terraformer will change a group of nearby [BasicMap|Basic Maps] to the shown Biome.

The Terraformer shows which biome it will change maps to. All maps in the Terraformed area will be replaced with maps that can appear in the shown biome.
zh:
激活先驱地形改造器会将一组相邻的[BasicMap|基础地图]转变为所显示的地貌。

地形改造器会显示其将地图转变为哪种地貌。被改造区域内的所有地图都将替换为该地貌类型中可能出现的地图。

en: Ancient Modifiers are fragments of Precursor power, adding many varied bonus effects to areas throughout the Precursor Fortress and beyond.
zh: 远古词缀是先驱者力量的碎片，能为先驱者要塞内外的区域添加多种多样的增益效果。

en: A mysterious [Augment] that shifts and shimmers. Is that whispering you hear?
zh: 一个神秘而闪烁的[Augment|增幅器]。你是否听到了低语？

en:
Sealed Skills are skills which gain Seals. Only skills you use yourself can be Sealed.

When you use a Sealed Skill, its Seals are broken, and that use of the skill will gain some benefit based on how many Seals it had.
zh:
“封印技能”是指能够获得封印的技能。只有你自身使用的技能才能被获得封印。

当你使用封印技能时，其封印会被打破，此次技能使用将根据其拥有的封印数量获得相应的增益。

en:
Raven-Touched items have been warped by the Raven Trickster, Tangmazu.

The influence of the mist allows you to instil the item with a Notable Passive Skill at the Withered Willow.

Items that are already instillable will not be able to gain an additional instillment if they become Raven-Touched.
zh:
沾染“渡鸦之触”的物品已被黑鸦欺诈者唐玛祖扭曲。

迷雾的影响允许你在萎败细柳处为该物品灌注 1 个核心天赋。

可灌注的物品如果沾染了“渡鸦之触”，将无法再获得额外灌注。

en: Great Beasts are [MapBoss|Map Bosses] marked by Hilda as worthy targets to defeat. Defeating a Great Beast will earn you [HildasFavour| Hilda's Favour].
zh: 巨兽是希尔达标记为值得击败的[MapBoss|地图首领]。击败巨兽将为你赢得[HildasFavour|希尔达的青睐]。

en: Hilda will reward you with an Atlas Master point to spend on Atlas Keystones.
zh: 希尔达会奖励你 1 点异界大师点数，用于分配异界核心天赋。

en:
Temple Currency are currency items found primarily throughout the Temple.

These currency items typically interact with [Corrupted|Corrupted Items] in a variety of ways.
zh:
神庙通货主要是在神庙各处找到的通货物品。

这些通货物品通常会以各种方式与[Corrupted|腐化物品]互动。

en:
Anomaly Maps have added requirements to access on the World Map. 

Bosses of these maps are [DeadlyMapBoss|Deadly] and may drop an additional lineage support.
zh:
异常地图在世界地图上具有额外的进入要求。

这些地图中的首领是[DeadlyMapBoss|危险的]地图首领，并可能掉落 1 个额外血脉辅助宝石。

en: Landmark Areas in the Atlas may be accessed multiple times and do not require a [Waystone] to access.
zh: 异界图鉴中的地标区域可以多次进入，且无需[Waystone|引路石]即可进入。

en:
Hiveblood is used to birth Wombgifts from The Genesis Tree in Monastery of the Keepers.

The maximum amount of Hiveblood you can have is 100,000.
zh:
虫巢之血可用于在守护者修道院的起源之树上孕育孕育赠礼。

你最多可拥有 100,000 点虫巢之血。

en:
Vivid Spirits are a type of [AzmeriSpirit|Azmeri Spirit].

Monsters [SpiritTouched|Influenced] or [SpiritPossessed|Possessed] by Vivid Spirits gain increased Skill Speed, in addition to any bonuses from the specific spirit type.

Monsters [SpiritPossessed|Possessed] by Vivid Spirits drop [Dexterity] items.
zh:
活性鬼灵是[AzmeriSpirit|阿兹莫里之灵]的一种。

受活性鬼灵[SpiritTouched|影响]或[SpiritPossessed|附身]的怪物，除了获得该鬼灵类型带来的加成外，还会获得技能速度提高。

被活性鬼灵[SpiritPossessed|附身]的怪物会掉落[Dexterity|敏捷]物品。

en:
Wild Spirits are a type of [AzmeriSpirit|Azmeri Spirit].

Monsters [SpiritTouched|Influenced] or [SpiritPossessed|Possessed] by Wild Spirits gain increased [Toughness], in addition to any bonuses from the specific spirit type.

Monsters [SpiritPossessed|Possessed] by Wild Spirits drop [Strength] items.
zh:
狂野鬼灵是[AzmeriSpirit|阿兹莫里之灵]的一种。

受狂野鬼灵[SpiritTouched|影响]或[SpiritPossessed|附身]的怪物，除了获得该鬼灵类型带来的加成外，还会获得[Toughness|韧性]提高。

被狂野鬼灵[SpiritPossessed|附身]的怪物会掉落[Strength|力量]物品。

en:
Primal Spirits are a type of [AzmeriSpirit|Azmeri Spirit].

Monsters [SpiritTouched|Influenced] or [SpiritPossessed|Possessed] by Primal Spirits deal increased damage, in addition to any bonuses from the specific spirit type.

Monsters [SpiritPossessed|Possessed] by Primal Spirits drop [Intelligence] items.
zh:
原始鬼灵是[AzmeriSpirit|阿兹莫里之灵]的一种。

受原始鬼灵[SpiritTouched|影响]或[SpiritPossessed|附身]的怪物，除了获得该鬼灵类型带来的加成外，还会获得造成的伤害提高。

被原始鬼灵[SpiritPossessed|附身]的怪物会掉落[Intelligence|智慧]物品。

en:
Puppet Master is a stacking [Buff] which grants: 
10% increased Skill Speed with Command Skills
10% reduced Movement Speed Penalty with Command Skills
Minions deal 10% increased damage with Command Skills
Minions have 2% increased Movement Speed
Minions have 3% increased Skill Speed

Each stack has an independent duration of 8 seconds. Maximum 5 stacks.
zh:
傀儡大师是一种可叠加的[Buff|增益]状态，每层提供：
命令技能的技能速度提高 10%
命令技能的移动速度惩罚降低 10%
使用命令技能指挥召唤生物造成的伤害提高 10%
召唤生物移动速度提高 2%
召唤生物技能速度提高 3%

每层增益有独立的持续时间。最多 5 层。

en: Aldur's Legacies are [Augment|Augments] which have taken the power of a Unique Ezomyte or Kalguuran Unique. You may not have more than one [Augment] of this type socketed at a time.
zh: 奥杜尔的遗产是一种[Augment|增幅器]，汲取了艾兹麦或卡古兰传奇物品的力量。你无法同时镶嵌超过 1 个此类[Augment|增幅器]物品。

en:
Corrupted Monsters have an additional Corrupted [MonsterModifiers|Modifier].

These modifiers may increase the difficulty and reward of the Monster, or may make it easier to defeat.
zh:
腐化怪物拥有额外已腐化的[MonsterModifiers|词缀]。 

这些词缀可能增加怪物的难度和奖励，也可能使其更容易被击败。

en: A skill created by Ailith that increases the [MonsterEffectiveness|Effectiveness] of Monsters in [Breach] Hive encounters.
zh: 艾利丝创造的技能，可提高[Breach|裂隙]遭遇战中的怪物[MonsterEffectiveness|效能]。

en:
A skill created by Ailith that creates a zone which upgrades the [MonsterRarity|Rarity] of Breach Monsters which enter it.

Monsters can only have their [MonsterRarity|Rarity] upgraded once, and can not be upgraded beyond Rare.
zh:
艾利丝创造的技能，可创造一个区域，提升进入其中的裂隙怪物的[MonsterRarity|稀有度]。

怪物的[MonsterRarity|稀有度]只能被提升一次，且无法被提升至稀有以上。

en:
Adds an additional Modifier to the area. These modifiers generally add danger and reward.

These modifiers will apply for all remaining waves in the Simulacrum.
zh:
为区域添加一条额外词缀。这些词缀通常会增加危险性和奖励。

这些词缀将应用于梦魇拟像中剩余的所有波次。

en:
Adds an additional Boss to the encounter. 

Additional bosses will be summoned into all remaining waves in the Simulacrum.
zh:
为遭遇添加一个额外首领。

额外首领将在梦魇拟像中剩余的所有波次中被召唤。

en:
Adds additional monster packs to the encounter. 

Additional monster packs will be added to all remaining waves in the Simulacrum.
zh:
为遭遇添加额外的怪物群。

额外的怪物群将被添加到梦魇拟像中剩余的所有波次中。

en: A skill created by Ailith that adds an additional Pack with a Rare Monster to each wave.
zh: 艾利丝创造的技能，每波额外增加一群包含稀有怪物的群怪。

en:
A skill created by Ailith that creates a zone which adds a [MonsterModifiers|Modifier] to Rare Breach Monsters which enter it.

A Rare Monster can only have one Modifier added.
zh:
艾利丝创造的技能，创造一个区域，为进入其中的稀有裂隙怪物添加一条[MonsterModifiers|词缀]。

稀有怪物只能被添加一条词缀。

en: A skill created by Ailith that sacrifices half her life to grant players 100% increased [ItemRarity|Item Rarity] in Breach Hives.
zh: 艾利丝创造的技能，牺牲她一半的生命，使玩家在裂隙虫巢中的物品稀有度提高 100%。

en: A skill created by Ailith that sacrifices half her life to grant players 1000% more Damage and immunity to Damage for 10 seconds.
zh: 艾利丝创造的技能，牺牲她一半的生命，使玩家在 10 秒内造成 1000% 更多伤害，并免疫伤害。

en:
Verisium Sentries are ancient remnants of Kalguuran technology found within [ContainsExpedition|Expeditions].

When unearthed they follow the player, adding Runic [MonsterModifiers|Modifiers] to Monsters throughout the area.
zh:
维金哨卫是在[ContainsExpedition|先祖秘藏]中发现的远古卡古兰科技的遗物。

挖掘出来后，它们会跟随玩家，为整个区域的怪物添加符文[MonsterModifiers|词缀]。

zh: 力量符文会将该[ContainsExpedition2|残片]上所有其他符文[MonsterModifiers|词缀]升级为更强大、奖励更丰厚的变体。

en: Added Effects that apply to your weapon, such as Finishers. Finishers add effects when you kill a Monster of a specific Rarity. You can only have 1 Finisher per Rarity type equipped at a time.
zh: 适用于武器的附加效果，例如终结特效。终结特效会在你击杀特定稀有度的怪物时触发效果。每种稀有度等级你只能同时装备一种击败特效。

en: Adds a Frame to your character portrait. This can be seen in the Social Panel, Party UI, and on the character select menu.
zh: 为你的角色头像添加边框。该边框可在社交面板、队伍界面以及角色选择菜单中看到。

en: Changes the appearance of your Endurance, Frenzy and Power Charges.
zh: 改变你的耐力球、狂怒球和暴击球的外观。

en: Extra Effects are special effects that do not apply to specific mtx slot and are triggered on certain conditions, such as opening a chest.
zh: 额外特效是指不应用于特定外观槽位、而是在特定条件下（例如开启宝箱时）触发的特殊效果。

en: Effects that add tattoos or scars to your characters skin, or replace their skin entirely.
zh: 为角色添加纹身或伤疤，或完全替换角色外观。

en: Tracking Scrolls keep record of specific statistics such as monster kills or number of items picked up. You can pin a specific scroll to your profile to display to your friends, party or guild members, and can also be linked in chat.
zh: 追踪卷轴用于记录特定统计数据，例如击杀怪物数量或拾取物品数量。你可以将某个卷轴固定在个人资料上，向好友、队伍或公会成员展示，也可以在聊天中发送链接。

en: Effects that play when your character levels up. You can only have 1 Level Up Effect equipped at a time.
zh: 在你的角色升级时播放的特效。你每次只能装备一个升级特效。

en: Adds an effect when your dodge roll and sprint.
zh: 闪避翻滚和奔跑时添加特效。

en: Changes the appearance of your character when shapeshifted into a Bear.
zh: 变形为巨熊时，改变你的角色外观。

en: Great tacticians learn that consistency often trumps potential.
zh: 稳定的发挥比潜力更加重要。

en: The Titans did not vanish from this world. Their might lives on - in you.
zh: 巨人之力并未烟消云散，它们存续至今——由你传承。

en:
Stand your ground, child, keep your senses.
The pain is fleeting, but victory is forever.
zh:
坚定你的立场，孩子，信任你的直觉。
疼痛是短暂的，胜利是永恒的。

en: "In my dreams I see a great warrior, his skin scorched black, his fists aflame."
zh: “我在梦境之中看到了一位伟大的战士……皮肤被烧成焦黑，拳头缠绕着火焰。”

en: Lay open your veins, and draw power from your own spilled life.
zh: 献上你的命脉之源，并享受充能的狂喜。

en: Tear my flesh and splinter my bones. You will never break my spirit.
zh: 纵使身躯消亡，精神依然永存不灭。

en:
A wooden construct, mute and blind.
But fear the wrath of shackled mind.
zh:
一个木制雕塑，既安静又盲目；
即使看来无害，可别小看了它。

en:
Embrace the pain, drink it in.
Your enemies will know your agony tenfold.
zh:
拥抱痛苦并将其喝下。
你的敌人将会受到十倍的奉还。

en: Give up everything in pursuit of greatness - even life itself.
zh: 舍弃一切来追求更伟大的东西——甚至是生命。

en:
What need have I for defence when my enemies
are reduced to ash and splinters?
zh:
当我的敌人都已化为灰烬
还有什么好防守的？

en: While the mind endures, so too will the body.
zh: 当心灵升华至永久不灭时，肉体也将随之永存。

en: Your grandchildren will awaken screaming in memory of what I utter today.
zh: 我今日传述的话语，将令你的子孙在睡梦中惊醒。

en: I give you everything, my pets. Do not disappoint me.
zh: 我的玩物，我已赐予了你一切，不得令我失望。

en: To me, brave companions! Feel my radiance flow through you!
zh: 靠近我，勇者们！感受我充盈的能量流过你们体内吧！

en: I will wear your ghost, and you will die twice: against me, and for me.
zh: 你将为我所用，陨落二度……为对抗我，以及为我。

en: The notes may change, but the song remains the same.
zh: 音符已变，但歌曲始终如一。

en: Burn the spirit to vitalise the flesh.
The irrepressible spirit of the wilds burns within you, roaring to be let loose.
zh: 狂野之魂在你体内不羁燃烧，时刻咆哮着要奔涌而出。

en: You circle the black scorpion with enmity, daring it time and again.
zh: 你带着敌意环绕黑蝎，屡败屡战。

en: Skip a beat, hold your breath. Too slow a poison, only death.
zh: 凝心止息片刻短，毒流血脉嫌命长。

en: The fewer there are, the less you have to share.
zh: 数量越少，你分出去的就更少。

en:
My ancestral pact was sealed. Forevermore, I would gain sustenance
only from the ravaged flesh of my enemies.
zh:
我与先祖已然缔结契约。从今往后，我将只能蹂躏敌人的肉体，
 以此得到心灵的寄托，直到永远。

en: Why should I dodge blows that I do not fear?
zh: 没啥好怕的东西干嘛要去闪？

en: Utter trust in your defence unleashes ultimate potential.
zh: 相信防御，你将有无限潜力。

en: Balance is good in all things, but especially in the realm of magic.
zh: 平衡是件很重要的事——特别是对充满威力的魔法来说。

en: In battle, certainty is worth a little pain.
zh: 激战之时，熬过些许苦难，方可胜券在握。

en: Each nick and cut brings death one step closer.
zh: 每一道刻痕都让死神更近一步。

en: Bonds forged in battle surpass ties of blood.
The body is a weapon waiting to be mastered.
zh: 身体是亟待掌握的武器。

en:
Let the Darkness consume you.
Beyond the veil of death,
there burns a black fire.
zh:
让黑暗吞噬你。
远在死亡的面纱之外，
燃烧着黑色的火焰。

en: A properly disciplined mind gives rise to structured thought.
zh: 训练有素的心灵产生结构化的思想。

en: All animals share common ancestors. You carry them within you still.
zh: 所有生灵都拥有共同的祖先。这份古老的血脉，至今仍潜藏于你的体内。

en: Hope is a mistake. Pain is the only truth.
zh: 希望不过是谬误，苦痛才是唯一真理。

en: Strength begets respect. There is no simpler law.
zh: 力量才能带来尊重。这是最简单的道理。

en:
The world is a pattern, moving in natural waves.
With enough force, those waves can be made to converge...
zh:
世间万象皆为图景，循着自然的潮汐流转。
只需施加足够的力量，便能使诸般浪潮交汇合一……

"You knew the twisted plan these fools devised. As Tale-woman, you are their compass in the sandstorm. Yet... you did not act. And now we mourn these honoured dead. You must pay."
 
Varashta condemned Navira to the ritual of the <i>{barya}, sentenced to serve as a Djinn.
zh:
“你早知这些愚者扭曲的计划。身为说书女，你是沙暴中的罗盘。然而……你未曾行动。如今我们哀悼这些光荣的死者。你必须付出代价。”

瓦拉煞判处纳薇拉接受<i>{硬币}仪式，罚其作为巨灵侍奉。

en:
"And you... there was no excuse for your actions. You defiled them! You have tainted the very sands with the blood of your own! Yet the war rages on. You have achieved nothing. You must pay." 

Varashta condemned Kelari to the ritual of the <i>{barya}, sentenced to serve as a Djinn.
zh:
“而你……你的行为无可辩驳。你亵渎了他们！你让同胞之血玷污了沙原！可战争仍在肆虐。你一无所成。你必须付出代价。”

瓦拉煞判处凯拉里接受<i>{硬币}仪式，罚其作为巨灵侍奉。

en:
"You have forsaken your duty to my <i>{akhara}. Yes... we do not abide weakness. But we also do not abide madness in the fervour of battle! Your slain <i>{dekhara} will have their justice. You must pay." 

Varashta condemned Ruzhan to the ritual of the <i>{barya}, sentenced to serve as a Djinn.
zh:
“你背弃了对我的<i>{阿卡拉}的职责。诚然……我们不容软弱。但我们亦不容战斗狂热的疯癫！你剑下亡故的<i>{德卡拉}必将得到公正。你必须付出代价。”

瓦拉煞判处鲁詹接受<i>{硬币}仪式，罚其作为巨灵侍奉。

en:
"My heart was fractured. I believed Kelari's words. I knew not his true nature... his ambition. I convinced Ruzhan there were cowards among his ranks. I failed you. And I accept my fate." 

Navira confessed her failure to Varashta.
zh:
“我的心曾破碎。我相信了凯拉里的话语。我不知他的本性……他的野心。我说服鲁詹，称其麾下有懦夫。我辜负了你。我接受我的命运。”

纳薇拉向瓦拉煞忏悔。

en:
"Wipe the tears from your face, dear Navira. I did not deceive you. I meant every word. I will forever cherish you, my beloved. Know that I did it all for you... for our future!" 

Kelari pleaded with the Tale-woman.
zh:
“拭去你脸上的泪水吧，亲爱的纳薇拉。我未曾欺骗你。字字皆出真心。我将永远珍惜你，我的挚爱。要知道，我做这一切都是为了你……为了我们的未来！”

凯拉里向说书女恳求。

en:
"Kelari, you deceiver! I fell for your words, but no longer. Your sentence is a fate too good for you! I would give anything to bring back those who fell to your lies. Instead... I mourn my choices." 

Navira lambasted Kelari a final time.
zh:
“凯拉里，你这骗子！我曾为你言语所惑，但今已不再。判你此刑已是过于宽待！我愿付出一切换回那些葬送于你谎言之人。而今……我只能为我的选择哀悼。”

纳薇拉最后痛斥凯拉里。

en:
"Listen not to his simpering words. He means to languish before you to weaken your resolve! He is duplicitous. An assassin, thriving on deception and lies. His lust for power is what drove his choice!" 

Outrage trembled in Ruzhan's voice at the sentencing.
zh:
“不要听他的啜泣之言，他意图在你面前示弱以动摇你的决心！他口是心非。一个刺客，靠欺骗与谎言苟活。对权力的贪欲才是他行事的根源！”

宣判时，鲁詹的声音因愤慨而颤抖。

en:
"Knowing where and when to plunge your knife is more important than the sharpness of your blade. I will not forget my error... and I will be a living example of your wisdom, dear <i>{Sekhema}." 

Kelari accepted Varashta's sentence and committed himself to her.
zh:
“知晓何时何处落下匕首，比匕首是否锋利更为重要。我不会忘记我的过错……而我将成为您智慧的生证，亲爱的<i>{丝克玛}。”

凯拉里接受瓦拉煞的判决并宣誓效忠。

en:
"The snare was set on our fallen. Beetles burst from their flesh, flooding the sands. Their exploding carapaces halted the advancing enemy... but it was not enough. And for that... I grieve." 

Kelari admitted his wrongdoing to Varashta.
zh:
“陷阱设于我方阵亡者的身上。甲虫破体而出，淹没了沙地。它们爆裂的甲壳阻遏了推进的敌军……但这还不够。为此……我深感悲痛。”

凯拉里向瓦拉煞承认过错。

en:
"I have seen countless battles. I know war! The taste of defeat... The taste of victory! But in this war... everything is at stake. So yes, those you speak of will know my blade. I will do whatever I must!" 

Ruzhan confided in his Tale-woman, Navira.
zh:
“我历经无数战役。我懂战争！挫败的滋味……胜利的滋味！但在这场战争中……一切皆悬于一线。所以，是的，你提及的那些人将见识我的刀锋。我将不惜一切！”

鲁詹向他的说书女纳薇拉倾诉。

en:
"I stand before you, as your humble servant. Though I was betrayed, I would do it all again, if it would have saved us. But I accept your sentence. I will atone. I pledge myself to you... forevermore." 

Ruzhan accepted his fate at the <i>{barya} ritual site.
zh:
“我立于您面前，作为您卑微的仆从。纵遭背叛，若能挽救我们，我亦会重蹈覆辙。但我接受您的判决。我将赎罪。我向您宣誓效忠……至死不渝。”

鲁詹在<i>{硬币}仪式地点接受命运。

en:
"Yes... they fell by my blade and fire lashed them for their betrayal! No <i>{dekhara} is exempt from fighting back the Winter before us, lest they too know the Doom of the Desert!" 

Ruzhan fumed at Varashta, in pure defiance.
zh:
“是的……他们倒于我的刀下，烈火因其背叛而鞭笞其躯！凡我<i>{德卡拉}，无人可免于抗击眼前的凛冬。否则，他们亦将知晓沙漠的终焉！”

鲁詹怒火沸腾，全然违逆地对瓦拉煞说。
