en: Grants a temporary buff after spending enough mana with Blight. The buff grants Blight more spell damage, and mana regeneration for sustaining casting.
zh: 施放枯萎消耗一定魔力后提供一个临时增益效果，总增枯萎的法术伤害，并持续未施法提供魔力再生效果。

en: Grants more spell damage but reduces critical strike chance. However, Blight cannot critically hit meaning Controlled Destruction gives more spell damage with no drawbacks.
zh: 提高法术伤害，但会降低暴击率。然而枯萎无法暴击，这就意味着精准破坏会无偿提供更多法术伤害。

en: Increases the damage over time and spell damage of Blight. The increased skill effect duration also increases the duration of Blight's debuff on enemies.
zh: 增加枯萎的持续伤害和法术伤害。提升技能效果持续时间也可以提高枯萎减益效果对敌人的持续时间。

en: Decreases the total duration of Blight's debuff effect but compensates for this by increasing damage over time dealt by Blight.
zh: 降低枯萎减益效果的总持续时间，但会增加枯萎的持续伤害。

en: Increases the area of effect of Blight allowing it to affect a greater number of targets at once.
zh: 增加枯萎的作用范围，使其能够一次性影响更多目标。

en:
Increases the amount of projectiles Freezing Pulse casts, allowing it to hit more targets at once.

At later levels, obtain the Greater Multiple Projectiles Support gem to hit enemies in a larger area.
zh:
通过增加投射物数量，冰霜脉冲现在可同时命中的目标更多了。

达到更高级别后，利用高阶多重投射宝石还可打击更大范围内的敌人。

en: Reduces enemy resistance to cold damage, making them take more cold damage from Freezing Pulse.
zh: 降低敌人对冰霜伤害的抗性，提高敌人被冰霜脉冲击中的伤害。

en: Grants more spell damage to Freezing Pulse but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage not contingent on critical strikes.
zh: 提升冰霜脉冲的法术伤害，但是会降低暴击率。提供更多法术伤害，更直接更稳定，而非像暴击一样有不确定性。

en: Increases Freezing Pulse's projectile speed, increasing the maximum distance that the projectiles travel. This allows Freezing Pulse to hit targets further away.
zh: 提高投射物速度可以提高冰霜脉冲投射物的最大飞行距离。这让冰霜脉冲可以击中更远的目标。

en: Repeats Freezing Pulse an additional time while also greatly increasing the cast speed.
zh: 重复施放冰霜脉冲，同时大幅提升施法速度。

en: Increases the number of projectiles Freezing Pulse casts. Projectiles are in parallel to each other allowing a greater number of targets to be hit at once.
zh: 增加冰霜脉冲发射的投射物。投射物彼此平行，可以同时击中更多目标。

en: Increases the amount of flat lightning damage your Lightning Tendrils does.
zh: 增加电能释放造成的闪电伤害。

en: Grants more spell damage to Lightning Tendrils but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage, not contingent on critical strikes.
zh: 提升电能释放的法术伤害，但是会降低暴击率。提供更多法术伤害，更直接更稳定，而非像暴击一样有不确定性。

en: Removes the ability for Lightning Tendrils to inflict elemental ailments, such as shock, on enemies. However, it significantly boosts Lightning Tendril's elemental damage.
zh: 移除电能释放对敌人的感电等元素减益效果，但能够大幅提升电能释放的元素伤害。

en: Reduces enemy resistance to lightning damage, making them take more lightning damage from Lightning Tendrils.
zh: 降低敌人对闪电伤害的抗性，提高敌人被电能释放击中的伤害。

en: Gives Rolling Magma more fire damage, additional chance to ignite enemies and reduces the fire resistance of ignited enemies. This makes it a great all-round support for any fire based skill.
zh: 使熔岩奔涌伤害更高，有额外几率点燃敌人，并降低它们的火焰抗性，为所有火系技能提供全面支援。

en:
Increases the amount of projectiles Rolling Magma casts, allowing it to hit more targets at once.

At later levels, obtain the Greater Multiple Projectiles Support gem to hit enemies in a larger area.
zh:
增加施放熔岩奔涌的投射物数量，让它一次性击中更多敌人。

高等级的熔岩奔涌在高阶多重投射辅助下可以攻击一大片地区的敌人。

en: Reduces enemy resistance to fire damage, making them take more fire damage from Rolling Magma.
zh: 熔岩奔涌会降低敌人的火焰抗性，从而使它们受到更多伤害。

en: Repeats Rolling Magma an additional time while also greatly increasing the cast speed.
zh: 重复施放熔岩奔涌还可以极大加快其施法速度。

en: Increases Rolling Magma's damage and decreases the distance between each chain, allowing one orb to impact on a pack of monsters multiple times.
zh: 提高熔岩奔涌的伤害，缩减其每次连锁之间的距离，使每个火球可以反复击中同一群怪物。

en: Raises the gem level of Rolling Magma granting additional base fire damage and potentially allowing it to chain additional times. This is a drop-only gem that is very rare. Levelling this support gem takes a long time making it not very useful early on.
zh: 提升熔岩奔涌的技能石等级，提供额外基础火焰伤害，并有可能产生额外连锁。该辅助宝石为掉落限定，非常稀有。提升它的等级非常漫长，因此在前期难以发挥功效。

en: Greatly increases the damage over time dealt by ignites inflicted from Fireball.
zh: 大幅提升火球的点燃效果带来的火焰伤害。

en: Gives Fireball more fire damage, additional chance to ignite enemies and reduces the fire resistance of ignited enemies. This makes it a great all-round support for any fire based skill.
zh: 提高火球的火焰伤害和点燃敌人的几率，并降低被点燃敌人的火焰抗性，是理想的火系法术全能辅助。

en: Grants more spell damage to Fireball but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage not contingent on critical strikes.
zh: 提升火球的法术伤害，但是会降低暴击率。提供更多法术伤害，更直接更稳定，而非像暴击一样有不确定性。

en: Reduces the hit damage of Fireball in exchange for more ailment damage. This makes it particularly strong for Fireball characters that want to focus on scaling the damage over time of ignites.
zh: 降低火球的命中伤害，换取更多异常状态伤害。因此配合注重提升点燃持续伤害的火球辅助效果尤其强大。

en: Reduces enemy resistance to fire damage, making them take more fire damage from Fireball.
zh: 降低敌人对火焰伤害的抗性，提高敌人被火球击中的伤害。

en: Increases the chance to inflict ignites on enemies with Fireball, whilst also enabling ignites to spread to nearby enemies.
zh: 增加火球点燃敌人的几率，同时允许点燃效果在敌人之中扩散。

en:
Increases the amount of projectiles Fireball casts, allowing it to hit more targets at once.

At later levels, obtain the Greater Multiple Projectiles Support gem to hit enemies in a larger area.
zh:
通过增加投射物数量，火球现在可同时命中的目标更多了。

达到更高级别后，利用高阶多重投射宝石还可打击更大范围内的敌人。

en: Repeats Fireball an additional time while also greatly increasing the cast speed.
zh: 重复施放火球，同时大幅提升施法速度。

en: Decreases the total duration of ignites on enemies but increases the damage that ignites deal, allowing your ignites to burn faster and stronger.
zh: 降低点燃的持续时间，但提高点燃造成的伤害，让点燃效果在更短时间内发挥更大威力。

en: Increases the attack speed of your zombie minions.
zh: 提高你的魔卫仆从的攻击速度。

en: Turns the basic attack of your zombie minions into an area of effect attack. This means that multiple enemies can be hit simultaneously by their basic attack.
zh: 将魔卫的基础攻击变为区域攻击。这使它们的基础攻击能同时攻击多个敌人。

en: Provides more damage to your zombie minions.
zh: 为你的魔卫仆从提供更多伤害。

en: Increases the maximum life of your zombie minions, allowing them to survive longer against hard hitting enemies.
zh: 提高你的魔卫仆从的生命上限值，延长在面对困难的敌人时的存活时间。

en: Causes your zombie minion's powerful ground slam area of effect skill to repeat an additional two times.
zh: 让魔卫的范围重击技能额外重复两次。

en: Reduces the elemental damage that your zombies take, allowing them to survive longer against elemental, damage-dealing enemies.
zh: 降低魔卫受到的元素伤害，延长在面对元素系伤害输出敌人时的存活时间。

en: Allows Glacial Hammer to target two additional nearby enemies. Pairing this support with the Melee Splash support will result in large areas of overlapping damage.
zh: 让冰霜之锤额外击中两个邻近的敌人，它跟近战伤害扩散组合能使区域效果的伤害叠加。

en: Adds flat cold damage to Glacial Hammer, an increased chance to freeze, chance to generate frenzy charges on killing frozen enemies and adds cold damage per frenzy charge on you. This synergises well with Glacial Hammer's built in shatter against frozen enemies on low life.
zh: 增加冰霜之锤的冰霜伤害，并提高冻结几率，同时在击杀冻结敌人时有几率获得狂怒球，每个狂怒球都能为你增加冰霜伤害。配合冰霜之锤自带的粉碎低生命值冻结敌人特性，效果奇佳。

en: Grants more melee physical damage for Glacial Hammer. Because 50% of physical damage is converted to cold damage, this support will also increase the cold damage done by Glacial Hammer.
zh: 提高冰霜之锤的近战物理伤害。因为将50% 物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害，这也使得冰霜之锤获得了更多的冰霜伤害。

en: Allows your Glacial Hammer hits to deal splash damage to nearby targets. Pairing this support with the Ancestral Call support will result in large areas of overlapping damage.
zh: 使冰霜之锤对附近目标造成溅射伤害。同先祖召唤组合，能造成大范围叠加伤害。

en: Causes Glacial Hammer to repeat an additional two times, as well as providing a large bonus to attack speed.
zh: 使冰霜之锤额外重复两次，同时大幅提升攻击速度。

en: Cold Penetration reduces enemy resistance to cold damage, making them take more cold damage from Glacial Hammer.
zh: 降低敌人的冰霜抗性，提高敌人被冰霜之锤击中的伤害。

en: Grants more spell damage to Ethereal Knives but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage not contingent on critical strikes.
zh: 提升虚空匕首的法术伤害，但是会降低暴击率。提供更多法术伤害，更直接更稳定，而非像暴击一样有不确定性。

en: Increases the cast speed of Ethereal Knives, allowing it to be used more frequently.
zh: 提高虚空匕首的施法速度，使技能更频繁地使用。

en: Increasing the projectile speed of Ethereal Knives increases how far the projectiles can travel. When paired with the Pierce support, Faster Projectiles will allow your projectiles to travel deeply through packs of mobs.
zh: 提高虚空匕首的飞行速度能增加它的飞行距离。和穿透组合的快速投射能让你的技能穿透更深的怪物群落。

en: Converts 50% of Ethereal Knives' physical damage to lightning damage, as well as providing extra lightning damage based on your physical damage.
zh: 将虚空匕首50%的物理伤害转化为闪电伤害，同时根据你的物理伤害提供额外的闪电伤害。

en: Allows projectiles from Ethereal Knives to travel through extra numbers of enemies, ensuring that more enemies in a pack will be hit by the projectiles.
zh: 让虚空匕首的投射物穿透更多敌人，使整群敌人都被技能击中。

en: Repeats Ethereal Knives an additional time while also greatly increasing the cast speed.
zh: 重复施放虚空匕首，同时大幅提升施法速度。

en: Grants more damage to your Explosive Trap. It also adds a small penalty to trap throwing speed.
zh: 增加爆炸陷阱的伤害，同时对陷阱设置速度有小幅减少。

en: Allows you to throw 2 additional Explosive Traps at once.
zh: 允许你同时多放置 2 个爆炸陷阱。

en: Grants a chance to gain frenzy and power charges when your Explosive Trap is triggered by enemies. It also grants increased trap throwing speed per frenzy charge and increased critical strike multiplier per power charge.
zh: 你的爆炸陷阱被敌人触发时，有一定获得狂怒球和暴击球。同时每个狂怒球都能增加陷阱设置速度，每个暴击球都能增加暴击倍数。

en: Grants more spell damage to Explosive Trap but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage not contingent on critical strikes.
zh: 提升爆炸陷阱的法术伤害，但是会降低暴击率。提供更多法术伤害，更直接更稳定，而非像暴击一样有不确定性。

en: Removes the ability for Explosive Trap to inflict elemental ailments, such as ignite, on enemies. However, it significantly increases the amount of elemental damage Explosive Trap does. Converting all physical damage from Explosive Trap to elemental damage maximizes the benefit this support provides.
zh: 移除爆炸陷阱对敌人的点燃等元素减益效果，但能够大幅提升爆炸陷阱的元素伤害。将爆炸陷阱的所有物理伤害转为元素伤害，使本辅助技能的加成效果最大化。

en: Converts 50% of Explosive Trap's physical damage to lightning damage, as well as providing extra lightning damage based on your physical damage.

zh: 将惩击50%的物理伤害转化为闪电伤害，同时根据你的物理伤害提供额外的闪电伤害。由于该技能已经有50%的物理伤害转化成了闪电伤害，因此本辅助技能将使惩击的所有物理伤害都变为闪电伤害。

en: Multiplies the elemental damage done by Smite. Converting all physical damage from Smite to elemental damage maximizes the benefit this support provides.
zh: 使惩击造成的元素伤害成倍增加。将惩击的所有物理伤害转化为元素伤害，最大发挥本辅助技能的效益。

en: Causes Smite to repeat an additional two times, as well as providing a large bonus to attack speed.
zh: 使惩击额外重复两次，同时大幅提升攻击速度。

en: Removes the ability for Smite to inflict elemental ailments, such as shock, on enemies. However, it significantly boosts the amount of elemental damage Smite does. Converting all physical damage from Smite to elemental damage maximizes the benefit this support provides.
zh: 移除惩击对敌人的感电等元素减益效果，但能够大幅提升惩击的元素伤害。将惩击的所有物理伤害转为元素伤害，使本辅助技能的加成效果最大化。

en: Increases the amount of flat cold damage your Frostbolt does.
zh: 提高你的寒冰弹造成的直接冰霜伤害。

en: Reduces enemy resistance to cold damage, making them take more cold damage from Frostbolt.
zh: 降低敌人的冰霜抗性，提高敌人被寒冰弹击中的伤害。

en: Provides an increase to chill and freeze chance with Frostbolt, as well as providing more damage against chilled enemies.
zh: 增加寒冰弹造成冰缓和冻结的几率，并对冰缓的敌人造成更多伤害。

en: Grants more spell damage to Frostbolt but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage not contingent on critical strikes.
zh: 提升寒冰弹的法术伤害，但是会降低暴击率。提供更多法术伤害，更直接更稳定，而非像暴击一样有不确定性。

en: Repeats Frostbolt an additional time while also greatly increasing the cast speed.
zh: 重复施放寒冰弹，同时大幅提升施法速度。

en: Allows you to summon a totem that uses Frostbolt, freeing up your character to perform other actions. Can become exceeding powerful once your character gains abilities to summon multiple totems.
zh: 允许你召唤一个使用寒冰弹的图腾，让你的角色可以去进行其他操作。你的角色获得召唤多个图腾的能力后，将变得格外强力。

en: Increases the duration of Blight's slow effect and chaos damage over time debuff on enemies.
zh: 延长枯萎减速效果和对敌人的持续混沌伤害效果的时长。

en: Decreases the duration of Caustic Arrow's ground effect, but compensates for this by increasing damage over time dealt.
zh: 减少腐蚀箭矢的地面效果持续时间，但会增加持续伤害作为补偿。

en: Grants more chaos damage but lowers the elemental damage of Caustic Arrow. The Caustic ground effect only deals chaos damage, so Void Manipulation gives more damage at no drawback.
zh: 提升腐蚀箭矢的混沌伤害，降低元素伤害。腐蚀地面效果仅造成混沌伤害，因此虚空操纵能造成更多伤害，没有扣减。

en: Increases the amount of flat cold damage your Freezing Pulse does.
zh: 增加冰霜脉冲造成的冰霜伤害。

en:
Adds additional cold damage to Frost Blades, increasing freeze chance, and granting a chance to gain a Frenzy Charge on killing a frozen enemy.

Frenzy Charges increase a player's attack speed, cast speed and damage.
zh:
增加冰霜之刃的冰霜伤害，增加急冻几率，而且在击杀被冻结的敌人后有一定机率获得狂怒球。

狂怒球可增加玩家的攻击速度、施法速度和伤害。

en: Increases the cast speed of Frost Bolt, allowing the projectiles to be cast more frequently.
zh: 提升寒冰弹的施法速度，允许以更高频率发射冰弹。

en: Increases Glacial Hammer's damage and freeze chance against enemies that are chilled. Also increases the slow effect of chills applied by your Glacial Hammer.
zh: 增加冰霜之锤对被冰缓敌人的伤害和急冻几率。同时提升你的冰霜之锤造成的冰缓减速效果。

en: Increases the cast speed of Rolling Magma, allowing the projectiles to be cast more frequently.
zh: 加快熔岩奔涌的施法速度，使它的投射物发射速度更加频繁。

en: Grants more melee physical damage for your Zombie minions attacks. This support also increases the amount of damage inflicted bleeds and poisons do.
zh: 你的魔卫仆从将获得更高近战物理伤害。该辅助技能还将增加流血和中毒效果的伤害量。

en: Grants extra fire damage to your Spectral Throws's hits based on the physical damage dealt.
zh: 根据你的灵体投掷造成的物理伤害，额外增加火焰伤害。

en: Increases the attack speed of Split Arrow, allowing players to fire arrows more frequently
zh: 提升分裂箭矢的攻击速度，允许以更高频率发射箭矢。

en: Increases the chance of inflicting the bleed ailment on enemies with Split Arrow. Bleeding deals physical damage over time, with more damage dealt to moving targets. This support also adds a small amount of flat physical damage to Split Arrow.
zh: 增加分裂箭矢对敌人造成流血效果的几率。流血将带来持续物理伤害，对移动目标的伤害增加效果更高。本辅助技能还会小幅增加分裂箭矢的基础物理伤害。

en: Grants additional fire damage based on your physical damage.
zh: 基于你的物理伤害，赋予额外火焰伤害。

en: Converts 50% of Purifying Flame's physical damage to lightning damage, as well as providing extra lightning damage based on your physical damage. Because 50% of physical damage is already converted to fire from the skill gem, this causes all physical damage with Purifying Flame to deal elemental damage.
zh: 将净化烈焰 50%的物理伤害转化为闪电伤害，同样还会根据你的物理伤害来提供额外的闪电伤害。因为 50%的物理伤害已经通过该技能宝石转化为了火焰伤害，这会让净化烈焰将所有物理伤害转化为元素伤害。

en:
Increases Purifying Flame's area of effect and grants Intensify stacks with each cast, reducing its area of effect and increasing its damage. This helps it damage tough enemies with repeated casts. 

When you move or teleport you gradually lose Intensity stacks.
zh:
提高【净化烈焰】的效果区域，并在每次施放时堆叠法术凝聚，降低该效果区域并提高伤害。通过重复施放可以重创强大的敌人。

当你移动或传送时，你会逐渐失去或彻底失去法术凝聚的层数。

en: Grants more spell damage to Purifying Flame but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage not contingent on critical strikes.
zh: 净化烈焰获得更多法术伤害，但降低暴击率。此方式提供的更多法术伤害会让伤害得以直接提升，但对暴击来说没有多少收益。

en: Slowly grants charges of Purifying Flame over time. These expend when cast to unleash repeat effects of the skill, rapidly damaging enemies multiple times. The damage of the unleashed casts are slightly reduced.
zh: 持续并缓慢地为净化烈焰提供蓄能。当施放后，蓄能会导致该技能的效果得以重复生效，迅速地对敌人造成多次伤害。多次施放的伤害会略微下降。

en: Removes the ability for Purifying Flame to inflict elemental ailments, such as ignite, on enemies. However, it significantly increases the amount of elemental damage Purifying Flame does. Converting all physical damage from Purifying Flame to elemental damage maximizes the benefit this support provides.
zh: 移除净化烈焰可以造成元素异常状态的能力，例如对敌人的点燃。但它会极大提高净化烈焰所造成的元素伤害。将净化烈焰的所有物理伤害转化为元素伤害就可以最大化这个效果。

en:
Adds flat lightning damage to Stormblast Mine's explosions.

Dealing more damage also increases the strength of Shock, causing more damage taken on Shocked enemies.
zh:
给雷暴地雷附加闪电伤害。

制造更多伤害同样可以提高感电强度，使感电敌人承受更多伤害。

en: While Swift Assembly supports Stormblast Mine, throwing a Mine grants a chance to throw additional mines. More mines means more Stormblast Explosions
zh: 【迅整】辅助雷暴地雷时，投掷地雷有几率投掷额外的地雷。更多地雷可以造成更多爆炸。

en:
Causes Stormblast mine explosions to deal more damage.

Dealing more damage also increases the strength of Shock, causing more damage taken on Shocked enemies.
zh:
使得雷暴地雷造成更多爆炸伤害。

制造更多伤害也能提高感电强度，使感电敌人承受更多伤害。

en:
Allows Stormblast mine's lightning damage to penetrate lightning resistance. This allows for more consistent damage against lightning-resistant enemies, such as Bosses, Rares, and Magic enemies.

Monsters show if they are resistant to damage in their mods. Hover over monsters to see their mods.
zh:
使雷暴地雷的闪电伤害穿透闪电抗性。这将使具有闪电抗性的敌人（如首领、稀有、魔法敌人）承受更多连续伤害。

可以在怪物的词缀中查看它们的抗性。悬停在怪物上查看它们的词缀。

en:
While Charged Mines is linked, damaging enemies with Stormblast explosions has a chance to grant you Frenzy and Power Charges.

Frenzy charges increase the speed that you move, attack and cast spells for each charge (up to a maximum of 3).

Power charges increases your chance to critically strike for high damage each charge (up to a maximum of 3).
zh:
连接【充能地雷】后，雷暴地雷爆炸对敌人造成伤害有一定几率给你狂怒球和暴击球。

每个狂怒球可以提高你的移动速度、攻击速度、施法速度（最多 3 个）。

每个暴击球可以提高你的暴击率（最多 3 个）。

en: Increased Area of Effect makes your Stormblast Mine explosions wider, so they can hit more enemies. It also means Stormblast Mine can cause more enemies to take increased damage before exploding.
zh: 使雷暴地雷的爆炸范围扩大，击中更多敌人。它同样可以使范围内的敌人在爆炸前承受更多伤害。

en:
Concentrated Effect makes your Stormblast explosions smaller, causing more damage in a tighter area.
This means they can hit less enemies but they deal more damage to the enemies they hit.
zh:
专注效果使雷暴地雷的爆炸范围缩小，但在更密集区域内造成更多伤害。
这会使击中的敌人变少，但造成的伤害却更高。

en:
Increase the number of Cobra Lash projectiles thrown, hitting multiple targets over a wider area. Each projectile will bounce between targets to hit large groups of enemies.

Obtain the Greater Multiple Projectiles Support gem at later levels to throw more projectiles and hit larger groups of enemies.
zh:
提高毒蛇鞭击的投射物数量，在更宽阔的范围内击中多个目标。每个投射物都会在大群敌人之间弹跳。

在高等级获得高阶多重投射辅助会投掷更多投射物，并击中更多敌人。

en: Increase Cobra Lash's chance to poison enemies and cause it to deal more poison damage. This is valuable for applying multiple deadly poisons on enemies.
zh: 提高毒蛇鞭击使敌人中毒的几率，并造成更多中毒伤害。对敌人反复施毒时非常有用。

en:
Cause Cobra Lash to deal a great amount more poison damage, at the cost of slightly reduced hit damage.
This is valuable for applying strong poisons on enemies.
zh:
大幅提高毒蛇鞭击造成的中毒伤害，略微降低击中伤害。
需要使敌人中毒时很有用。

en:
Add flat chaos damage to Cobra Lash, increasing the damage it deals when it hits enemies.

Increasing chaos damage of your hits also increases the damage of your poison, as strong hits with lots of chaos and physical damage also means stronger poisons.
zh:
给毒蛇鞭击附加混沌伤害，提高它击中敌人时造成的伤害。

提高击中混沌伤害同样会提高中毒伤害，因此击中时造成的高混沌伤害和高物理伤害同样造成高中毒伤害。

en: Vile Toxins increases the damage of Cobra Lash poison, and causes more damage when Cobra Lash hits poisoned enemies.This is valuable for stacking strong poisons and dealing more damage against powerful enemies, like bosses.
zh: 【猛毒】提高毒蛇鞭击的中毒伤害，同时毒蛇鞭击击中中毒的敌人会造成更多伤害。当你需要堆叠中毒伤害，或者对战强力敌人时候非常有用，例如首领战。

en: Unbound Ailments causes Cobra Lash poison to deal more damage and to last longer on enemies. This is valuable for stacking lots of poison on strong enemies, like bosses.
zh: 【异常爆发】使毒蛇鞭击对敌人造成更多伤害，并造成持续伤害。对强力敌人堆叠中毒伤害时很有用，例如首领战。

en: Support Perforate with this gem to Maim enemies, dealing more physical damage and slowing their movement. Use this to slow monsters and make them easier to avoid.
zh: 使凿击可以瘫痪敌人，对其造成更多物理伤害，并降低移动速度。你可以用它给敌人减速，使你更容易避开它们的攻击。

en: This gem causes Perforate to deal more damage. A simple but invaluable way to quickly kill enemies.
zh: 使凿击造成更多伤害。简单粗暴，助你快速击败敌人。

en:
Close Combat improves your damage against monsters close to you. As Perforate only hits nearby enemies (without Sand stance), this support is a valuable way to increase your damage.

Travel Skills are also quicker after you hit enemies with this gem. Travel skills move you quickly to avoid danger.
zh:
【近战】提高你对近身怪物造成的伤害。如非沙姿态下的凿击就只会击中周围的敌人。它可以行之有效地提高你的伤害。

该宝石也可以使旅行技能在击败敌人后移动得更快，让你更迅速地避开伤害。

en:
Deal more physical damage and Impale enemies with the Impale debuff.

Impaling enemies stores some of your damage on the enemy. For the next 5 hits on that enemy you deal extra stored damage. You can impale the same enemy more than once for extra damage from attacks.
zh:
造成更多物理伤害，并给敌人施加穿刺减益效果。

被穿刺的敌人会积蓄你的部分伤害。对该敌人接下来 5 次击中会使积蓄的伤害作为额外伤害。你可以为了获取额外伤害而反复穿刺同一个敌人。

en:
Cause Perforate to deal much more physical damage, but reduce any elemental damage it deals to zero.

Try not to get any modifiers that grant lightning, fire, cold or chaos damage with this support gem. Only physical damage will be increased by this gem.
zh:
大幅提高凿击造成的物理伤害，但将其造成的元素伤害降为 0。

使用该辅助宝石时，请不要附加任何元素伤害的词缀。该宝石仅提高物理伤害。

en:
Greatly increase Perforate's attacking speed by performing three attacks in quick succession, dealing more damage on the second and third attacks.

You cannot stop or move while multistriking. This gem greatly improves damage but be careful not to get stuck while monsters damage you.
zh:
极大提高凿击的攻击速度，使其可以迅速发动三重连击，第二击和第三击会造成更多伤害。

连击发动时无法移动，也无法停止。该宝石可以大幅提高伤害，但请勿在怪物攻击你时使用。

en: Increase the size of Frostblink's cold explosion and chilled ground. This is valuable for damaging multiple enemies and leaving them slowed, unable to pursue you.
zh: 扩大【冰霜闪现】的冰霜爆发和冰缓地面的范围。很适合用于伤害多个敌人，使它们减速，无法追上你。

en: Bonechill makes Frostblink's chill effect more potent, slowing enemies further to keep you safe. Enemies chilled by Frostblink also take more Cold Damage, making this valuable for your main skill if it deals cold damage.
zh: 【彻骨】可以强化【冰霜闪现】的冰缓效果，进一步使敌人减速来保护你的安全。被【冰霜闪现】冰缓的敌人同样会承受更多冰霜伤害，很适合配合冰霜伤害的主技能使用。

en: Allow Steelskin's bonus to last longer, to defend against more hits from enemies. A simple but valuable way to improve defense.
zh: 使【钢铁之肤】持续更长时间，承受更多击中。是一种简单有效提高防御力的办法。

en:
Automatically cast Steelskin after taking damage. This is valuable for defending against surprise attacks.

Steelskin can not be cast manually with this gem, and cannot be used to defend against a monster about to hit you. It's important to have another way to defend against monsters if you use this gem.
zh:
受到伤害自动施放【钢铁之肤】。对付突发攻击时很有用。

该宝石无法手动施放【钢铁之肤】，也无法在怪物即将攻击你时启动。要使用该宝石，请确保有其它抵御怪物的手段。

en:
This gem makes all of Galvanic Arrows physical damage turn to lightning damage. This causes Galvanic Arrow deal full lightning damage, instead of 50% lightning and 50% physical damage.

This gem makes it much easier to increase your damage. If you get any skills that increase your lighting or elemental damage, it will increase the full lightning damage dealt by Galvanic Arrow.
zh:
此宝石可以将电光箭的所有物理伤害转化为闪电伤害。这能让电光箭造成全额的闪电伤害，而并非50%闪电伤害和50%物理伤害。

此宝石可以轻易提高你的伤害。如果你有任何技能可以提高闪电或元素伤害，它就能将电光箭的闪电伤害全额化。

en:
Increase Galvanic Arrow's elemental damage, hitting enemies harder for more damage.
This gem will not increase the physical damage dealt by Galvanic Arrow, but it will increase the lightning damage it deals. 

This gem is very good when paired with the Physical to Lightning support gem, as it will increase the full lightning damage dealt by Galvanic Arrow.
zh:
提高电光箭的元素伤害，对敌人造成更多伤害。
该宝石将不会提高电光箭造成的物理伤害，但会提高其造成的闪电伤害。该宝石非常适合搭配物理转闪电辅助宝石，能最大化提高电光箭造成的闪电伤害。

en:
Allow Galvanic Arrow's lightning damage to penetrate lightning resistance on enemies. This allows for more consistent damage against lightning-resistant enemies, such as Bosses, Rares, and Magic enemies.

This will not allow Galvanic Arrow's physical damage to penetrate resistance, as physical damage is unaffected by lightning resistance.
Monsters show if they are resistant to damage in their mods. Hover over monsters to see their mods.
zh:
使电光箭的闪电伤害穿透敌人的闪电抗性。这将使具有闪电抗性的敌人（如首领、稀有、魔法敌人）承受更多连续伤害。

电光箭的物理伤害将无法穿透物理抗性，物理伤害也不会受闪电抗性影响。
可以在怪物的词缀中查看它们的抗性。悬停在怪物上查看它们的词缀。

en:
Summon a Mirage Archer above your head when Galvanic Arrow hits an enemy. This Mirage Archer will fire Galvanic Arrows at nearby enemies until it disappears.

This gem has many uses. Use it to attack enemies while you're moving, to attack enemies you're not facing, or to deal more damage.
zh:
在你使用电光箭击中一名敌人时，在你的头顶召唤一个幻影射手。他会在消失前对周围的敌人发射电光箭。

该宝石有许多用途。在移动时可以使用它攻击位于其他方位的敌人，或者只是单纯造成更多伤害。

en:
Let loose a flurry of arrows with the Barrage support gem. With each Galvanic Arrow fired, lightning will burst from your bow.This will stop your arrows from firing in a cone, and instead make them fire in sequence.

This gem is invaluable for unleashing a flurry of attacks on strong enemies, like bosses.
Be careful using it in dangerous dangerous situations. You cannot move while firing, so you cannot escape dangerous enemies.
zh:
用弹幕辅助类宝石来施放一簇箭矢。每发射一个电光箭，你的弓箭便会迸射闪电。这会让你的箭矢不再以锥形飞出，而变为连续发射。

这个宝石是无上之品，可以对强大的敌人，如首领发动连环攻击。
请不要危险之处使用它，因为你在发射时无法移动，那么危险的敌人可能随时对你造成威胁。

en: Increase the size of Galvanic Arrow's lightning burst, and the speed of its arrows before they dissipate. This gem is invaluable for making your lightning burst bigger and your arrows fire further, hitting more enemies with each shot.
zh: 提高【电光箭】闪电爆发的规模和箭矢消散前的速度。该宝石可以让闪电爆发范围更大，箭矢速度更快，每次射击击中更多敌人。

en:
Fire a flurry of Kinetic Bolts in quick succession, damaging enemies consistently over a wide area. 

You cannot stop or move while firing. This gem improves damage but be careful not to get stuck taking damage while monsters attack you.
zh:
急速射出一阵念动飞箭，对一大片区域里的敌人造成伤害。

发射时无法停止，也无法移动。该宝石能提高伤害，但不要在陷入敌人包围时使用。

en: Add lightning damage to Kinetic Bolt and its projectiles. A simple but valuable way to quickly kill enemies.
zh: 为念动飞箭和它的投射物增加闪电伤害。简单迅速击败敌人。

en: Add cold damage to Kinetic Bolt and its projectiles. A simple but valuable way to quickly kill enemies.
zh: 为念动飞箭和它的投射物增加冰霜伤害。简单迅速击败敌人。

en:
Increase the elemental damage dealt by Kinetic Bolt and its projectiles.

Kinetic Bolt doesn't inherently deal elemental damage. Added elemental damage can come from equipment (or from Added Lightning and Added Cold support gems). This gem can increase that damage to more quickly kill enemies.
zh:
提高念动飞箭和它投射物的元素伤害。

念动飞箭本身不造成元素伤害，它可以通过装备获得（或增加闪电伤害或冰霜伤害的辅助宝石。）该宝石能提高伤害，更快速击败敌人。

en:
Reduce the mana cost of using Kinetic Bolt. Also increase Kinetic Bolt's elemental damage and chance to critically strike with each attack.
Wands can have powerful critical strikes. Critical strikes can deal more damage and inflict elemental ailments on enemies.
Kinetic Bolt doesn't inherently deal elemental damage. Added elemental damage can come from equipment (or from Added Lightning and Added Cold support gems).

en:

大幅提高分裂钢刃造成的物理伤害，但不造成元素伤害。

zh: 辅助[Curse|诅咒]技能。被辅助技能会创造一个区域，[Curse|诅咒]其中的敌人，并在该区域生成女巫蟾蜍。女巫蟾蜍会跳向靠近的敌人，并以更高的攻击性寻找[Curse|被诅咒]的敌人。当蟾蜍跳跃击中敌人时，会[Trigger|触发]黑暗恶果，发生猛烈爆炸。

en: Supports [Attack|Attacks], causing them to deal more [ElementalDamage|Elemental] damage.
zh: 辅助[Attack|攻击]，使攻击造成更高[ElementalDamage|元素]伤害。

zh: 辅助[Attack|攻击]，使攻击造成更高[ElementalDamage|元素]伤害。

zh: 辅助[Attack|攻击]，被辅助技能击中的敌人每有一种[ElementalAilments|元素异常状态]，造成的伤害就会提高，但其本身无法造成[ElementalAilments|元素异常状态]。

en: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those [CooldownRecovery|Cooldowns Recover]. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

en: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those [CooldownRecovery|Cooldowns Recover]. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
zh: 辅助有冷却时间的技能，加快[CooldownRecovery|冷却回复]速度。不能调整召唤生物技能。

zh: 辅助产生[Totem|图腾]的技能。被辅助技能产生的[Totem|图腾]生成血脉源泉，为范围内的[Allies|友军][LifeLeech|偷取生命]。

en: Supports Skills which create [Totem|Totems]. [Totem|Totems] created by supported Skills generate a Font of Rage which will [RageLeech|Leech Rage] to [Allies] within it.
zh: 辅助产生[Totem|图腾]的技能。被辅助技能产生的[Totem|图腾]生成怒火源泉，为范围内的[Allies|友军][RageLeech|偷取怒火]。

zh: 辅助你使用的[Slam|猛击]，使其有几率产生[Aftershock|余震]。

en: Supports [Slam|Slams] you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an [Aftershock].
zh: 辅助你使用的[Slam|猛击]，使其有几率产生[Aftershock|余震]。

en: Supports [Slam] Skills. Supported Skills a chance to create an [Aftershock] as well as increased chance to cause [Aftershock|Aftershocks] the longer their [Attack] time
zh: 辅助[Slam|猛击]技能。被辅助技能有几率造成[Aftershock|余震]，且[Attack|攻击]时间越长，造成[Aftershock|余震]的几率越高。

en: Supports [Slam|Slams] you use yourself, causing them to create simultaneous [Aftershock|Aftershocks] behind the [Slam], but lowering [Aftershock] damage and area of effect with Supported Skills. Cannot Support Skills which create Fissures.
zh: 辅助你使用的[Slam|猛击]，使其在[Slam|猛击]后同时产生一道[Aftershock|余震]，但会降低被辅助技能的[Aftershock|余震]伤害与影响范围。无法辅助会产生裂缝的技能。

en: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create [ConsecratedGround|Consecrated Ground] when you land.
zh: 辅助跃入空中的技能，使其在你落地时产生[ConsecratedGround|奉献地面]。

en: Supports any Skill which creates [RunicInscription|Runic Inscriptions] when Cast, causing those [RunicInscription|Runic Inscriptions] to trigger Burning Inscription when they expire. Burning Inscription is a [Spell] which creates [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground] based off of your Maximum Mana.
zh: 辅助任意施放时产生[RunicInscription|铭刻符文]的技能，使[RunicInscription|铭刻符文]效果结束时产生燃烧铭文。燃烧铭文属于[Spell|法术]，会根据你的魔力上限造成[IgnitedGround|点燃地面]。

en: Supports [Crossbow] [Ammunition] Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩][Ammunition|弹药]技能，使其额外装填一发弩箭，但会牺牲装填速度。

en: Supports [Crossbow] [Ammunition] Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩][Ammunition|弹药]技能，使其额外装填一发弩箭，但会牺牲装填速度。

en: Supports [Crossbow] [Ammunition] Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed. Supported Skills will also automatically reload when they [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] an enemy.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩][Ammunition|弹药]技能，使其额外装填一发弩箭，但会牺牲装填速度。辅助的技能还会在使敌人[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]时自动装填。

en: Supports [Crossbow] [Ammunition] Skills, causing them to load multiple extra bolts and attack faster. Supported Skills cannot reload normally, instead loading bolts when you Dodge.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩][Ammunition|弹药]技能，使其装填多发额外弩箭并提升击发速度。被辅助技能无法正常装填，改为在闪避时进行装填。

en: Supports [Crossbow] [Ammunition] Skills, causing them to automatically reload when they [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] an enemy.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩][Ammunition|弹药]技能，使其令敌人[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]时自动装填。

en: Supports [Crossbow] [Ammunition] Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩][Ammunition|弹药]技能，使其射击时有几率不消耗弩箭。

en: Supports [Crossbow] [Ammunition] Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩][Ammunition|弹药]技能，使其射击时有几率不消耗弩箭。

en: Supports [Crossbow] [Ammunition] Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing, at the cost of Reload speed.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩][Ammunition|弹药]技能，使其射击时有几率不消耗弩箭，但会牺牲装填速度。

en: Supports [Crossbow] Skills, causing them to load a bolt into all [Crossbow] [Ammunition] on kill.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩]技能，击败敌人时为所有[Crossbow|战弩][Ammunition|弹药]装填一发弩箭。

en: Supports [Crossbow] [Ammunition] Skills, causing them to Reload bolts significantly faster.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩][Ammunition|弹药]技能，使其装填弩箭的速度大幅加快。

en: Supports [Crossbow] Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 6 seconds.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩]技能，该技能过去 6 秒内每装填一发弩箭都会提高它造成的伤害。

en: Supports [Crossbow] Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 8 seconds.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩]技能，该技能过去 8 秒内每装填一发弩箭都会提高它造成的伤害。

en: Supports Skills which create [Minion|Minions], causing your Skills which can target [Minion|Minions] to prioritise targeting [Minion|Minions] from the Supported Skill before your other [Minion|Minions] where possible.
zh: 辅助能够产生[Minion|召唤生物]的技能，使你以[Minion|召唤生物]为目标的技能，优先选中被辅助技能产生的[Minion|召唤生物]，而非其他[Minion|召唤生物]。

en: Supports Skills which create [Minion|Minions], causing your Skills which can target [Minion|Minions] to prioritise targeting [Minion|Minions] from the Supported Skill before your other [Minion|Minions] where possible, as well as causing them to always be considered Detonatable.
zh: 辅助能够产生[Minion|召唤生物]的技能，使你以[Minion|召唤生物]为目标的技能，优先选中被辅助技能产生的[Minion|召唤生物]，而非其他[Minion|召唤生物]，并使其总是被视为可引爆的。

en: [DNT-UNUSED] Modifiers to Melee damage also apply to Spell damage for supported skill
zh: 近战伤害的词缀也适用于被辅助技能造成的法术伤害

zh: 近战伤害的词缀也适用于被辅助技能造成的投射物伤害

en: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.
zh: 辅助在地上产生裂缝的技能，使其产生额外的次级裂缝。次级裂缝从主裂缝分支出来，效果范围和伤害降低。

en: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.
zh: 辅助在地上产生裂缝的技能，使其产生额外的次级裂缝。次级裂缝从主裂缝分支出来，效果范围和伤害降低。

zh: 辅助在地上产生裂缝的技能，使其产生一道额外的裂缝，但会牺牲伤害和攻击速度。

en: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and speed.
zh: 辅助在地上产生裂缝的技能，使其产生额外的裂缝，但会牺牲伤害和攻击速度。

zh: 辅助在地上产生裂缝的技能，使其产生大量额外的裂缝，但会牺牲伤害、攻击速度和效果范围。

zh: 辅助产生[Projectile|投射物]的技能，使[Projectile|投射物]击中地形时有几率[Chain|连锁]。

en: Supports any Skill which creates [Projectile|Projectiles], giving those [Projectile|Projectiles] a chance to [Chain] when impacting terrain.
zh: 辅助产生[Projectile|投射物]的技能，使[Projectile|投射物]击中地形时有几率[Chain|连锁]。

zh: 辅助创造[Projectile|投射物]的技能，使[Projectile|投射物]撞击地形时[Chain|连锁]，但会失去任何额外[Projectile|投射物]，并使其总是[Pierce|穿透]。

en: Supports Skills which create [Totem|Totems], causing those Skills to place [Totem|Totems] much more quickly.
zh: 辅助放置[Totem|图腾]的技能，使技能放置[Totem|图腾]的速度大幅加快。

zh: 辅助放置[Totem|图腾]的技能，使技能放置[Totem|图腾]的速度大幅加快。[Totem|图腾]在被辅助技能创造后的短时间内提高[Attack|攻击]和施法速度。

en: Supports Skills which have a [DetonationTime|Detonation Time], causing those Skills to have much higher [DetonationTime|Detonation Time] and detonation damage.

en: Supports Skills which have a [DetonationTime|Detonation Time], causing those Skills to have much higher [DetonationTime|Detonation Time] and detonation damage.
zh: 辅助具有[DetonationTime|引爆时间]的技能，使技能的[DetonationTime|引爆时间]和引爆伤害大幅提高。

en: Supports Skills which fire [Grenade|Grenades], giving fired [Grenade|Grenades] a chance to activate again, but lengthening their cooldowns.
zh: 辅助发射[Grenade|榴弹]的技能，使发射的[Grenade|榴弹]有几率再次激活，但延长冷却时间。

en: Supports Skills which apply [Exposure] to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied [Exposure].
zh: 辅助对敌人施加[Exposure|曝露]的技能，提高施加的[Exposure|曝露]的效果。

en: Supports Skills which create [Totem|Totems]. [Totem|Totems] created by Supported Skills have additional [ElementalDamage|Elemental] [Resistances].
zh: 辅助产生[Totem|图腾]的技能。被辅助技能产生的[Totem|图腾]具有额外的[ElementalDamage|元素][Resistances|抗性]。

en: Supports Skills which create [Totem|Totems]. [Totem|Totems] created by Supported Skills have additional [ElementalDamage|Elemental] [Resistances].
zh: 辅助产生[Totem|图腾]的技能。被辅助技能产生的[Totem|图腾]具有额外的[ElementalDamage|元素][Resistances|抗性]。

en: Supports [Projectile] [Spell|Spells]. Supported [Spell|Spells] have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional [Projectile|Projectiles] in a circle, resetting when they do.
zh: 辅助[Projectile|投射物][Spell|法术]。被辅助[Spell|法术]额外环形发射大量[Projectile|投射物]的几率越来越高，触发时重置几率。

en: Supports any Skill which creates [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals], causing them to be created with lower Life.
zh: 辅助产生[IceCrystals|冰晶]的技能，使其产生的冰晶具有较低的生命。

en: Supports any Skill which creates [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals], causing them to be created with higher Life.
zh: 辅助产生[IceCrystals|冰晶]的技能，使其产生的冰晶具有较高的生命。

en: Supports Skills which deal Damage, increasing the maximum [Physical] Damage of their [HitDamage|Hits].
zh: 辅助造成伤害的技能，使其造成的[HitDamage|击中][Physical|物理]伤害上限提高。

en: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] dealt for each Skill used [Recently] of a different [ElementalDamage|Elemental] type. Cannot support [Minion] Skills.
zh: 辅助造成伤害的技能，[Recently|近期]每使用一个不同的[ElementalDamage|元素]类型的技能，其造成的[ElementalDamage|元素伤害]提高。无法辅助[Minion|召唤生物]技能。

en: Supports [Spell] Skills which cause [HitDamage|Damaging Hits]. Using supported [Spell|Spells] will cause you to [Sacrifice] a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra [Chaos] Damage in exchange. Does not support [Persistent] Skills, [Minion] Skills, or [Trigger|Triggered] Skills.
zh: 辅助造成[HitDamage|伤害性击中]的[Spell|法术]技能。使用被辅助的[Spell|法术]会使你[Sacrifice|牺牲]一部分生命，并获得额外的[Chaos|混沌]伤害。无法辅助[Persistent|永久性]技能、[Minion|召唤生物]技能或[Trigger|触发]技能。

en: Supports [Nova] Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.
zh: 辅助[Nova|新星]技能，使用这些技能时不再在你的周围生效，改为在目标位置生效。

en: Supports [Strike] Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional [Combo] on [HitDamage|Hit]. Cannot support Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助[Strike|打击]技能。被辅助技能[HitDamage|击中]时有几率积累额外的[Combo|连击]。无法辅助[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports Skills which [HitDamage|Hit] Enemies. Supported Skills gain increased [Critical|chance to Critically Hit] against [Immobilised] Enemies.

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills gain [Combo] when you successfully [Strike] Enemies with other [Melee] [Attack|Attacks]. Supported Skills reset their [Combo] on use, dealing more Damage the higher [Combo] you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain [Combo]. Cannot modify the Skills of [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。使用其他[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]成功[Strike|打击]敌人会使被辅助技能获得[Combo|连击]。使用被辅助技能时重置[Combo|连击]，使用时具有的[Combo|连击]越高，造成的伤害越高。无法辅助本身获得[Combo|连击]的技能。无法修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills gain [Combo] when you successfully [Strike] Enemies with other [Melee] [Attack|Attacks]. Supported Skills reset their [Combo] on use, dealing more Damage the higher [Combo] you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain [Combo]. Cannot modify the Skills of [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。使用其他[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]成功[Strike|打击]敌人会使被辅助技能获得[Combo|连击]。使用被辅助技能时重置[Combo|连击]，使用时具有的[Combo|连击]越高，造成的伤害越高。无法辅助本身获得[Combo|连击]的技能。无法修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a [Charges|Power Charge] on use if possible, and will be much more likely to [Critical|Critically Hit] if they do. Supported Skills cannot generate [Charges|Power Charges]. Cannot Support Skills which consume [Charges|Power Charges].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的技能。使用被辅助技能时会尽可能消耗一个[Charges|暴击球]，消耗时有更高的可能[Critical|暴击]。被辅助技能无法产生[Charges|暴击球]。无法辅助会消耗[Charges|暴击球]的技能。

en: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
zh: 辅助你使用的任意技能，使其效果范围明显提高，但冷却时间变长。无法辅助本身具有冷却时间的技能。

en: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to [Critical|Critically Hit], but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
zh: 辅助你使用的任意伤害性技能，使其[Critical|暴击率]明显提高，但冷却时间变长。无法辅助本身具有冷却时间的技能。

en: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to inflict [Ailments] on hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
zh: 辅助你使用的任意伤害性技能，使其击中时造成[Ailments|异常状态]的几率明显提高，但冷却时间变长。无法辅助本身具有冷却时间的技能。

en: Supports [Meta] Skills. Supported Skills gain a chance to partially Refund a portion of [Energy] cost when [Trigger|Triggering] or [Invoke|Invoking] other Skills.
zh: 辅助[Meta|非凡]技能。被辅助技能[Trigger|触发]或[Invoke|祈唤]其他技能时，有几率返还消耗的一部分[Energy|能量]。

en: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] on use if possible, and will gain significant [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed] if they do, but cannot generate [Charges|Frenzy Charges]. Cannot Support Skills which consume [Charges|Frenzy Charges].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的技能。使用被辅助技能时会尽可能消耗一个[Charges|狂怒球]，消耗时大幅提高[SkillSpeed|技能速度]。被辅助技能无法产生[Charges|狂怒球]。无法辅助会消耗[Charges|狂怒球]的技能。

en: Supports [Offering] Skills. Supported Skills [Sacrifice] a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful [Buff|Buffs] in return.
zh: 辅助[Offering|奉献]技能。使用被辅助的技能会使你[Sacrifice|牺牲]一部分生命，但造成的伤害大幅提高，并且产生更强大的[Buff|增益状态]。

en: Supports [Offering] Skills. Supported Skills [Sacrifice] a portion of your life on use. While [Offering] spikes from Supported Skills persist, you are periodically granted a [Charges|Power Charge]. When spikes from Supported Skills die, Regenerate a percentage of your maximum Life and Mana per second based on the duration the [Offering] persisted.
zh: 辅助[Offering|奉献]技能。使用被辅助技能会使你[Sacrifice|牺牲]一部分生命。当被辅助技能产生的[Offering|奉献]尖刺存留期间，你会周期性获得一个[Charges|暴击球]。当尖刺消失时，基于该[Offering|奉献]技能的持续时长，每秒回复一定比例的最大生命与魔力。

en: Supports [Offering] Skills. Supported Skills have increased [Buff] effect and deal more damage, but will target an additional skeletal [Minion] when cast. If there is not an additional skeletal [Minion] to target, no damage or [Buff] effect will be granted.
zh: 辅助[Offering|奉献]技能。被辅助技能的[Buff|增益状态]效果提高，造成更高的伤害，但施放时会额外以一个魔侍[Minion|召唤生物]为目标。如果没有额外的魔侍[Minion|召唤生物]，则不会提高伤害或[Buff|增益状态]效果。

en: Supports Invocation Skills which [Trigger] other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum [Energy].
zh: 辅助[Trigger|触发]其他技能的祈求技能。被辅助技能的[Energy|能量]上限大幅提高。

en: Supports [Meta] Skills. Supported Skills generate [Energy] significantly faster.
zh: 辅助[Meta|非凡]技能。被辅助技能产生[Energy|能量]的速度大幅加快。

en: Supports [Meta] Skills. Supported Skills generate [Energy] significantly faster.
zh: 辅助[Meta|非凡]技能。被辅助技能产生[Energy|能量]的速度大幅加快。

en: Supports Skills which create [Remnant|Remnants], allowing those [Remnant|Remnants] to be collected from further away.
zh: 辅助产生[Remnant|残片]的技能，使[Remnant|残片]能够从更远处收集。

en: Supports Skills which create [Remnant|Remnants], allowing those [Remnant|Remnants] to be collected from further away, with a chance to create an additional [Remnant].
zh: 辅助产生[Remnant|残片]的技能，使[Remnant|残片]能够从更远处收集，并有几率创造额外的[Remnant|残片]。

en: Supports Skills which [Trigger] other Skills. Skills [Trigger|Triggered] by Supported Skills have their Damage randomly raised or lowered when [Trigger|Triggered], as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when [Trigger|Triggered].
zh: 辅助[Trigger|触发]其他技能的技能。被辅助技能所[Trigger|触发]的技能的伤害在被[Trigger|触发]时随机增减，[Trigger|触发]时还会随机恢复一定比例的消耗。

en: Supports Skills which [Trigger] other Skills. Skills [Trigger|Triggered] by Supported Skills have their Damage, Area of Effect, and [Projectile] Speed randomly raised or lowered when [Trigger|Triggered], as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when [Trigger|Triggered].
zh: 辅助[Trigger|触发]其他技能的技能。被辅助技能[Trigger|触发]的技能在被[Trigger|触发]时伤害、效果范围和[Projectile|投射物]速度随机增减，被[Trigger|触发]时还会随机回复一定消耗。

en: Supports [Spell] Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助[Spell|法术]技能。当你的魔力高于魔力上限的 90% 时，被辅助技能造成更高的伤害。不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports [Spell] Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost [Efficiency] and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助[Spell|法术]技能。被辅助技能的魔力消耗[Efficiency|效能]提高，并且当你的魔力高于魔力上限的 90% 时，技能造成更高的伤害。不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports [Minion] Skills. Supported [Minion|Minions] deal more damage and have increased [CooldownRecovery|Cooldown Recovery Rate] with [Command] Skills.
zh: 辅助[Minion|召唤生物]技能，被辅助的[Minion|召唤生物]造成更高的伤害，[Command|命令]技能的[CooldownRecovery|冷却回复速度]提高。

en: Supports [Minion] Skills. Supported [Minion|Minions] deal more damage and have increased [CooldownRecovery|Cooldown Recovery Rate] with [Command] Skills.
zh: 辅助[Minion|召唤生物]技能，被辅助的[Minion|召唤生物]造成更高的伤害，[Command|命令]技能的[CooldownRecovery|冷却回复速度]提高。

en: Supports [Minion] Skills. Supported [Minion|Minions] have significantly increased [CooldownRecovery|Cooldown Recovery Rate] with [Command] Skills.
zh: 辅助[Minion|召唤生物]技能，被辅助的[Minion|召唤生物][Command|命令]技能的[CooldownRecovery|冷却回复速度]大幅提高。

en: Supports [Minion|Minions] which have [Command] Skills. Supported [Minion|Minions] have massively increased cooldown recovery speed for [Command] Skills they use, but deal no damage with non-[Command] Skills.
zh: 辅助具有[Command|命令]技能的[Minion|召唤生物]。被辅助的[Minion|召唤生物]的[Command|命令]技能冷却回复速度大幅加快，但是非[Command|命令]技能无法造成伤害。

en: Supports Skills which require [Combo] to use. Supported Skills lose their [Combo] stacks after a longer delay spent not gaining any [Combo].
zh: 被辅助技能需要[Combo|连击]才能使用。较长时间未获得[Combo|连击]后，被辅助技能会失去[Combo|连击]层数。

en: Supports [Grenade] Skills. [Grenade|Grenades] from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.
zh: 辅助[Grenade|榴弹]技能，被辅助技能的[Grenade|榴弹]不会弹跳，而是停留在初始落点，引爆时造成的伤害较低。

en: Supports [Grenade] Skills. [Grenade|Grenades] from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land.
zh: 辅助[Grenade|榴弹]技能，被辅助技能的[Grenade|榴弹]不会弹跳，而是停留在初始落点。

en: Supports [Grenade] Skills. [Grenade|Grenades] from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land. [Grenade|Grenades] from Supported Skills have longer cooldowns, and a chance to detonate an additional time.
zh: 辅助[Grenade|榴弹]技能。被辅助技能的[Grenade|榴弹]不会弹跳，而是停在初始落点。被辅助技能的[Grenade|榴弹]冷却时间更长，有几率额外引爆一次。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage the closer you are to being [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavily Stunned].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。你越接近[HeavyStunPlayer|重度晕眩]状态，被辅助技能造成的伤害越高。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage and are more capable of [Stun|Stunning] Enemies the closer you are to being [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavily Stunned].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。你越接近[HeavyStunPlayer|重度晕眩]状态，被辅助技能造成的伤害越高，[Stun|晕眩]敌人的能力越强。

en: Supports [Slam] Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain multiple independent chances to cause [Aftershock|Aftershocks], but deal less Damage.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Slam|猛击]技能。被辅助技能获得独立的[Aftershock|余震]几率，但造成的伤害降低。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills you use yourself which fire [Projectile|Projectiles], [Seal|Sealing] them over time. The [Seal|Seals] are broken when used, causing additional [Projectile|Projectiles] to be fired. [Projectile|Projectiles] from Supported Skills are fired in random directions. Cannot Support Skills which require [Combo], have a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
zh: 辅助你使用的发射[Projectile|投射物]的[Attack|攻击]技能，使其随时间获得[Seal|封印]。使用时打破[Seal|封印]，发射额外[Projectile|投射物]。来自被辅助技能的[Projectile|投射物]会向随机方向发射。无法辅助需要[Combo|连击]、有冷却时间或能获得封印的技能。

en: Supports [Attack|Attacks] you use yourself. Supported Skills gain more [Attack] speed each time you use them, but will become unusable if used too frequently in a short time frame. [Sustained] Skills will instead gain [Attack] speed periodically while being used.
zh: 辅助你使用的[Attack|攻击]。被辅助技能每次使用都会提高[Attack|攻击]速度，但在短时间内使用过多就会无法使用。若为[Sustained|持续性技能]，则在使用期间会定期获得[Attack|攻击]速度提升。

en: Supports [Projectile] [Attack] Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra [Lightning] Damage.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能在你移动时获得电伏充能，最多积累到最大值。使用被辅助技能时消耗充能，获得额外的[Lightning|闪电]伤害。

en: Supports Skills which [HitDamage|Hit] Enemies. Supported Skills trigger Bone Shrapnel explosions when killing [Pinned] Enemies.
zh: 辅助[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能。被辅助技能击败[Pinned|定身]的敌人时触发钙质碎片爆破。

en: Supports [Bow] [Attack|Attacks]. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an [Attack] with Supported Skill matches that direction. [Attack|Attacks] from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support [Channelling|Channelled] Skills.
zh: 辅助[Bow|弓类]的[Attack|攻击]。被辅助技能指示四个方向之一，被辅助技能的[Attack|攻击]与指示方向相同时改变指示方向。被辅助技能对指示方向的[Attack|攻击]会造成更高的伤害。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能。

en: Supports [Bow] [Attack|Attacks]. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an [Attack] with Supported Skill matches that direction. [Attack|Attacks] from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support [Channelling|Channelled] Skills.
zh: 辅助[Bow|弓类]的[Attack|攻击]。被辅助技能指示四个方向之一，被辅助技能的[Attack|攻击]与指示方向相同时改变指示方向。被辅助技能对指示方向的[Attack|攻击]会造成更高的伤害。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能。

en: Supports [Bow] [Attack|Attacks]. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an [Attack] with Supported Skill matches that direction. [Attack|Attacks] from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction fire additional [Projectile|Projectiles]. Cannot Support [Channelling|Channelled] Skills.
zh: 辅助[Bow|弓类]的[Attack|攻击]。被辅助技能指示四个方向之一，被辅助技能的[Attack|攻击]与指示方向相同时改变指示方向。被辅助技能与指示方向相同的[Attack|攻击]发射额外[Projectile|投射物]。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能。

en: Supports Skills which you use yourself which can deal damage. Supported Skills gain an [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] cost equal to your [Intelligence], while also dealing more non-[DamagingAilments|Ailment] Damage over time based off of your [Intelligence]. Cannot support [Channelling] Skills.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的能够造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能获得等同于你的[Intelligence|智慧]的[EnergyShield|能量护盾]消耗，同时会根据你的[Intelligence|智慧]造成更高的非[DamagingAilments|异常状态]的持续伤害。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能。

en: Supports [Bow] [Attack|Attacks]. Every third shot with Supported Skills restores a portion of its Mana cost and [Gain|Gains] Damage as extra [Lightning] Damage.
zh: 辅助[Bow|弓类][Attack|攻击]。每当第三次使用被辅助技能进行射击时,会恢复一定比例的魔力消耗，并使造成的伤害[Gain|获得]额外的[Lightning|闪电]伤害.

en: Supports [Bow] [Attack|Attacks]. Every third shot with Supported Skills [Gain|Gains] Damage as extra [Lightning] Damage.
zh: 辅助[Bow|弓类][Attack|攻击]。被辅助技能的每第三次射击[Gain|获得]额外[Lightning|闪电]伤害。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume a [Corpse] on use, dealing more [Chaos] Damage if they do.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的技能。被辅助技能在使用时消耗一个[Corpse|灵柩]，消耗时造成更高的[Chaos|混沌]伤害。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume many [Corpse|Corpses] on use, dealing more [Chaos] Damage per [Corpse] consumed.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的技能。被辅助技能使用时消耗大量[Corpse|灵柩]，每消耗一个[Corpse|灵柩]就能造成更高的[Chaos|混沌]伤害。

en: Supports [Channelling] Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been [Channelling|Channelled].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能，使其[Channelling|吟唱]的时间越久，造成的伤害越高。

en: Supports [Channelling] Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been [Channelling|Channelled].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能，使其[Channelling|吟唱]的时间越久，造成的伤害越高。

en: Supports [Channelling] Skills you use yourself, granting you higher [StunThreshold|Stun Threshold] while [Channelling] them.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能，使你在[Channelling|吟唱]期间提高[StunThreshold|晕眩阈值]。

en: Supports [Channelling] Skills you use yourself, granting you higher [StunThreshold|Stun Threshold] and [AilmentThreshold|Ailment Threshold]  while [Channelling] them.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能，使你在[Channelling|吟唱]期间提高[StunThreshold|晕眩阈值]和[AilmentThreshold|异常状态阈值]。

en: Supports Skills which can fire [Projectile|Projectiles]. Initial [Projectile|Projectile] created by Supported Skills will always [Pierce] [Ignite|Ignited] Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot inflict [Ignite] themselves.
zh: 辅助可以发射[Projectile|投射物]的技能。被辅助技能的初始[Projectile|投射物]必定[Pierce|穿透][Ignite|被点燃]的敌人，但被辅助技能自身无法施加[Ignite|点燃]。

en: Supports Skills which can fire [Projectile|Projectiles]. [Projectile|Projectiles] from Supported Skills always [Fork] when the initial [Projectile] [HitDamage|Hits] [Frozen] Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot build up [Freeze] themselves.
zh: 辅助可以发射[Projectile|投射物]的技能。被辅助技能的初始[Projectile|投射物][HitDamage|击中][Frozen|被冻结]的敌人时，[Projectile|投射物]必定[Fork|分叉]，但被辅助技能自身无法累积[Freeze|冻结]。

en: Supports [Projectile] Skills and Skills which can [Chain]. Supported Skills always [Chain] when initially [HitDamage|Hitting] a [Shock|Shocked] Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict [Shock]. Does not support Skills which cannot [Chain].
zh: 辅助[Projectile|投射物]技能和可以[Chain|连锁]的技能。被辅助技能第一次[HitDamage|击中][Shock|感电]的敌人时必定[Chain|连锁]，但自身无法施加[Shock|感电]。无法辅助不能[Chain|连锁]的技能。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself which can [HitDamage|Hit] Enemies. Supported Skills [Gain] a percentage of their Damage as [Cold] Damage when you destroy [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals].
zh: 辅助你自己使用且能够[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能。当你摧毁[IceCrystals|冰晶]时，被辅助技能[Gain|获得]一定比例的[Cold|冰霜]伤害。

en: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies with [HitDamage|Hits], causing all sources of Damage [Gain|Gained] to instead be treated as Damage [Gain|Gained] as extra [Cold] for Supported Skills.
zh: 辅助能够[HitDamage|击中]敌人并造成伤害的技能，使从所有来源[Gain|获得]的伤害被视作被辅助技能[Gain|获得]的额外[Cold|冰霜]伤害。

en: Supports [Warcry] Skills. Supported Skills [Consume] [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour] to trigger [Physical] Damage explosions on Enemies within their range but cannot themselves [ArmourBreak|Break Armour].
zh: 辅助[Warcry|战吼]技能。被辅助技能[Consume|消耗]范围内敌人的[ArmourBreak|护甲完全破损]以触发[Physical|物理]伤害爆炸，但本身无法[ArmourBreak|粉碎护甲]。

en: [DNT-UNUSED] Supports Skills which gain Stages or Seals. Supported Skills have lower Maximum Stage or Seal count, but have a Minimum Stage or Seal count they cannot fall below.
zh: 辅助能够获得层数或封印的技能。被辅助技能的最大层数或封印数量降低，但不会降低至最小层数或封印数量以下。

en: Supports [Curse] Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume [Charges|Power Charges] on use, gaining significant [Curse] duration if they do. Cannot Support Skills which consume [Charges|Power Charges].
zh: 辅助你自己施放的[Curse|诅咒]技能。被辅助技能使用时可以消耗[Charges|暴击球]，消耗时大幅延长[Curse|诅咒]的持续时间。无法辅助会消耗[Charges|暴击球]的技能。

en: Supports Skills which deal Damage with [HitDamage|Hits]. When Supported Skills [Pinned|Pin] an Enemy, they also [Aggravate] [Bleeding] on that Enemy.
zh: 辅助能够[HitDamage|击中]敌人并造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能使敌人[Pinned|定身]时，还会使利刃受到的[Bleeding|流血]变为[Aggravate|恶性]。

en: Supports [Minion] Skills which summon [Reviving] [Minion|Minions]. Supported [Minion|Minions] deal significantly more Damage if they have [Reviving|Revived] [Recently].
zh: 辅助能够召唤[Reviving|可复活的][Minion|召唤生物]的[Minion|召唤生物]技能。被辅助的[Minion|召唤生物]若[Recently|近期][Reviving|复活过]，则造成的伤害大幅提高。

en: Supports [Bow] or [Spear] [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Spectral Projectiles linger and will fire a short duration after no new Spectral Projectiles have been created. Cannot support [Channelling] Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain [Projectile|Projectiles] from above.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Bow|弓类]或[Spear|战矛][Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击]。被辅助技能造成的初始伤害降低，但会产生灵体投射物，发射时能造成更高的伤害。灵体投射物会持续保留，并在不再产生新的灵体投射物后的短时间内发射。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能、跳跃技能，以及使[Projectile|投射物]从天而降的技能。

en: Supports Melee [Attack|Attacks] you use yourself. Supported Skills [Consume] all [Charges|Endurance Charge] on use, causing you to restore a percentage of your maximum Life for each [Charges|Charge] [Consume|Consumed]. Cannot Support Skills which consume [Charges|Endurance Charges].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的近战[Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能使用时[Consume|消耗]全部[Charges|耐力球]，每[Consume|消耗]一个[Charges|能量球]为你回复一定比例的最大生命。无法辅助会消耗[Charges|耐力球]的技能。

en: Supports Skills which create [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals]. Supported Skills create chilling areas which deal [Cold] Damage over time instead of creating [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals].
zh: 辅助产生[IceCrystals|冰晶]的技能。被辅助技能不再产生[IceCrystals|冰晶]，改为产生冰缓区域，持续造成[Cold|冰霜]伤害。

en: Supports Skills which create [Persistent] [Minion|Minions]. Supported [Minion|Minions] will restore Life to nearby [Allies|Allied] [Minion|Minions] on death, as well as removing [Ailments] from those [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助能够产生[Persistent|永久性][Minion|召唤生物]的技能。被辅助的[Minion|召唤生物]被击败时使附近的[Allies|友军][Minion|召唤生物]回复生命，并移除这些[Minion|召唤生物]受到的[Ailments|异常状态]。

en: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies. Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a [DamagingAilments|Damaging Ailment] have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this [Debuff] will apply. Does not Support Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助能够对敌人造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能的非[DamagingAilments|伤害性异常状态]造成的持续伤害会使敌人的生命回复速度降低。仅有最强效的该[Debuff|减益状态]能够生效。无法辅助[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with [HitDamage|Hits]. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life [Flask] charges, inflicting more powerful [Bleeding] based on Life [Flask] charges consumed.
zh: 辅助你自己使用且能够[HitDamage|击中]敌人并造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能会消耗一定比例的最大生命[Flask|药剂]充能，根据消耗的生命[Flask|药剂]充能造成更强的[Bleeding|流血]效果。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with [HitDamage|Hits]. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life [Flask] charges, inflicting more powerful [Bleeding] based on Life [Flask] charges consumed.
zh: 辅助你自己使用且能够[HitDamage|击中]敌人并造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能会消耗一定比例的最大生命[Flask|药剂]充能，根据消耗的生命[Flask|药剂]充能造成更强的[Bleeding|流血]效果。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with [HitDamage|Hits]. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana [Flask] charges, [Gain|Gaining] a percentage of damage as extra [Lightning] damage per Mana [Flask] charge consumed.
zh: 辅助你自己使用且能够[HitDamage|击中]敌人并造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能会消耗一定比例的最大魔力[Flask|药剂]充能，每消耗一层魔力[Flask|药剂]充能就[Gain|获得]一定比例的额外[Lightning|闪电]伤害。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with [HitDamage|Hits]. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana [Flask] charges, [Gain|Gaining] a percentage of damage as extra [Lightning] damage per Mana [Flask] charge consumed.
zh: 辅助你自己使用且能够[HitDamage|击中]敌人并造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能会消耗一定比例的最大魔力[Flask|药剂]充能，每消耗一层魔力[Flask|药剂]充能就[Gain|获得]一定比例的额外[Lightning|闪电]伤害。

en: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer.
zh: 辅助能够产生地面效果的技能，使产生的地面效果持续时间大幅延长。

en: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer and only end when their duration expires.
zh: 辅助能够产生地面效果的技能，使产生的地面效果持续时间大幅延长，且仅会在持续时间结束时消失。

en: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer as well as lowering the [CooldownRecovery|Cooldown Recovery Speed] of affected Enemies. Ground Surfaces from Supported Skills only end when their duration expires.
zh: 辅助能够产生地面效果的技能，使创造的地面效果持续时间大幅延长，并降低受影响敌人的[CooldownRecovery|冷却回复速度]。被辅助技能的地面效果只在持续时间结束时消失。

en: Supports Skills that generate [Remnant|Remnants], causing those [Remnant|Remnants] to affect [Allies] in your [Presence] when collected instead of you.
zh: 辅助产生[Remnant|残片]的技能，收集[Remnant|残片]时使其影响[Presence|在场]的[Allies|友军]，但不影响你。

en: Supports Skills which create [Remnant|Remnants], making those [Remnant|Remnants] more powerful.
zh: 辅助产生[Remnant|残片]的技能，使[Remnant|残片]更加强大。

en: Supports Skills which create [Remnant|Remnants], making those [Remnant|Remnants] more powerful, but delaying their effect.
zh: 辅助产生[Remnant|残片]的技能，使[Remnant|残片]更加强大，但延迟其效果。

en: Supports Skills which create [Remnant|Remnants], making those [Remnant|Remnants] more powerful, but delaying their effect.
zh: 辅助产生[Remnant|残片]的技能，使[Remnant|残片]更加强大，但延迟其效果。

en: Supports [Slam] Skills. Supported Skills that have a chance to [Aftershock] have increased chance to cause [Aftershock|Aftershocks] the longer their [Attack] time.
zh: 辅助[Slam|猛击]技能。被辅助技能拥有[Aftershock|余震]几率时，其[Attack|攻击]时间越长，造成[Aftershock|余震]的几率越高。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills deal more Damage while you have a lower percentage of your Life remaining than the target struck, but less Damage when the reverse is true.
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。当你的剩余生命比例低于击中的目标时，被辅助技能会造成更高的伤害，但反之会造成更低的伤害。

en: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging [HitDamage|Hits], causing base chance to inflict [Bleeding] with Supported Skills to instead apply to base chance to [Poison], and causing base chance to [Poison] to instead apply to [Bleeding].
zh: 辅助造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能，使被辅助技能造成[Bleeding|流血]的基础几率改为对[Poison|中毒]的基础几率生效，[Poison|中毒]的基础几率生效改为对[Bleeding|流血]生效。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills always hit [Daze|Dazed] Enemies, but [Consume] [Daze] on [HitDamage|Hit], and cannot themselves inflict [Daze]. Cannot Support Skills which [Consume] [Daze].
zh: 辅助[Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能必定击中[Daze|恍惚]的敌人，但[HitDamage|击中]时[Consume|消耗][Daze|恍惚]，并且本身无法造成[Daze|恍惚]。无法辅助会[Consume|消耗][Daze|恍惚]的技能。

en: Supports [Slam] Skills you use yourself. [HitDamage|Hits] from Supported Skills are considered [CrushingBlow|Crushing Blows] against Enemies which are both [Ignite|Ignited] and [ArmourBreak|Fully Armour Broken]. [HitDamage|Hits] with Supported Skills that [HeavyStun|Heavily Stun] [Ignite|Ignited] and [ArmourBreak|Fully Armour Broken] Enemies will [Intimidate] them.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Slam|猛击]技能。被辅助技能的[HitDamage|击中]对同时受到[Ignite|点燃]和[ArmourBreak|护甲完全破损]的目标视作[CrushingBlow|粉碎打击]。被辅助技能使[Ignite|点燃]和[ArmourBreak|护甲完全破损]的目标陷入[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]的[HitDamage|击中]还会[Intimidate|威吓]他们。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is [Recoup|Recouped] as Life, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the [Attack] time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support [Channelling] Skills.
zh: 辅助你使用的[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。使用被辅助技能时，受到伤害的一定比例将被[Recoup|吸纳]为生命，被辅助技能的[Attack|攻击]时间越长该比例越高。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills you use yourself. Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used while [Surrounded].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。[Surrounded|被包围]时，魔力不足不会使被辅助技能无法使用。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills deal more Damage with [Critical|Critical Hits], but [Critical|Critically Hitting] an Enemy with them will [Daze] you for a short time.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能的[Critical|暴击]造成更高的伤害，但对敌人造成[Critical|暴击]会使你短暂地陷入[Daze|恍惚]。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills deal more [Melee] Damage for each [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailment] on Enemies they hit, but cannot themselves inflict [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments].
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能击中的敌人每受到一个[ElementalAilments|元素异常状态]影响，造成的[Melee|近战]伤害都会提高，但其本身无法造成[ElementalAilments|元素异常状态]。

en: Supports [Spell] Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is [Recoup|Recouped] as Mana, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Cast time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support [Channelling] Skills.
zh: 辅助你使用的[Spell|法术]技能。使用被辅助技能时，受到伤害的一定比例将被[Recoup|吸纳]为魔力，被辅助技能的施法时间越长该比例越高。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能。

en: Supports Skills which create [Projectile|Projectiles]. Supported Skills deal more damage with [Projectile|Projectiles] if you have struck with a [Melee] [HitDamage|Hit] in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal [Melee] Damage.
zh: 辅助产生[Projectile|投射物]的技能。如果你在过去八秒内造成过[Melee|近战][HitDamage|击中]，被辅助技能造成的[Projectile|投射物]伤害会提高，但其本身无法造成[Melee|近战]伤害。

en: Supports Skills which create [Projectile|Projectiles]. Supported Skills deal more damage with [Projectile|Projectiles] if you have struck with a [Melee] [HitDamage|Hit] in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal [Melee] Damage.
zh: 辅助产生[Projectile|投射物]的技能。如果你在过去八秒内造成过[Melee|近战][HitDamage|击中]，被辅助技能造成的[Projectile|投射物]伤害会提高，但其本身无法造成[Melee|近战]伤害。

en: Supports Skills which create [Projectile|Projectiles]. Supported Skills deal more damage with [Projectile|Projectiles] if you have struck with a [Melee] [HitDamage|Hit] in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal [Melee] Damage.
zh: 辅助产生[Projectile|投射物]的技能。如果你在过去两秒内造成过[Melee|近战][HitDamage|击中]，被辅助技能造成的[Projectile|投射物]伤害会提高，但其本身无法造成[Melee|近战]伤害。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack|Attacks]. Supported Skills deal more [Melee] damage if you have struck with a [Projectile] [Attack] [HitDamage|Hit] in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal [Projectile] Damage.
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]。如果你在过去八秒内造成过[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]，被辅助技能造成的[Melee|近战]伤害会提高，但其本身无法造成[Projectile|投射物]伤害。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack|Attacks]. Supported Skills deal more [Melee] damage if you have struck with a [Projectile] [Attack] [HitDamage|Hit] in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal [Projectile] Damage.
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]。如果你在过去八秒内造成过[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]，被辅助技能造成的[Melee|近战]伤害会提高，但其本身无法造成[Projectile|投射物]伤害。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack|Attacks]. Supported Skills deal more [Melee] damage if you have struck with a [Projectile] [Attack] [HitDamage|Hit] in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal [Projectile] Damage.
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]。如果你在过去两秒内造成过[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]，被辅助技能造成的[Melee|近战]伤害会提高，但其本身无法造成[Projectile|投射物]伤害。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills which deal Damage in an Area. Supported Skills have significantly increased Area of Effect, but are less [Accuracy|Accurate] against nearby targets.
zh: 辅助在范围内造成伤害的[Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能的效果范围大幅提高，但对周围目标的[Accuracy|命中]降低。

en: Supports Skills you use or [Trigger] yourself, which can cause [HitDamage|Damaging Hits]. Supported Skills inflict more powerful [Ailments] if you are afflicted with those [Ailments] when you inflict them, while also removing from you any [Ailments|Ailment] that they inflict.
zh: 辅助你自己使用或自己[Trigger|触发]的造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能。当你受到[Ailments|异常状态]影响时，被辅助技能造成的同类[Ailments|异常状态]更为强大，并且会移除你受到的同类[Ailments|异常状态]。

en: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging [HitDamage|Hits]. Supported Skills are more likely to [Critical|Critically Hit] [Blind|Blinded] Enemies, and deal more Damage with [Critical|Critical Hits] against [Blind|Blinded] Enemies, but cannot themselves inflict [Blind].
zh: 辅助造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能。被辅助技能更有可能对[Blind|被致盲]的敌人造成[Critical|暴击]，对[Blind|被致盲]的敌人造成的[Critical|暴击]伤害提高，但其本身无法造成[Blind|致盲]。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills you use yourself which do not already have some [Conditional|Condition] for use. Supported Skills can only be used after you have moved a certain distance, but have massively increased [SkillSpeed|Skill Speed]. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown.
zh: 辅助你自己使用且不具有使用[Conditional|条件]的[Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能只能在你移动了一定距离后使用，但会大幅提高[SkillSpeed|技能速度]。无法辅助具有冷却时间的技能。

en: Supports [Channelling] Skills. While [Channelling] Supported Skills, you gain [Lightning] [Thorns] based off of your maximum Mana.
zh: 辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能。在[Channelling|吟唱]被辅助技能时，你会根据魔力上限获得[Lightning|闪电][Thorns|荆棘]。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills you use yourself. [HitDamage|Hit] Damage from Supported Skills is [Lucky] if you are [Surrounded].
zh: 辅助你使用的[Attack|攻击]技能。如果你被[Surrounded|被包围]，被辅助技能的[HitDamage|击中]伤害[Lucky|特别幸运]。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills you use yourself. [HitDamage|Hit] Damage from Supported Skills is [Lucky] and Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used if you are [Surrounded].
zh: 辅助你使用的[Attack|攻击]技能。如果你被[Surrounded|包围]，被辅助技能的[HitDamage|击中]伤害[Lucky|特别幸运]，魔力不足不会阻止被辅助技能的使用。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging [HitDamage|Hits]. Supported Skills grant [Volatility] on [Critical|Critical Hit].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能。被辅助技能[Critical|暴击]时产生[Volatility|无常]。

en: Supports Skills which summon [Minion|Minions]. Supported [Minion|Minions] deal more Damage the more different kinds of [Reviving] [Minion|Minions] you have summoned.
zh: 辅助能够召唤出[Minion|召唤生物]的技能。你召唤的[Reviving|可复活的][Minion|召唤生物]类型越多，被辅助的[Minion|召唤生物]造成的伤害越高。

en: Supports Skills which summon [Persistent] [Minion|Minions]. Supported [Minion|Minions] are larger, have more Life, and deal more Damage, but cost significantly more [Spirit].
zh: 辅助能够召唤[Persistent|永久性][Minion|召唤生物]的技能。被辅助的[Minion|召唤生物]体型变大，具有更多生命，造成更高的伤害，但大幅提高[Spirit|精魂]消耗。

en: Supports Ranged [Spear] [Attack|Attacks]. Supported Skills create Caltrops when [Projectile|Projectiles] they create reach the end of their flight.
zh: 辅助远程[Spear|战矛][Attack|攻击]。被辅助技能的[Projectile|投射物]结束飞行时产生铁蒺藜。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging [HitDamage|Hits]. Supported Skills [Consume] [Bleeding] on [HitDamage|Hit] to create explosive blood-filled crystals, but cannot themselves inflict [Bleeding]. Cannot Support Skills which already [Consume] [Bleeding].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的可造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的[Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能[HitDamage|击中]时[Consume|消耗][Bleeding|流血]产生爆炸性血晶，但其本身无法造成[Bleeding|流血]。无法辅助已经[Consume|消耗][Bleeding|流血]的技能。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of [Stun|Stunning] Enemies the closer you are to being [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavily Stunned].
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。你距离[HeavyStunPlayer|重度晕眩]状态越近，被辅助技能使敌人[Stun|晕眩]的能力越强。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging [HitDamage|Hits]. Supported Skills cannot be used unless you have been stationary for a certain duration, but deal increasingly more damage the longer you are stationary. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown or another usage [Conditional|Condition].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能。被辅助技能只有在你静止不动一段时间后才能使用，但静止的时间越长，造成的伤害越高。无法辅助具有冷却时间的技能或存在其他使用[Conditional|条件]的技能。

en: Supports Skills which create [Remnant|Remnants], allowing those [Remnant|Remnants] to be collected from further away.
zh: 辅助产生[Remnant|残片]的技能，使[Remnant|残片]能够从更远处收集。

en: Supports [Strike|Strikes] you use yourself, providing a powerful [AncestralBoost|Ancestral Boost] every few seconds. Cannot Support [Channelling|Channelled] Skills and does not modify Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助你使用的[Strike|打击]技能，每隔几秒提供强大的[AncestralBoost|先祖加持]。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能，不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports [Strike|Strikes] you use yourself, providing a powerful [AncestralBoost|Ancestral Boost] every few seconds. Cannot Support [Channelling|Channelled] Skills and does not modify Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助你使用的[Strike|打击]技能，每隔几秒提供强大的[AncestralBoost|先祖加持]。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能，不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports [Strike|Strikes] you use yourself, providing a powerful [AncestralBoost|Ancestral Boost] every second, at the cost of a damage penalty. Cannot Support [Channelling|Channelled] Skills and does not modify Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助你使用的[Strike|打击]技能，每隔几秒提供强大的[AncestralBoost|先祖加持]，但会受到伤害惩罚效果影响。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能，不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en:
Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills trigger Quill Burst, which deals your [Thorns] Damage in an Area around the target struck. Quill Burst can only be triggered on [HitDamage|Hit] after you've
[ThornsRetaliation|Retaliated with Thorns] Damage.
zh:
辅助[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能会触发棘刺爆发，对击中的目标周围的区域造成你的[Thorns|荆棘]伤害。只有当你[ThornsRetaliation|用荆棘进行反击]后，
才能在[HitDamage|击中]时触发棘刺爆发。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills you use yourself. [Attack|Attacking] with Supported Skills will cycle through various effects, with the first [Attack] in sequence inflicting [Hobble] on you. The second and third [Attack|Attacks] in sequence will powerfully scale chance to [Critical|Critically Hit] and overall damage, respectively, at which point the cycle will reset. Cannot Support [Channelling] Skills.
zh: 辅助你使用的[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能的[Attack|攻击]会循环产生多种效果，第一次[Attack|攻击]会对你造成[Hobble|跛行]，连续的第二和第三次[Attack|攻击]分别会大幅提高[Critical|暴击]几率和整体伤害，随后循环效果重置。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能。

en: Supports [Strike|Strikes] you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until you have [Block|Blocked] a certain number of [HitDamage|Hits], but will be [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted] when used. After use, this [Block|Blocked Hit] counter will reset. Cannot Support [Channelling|Channelled] Skills or Skills which already have a [Conditional|Condition] for use.
zh: 辅助你使用的[Strike|打击]技能。被辅助技能只有在你[Block|格挡]一定次数的[HitDamage|击中]后才能使用，但使用时会获得[AncestralBoost|先祖加持]。使用后[Block|格挡]计数会重置。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能或存在其他使用[Conditional|条件]的技能。

en: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground] the first time they [Critical|Critically Hit] an enemy.
zh: 辅助会跳跃并造成伤害的技能，使其在第一次对敌人造成[Critical|暴击]时制造[ShockedGround|感电地面]。

en: Supports [Melee] [Strike] Skills. After you [ThornsRetaliation|Retaliate] with [Thorns] Damage, you also deal your [Thorns] damage to enemies you [HitDamage|Hit] with Supported Skills.
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Strike|打击]技能。当你用[Thorns|荆棘]伤害进行[ThornsRetaliation|反击]后，你同时会对被辅助技能[HitDamage|击中]的敌人造成你的[Thorns|荆棘]伤害。

en: Supports [Melee] [Strike] Skills. After you [ThornsRetaliation|Retaliate] with [Thorns] Damage, you also deal your [Thorns] damage to enemies you [HitDamage|Hit] with Supported Skills.
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Strike|打击]技能。当你用[Thorns|荆棘]伤害进行[ThornsRetaliation|反击]后，你同时会对被辅助技能[HitDamage|击中]的敌人造成你的[Thorns|荆棘]伤害。

en: Supports [Melee] [Strike] Skills. After you [ThornsRetaliation|Retaliate] with [Thorns] Damage, you also deal your [Thorns] damage twice to enemies you [HitDamage|Hit] with Supported Skills.
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Strike|打击]技能。当你用[Thorns|荆棘]伤害进行[ThornsRetaliation|反击]后，你会对被辅助技能[HitDamage|击中]的敌人造成两次你的[Thorns|荆棘]伤害。

en: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing Enemies [Chill|Chilled] by those Surfaces to be more easily [Frozen], but at the cost of some [Chill] magnitude.
zh: 辅助产生地面效果的技能，被地面效果[Chill|冰缓]的敌人更容易被[Frozen|冻结]，但会牺牲一定的[Chill|冰缓]强度。

en: Supports Skills which [HitDamage|Hit] Enemies, causing [Knockback] from those [HitDamage|Hits] to be significantly more effective.
zh: 辅助[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能，使[HitDamage|击中]产生的[Knockback|击退]效果大幅提高。

en: Supports any Skill that [HitDamage|Hits] Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more [Charm] charges.
zh: 辅助任意[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能，使其击败敌人后获得更多的[Charm|咒符]充能。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing you to deal increased [Thorns] Damage while the Supported Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性][Buff|增益状态]技能，激活被辅助技能时，提高你造成的[Thorns|荆棘]伤害。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing you to deal increased [Thorns] Damage while the Supported Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性][Buff|增益状态]技能，激活被辅助技能时，提高你造成的[Thorns|荆棘]伤害。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing you to deal increased [Spell] Damage while on full [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] while the Supported Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性][Buff|增益状态]技能，激活被辅助技能且[EnergyShield|能量护盾]已满时，提高你造成的[Spell|法术]伤害。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing you to deal increased [Spell] Damage while on full [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] while the Supported Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性][Buff|增益状态]技能，激活被辅助技能且[EnergyShield|能量护盾]已满时，提高你造成的[Spell|法术]伤害。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing you to deal increased [Attack] Damage while on [LowLife|Low Life] while the Supported Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性][Buff|增益状态]技能，激活被辅助技能且[LowLife|低血]时，提高你造成的[Attack|攻击]伤害。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing you to deal increased [Attack] Damage while on [LowLife|Low Life] while the Supported Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性][Buff|增益状态]技能，激活被辅助技能且[LowLife|低血]时，提高你造成的[Attack|攻击]伤害。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing your [Minion|Minions] to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性][Buff|增益状态]技能，激活被辅助技能且你的魔力未满时，提高你的[Minion|召唤生物]造成的伤害。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing your [Minion|Minions] to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性][Buff|增益状态]技能，激活被辅助技能且你的魔力未满时，提高你的[Minion|召唤生物]造成的伤害。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing [Freeze] applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性][Buff|增益状态]技能，激活被辅助技能时，缩短对你施加的[Freeze|冻结]的持续时间。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing [Ignite] applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性][Buff|增益状态]技能，激活被辅助技能时，缩短对你施加的[Ignite|点燃]的持续时间。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing [Shock] applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性][Buff|增益状态]技能，激活被辅助技能时，缩短对你施加的[Shock|感电]的持续时间。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased [Evasion|Evasion Rating], with the increase scaling higher the longer the [Attack] time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support [Channelling] Skills.
zh: 辅助你使用的[Attack|攻击]技能。使用被辅助技能时你的[Evasion|闪避值]提高，被辅助技能的[Attack|攻击]时间越长该比例越高。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能。

en: Supports [Banner] Skills, causing those affected by [Aura|Auras] they create to gain Refractive Plating, a [Buff] which grants [Deflect|Deflection Rating] and causes [Armour] to partially apply to [ElementalDamage|Elemental Hit Damage].
zh: 辅助[Banner|旗帜]技能，使受到其[Aura|光环]影响的目标获得折射镀层[Buff|增益状态]，提供[Deflect|偏转值]，使一部分[Armour|护甲]能够对[ElementalDamage|元素击中伤害]生效。

en: Supports [Banner] Skills, causing those affected by [Aura|Auras] they create to gain Refractive Plating, a [Buff] which grants [Deflect|Deflection Rating] and causes [Armour] to partially apply to [ElementalDamage|Elemental Hit Damage].
zh: 辅助[Banner|旗帜]技能，使受到其[Aura|光环]影响的目标获得折射镀层[Buff|增益状态]，提供[Deflect|偏转值]，使一部分[Armour|护甲]能够对[ElementalDamage|元素击中伤害]生效。

en: Supports [Banner] Skills, causing Enemies within their area to gain Refractive Dissolution, a [Debuff] which lowers [Resistances|Elemental Resistances].
zh: 辅助[Banner|旗帜]技能，使其范围内的敌人获得折射消散效果，该[Debuff|减益状态]会降低[Resistances|元素抗性]。

en: Supports Skills which create [Totem|Totems], preventing you from having more than one of that [Totem] but granting significant benefits for Supported [Totem|Totems] based how many allied [Totem|Totems] are near them. Does not Support Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助可创建[Totem|图腾]的技能，但仅允许拥有一个该种[Totem|图腾]，但会依据周围友军拥有的[Totem|图腾]数量，为被辅助的[Totem|图腾]提供显著增益。无法辅助由[Minion|召唤生物]施放的技能。

en: [DNT] Supports Skills which create [Totem|Totems], limiting their active [Totem] count to one but granting significant benefits for supported [Totem|Totems] based how many allied [Totem|Totems] are near them. Does not support Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助放置[Totem|图腾]的技能，将能够激活的[Totem|图腾]数量限制为一个，并根据不受限制时的[Totem|图腾][Limit|上限]，为被辅助的[Totem|图腾]提供大幅加成。无法辅助[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports Skills which create [Totem|Totems], preventing having more than one active [Totem] but causing that [Totem] to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an [Attack] or [Spell], with each [Totem] becoming less effective. Each splintered [Totem] can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by [Minion|Minions]. Only one [Totem] can be splintering at a time.
zh: 辅助可创建[Totem|图腾]的技能，但仅允许存在一个激活的[Totem|图腾]。该[Totem|图腾]在使用[Attack|攻击]或[Spell|法术]后会分裂为若干小型分身，且每个分裂出来的[Totem|图腾]效果会减弱。分裂产生的[Totem|图腾]可继续分裂，直至达到最大分裂次数。无法辅助由[Minion|召唤生物]施放的技能。同一时间仅能有一个[Totem|图腾]处于分裂状态。

en: Supports Skills which create [Totem|Totems], preventing having more than one active [Totem] but causing that [Totem] to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an [Attack] or [Spell], with each [Totem] becoming less effective. Each splintered [Totem] can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by [Minion|Minions]. Only one [Totem] can be splintering at a time.
zh: 辅助可创建[Totem|图腾]的技能，但仅允许存在一个激活的[Totem|图腾]。该[Totem|图腾]在使用[Attack|攻击]或[Spell|法术]后会分裂为若干小型分身，且每个分裂出来的[Totem|图腾]效果会减弱。分裂产生的[Totem|图腾]可继续分裂，直至达到最大分裂次数。无法辅助由[Minion|召唤生物]施放的技能。同一时间仅能有一个[Totem|图腾]处于分裂状态。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased [Armour], with the increase scaling higher the longer the [Attack] time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support [Channelling] Skills.
zh: 辅助你使用的[Attack|攻击]技能。使用被辅助技能时你的[Armour|护甲]提高，被辅助技能的[Attack|攻击]时间越长该比例越高。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能。
