en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills apply [EasyTargetDebuff|Easy Target] when [Knockback|Knocking Back] Enemies, causing the next [Projectile] [Attack] [HitDamage|Hit] they take to deal increased Damage.
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能[Knockback|击退]敌人时施加[EasyTargetDebuff|活靶子]，使其受到的下一次[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]造成更高的伤害。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills you use or [Trigger] yourself. [KillingBlow|Killing Blows] with Supported Skills on [Bleeding] enemies create a Blood [Remnant]. Blood [Remnant|Remnants] increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.
zh: 辅助你使用或你自己[Trigger|触发]的[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能对[Bleeding|流血]的敌人造成[KillingBlow|最后一击]会产生一个赤色[Remnant|残片]。收集赤色[Remnant|残片]会在短时间里提高你的生命回复速度。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] you use or [Trigger] yourself. On-Kill effects caused by [KillingBlow|Killing Blows] with Supported Skills on [Bleeding] enemies have a chance to occur twice.
zh: 辅助你使用或你自己[Trigger|触发]的[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]。被辅助技能对[Bleeding|流血]的敌人造成[KillingBlow|最后一击]产生的击败效果有几率生效两次。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills build up [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] more quickly, but cannot themselves [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun].
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能积蓄[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]的速度更快，但其本身无法造成[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills build up [HeavyStun|Stun] more quickly, but cannot themselves [HeavyStun|Stun].
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能积蓄[HeavyStun|晕眩]的速度更快，但其本身无法造成[HeavyStun|晕眩]。

en: Supports [Warcry] Skills. [Attack|Attacks] [Empowered] by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the [Empowered|Empowerment] count of Supported Skills when they are used.
zh: 辅助[Warcry|战吼]技能。被辅助技能[Empowered|强化]的[Attack|攻击]使用时有几率不减少被辅助技能的[Empowered|强化]次数。

en: Supports [Melee] [Strike] Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on [HitDamage|Hit] against [Ignite|Ignited] Enemies.
zh: 辅助你使用的[Melee|近战][Strike|打击]技能。被辅助技能[HitDamage|击中][Ignite|点燃]的敌人时触发熔火喷发。

en: Supports [Attack|Attacks]. Supported Skills are far more likely to inflict [Bleeding] on [HitDamage|Hitting] full Life Enemies.
zh: 辅助[Attack|攻击]。被辅助技能[HitDamage|击中]满血的敌人时造成[Bleeding|流血]的几率大幅提高。

en: Supports [Attack|Attacks] you use or [Trigger] yourself, causing them to [Consume] the Parried [Debuff] on [HitDamage|Hit] to grant you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge]. Cannot support Skills which already [Consume] the Parried [Debuff].
zh: 辅助你使用或你自己[Trigger|触发]的[Attack|攻击]，使其在[HitDamage|击中]时[Consume|消耗]被招架的[Debuff|减益状态]，使你获得一个[Charges|狂怒球]。无法辅助本就可以[Consume|消耗]被招架的[Debuff|减益状态]的技能。

en: Supports Skills that [HitDamage|Hit] Enemies, causing those [HitDamage|Hits] to [Hobble] [Bleeding] Enemies based on a portion of [Physical|Physical Damage] dealt.
zh: 辅助[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能，使[HitDamage|击中]能够根据造成[Physical|物理伤害]的一定比例，使[Bleeding|流血]的敌人[Hobble|跛行]。

en: Supports any Skill that [Consume|Consumes] [Charges], granting a chance for benefits of that [Consume|Consumption] to be doubled.
zh: 辅助[Consume|消耗][Charges|能量球]的技能，使[Consume|消耗]的加成有几率翻倍。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills inflict [Incision] on [HitDamage|Hit], which causes Enemies to be increasingly more likely to be inflicted with [Bleeding]. All [Incision] is removed from a target on inflicting it with [Bleeding].
zh: 辅助[Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能在[HitDamage|击中]时施加[Incision|创口]，使敌人受到[Bleeding|流血]的几率大幅提高。对目标造成[Bleeding|流血]会移除其受到的所有[Incision|创口]。

en: Supports any Skill you use yourself, causing supported Skill to detonate [Volatility] that is present on you. Supported Skill can only be used while you have a certain amount of [Volatility] and cannot support Skills which already have another [Conditional|Condition].
zh: 辅助你使用的任意技能，使被辅助技能引爆你当前具有的[Volatility|无常]。被辅助技能只能在你具有一定数量的[Volatility|无常]后使用，无法辅助已有其他[Conditional|条件]的技能。

en: Supports Skills which require some [Conditional|Condition] to be met for use. Supported Skills can be used an additional time after their [Conditional|Condition] has been met, but meeting that [Conditional|Condition] is harder.
zh: 辅助需要满足[Conditional|条件]才能使用的技能。被辅助技能满足[Conditional|条件]后可以额外使用一次，但[Conditional|条件]会更难满足。

en: Supports Skills that create [Companion|Companions] which can be damaged. [Minion|Minions] created by Supported Skills take a portion of [HitDamage|Hit Damage] you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life.
zh: 辅助产生能够受到伤害的[Companion|伙伴]的技能。被辅助技能产生的[Minion|召唤生物]会替你承担一定比例的[HitDamage|击中伤害]，但其生命上限降低。

en: Supports Skills that create [Companion|Companions] which can be damaged. [Minion|Minions] created by Supported Skills take a portion of [HitDamage|Hit Damage] you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life. A percentage of Damage taken this way is [Recoup|Recouped] by you as Life.
zh: 辅助产生能够受到伤害的[Companion|伙伴]的技能。被辅助技能产生的[Minion|召唤生物]会替你承担一定比例的[HitDamage|击中伤害]，但其生命上限降低。以此方式受到的一部分伤害会[Recoup|吸纳]为你的生命。

en: Supports Skills which create [Hazard|Hazards]. [Hazard|Hazards] created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.
zh: 辅助产生[Hazard|危害]的技能。被辅助技能产生的[Hazard|危害]有几率在触发后的短时间里重新武装。

en: Supports Skills which create [Hazard|Hazards]. [Hazard|Hazards] created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.
zh: 辅助产生[Hazard|危害]的技能。被辅助技能产生的[Hazard|危害]有几率在触发后的短时间里重新武装。

en: Supports Skills which create [Hazard|Hazards], causing those [Hazard|Hazards] to only be able to trigger immediately after creation or at the end of their duration. Created [Hazard|Hazards] have significantly lowered duration, and deal more damage.
zh: 辅助产生[Hazard|危害]的技能，使[Hazard|危害]只能在产生后立即触发或在持续时间结束时触发。产生的[Hazard|危害]持续时间大幅缩短，并且造成更高的伤害。

en: Supports Skills which you use yourself. On using Supported Skills while they are [Empowered], you gain [Volatility].
zh: 辅助你使用的技能。使用被[Empowered|强化]的被辅助技能会使你获得[Volatility|无常]。

en: Supports Skills which fire [Projectile|Projectiles] that are not ground targeted. [Projectile|Projectiles] from Supported Skills randomly [Fork], [Chain] or [Pierce].
zh: 辅助[Projectile|投射物]不以地面为目标的技能。被辅助技能的[Projectile|投射物]随机[Fork|分叉]、[Chain|连锁]或[Pierce|穿透]。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills you use yourself. When Supported [Attack|Attacks] are [Empowered], they have significantly lowered cost and raised [Accuracy].
zh: 辅助你使用的[Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助的[Attack|攻击]被[Empowered|强化]时，其消耗大幅降低，并且提高[Accuracy|命中]。

en: Supports [Attack|Attacks], causing them to [Impale] on [HitDamage|Hit] but making them unable to Extract [Impale] themselves.
zh: 辅助[Attack|攻击]，使其在[HitDamage|击中]时造成[Impale|穿刺]，但其本身无法提取[Impale|穿刺]。

en: Supports skills which have a benefit for [PerfectTiming|Perfectly Timing] their use. On successfully executing [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] with Supported Skills, gain [PerfectionBuff|Perfection], which is a powerful damage buff. However, failing to execute any [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] (even with skills not supported by Perfection) will remove all [PerfectionBuff|Perfection] on you.
zh: 辅助在[PerfectTiming|完美时机]使用能获得加成的技能。被辅助技能成功把握[PerfectTiming|完美时机]会获得[PerfectionBuff|完美]增益状态，大幅提高伤害。未能把握[PerfectTiming|完美时机]（包括未受到完美辅助的技能）会移除你身上的所有[PerfectionBuff|完美]状态。

en: Supports skills that can be used while moving, causing you to move slower while using them, but granting more damage in exchange.
zh: 辅助可在移动时使用的技能，使你在使用技能时移动速度减慢，同时提高伤害。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills. [Bleeding] inflicted with Supported Skills lasts significantly longer, but enemies you inflict [Bleeding] onto with Supported Skills will move and [Attack] faster.
zh: 辅助[Attack|攻击]技能，被辅助技能造成的[Bleeding|流血]持续时间大幅提高，但会加快被施加[Bleeding|流血]的敌人的移动和[Attack|攻击]速度。

en: Supports Skills which [DetonationTime|Detonate] after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before [DetonationTime|Detonation].
zh: 辅助经过一定时间后[DetonationTime|引爆]的技能，缩短[DetonationTime|引爆]前的时间。

en: Supports Skills which [DetonationTime|Detonate] after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before [DetonationTime|Detonation] at the cost of Damage.
zh: 辅助经过一定时间后[DetonationTime|引爆]的技能，大幅缩短[DetonationTime|引爆]前的时间，但会牺牲伤害。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills [Consume] [Maim] on hit, [ArmourBreak|Breaking] a percentage of the [Maim|Maimed] target's [Armour] in doing so. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict [Maim].
zh: 辅助[Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能击中时[Consume|消耗][Maim|瘫痪]，并[ArmourBreak|粉碎][Maim|被瘫痪]目标一定百分比的[Armour|护甲]。被辅助技能自身无法施加[Maim|致残]。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging [HitDamage|Hits]. Supported Skills [ArmourBreak|Break Armour] against [ParriedDebuff|Parried] Enemies.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能。被辅助技能对[ParriedDebuff|被招架]敌人施加[ArmourBreak|粉碎护甲]。

en: Supports [Mark] Skills. Enemies affected by Supported [Mark|Marks] will have their [ArmourBreak|Armour Broken] by [Physical|Physical Damage] they take.
zh: 辅助[Mark|印记]技能。受被辅助[Mark|印记]技能影响的敌人，在受到[Physical|物理伤害]时，[ArmourBreak|护甲破损]。

en: Supports [Mark] Skills. Enemies affected by Supported [Mark|Marks] will have their [ArmourBreak|Armour Broken] by [Physical|Physical Damage] they take.
zh: 辅助[Mark|印记]技能。受被辅助[Mark|印记]技能影响的敌人，在受到[Physical|物理伤害]时，[ArmourBreak|护甲破损]。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging [HitDamage|Hits]. Supported Skills consume a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] on use to powerfully [ArmourBreak|Break Armour].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能。被辅助技能在使用时消耗一个[Charges|狂怒球]，施加强力[ArmourBreak|粉碎护甲]。

en: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging [HitDamage|Hits]. [Bleeding] inflicted by those [HitDamage|Hits] is more effective against [Poison|Poisoned] Enemies, and [Poison] inflicted by Supported Skills is more effective against [Bleeding] Enemies.
zh: 辅助可以造成[HitDamage|击中]伤害的技能。由这些[HitDamage|击中]造成的[Bleeding|出血]对[Poison|中毒]敌人更有效，而由被辅助技能造成的[Poison|中毒]对[Bleeding|出血]敌人更有效。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a [Travel] Skill.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助的技能会逐渐获得更高伤害，直到达到上限。若你使用翻滚闪避或[Travel|旅行]技能，则该加成会重置。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a [Travel] Skill.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助的技能会逐渐获得更高伤害，直到达到上限。若你使用翻滚闪避或[Travel|旅行]技能，则该加成会重置。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself. On spending [Rage] with any skill you will gain a [Buff]. Using Supported Skills consumes this [Buff] to grant you [Rage].
zh: 辅助你使用的技能，当你通过任何技能消耗[Rage|怒火]时，将获得一个[Buff|增益状态]。使用被辅助的技能会消耗此[Buff|增益状态]并为你提供[Rage|怒火]。

en: Supports [Slam|Slam] Skills. Supported Skills create [Hazard|Hazardous] Brambles on the ground that activate after a duration. Enemies which come in contact with these thorns take damage and are [Maim|Maimed]. A maximum of 20 Brambles are allowed at one time. Does not modify Skills used by [Minion|Minions] or [Totem|Totems].
zh: 辅助[Slam|猛击]技能。被辅助技能在地面产生[Hazard|危害]荆棘，在一段时间后激活。接触这些荆棘的敌人受到伤害并被[Maim|瘫痪]。同时最多允许 20 个荆棘存在。不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]或[Totem|图腾]使用的技能。

en: Supports any Skill you use or [Trigger] yourself. Supported Skills cannot consume [Charges] or [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] by any means. Cannot Support Skills which require [Charges] or [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] to be used.
zh: 辅助你自己使用或你自己[Trigger|触发]的技能。被辅助技能无法以任何方式消耗[Charges|能量球]或[ElementalInfusion|灌注]。无法辅助需要消耗[Charges|能量球]或[ElementalInfusion|灌注]才能使用的技能。

en: Supports Skills which can [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. [Shock|Shocking] an enemy with [HitDamage|Hits] from Supported Skills [Trigger|Triggers] Static Shocks, causing that enemy to become a source of [Lightning] damage sending pulses towards nearby enemies.
zh: 辅助可[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能[HitDamage|击中]并使敌人[Shock|感电]，会[Trigger|触发]静电脉冲，使该敌人成为一个[Lightning|闪电]伤害源，向附近的敌人释放脉冲。

en: Supports Skills which create [Totem|Totems], causing those [Totem|Totems] to have more Life.
zh: 辅助产生[Totem|图腾]的技能，使其产生的[Totem|图腾]拥有更多生命。

en: Supports Skills which create [Totem|Totems], causing those [Totem|Totems] to have more Life.
zh: 辅助产生[Totem|图腾]的技能，使其产生的[Totem|图腾]拥有更多生命。

en: Supports Skills which create [Totem|Totems], causing those [Totem|Totems] to have more Life. [Totem|Totems] created by Supported Skills explode on death, dealing [Physical] damage based on their Life.
zh: 辅助产生[Totem|图腾]的技能，使[Totem|图腾]拥有更多生命。被辅助技能产生的[Totem|图腾]被击败时爆炸，根据其生命造成[Physical|物理]伤害。

en: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those Surfaces to grow over time, up to a limit.
zh: 辅助产生地面效果的技能，使地面效果持续扩张至特定上限。

en: Supports Skills which cause [HitDamage|Damaging Hits]. Living Lightning [Minion|Minions] are created when dealing [Lightning] damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with [Chain|Chaining] [Attack|Attacks]. Enemies will not directly engage these [Minion|Minions], and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能。被辅助技能造成[Lightning|闪电]伤害时产生活体闪电[Minion|召唤生物] - 以[Chain|连锁][Attack|攻击]攻击附近敌人的活体电流。敌人不会直接攻击这些[Minion|召唤生物]，但可以穿过它们。不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports Skills which cause [HitDamage|Damaging Hits]. Living Lightning [Minion|Minions] are created when dealing [Lightning] damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with [Chain|Chaining] [Attack|Attacks]. Enemies will not directly engage these [Minion|Minions], and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能。被辅助技能造成[Lightning|闪电]伤害时产生活体闪电[Minion|召唤生物] - 以[Chain|连锁][Attack|攻击]攻击附近敌人的活体电流。敌人不会直接攻击这些[Minion|召唤生物]，但可以穿过它们。不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills, causing them to create [IceFragment|Ice Fragments] on killing [Frozen] Enemies. Cannot Support [Totem] Skills and does not modify Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助[Attack|攻击]技能，使其击败[Frozen|冻结]敌人时产生[IceFragment|冰霜碎片]。无法辅助[Totem|图腾]技能，不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports Skills that [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. When Supported Skills [Shock] an enemy that is nearby other [Shock|Shocked] enemies, trigger Electromagnetism, sucking in nearby enemies, [Hinder|Hindering] them, and dealing [Lightning] damage at an interval.
zh: 辅助可[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能对敌人施加[Shock|感电]时，且该敌人周围存在其他[Shock|感电]敌人时，将触发电磁力场，使附近敌人[Hinder|缓速]并将其吸入中心，以固定间隔造成[Lightning|闪电]伤害。

en: Supports [Projectile|Projectile] skills and any other skills that [Chain|Chain], causing them to [Chain|Chain] more times.
zh: 辅助[Projectile|投射物]技能及其他可[Chain|连锁]的技能，增加它们的[Chain|连锁]次数。

en: Supports any Skill you use yourself which can cause [HitDamage|Damaging Hits]. Supported Skills [Consume] [Ignite] on [HitDamage|Hit] to create pillars of flame, but cannot themselves inflict [Ignite]. Cannot Support Skills which already [Consume] [Ignite], and does not modify the Skills of [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助你自己使用的可造成[HitDamage|伤害性击中]的任意技能。被辅助技能[HitDamage|击中]时[Consume|消耗][Ignite|点燃]产生烈焰之柱，但其本身无法造成[Ignite|点燃]。无法辅助已经[Consume|消耗][Ignite|点燃]的技能，不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]的技能。

en: Supports [Crossbow] [Ammunition] Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher [Attack] speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.
zh: 辅助[Crossbow|战弩][Ammunition|弹药]技能。被辅助技能的[Attack|攻击]速度和弩箭容量大幅提高，但伤害降低，装填时间延长。

en: Supports skills which have a benefit for [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing]. Supported Skills grant at least one [Charges|Endurance Charge] when [HitDamage|Hitting] an enemy with [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing].
zh: 辅助在[PerfectTiming|完美时机]使用能获得加成的技能。被辅助技能以[PerfectTiming|完美时机][HitDamage|击中]敌人时，至少获得一个[Charges|耐力球]。

en: Supports any skill that [HitDamage|Hits] enemies, giving it a chance to gain an [Charges|Endurance Charge] when causing a [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun].
zh: 辅助任意[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能，使其造成[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]时有几率获得一个[Charges|耐力球]。

en: Supports any skill that [HitDamage|Hits] enemies, giving it a chance to gain an [Charges|Endurance Charge] when causing a [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun].
zh: 辅助任意[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能，使其造成[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]时有几率获得一个[Charges|耐力球]。

en: Supports Melee Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Fissures when you land. Cannot Support [Totem] Skills, and does not modify Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助跃入空中的近战技能，使其落地时产生裂缝。无法辅助[Totem|图腾]技能，不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports [Shield] Skills, causing you to gain [Guard] on [Stun|Stunning] Enemies with the Supported Skill.
zh: 辅助[Shield|盾牌]技能，使你用被辅助技能[Stun|晕眩]敌人时获得[Guard|防卫]。

en: Supports [Shield] Skills, causing you to gain [Guard] on [Stun|Stunning] Enemies with the Supported Skill.
zh: 辅助[Shield|盾牌]技能，使你用被辅助技能[Stun|晕眩]敌人时获得[Guard|防卫]。

en: Supports Skills which create [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals]. Damaging Explosions caused by [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] from Supported Skills will [Impale] Enemies.
zh: 辅助产生[IceCrystals|冰晶]的技能。被辅助技能的[IceCrystals|冰晶]造成的伤害性爆炸会[Impale|穿刺]敌人。

en: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助产生可破坏土质物体的技能。在这些物体范围内击败足够敌人后，它们会破碎，释放出飞掠石[Minion|召唤生物]。

en: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助产生可破坏土质物体的技能。在这些物体范围内击败足够敌人后，它们会破碎，释放出飞掠石[Minion|召唤生物]。

en: Supports any Skill which has levels, increasing the level and [Quality], while reducing the cost and [Reservation].
zh: 辅助任何有等级的技能，提高等级和[Quality|品质]，同时降低消耗和[Reservation|保留]。

en: Supports [Curse] Skills. Enemies [Curse|Cursed] by Supported Skills are [Pacify|Pacified] for the final portion of the Supported [Curse|Curse's] duration.
zh: 辅助[Curse|诅咒]技能。被辅助技能[Curse|诅咒]的敌人在被辅助[Curse|诅咒]持续时间的最后阶段被[Pacify|宁心]。

en: Supports Skills which create objects that are destroyed after being [HitDamage|Hit] a number of times, allowing for them to last for additional [HitDamage|Hits]. Does not modify Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助产生被[HitDamage|击中]一定次数后被破坏的物体的技能，使其可以承受额外次数的[HitDamage|击中]。不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports Skills that can cause [HitDamage|Damaging Hits], granting extra [Chaos] damage and causing [Chaos] damage to [Contributes|Contribute] to [Ignite|Ignites].
zh: 辅助可造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能，提供额外[Chaos|混沌]伤害，使[Chaos|混沌]伤害[Contributes|作用于][Ignite|点燃]。

en: Supports Skills that can cause [HitDamage|Damaging Hits], granting extra [Chaos] damage and causing [Chaos] damage to [Contributes|Contribute] to [Shock].
zh: 辅助可造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能，提供额外[Chaos|混沌]伤害，使[Chaos|混沌]伤害[Contributes|作用于][Shock|感电]。

en: Supports Skills that can cause [HitDamage|Damaging Hits], granting extra [Chaos] damage and causing [Chaos] damage to [Contributes|Contribute] to [Freeze|Freeze Buildup].
zh: 辅助可造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能，提供额外[Chaos|混沌]伤害，使[Chaos|混沌]伤害[Contributes|作用于][Freeze|冻结积蓄]。

en: Supports Skills that can cause [HitDamage|Damaging Hits], granting extra [Chaos] damage and causing [Chaos] damage to [ArmourBreak|Break Armour].
zh: 辅助可造成伤害性[HitDamage|击中]的技能，提供额外[Chaos|混沌]伤害，使[Chaos|混沌]伤害[ArmourBreak|粉碎护甲]。

en: Supports Skills that can cause [HitDamage|Damaging Hits], causing those [HitDamage|Hits] to treat Enemy [Resistances|Elemental Resistances] as inverted.
zh: 辅助可造成[HitDamage|伤害性击中]的技能，使[HitDamage|击中]将敌人的[Resistances|元素抗性]视为反转。

en: Supports [Attack] skills, granting them [Attack] Speed at the cost of Damage or Damage at the cost of [Attack] Speed depending on [WeaponSets|Weapon Set] they are used in. Does not modify skills used by [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助[Attack|攻击]技能，根据使用的[WeaponSets|武器组]，以伤害为代价提供[Attack|攻击]速度，或以[Attack|攻击]速度为代价提供伤害。不会修改[Minion|召唤生物]使用的技能。

en: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
zh: 辅助可升级的技能，在没有其他辅助宝石修改被辅助技能的情况下，提供大量额外等级。

en: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
zh: 辅助可升级的技能，在恰好有一个其他辅助宝石修改被辅助技能的情况下，提供额外等级。无法辅助没有等级的技能。

en: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
zh: 辅助可升级的技能，在恰好有两个其他辅助宝石修改被辅助技能的情况下，提供额外等级。无法辅助没有等级的技能。

en: Supports [Banner] Skills, causing them to require significantly less [Glory] to use.
zh: 辅助[Banner|旗帜]技能，使其需要的[Glory|荣耀]大幅降低。

en: Supports [Curse] [Spell|Spells] you cast yourself, causing those [Curse|Curses] to ignore the usual [Curse] [Limit], but be reflected back to you when inflicted.
zh: 辅助你释放的[Curse|诅咒][Spell|法术]技能，使这些[Curse|诅咒]突破通常的[Curse|诅咒][Limit|上限]，但施放时会将效果反弹至你自身。

en: [DNT] Supports [Spell|Spells] you use yourself which [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. On [Critical|Critical Hit] with supported [Spell|Spells], [Trigger] Atziri's Storm at the location of the nearest enemy.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的能[HitDamage|击中]敌人的[Spell|法术]。当被辅助的[Spell|法术]造成[Critical|暴击]时，在最近敌人的位置[Trigger|触发]阿兹里风暴。

en: Supports [Persistent] Skills, making them [Reservation|Reserve] Life instead of [Spirit]. Cannot Support Skills which create [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性]技能，使其改为[Reservation|保留]生命而非[Spirit|精魂]。无法辅助产生[Minion|召唤生物]的技能。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself that have Cooldowns, dramatically increasing the rate at which those [CooldownRecovery|Cooldowns Recover], but causing you to lose Life, Mana, and Energy Shield when they are used. Cannot Support [Meta] Skills or [Persistent] Skills, or modify the Skills of [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助拥有冷却时间的技能，大幅提升其[CooldownRecovery|冷却回复]速度，但使用时会消耗你的生命、魔力与能量护盾。无法辅助[Meta|非凡]技能、[Persistent|永久性]技能或影响[Minion|召唤生物]的技能。

en: Supports Skills which can cause [HitDamage|Damaging Hits]. [Poison] inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your [Rage].
zh: 辅助可造成[HitDamage|伤害性击中]的技能。根据你的[Rage|怒火]数量，被辅助技能施加的[Poison|中毒]伤害生效更快。

en: Supports [Cascadable|Cascadable] [Spell|Spells] you cast yourself. Supported [Spell|Spells] [Cascadable|Echo] thrice, but are given a Cooldown. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown.
zh: 辅助你自身施放的[Cascadable|扩散] [Spell|法术]。被辅助的法术产生 3 次[Spell|法术] [Cascadable|回响]，但会增加冷却时间。无法辅助有冷却时间的技能。

en: Supports [Attack] Skills you use yourself which do not already have some [Conditional|Condition] for use. Supported Skills have a maximum [Critical|Critical Hit chance], but will [ForksCrit|Bifurcate Critical Hit Chance].
zh: 辅助你自己使用且不具有使用[Conditional|条件]的[Attack|攻击]技能。被辅助技能将拥有最大[Critical|暴击率]，但会[ForksCrit|分叉暴击率]。

en: Supports [Command|Commandable Minions] causing you and the Supported [Minion] to gain [UnholyMight|Unholy Might] when you [Command] them.
zh: 辅助[Command|可命令的召唤生物]，使你和被辅助[Minion|召唤生物]在[Command|命令]它们时获得[UnholyMight|不洁之力]。

en: Supports [Offering] Skills, causing your [Cascadable|Cascadable] [Spell|Spells] to [Cascadable|Cascade] to the locations of Supported [Offering|Offerings].
zh: 辅助[Offering|奉献]技能，使你的[Cascadable|可扩散][Spell|法术][Cascadable|扩散]至被辅助的[Offering|奉献]技能的所在位置。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Minion] Skills, granting a chance when Supported [Minion|Minions] die for you to gain an Abyssal Monster Modifier.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|永久性][Minion|召唤生物]的技能，使被辅助的[Minion|召唤生物]为你而被击败后有几率获得一个深渊怪物词缀。

en: Supports any Skill that can deal damage, causing it to deal more damage for each different [Command] Skill you have used in the past few seconds. Cannot modify the Skills of [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助任意可造成伤害的技能，根据你在过去几秒内使用过的不同[Command|命令]技能的数量，提高其伤害。无法影响[Minion|召唤生物]的技能。

en: Supports [Fire] [Spell] Skills causing you to gain [ElementalArchon|Elemental Archon] when [Ignite|Igniting] with them.
zh: 辅助[Fire|火焰][Spell|法术]技能。用被辅助技能[Ignite|点燃]敌人时有获得[ElementalArchon|元素执政官]。

en: Supports any Skill that [HitDamage|Hits] Enemies, causing it to deal increasingly higher damage the more [Poison|Poisons] are on the target.
zh: 辅助任意[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能，目标身上[Poison|中毒]越多，造成的伤害越高。

en: Supports Skills which have a benefit for [PerfectTiming|Perfectly Timing] their use. On successfully executing [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] with Supported Skills, gain Tasalio's Rhythm. Tasalio's Rhythm causes Supported Skills to deal more damage and have shorter [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] windows for each stack. Failing to execute any [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] (even with skills not supported by Tasalio's Rhythm) will remove all Tasalio's Rhythm on you.
zh: 辅助在[PerfectTiming|完美时机]使用能获得加成的技能。被辅助技能成功把握[PerfectTiming|完美时机]会获得塔萨里奥的律动。塔萨里奥的律动会使被辅助技能造成更多伤害，且每层律动都会缩短技能的[PerfectTiming|完美时机]判定窗口。未能把握[PerfectTiming|完美时机]（包括未受到塔萨里奥的律动辅助的技能）会移除你身上的所有塔萨里奥的律动。

en: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing [Corpse|Corpses] in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.
zh: 辅助可跃向空中的技能。落地时，使你着陆区域内的[Corpse|灵柩]猛烈爆炸，并对周围敌人造成伤害。

en: Supports Skills that generate [Remnant|Remnants]. Picking up [Remnant|Remnants] from Supported Skills grants [KhatalsRejuvenation|Khatal's Rejuvenation].
zh: 辅助可生成[Remnant|残片]的技能。拾取被辅助技能生成的[Remnant|残片]时，将获得[KhatalsRejuvenation|卡塔尔的复苏]。

en: Supports [Storm] skills, increasing their [Limit] and causing them to move quickly from the user to the target location, but become less effective. Cannot Support [Trigger|Triggered] Skills.
zh: 辅助[Storm|风暴]技能，增加其数量[Limit|上限]，并使其从玩家处更快移向目标地点，但效果会减弱。无法辅助[Trigger|触发]类技能。

en: Supports any Skill that creates [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals], causing that Skill to [Consume] a [Charges|Power Charge] if possible to create [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground] around the [IceCrystals|Crystal].
zh: 辅助生成[IceCrystals|冰晶]的技能，若有可能，该技能将[Consume|消耗]一个[Charges|暴击球]以在[IceCrystals|冰晶]周围生成[ChilledGround|冰缓地面]。

en: Supports [Mark] Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech [ManaLeech|Mana] to you when you [HitDamage|Hit] them with [Attack|Attacks].
zh: 辅助[Mark|印记]技能，你的[Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]被施加印记的敌人时可偷取[ManaLeech|魔力]。

en: Supports [Mark] Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech [LifeLeech|Life] and [ManaLeech|Mana] to you when you [HitDamage|Hit] them with [Attack|Attacks].
zh: 辅助[Mark|印记]技能，你的[Attack|攻击][HitDamage|击中]被施加印记的敌人时可偷取[LifeLeech|生命]和[ManaLeech|魔力]。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself which [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. [CullingStrike|Culling] a [Shock|Shocked] enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your [Attack|Attacks] with [Lightning] damage for a short time.
zh: 辅助你使用的[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能[CullingStrike|终结][Shock|感电]状态的敌人时，将为你的所有[Attack|攻击]短暂附加[Lightning|闪电]伤害。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself which [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. [CullingStrike|Culling] a [Shock|Shocked] enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your [Attack|Attacks] with [Lightning] damage and grants an increased chance to [Shock] for a short time.
zh: 辅助你使用的[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能[CullingStrike|终结][Shock|感电]状态的敌人时，将为你的所有[Attack|攻击]短暂附加[Lightning|闪电]伤害并提高[Shock|感电]几率。

en: Supports [Warcry|Warcries]. Supported Skills apply [Exposure] on [HitDamage|Hitting] enemies.
zh: 辅助[Warcry|战吼]技能。被辅助的技能在[HitDamage|击中]敌人时会施加[Exposure|曝露]效果。

en: Supports [Travel] Skills which [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. [HitDamage|Hits] with Supported Skills against enemies on full life will [Daze].
zh: 辅助可[HitDamage|击中]敌人的[Travel|旅行]技能。被辅助的技能对满血敌人的[HitDamage|击中]将造成[Daze|恍惚]。

en: Supports [Plant] Skills, causing them to [Trigger] an explosion after they have been [Plant|Overgrown].
zh: 辅助[Plant|植物技能与蔓生]，使其在[Plant|蔓生]后[Trigger|触发]爆炸。

en: Supports [Plant] Skills, causing them to [Trigger] an explosion after they have been [Plant|Overgrown], [Blind|Blinding] enemies [HitDamage|Hit].
zh: 辅助[Plant|植物技能与蔓生]，使其在[Plant|蔓生]后[Trigger|触发]爆炸，并[Blind|致盲]被[HitDamage|击中]的敌人。

en: Supports [Wind] Skills which [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. [HitDamage|Hits] with Supported Skills against [Ignite|Ignited] enemies [Trigger] a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them.
zh: 辅助可[HitDamage|击中]敌人的[Wind|风系]技能。被辅助的技能[HitDamage|击中]处于[Ignite|点燃]状态的敌人将[Trigger|触发]火焰爆炸，对该敌人及其身后的锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害。

en: Supports [Wind] Skills which [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. [HitDamage|Hits] with Supported Skills against [Ignite|Ignited] enemies [Trigger] a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them. The explosion [AilmentSpread|Spreads] the initial enemy's [Ignite] to other enemies [HitDamage|Hit].
zh: 辅助可[HitDamage|击中]敌人的[Wind|风系]技能。被辅助的技能[HitDamage|击中]处于[Ignite|点燃]状态的敌人将[Trigger|触发]火焰爆炸，对该敌人及其身后的锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害。该爆炸会将初始敌人的[Ignite|点燃]状态[AilmentSpread|传播]给其他被[HitDamage|击中]的敌人。

en: Supports Skills which [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. [Shock|Shocking] an enemy with Supported Skills [Trigger|Triggers] Coursing Current, which sends [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] [Projectile|Projectiles] to nearby [Drenched] enemies.
zh: 辅助可[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能[Shock|感电]敌人会[Trigger|触发]奔雷疾走，向附近处于[Drenched|浸湿]状态的敌人发射[Chain|连锁]的[Lightning|闪电][Projectile|投射物]。

en: Supports [Plant] Skills which [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. Supported Skills [Trigger] Toxic Pustule on [HitDamage|Hitting] an enemy.
zh: 辅助可[HitDamage|击中]敌人的[Plant|植物技能与蔓生]。被辅助的技能在[HitDamage|击中]敌人时[Trigger|触发]剧毒芽孢。

en: Supports [Curse] Skills, giving them a short cooldown but causing them to create areas which [Curse] enemies so long as they are within them. [Curse|Cursed] areas from Supported Skills gather power before erupting in a column of annihilating light after a moderate delay.
zh: 辅助[Curse|诅咒]类技能。被辅助技能会拥有短暂的冷却时间，但会生成多个区域，敌人处于区域内将持续被[Curse|诅咒]。被辅助技能生成的[Curse|诅咒]区域会积蓄力量，经过短暂延迟后迸发一束摧残之光。

en:
Supports [Attack|Attacks] and [Warcry|Warcries] you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a [Glory] requirement, and build [Glory] when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly
 increased area of effect.
zh:
辅助你施放的[Attack|攻击]与[Warcry|战吼]。被辅助的技能将需要消耗[Glory|荣耀]，并且当你在技能上消耗生命时会积攒[Glory|荣耀]。被辅助的技能会造成更多伤害，并显著
扩大影响范围。

en: Supports [Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] Skills, causing them to grant [HelbrymsComposure|Helbrym's Composure] for a brief duration when they cause you to [Shapeshift]. [Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] into a different form before the [Buff] expires causes it to be removed without effect.
zh: 辅助[Shapeshift|变形]技能，使你[Shapeshift|变形]时，于短时间内获得[HelbrymsComposure|赫尔布林的沉着]。若在结束前再次[Shapeshift|变形]为不同形态，该[Buff|增益状态]将被移除且不产生效果。

en: Supports [Channelling] Skills you use yourself. While [Channelling] Supported Skills, periodically gain stages of Deadly Resolve. Expend a stage of Deadly Resolve when an enemy [HitDamage|Hits] you to [Trigger] a deadly slash towards that enemy, dealing more damage based on your [Armour].
zh: 辅助你使用的[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能。在[Channelling|持续吟唱]被辅助技能时，会周期性获得致命决心层数，之后当你被[HitDamage|击中]时，消耗一层致命决心，[Trigger|触发]一次致命的斩击，造成的伤害会基于你的[Armour|护甲]提高。

en: Supports [Storm] skills, causing them to appear at the user's location and move towards the target location.
zh: 辅助[Storm|风暴]技能，使其从玩家处产生，并向目标位置移动。

en: Supports [Warcry|Warcries]. Supported Skills [Cascadable|Echo] twice, and their area grows larger each time, but are less effective and require you to have travelled a certain distance before use.
zh: 辅助[Warcry|战吼]类技能。被辅助技能会[Cascadable|回响] 2 次，每次范围扩大，但效果降低，并且需要你在使用前移动一定距离。

en: Supports skills that consume [Corpse|Corpses]. Consuming [Corpse|Corpses] with supported skills grants [Flask] charges.
zh: 辅助消耗[Corpse|灵柩]的技能。使用被辅助的技能消耗[Corpse|灵柩]会获得[Flask|药剂]充能。

en: Supports Skills which generate [Charges]. When generating [Charges|Power Charge] with Supported Skills, [Empowered|Empower] some of your [Attack|Attacks] to [Trigger] Spark [Projectile|Projectiles] on use.
zh: 辅助可生成[Charges|能量球]的技能。当你使用被辅助的技能生成[Charges|暴击球]时，会[Empowered|强化]你的部分[Attack|攻击]，使其在使用时[Trigger|触发]火花[Projectile|投射物]。

en: Supports Skills which generate [Charges]. When generating [Charges|Power Charge] with Supported Skills, [Empowered|Empower] some of your [Attack|Attacks] to [Trigger] Spark [Projectile|Projectiles] on use.
zh: 辅助可生成[Charges|能量球]的技能。当你使用被辅助的技能生成[Charges|暴击球]时，会[Empowered|强化]你的部分[Attack|攻击]，使其在使用时[Trigger|触发]火花[Projectile|投射物]。

en: Supports Skills which create [Hazard|Hazards], causing those [Hazard|Hazards] to be unable to be triggered for 3 seconds after being created.
zh: 辅助产生[Hazard|危害]的技能，使这些[Hazard|危害]在生成后的 3 秒内无法被触发。

en: Supports Skills which can [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. [HitDamage|Hits] with Supported Skills which [Freeze] enemies cause [Physical] damage against them to [ArmourBreak|Break their Armour] while they remain [Freeze|Frozen].
zh: 辅助可[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能。若使用被辅助技能[HitDamage|击中]，从而使敌人[Freeze|冻结]，在其保持[Freeze|冻结]状态期间，对其造成的[Physical|物理]伤害会造成[ArmourBreak|护甲破损]。

en: Supports [Strike|Strikes] that perform a [FinalStrike|Final Strike] at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the [FinalStrike|Final Strike] to [ArmourBreak|Break Armour] based on a portion of [Attack] damage dealt.
zh: 辅助可在连击结束时发动[FinalStrike|绝杀打击]的[Strike|打击]技能，使该[FinalStrike|绝杀打击]能基于所造成的[Attack|攻击]伤害的一部分使敌人[ArmourBreak|护甲破损]。

en: Supports Skills which [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] an enemy with Supported Skills increases your [Spell] damage for a duration.
zh: 辅助可[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能使敌人[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]后，会在持续一段时间内提高你的[Spell|法术]伤害。

en: Supports Skills which [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] an enemy with Supported Skills increases your [Spell] damage for a duration.
zh: 辅助可[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能使敌人[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]后，会在持续一段时间内提高你的[Spell|法术]伤害。

en: Supports Skills you use yourself which [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. [Critical|Critical Hits] with Supported Skills imbue all of your [Attack|Attacks] with [Fire] damage for a duration.
zh: 辅助你使用的可[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能造成[Critical|暴击]后，会在持续一段时间内为你所有的[Attack|攻击]附加[Fire|火焰]伤害。

en: Supports [Spell|Spells] which [HitDamage|Hit] enemies. Supported Skills [Daze] on [Critical|Critically Hitting] enemies with [Physical] damage.
zh: 辅助可[HitDamage|击中]敌人的[Spell|法术]。被辅助的技能若以[Physical|物理]伤害对敌人造成[Critical|暴击]，则会使其[Daze|恍惚]。

en: Supports [Mark] Skills, causing them to not be [Consume|Consumed] the first time they are [MarkActivate|Activated].
zh: 辅助[Mark|印记]技能，使其第一次[MarkActivate|激活]时不会被[Consume|消耗]。

en: Supports Skills which are boosted by [ElementalGround|Elemental Ground Surfaces], [Trigger|Triggering] Catalysing Discharge of the corresponding type when they are boosted by an allied [ElementalGround|Elemental Ground Surface].
zh: 辅助那些可通过[ElementalGround|元素地面效果]获得强化的技能。当它们因友方创造的[ElementalGround|元素地面效果]而获得强化时，将[Trigger|触发]相应类型的催化迸放效果。

en: Supports [Projectile|Projectile] Skills, making them fire extra [Projectile|Projectiles] in a circle, at the cost of Damage and gaining a cooldown. Does not Support Skills which rain down [Projectile|Projectiles] from above. Cannot Support Skills which already have a cooldown.
zh: 辅助[Projectile|投射物]类技能，使其以环形发射额外[Projectile|投射物]，但会降低伤害并获得冷却时间。无法辅助从空中降下[Projectile|投射物]的技能，也无法辅助已有冷却时间的技能。

en: Supports [Mark] Skills, causing them to [Trigger] Charged Mark when they are [MarkActivate|Activated]. Charged Mark creates [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground] at the target's location.
zh: 辅助[Mark|印记]技能，使其[MarkActivate|激活]时[Trigger|触发]充能印记。充能印记会在目标位置生成[ShockedGround|感电地面]。

en: Supports Skills which create [Minion|Minions] which [Strike], causing those [Minion|Minions]' [Strike|Strikes] to have [MeleeSplash|Melee Splash].
zh: 辅助可创造[Minion|召唤生物]并进行[Strike|打击]的技能，使这些[Minion|召唤生物]的[Strike|打击]获得[MeleeSplash|近战伤害扩散]效果。

en: Supports Skills which create [Minion|Minions] which [Strike], increasing their Area of Effect and causing those [Minion|Minions]' [Strike|Strikes] to have [MeleeSplash|Melee Splash].
zh: 辅助可创造[Minion|召唤生物]并进行[Strike|打击]的技能，扩大其效果范围，并使这些[Minion|召唤生物]的[Strike|打击]获得[MeleeSplash|近战伤害扩散]效果。

en: Supports [Persistent|Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing enemies that enter your [Presence] to become [Intimidate|Intimidated] while the Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|持续性] [Buff|增益状态]技能。技能激活时，进入你[Presence|存在]范围内的敌人会[Intimidate|被威吓]。

en: Supports non-[Channelling] skill you use yourself that [HitDamage|Hits] enemies, causing it to gain [Critical|Critical Hit] chance based on [Rage], but also remove all [Rage] upon [Critical|Critically Hitting].
zh: 辅助任何你施放的、能够[HitDamage|击中]敌人的非[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能，使其根据[Rage|怒气]获得[Critical|暴击]几率，但当你[Critical|暴击]时也会使你失去所有[Rage|怒气]。

en: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, providing a chance for enemies to calculate their [HitDamage|Hits] as though your [Resistances] were 90% while the skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|持续性] [Buff|增益状态]技能。技能激活时，有几率使敌人的[HitDamage|击中]视你的[Resistances|抗性]为 90%来计算。

en: Supports skills with Cooldowns, causing them to grant [OverflowingChalice|Overflowing Chalice] when used. Supported skills deal more damage during the effect of your Life Flask and have increased Mana Cost [Efficiency] during the effect of your Mana Flask.
zh: 辅助有冷却时间的技能，使其在使用时获得[OverflowingChalice|满溢圣杯]。被辅助技能在生命药剂生效期间造成更多伤害，并在魔力药剂生效期间提高魔力消耗[Efficiency|效能]。

en: Supports non-instant [Spell|Spells] you cast yourself. Supported [Spell|Spells] will [Trigger] Fragment Self, creating a Fractured Mimic which will cast that [Spell] if you get enough of them.
zh: 辅助你自己施放的非瞬发[Spell|法术]。被辅助的[Spell|法术]将[Trigger|触发]“破碎拟像”，创造一个破碎拟像，若你获得足够数量的拟像，它们将施放该[Spell|法术]。

en: Supports [Persistent|Persistent] [Buff|Buff] Skills, causing you periodically grant [Guard] to allies in your [Presence] while the Skill is active.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|持续性] [Buff|增益状态]技能。技能激活时，定期为你[Presence|存在]范围内的盟友提供[Guard|防卫]。

en: Supports Skills which summon [Companion|Companions] causing them to be [Gigantic] and gain [Evasion] and [Deflect|Deflection] based on your own.
zh: 辅助召唤[Companion|伙伴]的技能，使其体型变为[Gigantic|庞然大物]，并获得基于你自身的[Evasion|闪避]和[Deflect|偏转]。

en: Supports [Lightning] skills that [HitDamage|Hit] targets, granting them an additional level and causing them to [BooleanDamageRoll|only roll the minimum or maximum value] for [Lightning] damage. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
zh: 辅助[HitDamage|击中]目标的[Lightning|闪电]技能，使其等级 +1，并且造成的[Lightning|闪电]伤害[BooleanDamageRoll|仅取最小值或最大值]。无法辅助没有等级的技能。

en: Supports any skill that [HitDamage|Hits] enemies, causing it to [ArmourBreak|Break Armour] of enemies it [Freeze|Freezes] or [Electrocute|Electrocutes].
zh: 辅助能够[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能，使其对[Freeze|冻结]或[Electrocute|触电]的敌人造成[ArmourBreak|护甲破损]。

en: Supports [Lightning] or [Cold] skills you use yourself which fire [Projectile|Projectiles] and do not already have cooldowns, adding a cooldown and making the [Projectile|Projectiles] return, piercing through targets as they do so.
zh: 辅助你使用的、发射[Projectile|投射物]且尚无冷却时间的[Lightning|闪电]或[Cold|冰霜]技能，增加技能冷却时间，并使[Projectile|投射物]能够返回，返回时穿透目标。

en: Supports [Warcry|Warcries], causing them to destroy [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] and [IceFragment|Ice Fragments]. Supported Skills empower additional [Attack|Attacks] if they destroy enough [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] and [IceFragment|Ice Fragments].
zh: 辅助[Warcry|战吼]类技能，使其能够摧毁[IceCrystals|冰晶]和[IceFragment|冰霜碎片]。若被辅助技能摧毁足够数量的[IceCrystals|冰晶]和[IceFragment|冰霜碎片]，则会强化额外的[Attack|攻击]。

en: Supports [Melee] [Attack] Skills. Supported Skills gain [Combo] when you successfully [Strike] Enemies with other [Melee] [Attack|Attacks]. Supported Skills expend their [Combo] when used, gaining more area of effect the higher [Combo] they had. Cannot support skills which already gain [Combo]. Cannot modify the Skills of [Minion|Minions].
zh: 辅助[Melee|近战] [Attack|攻击]技能。当你使用其他[Melee|近战] [Attack|攻击]成功[Strike|打击]敌人时，被辅助技能获得[Combo|连击]。被辅助技能使用时花费[Combo|连击]数，使用时[Combo|连击]数越高，获得的效果区域越大。无法辅助能获得[Combo|连击]的技能。无法修改[Minion|召唤生物]的技能。

en: Supports non-instant skills which have a cooldown, granting them two additional cooldown uses and more damage per different skill with a cooldown you have used recently.
zh: 辅助有冷却时间的非瞬发技能，为其增加 2 次额外的冷却使用次数，并且你近期每使用一种不同的具有冷却时间的技能，被辅助技能就会获得更多伤害。

en: Supports [Melee|Melee Attacks] you use yourself, causing them to attack faster the more [Rage] you have and grant [Rage] on Hit, but also making you lose Life based on your [Rage] when using them.
zh: 辅助你施展的[Melee|近战攻击]，使其根据你拥有的[Rage|怒气]提高攻击速度，并在击中时提供[Rage|怒气]，但使用时也会根据你的[Rage|怒气]损失生命。

en: Supports skills which [HitDamage|Hit] targets and have an area of effect, increasing the affected area and causing it to [HitDamage|Hit] [Isolated] targets harder.
zh: 辅助具有效果区域且能[HitDamage|击中]目标的技能，使其范围扩大，并对[Isolated|孤立]目标造成更高的[HitDamage|击中]伤害。

en: Supports Skills that Raise your Shield causing your other melee skills to deal more damage if you block.
zh: 辅助架盾技能，使你在格挡时，其他近战技能造成更多伤害。

en: Supports Shield Skills that [HitDamage|Hit] enemies, causing those Hits to [Crushed|Crush] their targets, additionally causing any [Physical|Physical Damage] [HitDamage|Hits] against those targets while [Crushed] to [ArmourBreak|Break their Armour].
zh: 辅助能够[HitDamage|击中]敌人的盾牌技能，使这些击中能够[Crushed|碾压]目标。此外，在被[Crushed|碾压]期间，针对这些目标的任何[Physical|物理伤害][HitDamage|击中]都会造成[ArmourBreak|护甲破损]。

en: Supports skills which create [Companion|Companions], causing enemies near them to be [Blind|Blinded] and [Ignite|Ignited]. The damage of the [Ignite] is based on the Life of the supported [Minion].
zh: 辅助能够创造[Companion|伙伴]的技能，[Blind|致盲]并[Ignite|点燃]伙伴附近的敌人。[Ignite|点燃]伤害基于被辅助召唤生物的生命值。

en: Supports any skill that [HitDamage|Hits] enemies, causing them to deal more damage and trigger Nature's Exchange when consuming [Freeze] on enemies. Cannot support skills that [Consume|Consume] [Freeze|Freeze].
zh: 辅助能够[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能，造成更多伤害，并在消耗敌人的[Freeze|冰冻]时触发自然交换。无法辅助会[Consume|消耗][Freeze|冰冻]的技能。

en: Supports [Cascadable|Cascadable] [Spell|Spells] you cast yourself, [Seal|Sealing] them when you [Block], The [Seal|Seals] are broken when used, each making the [Spell] [Cascadable|Echo]. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
zh: 辅助你自己施放的[Cascadable|可扩散][Spell|法术]，在你[Block|格挡]时为其附加[Seal|封印]。使用时打破[Seal|封印]，每层封印使该[Spell|法术]产生一次[Cascadable|回响]。无法辅助有冷却时间或能获得封印的技能。

en: Supports [Attack|Attacks], causing a Runic Shockwave to erupt under enemies they [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun]. The Shockwave costs [Ward|Runic Ward], and will not [Trigger] if you do not have enough [Ward|Runic Ward].
zh: 辅助[Attack|攻击]，使被你[HeavyStun|重度晕眩]的敌人脚下爆发出符文震波。该冲击波消耗[Ward|符文结界]，若你的[Ward|符文结界]不足，则不会[Trigger|触发]。

en: Supports [Attack|Attacks] you use or [Trigger] yourself, causing them to cost [Ward|Runic Ward] to use but deal additional [Physical] damage based on their [Ward|Runic Ward] cost. Cannot Support [Channelling] Skills, [Sustained] Skills, or Skills without a cost.
zh: 辅助你自己使用或你自己[Trigger|触发]的[Attack|攻击]，使其使用时消耗[Ward|符文结界]，并根据其消耗的[Ward|符文结界]值造成额外[Physical|物理]伤害。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能、[Sustained|持续性]技能或或无消耗的技能。

en: Supports [Attack|Attacks] you use yourself, causing them to [Consume] [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour] on enemies to fire a nova of runic [Projectile|Projectiles] at the cost of [Ward|Runic Ward]. The [Projectile|Projectiles] cannot [HitDamage|Hit] the enemy from which they originated. Cannot support skills that [Consume|Consume] [ArmourBreak|Broken Armour].
zh: 辅助你自身施放的[Attack|攻击]技能，使其[Consume|消耗]敌人的[ArmourBreak|护甲完全破损]状态，以[Ward|符文结界]为代价，发射一圈符文[Projectile|投射物]。这些[Projectile|投射物]无法[HitDamage|击中]产生它们的敌人。无法辅助[Consume|消耗][ArmourBreak|护甲破损]的技能。

en: Supports any Skill that deals damage. Enemies you kill with supported Skills have a chance to drop a [VerisiumInfusion|Verisium Infusion] [Remnant].
zh: 辅助能够造成伤害的技能。使用被辅助技能击杀的敌人有几率掉落一个[VerisiumInfusion|维金灌注][Remnant|残片]。

en: Supports any skill that [HitDamage|Hits] enemies, causing inflicted [Ignite|Ignites] to deal more damage but the skill to gain a [Ward|Runic Ward] cost.
zh: 辅助任何[HitDamage|击中]敌人的技能，使施加的[Ignite|点燃]造成更多伤害，但该技能会获得[Ward|符文结界]消耗。

en: Supports [Slam|Slams] you use yourself, allowing them to spend large amounts of [Ward|Runic Ward] to become Runically Boosted. Runically Boosted [Slam|Slams] are [Empowered] with extra [Physical] damage and create a rune the first time they hit an enemy. The rune erupts in an [Aftershock] after a duration. Cannot support [Channelling] Skills.
zh: 辅助你自己使用的[Slam|猛击]技能，使其能够消耗大量[Ward|符文结界]以获得符文加持。符文加持的[Slam|猛击]技能获得额外的[Physical|物理]伤害[Empowered|强化]，并在首次击中敌人时创造一个符文。该符文经过一段时间后会以[Aftershock|余震]的形式爆发。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能。

en: Supports [Persistent|Persistent] [Buff|Buff] Skills, causing you to lose [Ward|Runic Ward] and heal nearby allies based on the [Ward] lost. Healing done is split between allies who are not on full Life.
zh: 辅助[Persistent|持续性] [Buff|增益状态]技能，使你失去[Ward|符文结界]，并根据失去的[Ward|符文结界]治疗附近的盟友。治疗量在非满生命的盟友之间分摊。

en: Supports skills that can [Empowered|Empower] a specific number of other skills, causing them to apply to more skill uses.
zh: 辅助能够[Empowered|强化]特定数量其他技能的技能，使其可以应用于更多技能使用次数。

en: Supports [Attack|Attacks] you use or [Trigger] yourself, causing them to cost [Ward|Runic Ward] to use but deal additional [Physical] and [Cold] damage based on their [Ward|Runic Ward] cost, in addition to causing [Physical] damage to [Contributes|Contribute] to [Freeze] buildup. Cannot Support [Channelling] Skills, [Sustained] Skills, or Skills without a cost.
zh: 辅助你自己使用或你自己[Trigger|触发]的[Attack|攻击]，使其使用时消耗[Ward|符文结界]，并根据消耗的[Ward|符文结界]值造成额外的[Physical|物理]和[Cold|冰霜]伤害，此外，[Physical|物理]伤害也会[Contributes|作用于][Freeze|冻结]积蓄。无法辅助[Channelling|持续吟唱]技能、[Sustained|持续性]技能或无消耗的技能。

zh: 给每个时空之门使用一种随机外观

en: Use random variations for all portals
zh: 给所有时空之门使用随机外观

en:
The Order hunts and secures artefacts
too powerful for the world to handle.
zh:
巨灵教追猎并收容那些过于强大、
世间无法掌控的神器。

en:
...there is no telling what damage
could be wrought by such relics.
zh:
……无从知晓这等遗物
会造成何等灾祸。

en: We go where our duty demands.

I have no answers for you.
Some things... simply exist.
zh:
我无法给你答案。
有些东西……只是存在着。

en:
The Order has had Kalguuran
members... at times.
zh:
教团中，有过卡古兰人……
曾经。

en:
We have spent centuries deciphering
Precursor writings. We know... a little.
zh:
我们耗费数个世纪破译先驱者的文字。
所知……不过皮毛。

en:
Twenty years ago, the Order lost
much. We will recover it.
zh:
二十年前，教团失去了太多。
我们会夺回来。

en:
We do not have the benefit of rest.
Our task is never complete.
zh:
我们无法享受休息。
我们的任务永无止境。

en:
As a seeker of powerful artefacts,
I know how to spot master works.
zh:
作为强大神器的追寻者，
我懂得如何识别大师之作。

en:
We are keepers of a world lost
to the marches of time.
zh:
我们是失落于时间洪流，
世界的守护者。

en:
There is a great mystery all around us.
Be careful what you disturb.
zh:
我们周围有一个巨大的谜团。
当心你惊动的东西。

en:
Did you think I would let a simple thing
like dying interfere with our work?
zh:
你以为我会让死亡这等小事
来妨碍我们的工作？

en: Let's make this a little more... efficient.
zh: 让我们把这变得更……高效一些。

en:
The leylines can affect more than just
the terrain... curious...
zh:
地脉能影响的远不止地形……
有意思……

en:
The more we work with these leylines,
the more I feel I... understand them...
zh:
我们对这些地脉研究得越深，
我就越发觉得自己……理解了它们……

en:
Our long-term survival no longer matters.
We are already dead men walking.
zh:
我们的长期生存已无关紧要。
我们已经是行尸走肉。

en:
We will need quite a few resources if
we are to succeed. I will teach you.
zh:
若要成功，我们需要大量资源。
我来教你。

en:
I need more data on a new process.
Please, do what you do best.
zh:
我需要更多新流程的数据。
去吧，做你最擅长的事。

en:
Their creators are long since dust,
but their duty remains.
zh:
它们的创造者早已化为尘土，
但它们的职责犹存。

en:
It's all connected. The Grand Project...
I can almost see its intent...
zh:
一切皆有联系。那个宏大工程……
我几乎能窥见它的意图……

en:
There's some sort of energy flow
underneath reality. Could it be...?
zh:
现实之下存在着某种能量流。
难道……

en:
They are drawn to the power of the
Grand Project. They know not why.
zh: 它们被宏大工程的力量所吸引。它们不知为何。

en:
We need a smarter strategy.
We must aim for the top.
zh:
我们需要更明智的策略。
我们必须瞄准顶峰。

en: What's gotten into this lot, I wonder?
zh: 我怀疑，这帮家伙是怎么了？

en:
Some days you're the spear,
some days you're the boar!
zh:
有时你是那长矛，
有时你是那野猪！

en:
Something terrible
happened here long ago.
zh:
很久以前，
这里发生过可怕的事情。

en: They're not gonna make it easy.
zh: 他们不会让我们轻易得逞。

en:
Some days, the hunt is
thankless and brutal.
zh:
有些时候，狩猎是费力不讨好的，
是残酷的。

en:
Sometimes, they hold out for bigger prey.
I ken there's a reason.
zh:
有时候，它们会等待更大的猎物。
我知道，其中必有缘由。

en:
All you've got do is listen, aye,
and they'll guide you on.
zh:
你只需倾听，对，
他们便会指引你前行。

en:
Got no idea what they say,
but they seem to fit together.
zh:
完全搞不懂上面写的是什么，
但它们似乎能结合到一起。

en:
Something's changin' 'em.
Be ready to get bloody.
zh:
有什么东西正在改变它们。
准备好浴血奋战吧。

en:
I'll make some noise and holler. Let's
see if I can drive them your way!
zh:
我会制造声响，大声吆喝。
看我能不能把他们赶向你那边！

en:
Use every part of what you kill.
To do otherwise is disrespectful.
zh:
利用你所杀之物的每一部分。
否则便是大不敬。

en:
You really wanna challenge their claim?
Alright then... let's see how this goes.
zh:
你真想挑战他们的宣称？好吧……
那就拭目以待吧。

en: Let arrows fly from afar. Kill them before they arrive.
zh: 从远处倾泻箭矢，使敌人无暇近身便一命呜呼。

en: Shoot on the move. Jump over your enemies. Leap away from danger.
zh: 移动射击，跃过敌人，远离危险。

en: Slow your enemies. Freeze them in place. Don't let them reach you.
zh: 减速敌人，将其冻结，不留近身之机。

en: Close in for the kill, then cover your retreat with a hail of spears. Don't let your enemies catch you.
zh: 近战克敌制胜，立起枪阵掩护撤退，不给对手可乘之机。

en: Blind them, bleed them, maim them. Prevail at any cost.
zh: 致盲、流血和瘫痪，不惜代价争取胜利。

en: Harness the ferocity of the wilds. Tame beasts and whip up storms.
zh: 驾驭荒野的凶悍之力，驯服野兽并掀起风暴。

en: Hit hard. Slam your mace on the ground. Crack the earth.
zh: 倾尽全力，重锤砸向地面，引得地裂天崩。

en: Stun your enemies. Push them back. Knock them to the ground.
zh: 击晕敌人，将其逼退，甚至砸倒在地。

en: Shrug off small hits with heavy armour. Block big attacks with your shield. Use your large life pool to absorb the rest.
zh: 重甲令小刮小蹭不值一提，坚盾可直面重击而面不改色，庞大的生命池足以背负一切。

en: Create large explosions. Set your enemies on fire. Watch them burn.
zh: 引燃爆炸，点燃敌人，让他们陷入火海。

en: Slow your enemies down. Freeze them in place. Control their movement.
zh: 减速敌人，将其冻结，限制他们的移动。

en: Bounce lightning around your foes. Shock them for even higher damage.
zh: 让闪电在敌人之间来回弹射，通过感电造成高额伤害。

en: Send forth armies of the dead. Command them to do your bidding.
zh: 复活无尽大军，自由发号施令。

en: Let loose plague and withering afflictions. A slow but painful death.
zh: 散播瘟疫和凋零等异常，带来缓慢而痛苦的结局。

en: Spikes of bone grow at your command. A fast and deadly magic.
zh: 任你掌控的尖刺，迅速致命的魔法。

en: Overwhelm them with a ceaseless flurry of blows. Don't let up.
zh: 施展无休无止的凌厉攻势，令对手难以招架。

en: Weave through hordes. Dodge out of danger. Close in for the kill.
zh: 来去如风，闪转腾挪，近身克敌。

en: Build up power before unleashing devastating finishers.
zh: 厚积薄发，使出势大力沉的终极技。

en: Switch between varied crossbow ammunition. Adapt to enemy behaviour. Exploit their weaknesses.
zh: 切换花样百出的战弩弹药，根据敌人的状况灵活应变，利用他们暴露的弱点。

en: Use cold to freeze them. Use fire rounds to set them aflame. Unleash cascading lightning bolts.
zh: 以冰霜之力冻结敌人，用烈火弹药将其点燃，再倾泻闪电弩箭予以痛击。

en: Adapt to enemy behaviour. Pick them off from afar. Destroy any that get close.
zh: 根据敌人的状况灵活应变，从远处各个击破，令他们不敢近身。

en: Crush your enemies as a Bear. Tear them to pieces as a Werewolf. Incinerate them as a Wyvern.
zh: 变形为巨熊碾碎敌人；变形为狼人撕碎敌人；变形为双足飞龙将敌人焚灭殆尽。

en: The wrath of the earth is not easily stilled. The storming sky and fractured earth will not relent until your foes are dust.
zh: 大地之怒，不会轻易止息。风暴笼罩的天空与崩裂的大地，只有敌人化作尘埃，才会罢休。

en: The full might of the wilds is yours to command as you see fit. Wing and claw, fire and stone, root and vine — the choice is yours.
zh: 荒野的全部力量，都任你随心驱使。飞翼与利爪，火焰与岩石，根须与藤蔓——选择权在你手中。

en: The last light at the end of the world.
zh: 世界尽头的最后一点微光。

en: Bright colours hide the rot beneath.
zh: 明艳的色彩掩盖了底下的腐朽。

en: Wild lands spurn those who claim to rule them.
zh: 荒芜之地唾弃那些自诩为统治者的人。

en: Time overwhelms even the sturdiest walls.
zh: 时光终将淹没最坚固的城墙。
不安的囚徒渴望着自由。

en: The grandest of monuments, standing proudly before an audience of none.
zh: 最宏伟的纪念碑，傲然矗立在没有观众的舞台上。

en: A haven for seabirds. A hazard for sailors.
zh: 海鸟的庇护所，水手的险途。

en: No living hands ever stoked these flames.
zh: 从无活人的手曾为这些火焰添薪。

en: Beasts of many kinds sought shelter one final time.
zh: 百兽最后一次在此寻求庇护。

en: These waters devour the same souls they feed.
zh: 这片水域既滋养灵魂，也吞噬灵魂。

en: The woods give their leaves to the seasons. Man takes the rest.
zh: 树林随季节更迭献出叶片，其余则尽归人类之手。

en: Humanity trapped within a cage of desperation and agony.
zh: 人类被困于绝望与痛苦的牢笼之中。

en: Leaves cling to trees as souls cling to life.
Sturdy walls held out an armada, but not the famine it brought.
zh: 坚固的城墙抵御了舰队，却未能抵挡随之而来的饥荒。

en: The last vestiges of earth, lost beyond the sky.
zh: 大地最后的残迹，迷失于苍穹之外。

en: Silent stones mark ancient graves and forgotten sorrows.
zh: 沉默的石头标记着古老的坟墓与被遗忘的哀伤。

en: Those killed in battle do not rest peacefully.
The tears of a ravaged earth.
zh: 饱受摧残的大地流下的泪水。

en: The fetid home of foul generations.
Rushing waters threaten to move the earth.
zh: 湍急的流水誓要撼动大地。

en: Even the sparse vegetation does not linger here long.
zh: 连稀疏的植被也不会在此久留。

en: Stagnant oils mix to form a deadly concoction.
zh: 停滞的油料混合成致命的毒剂。

en: Vast lairs of silk span the treetops.
Hubris convinces men they can survive the mistakes of their forebears.
zh: 狂妄使人相信，自己能逃脱先辈错误的覆辙。

en: The ground shifts underfoot with disturbing ease.
zh: 脚下的大地轻易便会松动。

en: Shafts of light raise life where they fall.
A wound carved into the world, never to heal.
zh: 刻在世上的伤口，永远无法愈合。

en: The path grows treacherous as the world falls away.
zh: 随着世界分崩离析，前路也变得险恶。

en: They watched the birds to foretell what any fool could see.
zh: 他们观测鸟类的预兆，而愚者一目了然之事，他们却视而不见。

en: The final court for aristocrats no longer deemed fit to rule.
zh: 贵族们最后的法庭，他们已不再被认为适合统治。

en: Dark energies congeal the lifeblood of the forest.
zh: 黑暗的能量凝结成森林的命脉。

en: Fishermen once reaped a rich bounty here.
Spores dance through the air in search of new hosts.
zh: 孢子在空中舞动，寻觅新的宿主。

en: A city ravaged by time and sands.
zh: 被时光与黄沙摧残的城市。

en: Avarice in the conqueror builds contempt among the conquered.
zh: 征服者的贪婪，在被征服者心中种下仇恨。

en: The work of an invisible empire.
Embers swirl as bark crackles and sparks.
zh: 余烬飞舞，树皮爆裂，火星四溅。

en: A dark labyrinth of steel and stone.
zh: 钢铁与岩石构筑的黑暗迷宫。

en: Hidden amongst sunbleached wastes lies a mockery of paradise.
zh: 隐匿于日光炙烤的废土之中，是对天堂的嘲弄。

en: Stone shelters brace against the doom of the desert.
zh: 石质掩体抵御着沙漠的毁灭之力。

en: Life abounds on the shells of its dead ancestors.
zh: 生命在其死去先祖的壳上蓬勃生长。

en: This Vaal structure is not lost in the jungle. Not yet.
zh: 这座瓦尔建筑尚未被丛林吞没，尚未。

en: A heart of corruption, borne of steel.
zh: 腐化的心脏，由钢铁所生。

en: A heart of corruption, borne of stone.
zh: 腐化的心脏，由岩石所生。

en: A heart of corruption, borne of copper.
zh: 腐化的心脏，由古铜所生。

en: Hulls crash and splinter upon the shores.
zh: 船体撞击海岸，碎裂四散。

en: Life grows strong in this realm of plenty.
zh: 生命在这片丰饶之地茁壮成长。

en: By that era, Kamasa was just a name. Gold was their true god.
zh: 那个时代，卡马萨不过是一个名字。黄金才是他们真正的神。

en: A travelling merchant offers wares in perilous times.
zh: 游商于危难之际，贩卖货物。

en: A travelling merchant offers wares in perilous times.
zh: 游商于危难之际，贩卖货物。

en: A travelling merchant offers wares in perilous times.
zh: 游商于危难之际，贩卖货物。

en: A travelling merchant offers wares in perilous times.
zh: 游商于危难之际，贩卖货物。

en: A travelling merchant offers wares in perilous times.
zh: 游商于危难之际，贩卖货物。

en: The hunt never ends... but it does pause for rests.
zh: 狩猎永无止境……但确实也会歇歇脚。

en: A travelling merchant offers wares in perilous times.
zh: 游商于危难之际，贩卖货物。

en: A travelling merchant offers wares in perilous times.
zh: 游商于危难之际，贩卖货物。

en: A travelling merchant offers wares in perilous times.
zh: 游商于危难之际，贩卖货物。

en: Vice wears a mask of simplicity.
Aeons of wear have rotted steel to its core.
zh: 万古侵蚀，钢铁已然朽烂。

en: Humid air chokes and twists everything it touches.
zh: 潮湿的空气令人窒息，扭曲其所触及的一切。

en: The land returns the dead as easily as it received them.
zh: 大地接纳亡者，一如来时那般轻易。

en: Mud and air seethes with warped life.
zh: 泥泞与空气中翻涌着扭曲的生命。

en: A forgotten grotto, lost to the world.
zh: 一处被世界遗忘的幽僻洞穴。

en: A fragment of a glorious past.
A moment in time, on the eve of the end.
Wet stone emanates an inner warmth. Vaal brilliance lies in wait.
zh: 潮湿的岩石，内在的温热，都是瓦尔的智慧。

en: The waters have returned, but no empire remains to greet them.
zh: 潮水已归，却再无帝国相迎。

en: The cult of Kamasa exploited Utzaal long before its fall.
zh: 早在乌扎尔陷落之前，卡马萨邪教便已在此盘踞。

en: Remnants of Vaal artifice still remain.
zh: 瓦尔的神奇技艺依然留存着只鳞片爪。

en: Bleak heights overlook a devastated land.
zh: 荒凉的高地俯瞰着满目疮痍的大地。

en: Life still clings to the highest places.
zh: 生命仍在至高处顽强存续。

en: As separate worlds draw ever closer, the Nameless gather at the edge of existence.
zh: 随着诸界日益临近，无名者聚于存在的边缘。

en: The prismatic patterns of Time shimmer and coalesce in vast geodes hidden from sight.
zh: 时间的虹彩在隐秘的巨型晶洞中闪烁凝聚。

en:
<i>{"Sons from foreign shores}
<i>{Took refuge from the storm}
<i>{Bringing knowledge of runes}
<i>{Our fate was carved soon."} 
- Ezomyte Folklore
zh:
<i>{“异邦之子远渡重洋}
<i>{避风暴之灾殃}
<i>{携符文之智识}
<i>{铸吾等之命章。"} 
——艾兹麦民谣

en: A mirror is a perfect prison for one's sense of self... until it cracks.
zh: 镜子是自我意识的完美牢笼……直到它碎裂。

en: Beware a chill colder than death itself.
zh: 当心比死亡本身更冰冷的寒意。

en: The Cataclysm tore the land asunder.
A rare enclave of fertile earth.
A refuge from the villains it once contained.
zh: 曾囚恶徒之所，今成其避难之地。

en: Valako kept them here, to perfect their skills for war... but the Blood Fever consumed them.
zh: 瓦拉克将他们留于此地，精进战技……但血热病吞噬了他们。

en: Within the storm, warriors can be seen, heard and feared.
zh: 风暴之中，可见战士的身影，可闻其战吼，可感其威压。

en: Find and activate a Karui Beacon in a nearby Map to remove the Maelstrom and gain access to this Map.
zh: 在附近的地图中找到并激活一个卡鲁信标，以驱散大漩涡，进入此地图。

en: The Temporal's tongue captures the ear of those vying for power.
zh: 时空之舌攫住了那些争权夺利者的耳朵。

en: The Temporal's tongue captures the ear of those vying for power.
zh: 时空之舌攫住了那些争权夺利者的耳朵。

en: Find and activate Temporal Tethers in nearby Maps to dispel the Sandstorm and gain access to this Map.
zh: 在附近的地图中找到并激活时光套索，以驱散沙暴，进入此地图。

en: Darkness always finds its way into the minds of the weak.
zh: 黑暗总能侵入弱者的心智。

en: Dead litter the surrounding woods, their blood drained and taken.
zh: 周围的树林中横陈着死者，血液已被抽干取尽。

en:
Lure nearby Draiocht Wisps to this Mansion to purge the evil surrounding it.
Draiocht Wisps can be lured closer by completing Maps that they gather about.
zh:
将附近的德莱契鬼灵引至这座豪邸，以净化周围的邪祟。
德莱契鬼灵会聚集在地图周围，完成这些地图即可将其引近。

en: The Vaal who survived the Cataclysm must now survive each other.
zh: 在灾变中幸存的瓦尔人，如今必须在彼此之间求存。

en: Closed and forgotten to time, the Vault holds living secrets.
zh: 尘封已久、被时光遗忘的宝库，其中蕴藏着鲜活的秘密。

en: Find and activate a Vessel of Estazunti in one of the connected Maps to access the Sealed Vault.
zh: 在附近的地图中找到并激活埃斯塔祖提的容器，即可进入封印宝库。

en: Where nomads share tales of a time before drought.
zh: 游牧民在此讲述干旱之前的故事。

en: A garden bereft of its gardener still grows as it pleases.
zh: 失去园丁的花园，依旧肆意生长。

en: Merchants and pirates alike need a safe port to peddle their wares.
zh: 商贾与海盗皆需一处安全的港口兜售货物。

en: In the end, the river will always conquer the dam.
In these lands, a pure water source is the most valuable treasure.
zh: 在这片土地上，纯净的水源便是最珍贵的宝藏。

en: The bones of marooned wanderers assemble here.
zh: 被困于此的流浪者，骸骨在此汇聚。

en: We know the minds of generations past only by the works they left behind.
zh: 我们对先辈思想的了解，仅来自他们留下的作品。

en: The grandest sculptures are carved with neither hammer nor chisel.
zh: 最宏伟的雕塑，并非以锤凿雕就。

en: Spirits gather where the world falls away.
zh: 灵魂在世界分崩离析之处聚集。

en: An undrinkable lagoon girt in unbreathable air.
zh: 一片无法饮用的环礁湖，环绕着令人窒息的空气。

en: Violent seas and hungry shores devour vessels, crew and all.
zh: 狂暴的海洋与饥渴的海岸，吞噬着船只与船员。

en: Our world is becoming... their world.
zh: 我们的世界正在变成……他们的世界。

en: A rare chance to strike back at the horde...
zh: 反击虫群的良机难得一遇……

en: Silent and imposing, it dominates the landscape.
zh: 它沉默而威严，主宰着这片大地。

en: Long lost secrets lie buried beyond.
zh: 久远的秘密埋藏在彼岸。

en: What kind of people could have built such a thing?
zh: 什么样的人才能造出这样的东西？

en: Perhaps the truth of history may be found within.
zh: 或许，历史的真相就藏于其中。

en: One cannot create life without the power to take it.
zh: 若无夺取生命之力，便无法创造生命。

en: One cannot take life without the power to create it.
zh: 若无创造生命之力，便无法夺取生命。
其中蕴藏着超乎认知的力量。

en: Where reality begins and ends is uncertain.
zh: 现实始于何处、终于何处，无人知晓。

en: Your eyes betray you at every turn.
zh: 你的双眼处处都在背叛你。

en: There is no bleaker tundra than a city at night.
zh: 没有比夜晚的城市更阴冷的荒原了。

en: Fell blooms and grasping roots grow in shadow.
zh: 邪恶的花朵与攫取的根须在阴影中滋生。

en: Haunting echoes carry a song of sorrow...
zh: 萦绕的回声传唱着哀伤的歌谣……

en: They scrabble and dig; they know not why...
zh: 他们胡乱扒挖，却不知为何……

en: The sea returns everything eventually. Even the dead.
zh: 大海终将归还一切，甚至死者。

en: Cruel time and change, now plains only in name.
zh: 无情的时光与变迁，如今平原徒有其名。

en: Live by the power of Corruption... die by madness.
zh: 借腐化之力而生……终将因疯狂而死。

en: The air is acrid. The skin burns. No doubt... sulphite.
zh: 空气刺鼻，皮肤灼烧。毫无疑问……是亚硫酸。

en: It's always raining, but the channels never fill...
zh: 雨一直下，但沟渠永远填不满……

en: Calm, bleak twilight holds only despair.
zh: 平静、阴郁的暮色只带来绝望。

en: A mad Thane rules over ruin.
zh: 一个疯癫的领主统治着废墟。

en: Follow in her footsteps... if you dare.
zh: 跟随她的足迹……如果你敢。

en: It continues still, its purpose unknown.
When does protection become a prison?
Something rumbles in the lava-lit gloom.
zh: 有什么在熔岩照亮的幽暗中隆隆作响。
砍伐仍在继续，直至疯狂。

en: This cavern burns hot and deadly.
This lonely island lay untouched for centuries.
zh: 这座孤岛数个世纪以来无人踏足。
天空降下了怎样的灾厄……

en: And it shall be a legendary battle!
zh: 这将是一场传奇般的战斗！

en: Through the Dreamer they see their path.
zh: 透过幻梦者，他们看到了自己的道路。

en: Heroes of many different cultures gather to save the world.
zh: 来自不同文化的英雄们齐聚一堂，拯救世界。

en: Once the heart of Druidic power and culture...
zh: 曾是德鲁伊力量与文化的中心……

en: A gnarled tree reflects a terrifying truth.
zh: 一棵虬结的树，倒映出可怖的真相。

en: From anywhere, and everywhere, it is... down.
zh: 无论从何处来，往何处去，它终究是……向下。

en: The secrets of the Vaal await an intrepid explorer.
zh: 瓦尔的秘密等待着无畏的探索者。

en: Drown in the black waters of nightmare...
zh: 沉溺于梦魇的黑水之中……

en: What once was, shall be again.
zh: 过去曾有的，必将再次降临。
她孤身一人的圣战仍在继续。

en: What lies beyond the limits of mortal understanding?
zh: 凡人的理解之外究竟有何物？

en: The truth lies somewhere between light and shadow.
zh: 真相潜藏于光与影之间。

en: There is no how, or why, or when. Only awe.
zh: 没有如何，没有为何，没有何时。唯有敬畏。

en: There is no how, or why, or when. Only awe.
zh: 没有如何，没有为何，没有何时。唯有敬畏。

en: There is no how, or why, or when. Only awe.
zh: 没有如何，没有为何，没有何时。唯有敬畏。

en: There is no how, or why, or when. Only awe.
zh: 没有如何，没有为何，没有何时。唯有敬畏。

en: There is no how, or why, or when. Only awe.
zh: 没有如何，没有为何，没有何时。唯有敬畏。

en: On the crumbling edge of meaning, He awaits.
zh: 在意义崩解的边缘，他等待着。

en: The crumbling landscape reveals what lies beneath...
zh: 崩裂的大地露出了底下的东西……

en: You will find what they did not.
zh: 你会找到他们未能发现之物。

en: The past lies piled under dirt and rot.
zh: 过去掩埋于尘土与腐烂之下。

en: On the edge of the sea, the dead are closest to home.
zh: 在海的边缘，亡者离故乡最近。

en: The land has forgotten what came before.
zh: 这片土地已遗忘了往昔。

en: They came by ship... and they never left.
zh: 他们乘船而来……却再未离去。

en: Life roils over layers of bones.
zh: 生命在层层骸骨之上翻涌。

en: This place was not always so bleak.
zh: 此地并非一直如此荒凉。

en: The past lies untouched where the living dare not tread.
zh: 生者不敢踏足之处，过去安然沉睡。

en: They dig not to discover, but to escape.
zh: 他们挖掘不是为了发现，而是为了逃离。

en: The chill is second only to the stench.
Strife and terror rule the night.
zh: 纷争与恐惧统治着黑夜。

en: Only the shadow of death lives here now.
zh: 如今只有死亡的阴影居住于此。

en: There is beauty to be found in the depths.
These halls weren't meant for you...
zh: 这些殿堂并非为你而设……

en: One cannot create life without the power to take it.
zh: 若无夺取生命之力，便无法创造生命。

en: One cannot take life without the power to create it.
zh: 若无创造生命之力，便无法夺取生命。

en: Selfless ancients gave themselves to save tomorrow.
zh: 无私的先祖献出自身，只为拯救未来。

en: These gates have facilitated many trades. Silks, spices, and now horrors.
zh: 这些大门曾促成无数交易。丝绸，香料，如今则是恐惧。

en:
The Architect of the Hoard gathered every piece of Vaal
history he could, hoping to preserve them against the end.
She allowed him this, for it served her ends as well.
zh:
窖藏建筑师搜罗尽瓦尔的每一段历史，
渴望在终焉降临前将其保存。
她默许了他此举，因这亦遂她心愿。

en: Use to prevent the next [IncursionDestabilization|Destabilisation] of a Room
zh: 使用以可防止一个房间下次发生[IncursionDestabilization|瓦解]

en:
The Architect of Destruction ensured his own demise in an
'accidental' explosion. She ordered his pieces gathered, his
body reassembled and transcended. Death was no escape.
zh:
毁灭建筑师在一场“意外”爆炸中
亲手葬送了自己。她却下令拾其碎躯，重
组并超脱其肉身——死亡亦无处可逃。

en: Use to reroll a [IncursionRestrictedRoom|Restricted Room] in the Temple
zh: 使用以重掷神庙中的[IncursionRestrictedRoom|秘藏房间]

en: The Architect of the Nexus proposed the Temple of Atzoatl as a prototype. He thought the project would keep him safe. Instead all he achieved was building her another seat of power.
zh: 枢纽建筑师将阿佐亚特神庙奉为原型提出。他以为这工程能保全自己。到头来，不过是又为她筑起一座权座罢了。

en: Use to increase the Tier of a Room (does not stack)
zh: 使用以提升一个房间的等阶（无法叠加）

en:
The Architect of Expansion was always distant, working on
projects at the edge of the Empire. His excuses vanished soon
after his daughter was... given... a position at the Royal Temple.
zh:
扩充建筑师总在远方，于帝国边陲经营着他的工程。
直到他的女儿被……授予……皇家神庙的职位后，
他的种种托辞，便很快消散无踪了。

en:
The Architect of Power chose to bury himself in his work,
seeking freedom of the mind. She followed him even there,
learning the theories, ensuring he did not stray in his intent.
zh:
能量建筑师选择埋首于工作，寻求心灵的自由。
她却连此地也紧随而至，研习理论，
确保他永不偏离她既定的旨意。

en: Use to increase Maximum [IncursionCrystal|Crystal] Capacity by 6 (up to 60)
zh: 使用以使[IncursionCrystal|水晶]最大容量增加 6（上限为 60 ）

en:
The Architect of the Guild was more than happy to create a
continual stream of trinkets and baubles to distract the
Queen, but, in truth, she barely looked at any of them.
zh:
公会建筑师极乐意造出源源不断的小玩意儿，
以供女王分心消遣——
可实际上，她几乎不曾瞥上其中任何一件。

en: Use to increase Maximum Medallion Capacity by 1 (up to 6)
zh: 使用以使纹章最大容量增加 1（上限为 6 ）

en:
The Architect of the Vault pleaded with nobles and suitors,
begging them to stop sending treasure to the Queen. He
could never go home until his task was complete...
zh:
宝库建筑师曾向贵族与追求者们苦苦哀求，
恳请他们停止向女王进献珍宝。
使命未完，他便永无归期……

en: Use to place an additional [IncursionRestrictedRoom|Restricted Room Card] after defeating the Architect
zh: 使用以在击败建筑师后额外放置一张[IncursionRestrictedRoom|秘藏房间卡牌]

en:
The Architect of the Forge kept his hearth busy,
for the Queen's eye lingered on the idle. Her halls stood
adorned with his desperate artisanship.
zh:
熔炉建筑师，炉火不息，
因女王目光所及，不容懈怠。殿堂巍峨，
尽饰其呕心沥血之艺。

en:
Use to reroll the Room Cards available for placement
[IncursionRestrictedRoom|Restricted Room Cards] may not be rerolled this way
zh:
使用以重掷可供放置的房间卡牌
[IncursionRestrictedRoom|秘藏房间卡牌]无法通过此方式重掷

en:
The Architect of Concealment wove secrets into stone,
with passages and powers none were meant to see.
His renown rose in the shadows of his designs.
zh:
匿影建筑师，将秘密织入石中，
通道与威能，无人得见其踪。
他的声名，在设计之影中崛起。

en:
Use <bold>{<white>{Whirling Slash}} <<skillicon:sandstorm_swipe>> to <bold>{<white>{Blind}} enemies. It's an important defense!

Jumping out of <bold>{<white>{Whirling Slash}} <<skillicon:sandstorm_swipe>> causes an explosion. <bold>{<white>{More Uses}} before jumping means <bold>{<white>{More Damage!}}

Use <bold>{<white>{Puncture}} <<skillicon:advancing_strike>> to jump to an enemy and <bold>{<white>{Bleed}} it.

Use <bold>{<white>{Spearfield}} <<skillicon:spear_wall>> to <bold>{<white>{Maim}} large groups of enemies, slowing them down.

<bold>{<white>{Storm Spear}} <<skillicon:lightning_burst>> uses a lot of mana. Be careful!

Don't forget to turn on <bold>{<white>{Herald of Thunder}} <<skillicon:herald_of_thunder>>. It will increase your damage a lot!

If you are dying a lot, use <bold>{<white>{Dodge Roll}}! It's on space bar!
zh:
使用<bold>{<white>{回旋挥斩}} <<skillicon:sandstorm_swipe>>来<bold>{<white>{致盲}}敌人，这是重要的防御手段！

跃出<bold>{<white>{回旋挥斩}} <<skillicon:sandstorm_swipe>>的范围会引发一场爆炸。<bold>{<white>{多次使用}}后再跃出可以造成<bold>{<white>{更多伤害！}}

使用<bold>{<white>{洞穿}} <<skillicon:advancing_strike>>可以扑向一名敌人，并使其<bold>{<white>{流血}}。

<bold>{<white>{枪林矛阵}} <<skillicon:spear_wall>>能够<bold>{<white>{瘫痪}}大群敌人，使他们减速。

<bold>{<white>{雷暴战矛}} <<skillicon:lightning_burst>>会消耗大量魔力。一定要慎重！

别忘记开启<bold>{<white>{闪电之捷}} <<skillicon:herald_of_thunder>>。它会大幅提高你的伤害！

如果你发现自己经常会被击败，就使用<bold>{<white>{闪避翻滚}}吧！按空格键就行了！

en:
Hit enemies with <bold>{<white>{Armour Break}} <<skillicon:heavy_strike>> to remove their Armour. It takes more than one hit for bosses!

Use <bold>{<white>{Leap Slam}} <<skillicon:leap_slam>> on an an enemy with <bold>{<white>{Armour Break}} to do a <bold>{<white>{Heavy Stun}}

<bold>{<white>{Supercharged Slam}} <<skillicon:channelled_slam>> is a <bold>{<white>{Channeled}} skill that you can use against a stunned enemy. Hold the mouse down for more damage!

Using <bold>{<white>{Infernal Cry}} <<skillicon:infernal_cry>> will charge up your next skill. Use it before <bold>{<white>{Supercharged Slam}} <<skillicon:channelled_slam>> for massive damage.

Use <bold>{<white>{Sunder}} <<skillicon:new_sunder>> on an enemy with <bold>{<white>{Armour Break}} to do massive damage.

Don't forget to turn on <bold>{<white>{Herald of Ash}} <<skillicon:herald_of_ash>>. It will increase your damage!

If you are dying a lot, use <bold>{<white>{Dodge Roll!}} It's on space bar!
zh:
<bold>{<white>{摧甲重击}} <<skillicon:heavy_strike>>击中敌人时会消除他们的护甲，面对首领时可能需要击中多次才会生效！

对<bold>{<white>{护甲破损}}的敌人施放<bold>{<white>{跃击}} <<skillicon:leap_slam>>可以造成<bold>{<white>{重度晕眩}}

<bold>{<white>{蓄威神锤}} <<skillicon:channelled_slam>>是一种<bold>{<white>{吟唱}}技能，可以对晕眩的敌人使用。按住鼠标键就能造成更高的伤害！

<bold>{<white>{炽焰战吼}} <<skillicon:infernal_cry>>会充能你的下一个技能。先喊出战吼，再使用<bold>{<white>{蓄威神锤}} <<skillicon:channelled_slam>>便可造成巨额伤害。

对<bold>{<white>{护甲破损}}的敌人施放<bold>{<white>{大地震击}} <<skillicon:new_sunder>>可以造成巨额伤害。

别忘记开启<bold>{<white>{灰烬之捷}} <<skillicon:herald_of_ash>>。它会提高你的伤害！

如果你发现自己经常会被击败，就使用<bold>{<white>{闪避翻滚}}吧！按空格键就行了！

en:
Lower the monsters' life until there is a <bold>{<white>{Blue Marker}} and then use <bold>{<white>{Killing Palm}} <<skillicon:killing_palm>>

Follow up with <bold>{<white>{Falling Thunder}} <<skillicon:new_new_lightning_strike>> for a large AoE. 

Use <bold>{<white>{Ice Strike}} <<skillicon:quarterstaff_combo_attack>> to <bold>{<white>{Freeze}} tough enemies. 

Use <bold>{<white>{Wave of Frost}} <<skillicon:quarterstaff_frost_burst>> to <bold>{<white>{Freeze}} groups of weaker enemies. 

The last spike of <bold>{<white>{Glacial Cascade}} <<skillicon:glacial_cascade>> will shatter <bold>{<white>{Frozen}} enemies for massive damage 

If you are dying a lot, use <bold>{<white>{Dodge Roll!}} It's on space bar!
zh:
不断削弱怪物的生命，出现<bold>{<white>{蓝色标记}}后即可使用<bold>{<white>{终结掌}} <<skillicon:killing_palm>>。

以<bold>{<white>{霹雳闪}} <<skillicon:new_new_lightning_strike>>追击可以造成大范围伤害。

<bold>{<white>{幽寒打}} <<skillicon:quarterstaff_combo_attack>>可以<bold>{<white>{冻结}}强悍的敌人。

<bold>{<white>{寒霜浪涌}} <<skillicon:quarterstaff_frost_burst>>可以<bold>{<white>{冻结}}大量脆弱的敌人。

<bold>{<white>{冰川之刺}} <<skillicon:glacial_cascade>>最后的冰冷会击碎<bold>{<white>{冻结}}的敌人，造成巨额伤害。

如果你发现自己经常会被击败，就使用<bold>{<white>{闪避翻滚}}吧！按空格键就行了！

en:
<bold>{<white>{Arc}} <<skillicon:arc>> and <bold>{<white>{Spark}} <<skillicon:spark>> are your basic attacks. Feel free to spam them.

Use <bold>{<white>{Ice Nova}} <<skillicon:ice_nova>> to <bold>{<white>{Freeze}} enemies. It's an important defense!

Use <bold>{<white>{Frost Bomb}} <<skillicon:frost_bomb>> to reduce enemy cold resistance.

Use <bold>{<white>{Unleash}} <<skillicon:staff_unleash>> to triple-cast your next spell. It works great with <bold>{<white>{Comet}} <<skillicon:comet>> for a large damage boost.

Use <bold>{<white>{Mana Tempest}} <<skillicon:mana_tempest>> to further increase your damage, especially of lightning skills.

Don't forget to turn on <bold>{<white>{Arctic Armour}} <<skillicon:new_new_arctic_armour>> It will stop you from dying and will chill enemies!

If you are dying a lot, use <bold>{<white>{Dodge Roll!}} It's on space bar!
zh:
<bold>{<white>{电弧}} <<skillicon:arc>>和<bold>{<white>{电球}} <<skillicon:spark>>是你的基础攻击手段，尽情地施放它们吧。

<bold>{<white>{冰霜新星}} <<skillicon:ice_nova>>可以<bold>{<white>{冻结}}敌人。这是重要的防御手段！

<bold>{<white>{寒霜爆}} <<skillicon:frost_bomb>>可以降低敌人的冰霜抗性。

<bold>{<white>{释出}} <<skillicon:staff_unleash>>能够使你的下一个法术连续施放三次，很适合搭配<bold>{<white>{彗星落}} <<skillicon:comet>>，造成强大的爆发伤害。

<bold>{<white>{魔力风暴}} <<skillicon:mana_tempest>>能够进一步提高你造成的伤害，尤其是闪电技能。

别忘记开启<bold>{<white>{极地装甲}} <<skillicon:new_new_arctic_armour>>，它能冰缓敌人，保住你的性命！

如果你发现自己经常会被击败，就使用<bold>{<white>{闪避翻滚}}吧！按空格键就行了！

en:
<bold>{<white>{Lightning Storm}} <<skillicon:lightning_storm>> is a long-lasting spell that <bold>{<white>{Shocks}} enemies. 

<bold>{<white>{Volcano}} <<skillicon:volcano>> fires projectiles around itself and lasts a long time. Hold the button down longer to fire more initial projectiles. 

While your spells are active, transform into a bear! 

Use <bold>{<white>{Bear Maul}} <<skillicon:bear_maul>> to generate <bold>{<white>{Rage}}. 

Use <bold>{<white>{Rampage}} <<skillicon:bear_rampage>> to slam the ground repeatedly while consuming your <bold>{<white>{Rage}}. 

Use <bold>{<white>{Furious Slam}} <<skillicon:bear_slam>> to <bold>{<white>{Stun}} nearby enemies. 

Use <bold>{<white>{Ferocious Roar}} <<skillicon:bear_warcry_meta>> near <bold>{<white>{Stunned}} enemies to empower your <bold>{<white>{Slams}} with a second aftershock. 

Any <bold>{<white>{Slam}} near a <bold>{<white>{Volcano}} <<skillicon:volcano>> will will trigger more projectiles, including aftershocks! 

Use <bold>{<white>{Summoned Wolves}} <<skillicon:summon_wolf_companion>> to distract enemies! They also debuff enemies when they appear. 

If you are dying a lot, use <bold>{<white>{Dodge Roll}}! It's on space bar!
zh:
<bold>{<white>{闪电风暴}} <<skillicon:lightning_storm>>法术的持续时间较长，可以令敌人<bold>{<white>{感电}}。

<bold>{<white>{火山}} <<skillicon:volcano>>会在周围喷发投射物，并且持续时间很长。按住技能键便可提高初始投射物的数量。

法术激活的时候，亲自变形成巨熊吧！

<bold>{<white>{巨熊重殴}} <<skillicon:bear_maul>>可以产生<bold>{<white>{怒火}}。

<bold>{<white>{横冲直撞}} <<skillicon:bear_rampage>>会反复猛击地面，并不断消耗<bold>{<white>{怒火}}。

<bold>{<white>{狂怒猛击}} <<skillicon:bear_slam>>可以<bold>{<white>{晕眩}}周围的敌人。

在<bold>{<white>{晕眩的}}敌人周围施放<bold>{<white>{凶蛮咆哮}} <<skillicon:bear_warcry_meta>>来强化你的<bold>{<white>{猛击}}，使其产生第二次余震。

在激活的<bold>{<white>{火山}} <<skillicon:volcano>>周围使用任意<bold>{<white>{猛击}}都会触发更多投射物，余震也行！

 <bold>{<white>{召唤恶狼}} <<skillicon:summon_wolf_companion>>来干扰敌人！它们出现时也会为敌人施加减益状态。

如果你发现自己经常会被击败，就使用<bold>{<white>{闪避翻滚}}吧！按空格键就行了！
